symbols.purpose: Builds a reusable sequential release executor with one fixed ordering mode and error policy. Every run admits all descriptors before invoking callbacks, releases valid items despite other failures, then drains optional pending work.
symbols.core:
mode: Caller-authored `IDisposeTransactionMode`: `order` stably sorts descending priorities; `plan` preserves the supplied sequence and never reads priorities.
An `IDisposeTransaction`; missing required reporters and invalid schedulers fail construction with `INVALID_OPTION`.
errorPolicy: Selects the release error outcome from `LifecycleErrorPolicy`. Every admitted item still receives its release attempt; `report` and `firstError` require a reporter when creating a scope or transaction.
`throw`: rethrow one original failure or aggregate several after release.
report: Receives each diagnostic or policy-routed `error` from lifecycle. Return nothing synchronously; accidental thenable rejections and synchronous throws are contained. A scope or transaction requires this callback for `report` and `firstError` policies.
report.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.
No value is consumed; callback failures do not replace the operation result.
Omitted: diagnostics have no sink; factories reject this omission for `report` and `firstError`.
deadlineAt: Absolute finite time in the selected scheduler clock. Every item sees the same `deadlineAt`; it caps graceful waiting only, so forced release can continue beyond it.
Omitted: no shared deadline; an individual descriptor may still set its own graceful budget.
scheduler: Clock and timer implementation from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`. Supply the same scheduler that produced every absolute deadline; lifecycle snapshots methods with their original receiver and rejects invalid shapes with `INVALID_OPTION`.
Omitted: use the admitted `systemScheduler` when a timed phase first needs it.
signal: Caller-owned `IAbortSignal` mirrored into a private per-run native signal; running the transaction never aborts the input controller.
Omitted: every item receives an inert non-aborting signal.
disposer: Owner-bound `IDisposerContext` supplied by an owning scope; generic callers normally omit this capability.
Omitted: no scope self-join capability is placed in the context.
pending: Caller-owned object with async no-argument `drain()` invoked after all release items; fulfillment means pending work drained, and rejection becomes a transaction-pending failure.
Omitted: no final pending-work drain is run.
pending.drain: Caller-provided no-argument callback invoked after all release items; return a Promise<void> that settles when pending work drains. Synchronous throws or rejection become transaction-pending failures.

options: IDisposeTransactionOptions (optional)

blocks.text: 编排多个资源的释放，`order` 弱排序或 `plan` 强序列二选一，同一实例不能混用：
边界行为：

items: `{ kind: 'order' }`：按每个 item 的 `descriptor.order`（缺省 `0`）降序分组释放，稳定排序保留同序调用方给定的相对顺序；只在此模式读取 `order`。
`{ kind: 'plan' }`：严格按 `items` 给定顺序执行，从不读取 `order` 字段。
`signal?`：转发进每个 item 的 `context.signal`；`run()` 开始时自动镜像调用方传入信号的中止状态；无 `signal` 时 item 收到一个永不中止的惰性信号。
`deadlineAt`/`scheduler`：本次 `run()` 内所有 item 共享，不逐 item 重算。
`pending?`：全部 item 释放完后仅一次调用 `pending.drain()` 等待其触发的在途工作排空（典型传 `createPendingTracker()`）。
descriptor 校验（`order`/`custom`/`graceful`/`gracefulTimeoutMs`/`force` 的类型与访问）逐项独立进行——一个 item 的非法 descriptor（贴 `INVALID_OPTION` 码）不阻断其余 item 的释放，会作为该 item 的失败计入错误策略。
`errorPolicy` 语义同 `createErrorCollector`；`throw` 策略下单错保留原生实例并给未分类错误附 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`，primitive 通过 cause 包装；已有合法外部身份不变。多错聚合为携带 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 码的 `AggregateError`。

blocks.text: 按四种错误策略收集/上报错误，`createDisposeTransaction`/`createSyncLifecycleScope` 内部都用它：

`policy`、`report`（必填，`throw`/`collect` 可显式传 `undefined`；`report`/`firstError` 必须提供函数，否则创建时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`）。`add(source, error)` 按策略即时处理（`'report'` 策略立即调用 `report`；`'firstError'` 只记住第一个错误，其余经 `report` 观测）。`finalize(message)`：`'collect'` 返回收集到的数组；`'report'` 返回空数组（已在 `add` 时上报）；`'throw'` 单错保留原生实例并给未分类错误附 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`，primitive 通过 cause 包装；已有合法外部身份不变。多错聚合成携带 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 码的 `AggregateError`；`'firstError'` 有错误时抛首个，否则返回空数组。

blocks.code:
import {
  LIFECYCLE_SOURCE,
  containAsyncRejection,
  createErrorCollector,
  LifecycleErrorCode,
  LifecycleErrorText
} from '@migaia/lifecycle'
import { probeThenable, assimilateCapturedThen } from '@migaia/utils/function'

blocks.text: `LIFECYCLE_SOURCE`｜3 秒上手 —— 本包所有错误的 `source` 字段固定值：

blocks.code: LIFECYCLE_SOURCE // '@migaia/lifecycle'

blocks.text: 字符串常量，无调用。
错误构造与身份附加由包内部维护；业务包应使用自身 source/code owner 构造错误。
`containAsyncRejection`｜5 秒上手 —— 保护性地探测某个返回值是否是 thenable，是则观察其 rejection 而不让其变成未处理拒绝：

blocks.code: containAsyncRejection(maybeAsyncCallbackResult, (error) => report(error))

blocks.text: 参数：`value: unknown`（必填）、`onRejected: (error: unknown) => void`（必填）。非 thenable 时直接返回，不调用 `onRejected`。
以下 thenable 工具从 `@migaia/utils/function` 导入，属于 utils API。
`probeThenable`｜5 秒上手 —— 只读一次 `value.then`，返回判别结果（不是布尔值，是否 thenable/是否 getter 抛错都会区分）：
单参数 `value: unknown`，无选项。三种结果：`{ kind: 'not-thenable' }`、`{ kind: 'thenable', thenFn }`、`{ kind: 'failed', error }`（读 `.then` 本身抛错）。
`assimilateCapturedThen`｜5 秒上手 —— 把 `probeThenable` 捕获到的 `thenFn` 安全地 apply 成一个真正的 `Promise`，且只调用一次：

blocks.code: const promise = assimilateCapturedThen<T>(probe.thenFn, thenableValue)

blocks.text: 参数：`thenFn`（必填，来自 `probeThenable` 的 `thenFn`）、`thenable: unknown`（必填，作为 `this` receiver 传给 `thenFn`）。无可选项。
`createErrorCollector`｜10 秒上手 —— 按四种错误策略收集/上报错误，`createDisposeTransaction`/`createSyncLifecycleScope` 内部都用它：

参数：`policy: 'throw' | 'collect' | 'report' | 'firstError'`（必填）、`report: ((error: unknown) => void) | undefined`（必填，`throw`/`collect` 可显式传 `undefined`；`report`/`firstError` 必须提供函数，否则创建时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`）。`add(source, error)` 按策略即时处理（`report` 策略立即调用 `report`）；`finalize(message)`：`collect` 返回收集到的数组，`report` 返回空数组（已在 `add` 时上报），`throw` 单错保留原生实例并给未分类错误附 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`，primitive 通过 cause 包装；已有合法外部身份不变。多错聚合成携带 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 码的 `AggregateError`，`firstError` 有错误时抛首个（其余经 `report` 观测），否则返回空数组。
`LifecycleErrorCode`｜10 秒上手 —— 稳定错误码表（22 个码），唯一声明处，`source` 恒为 `'@migaia/lifecycle'`：

全部取值：`delayFailed`(`DELAY_FAILED`)、`scopeClosed`(`SCOPE_CLOSED`)、`scopeTerminal`(`SCOPE_TERMINAL`)、`scopeReentrantDispose`(`SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`)、`scopeReentrantOwn`(`SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`)、`scopeSyncViolation`(`SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`)、`scopeDisposalFailed`(`SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`)、`unitStartFailed`(`UNIT_START_FAILED`)、`generationSuperseded`(`GENERATION_SUPERSEDED`)、`generationCancellationFailed`(`GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED`)、`generationDisposed`(`GENERATION_DISPOSED`)、`generationTimedOut`(`GENERATION_TIMED_OUT`)、`quiescenceSealed`(`QUIESCENCE_SEALED`)、`quiescenceUnsealedWait`(`QUIESCENCE_UNSEALED_WAIT`)、`provisionalSettled`(`PROVISIONAL_SETTLED`)、`provisionalParentClosed`(`PROVISIONAL_PARENT_CLOSED`)、`queueAdmissionTimeout`(`QUEUE_ADMISSION_TIMEOUT`)、`queueSelfDependency`(`QUEUE_SELF_DEPENDENCY`)、`releaseForceFailed`(`RELEASE_FORCE_FAILED`)、`deadlineExceeded`(`DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`)、`envUnsupported`(`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`)、`invalidOption`(`INVALID_OPTION`)。逐条语义见 USEGUIDE.md。
`LifecycleErrorText`｜3 秒上手 —— 稳定诊断消息表（本包内部错误信息的唯一声明处，公开是为了让调用方按文本断言/比对）：

blocks.text: 用于“同步启动全部 disposer，但异步统一等待”的领域容器。Ledger 是 pending、raw error 与 terminal 的唯一事实源；调用方仍负责生成顺序计划、清空领域 registry，以及把 raw errors 投影成自己的 throw/report/aggregate 契约。
状态和 identity：

items: 初始 `open`；`start()` 不改变 lifecycle。
首次 `seal()` 同步进入 `closing`，冻结当时已经观察到的全部错误，并返回唯一 outcome；重复 `seal()` 返回同一对象，`outcome.physicalCompletion` 也保持同一 Promise。
已 seal 且 `pending === 0` 时进入 `terminal`；否则最后一个 thenable settle 后进入 `terminal`。`whenTerminal()` 只表达 terminal 等待，不承诺 Promise 对象 identity。
合法 thenable 永不 settle 时保持 `closing`；Ledger 不自造 timeout、abort、retry 或强制 terminal。

blocks.text: Callback 与 thenable：

items: `start()` 先校验 `source` 为 string、`callback` 为 function；非法输入同步抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，且不调用 callback。
callback 同步 throw 或读取 `.then` getter throw：记录进 seal 时的 `cleanupErrors` 快照；`start()` 不重抛 item failure，因此调用方仍能启动后续 item。
thenable 的 `.then` 只读取一次，并以原 thenable 为 receiver 调用；resolve/reject first-settlement-wins。Rejection按 settlement observation order进入最终 ledger。
每条错误是冻结的 `{ source, error }`；原始 `error` identity不被 Ledger替换。`physicalCompletion` 因 item failure也不会 reject，避免 Ledger抢走领域错误政策。

blocks.text: 重入和关闭边界：

items: 当前 item callback/thenable probe 尚未结束时重入 `start()` 或 `seal()`，同步抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`（`disposalLedgerReentrant` 文案）；外层 `start()` 把它当作当前 item 的同步 failure收集。
seal 后再 `start()` 同步抛 `SCOPE_CLOSED`（`disposalLedgerClosed` 文案），不调用新 callback。
Ledger 没有 rollback：进入 closing 后只能等待 admitted thenables settle。

blocks.text: 错误政策边界：Ledger 固定采用 raw `collect`。`firstError` 是最终 ledger 的第一条 observation；`throw`、`report`、`AggregateError` message/source/code和reporter failure containment全部属于调用 adapter，不应反向写入 Ledger。

symbols.name: IDisposeTransactionOptions
symbols.purpose: Per-transaction failure policy and shared release context forwarded unchanged to each run’s items.
symbols.core:
errorPolicy: Selects the release error outcome from `LifecycleErrorPolicy`. Every admitted item still receives its release attempt; `report` and `firstError` require a reporter when creating a scope or transaction.
`throw`: rethrow one original failure or aggregate several after release.
report: Receives each diagnostic or policy-routed `error` from lifecycle. Return nothing synchronously; accidental thenable rejections and synchronous throws are contained. A scope or transaction requires this callback for `report` and `firstError` policies.
report.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.
No value is consumed; callback failures do not replace the operation result.
Omitted: diagnostics have no sink; factories reject this omission for `report` and `firstError`.
deadlineAt: Absolute finite time in the selected scheduler clock. Every item sees the same `deadlineAt`; it caps graceful waiting only, so forced release can continue beyond it.
Omitted: no shared deadline; an individual descriptor may still set its own graceful budget.
scheduler: Clock and timer implementation from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`. Supply the same scheduler that produced every absolute deadline; lifecycle snapshots methods with their original receiver and rejects invalid shapes with `INVALID_OPTION`.
Omitted: use the admitted `systemScheduler` when a timed phase first needs it.
signal: Caller-owned `IAbortSignal` mirrored into a private per-run native signal; running the transaction never aborts the input controller.
Omitted: every item receives an inert non-aborting signal.
disposer: Owner-bound `IDisposerContext` supplied by an owning scope; generic callers normally omit this capability.
Omitted: no scope self-join capability is placed in the context.
pending: Caller-owned object with async no-argument `drain()` invoked after all release items; fulfillment means pending work drained, and rejection becomes a transaction-pending failure.
Omitted: no final pending-work drain is run.
pending.drain: Caller-provided no-argument callback invoked after all release items; return a Promise<void> that settles when pending work drains. Synchronous throws or rejection become transaction-pending failures.

`mergeCleanupResults` observes current cleanup snapshots and their later physical continuations. Each continuation contains only newly observed errors. `containAsyncRejection`｜5 秒上手 —— 保护性地探测某个返回值是否是 thenable，是则观察其 rejection 而不让其变成未处理拒绝：

以下 thenable 工具从 `@migaia/utils/function` 导入，属于 utils API。
`probeThenable`｜5 秒上手 —— 只读一次 `value.then`，返回判别结果（不是布尔值，是否 thenable/是否 getter 抛错都会区分）：
单参数 `value: unknown`，无选项。三种结果：`{ kind: 'not-thenable' }`、`{ kind: 'thenable', thenFn }`、`{ kind: 'failed', error }`（读 `.then` 本身抛错）。
`assimilateCapturedThen`｜5 秒上手 —— 把 `probeThenable` 捕获到的 `thenFn` 安全地 apply 成一个真正的 `Promise`，且只调用一次：

blocks.code: const promise = assimilateCapturedThen<T>(probe.thenFn, thenableValue)

blocks.text: 参数：`thenFn`（必填，来自 `probeThenable` 的 `thenFn`）、`thenable: unknown`（必填，作为 `this` receiver 传给 `thenFn`）。无可选项。
`createErrorCollector`｜10 秒上手 —— 按四种错误策略收集/上报错误，`createDisposeTransaction`/`createSyncLifecycleScope` 内部都用它：

参数：`policy: 'throw' | 'collect' | 'report' | 'firstError'`（必填）、`report: ((error: unknown) => void) | undefined`（必填，`throw`/`collect` 可显式传 `undefined`；`report`/`firstError` 必须提供函数，否则创建时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`）。`add(source, error)` 按策略即时处理（`report` 策略立即调用 `report`）；`finalize(message)`：`collect` 返回收集到的数组，`report` 返回空数组（已在 `add` 时上报），`throw` 单错保留原生实例并给未分类错误附 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`，primitive 通过 cause 包装；已有合法外部身份不变。多错聚合成携带 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 码的 `AggregateError`，`firstError` 有错误时抛首个（其余经 `report` 观测），否则返回空数组。

symbols.name: ILifecycleError
symbols.purpose: Native `Error` carrying lifecycle identity and traceable metadata. If diagnostic message/stack getters fail during normalization, the original thrown value remains cause and getter failures remain secondary errors; they never replace the primary.

source: Package identity assigned by lifecycle error construction; equals `LIFECYCLE_SOURCE`.

detail: Optional readonly context record supplied by the owner, such as a field label or timing attribution.
cause: Optional original primary thrown value retained for identity-based inspection and causal tracing.
errors: Frozen non-enumerable secondary failure list retained in occurrence order without replacing the primary cause.

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，22 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，`source` 恒为 `'@migaia/lifecycle'`：

rows: 相对延时无法注册、调度或清理；原错误保持可追溯，取消本身返回 false 而非错误
`close()` 之后调用 `own()`（异步/同步 scope）或某个 registry 的 `retain()`
容器已到达 `terminal` 之后，任何登记/激活操作
disposer 内部重入本 scope 的 `dispose()`
disposer 内部调用本 scope 的 `own()`
`SyncLifecycleScope` 收到 `syncSafe !== true` 的 descriptor、收到一个异步 scope 实例作为资源、或某回调返回了 thenable
`throw` 错误策略在多个资源释放失败时的 `AggregateError` 聚合出口
`LifecycleUnit.start()` 返回的 thenable 被 reject（单元进入 `failed`）
一次异步操作的结果在 `adopt()` 提交点已被更晚的 generation 取代（非失败信号，仅诊断）
generation 取消期间的 timer、parent listener 或 signal cleanup 失败
在已 `dispose()` 的 `GenerationController` 上调用 `begin()`
当前 generation 的 timeoutMs 预算到期；signal.reason 为带码 Error
未先 `seal(key)` 就调用严格 `whenZero(key)`（同步抛出，非 rejected Promise）
重复 commit、rollback 后 commit、成功 commit 后 rollback；重复 rollback 复用原 Promise
`commitTo()` 的目标 parent 已 `closing`/`terminal`，拒绝接收资源
mutation 在队列中等待超过配置的 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`
同一 `owner` 在自己尚未完成时又向同一队列提交新任务且被等待，会死锁
descriptor 的 `force` 抛出/reject（契约要求 `force` 必须无条件成功）
共享绝对 deadline 已过去，但仍有资源被要求进入新的 graceful 阶段；或同步 `graceful` 超过预算才返回（仍算成功，不跑 `force`）。两者都只经 `report` 上报，正常降级路径不用这个码
lifecycle 需要的宿主 `AbortController` 能力缺失；调度器宿主能力缺失由 utils `ENV_UNSUPPORTED` 报告
scheduler 收到非法时间/延迟参数，或 descriptor 字段类型非法

function createGenerationController(options?: IGenerationControllerOptions): IGenerationController

type IGenerationControllerOptions = {
  readonly parentSignal?: IAbortSignal
  readonly onSuperseded?: (info: ILifecycleError) => void
  readonly scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 systemScheduler
  readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void
}

type IGenerationToken = object

type IGenerationRequest = {
  readonly generation: number
  readonly token: IGenerationToken
  readonly signal: IAbortSignal
}

type IGenerationController = {
  readonly generation: number
  readonly disposed: boolean
  begin(options?: { readonly timeoutMs?: number }): IGenerationRequest
  isCurrent(token: IGenerationToken): boolean
  complete(token: IGenerationToken): boolean
  supersede(reason?: unknown): void
  adopt<T>(
    token: IGenerationToken,
    value: T,
    release: (value: T) => void | PromiseLike<void>,
    onReleaseError?: (error: unknown) => void
  ): boolean
  dispose(reason?: unknown): void
}

blocks.text: 代数 + 每代一个 `AbortSignal`，新一代自动使旧一代失效：
边界行为：

items: `begin(options?)`：使当前活跃代（若存在）立即失效（触发其 `signal` 中止），`generation` 自增，返回新的 `{ generation, token, signal }`。`options.timeoutMs?` 非法（非有限/负数）抛 `INVALID_OPTION`；超过该毫秒数后当前代的 `signal` 自动中止。控制器已 `dispose()` 后调用抛 `GENERATION_DISPOSED`。
`isCurrent(token)`：`token` 是否仍是当前代；`dispose()` 之后恒为 `false`。
`supersede(reason?)`：作废当前代（其 `signal` 中止）但控制器本身仍可用，之后 `begin()` 仍能开新代；对已 `dispose()` 的控制器调用是空操作。

`complete(token)`：只释放匹配的当前代，返回 true 并使 token 不再 current；先清 timer、再移除 parent listener，保持 signal 未中止。stale/disposed token 返回 false，不影响当前代。cleanup 失败仍以原 `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED` 保留原 cause，失败后 token 已作废；后续 `begin()` 仍可用。真正取消继续使用 `supersede`/parent/timeout/dispose，保持原 signal 与 reason。

`adopt(token, value, release, onReleaseError?)`：`token` 仍是当前代时返回 `true`，`value` 留给调用方；否则调用 `release(value)` 回收并返回 `false`——`release` 本身抛出/reject 只会经 `onReleaseError` 上报，绝不反过来污染"当前是哪一代"这一状态（不会抛出、不会重新计入错误策略）。若提供了 `onSuperseded`，在过期路径上先额外触发一次携带 `GENERATION_SUPERSEDED` 码的诊断信息（非失败信号）。
`dispose(reason?)`：终态；之后 `begin()` 恒抛 `GENERATION_DISPOSED`，`isCurrent()` 恒 `false`。
`parentSignal` 中止时，当前活跃代同步中止（清理 timer、移除 parent listener、abort 自身 controller）；清理过程中任一步失败会聚合为 `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED`。

symbols.purpose: Single-active-generation controller returned by `createGenerationController()`; stale results never regain ownership by matching a numeric counter alone.
symbols.core:
generation: Monotonically advanced counter for begins, supersedes and first disposal; it is diagnostic, while token identity decides currency.
disposed: Whether disposal has permanently closed this controller; a disposed controller cannot begin another generation.
begin: Invalidates the previous token and aborts its signal before creating a new request. Pair with `adopt()` or `isCurrent()` when accepting the eventual result.
begin.options: Optional object with `timeoutMs`: finite nonnegative per-generation milliseconds. Omitted timeout means no timer; a supplied invalid value throws `INVALID_OPTION` before replacing the old generation.
An `IGenerationRequest` with a fresh token, captured generation and native signal. A disposed controller throws `GENERATION_DISPOSED`; cancellation cleanup may throw `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED`.
isCurrent: Checks exact active token identity and controller liveness without changing state or refreshing the timeout.
isCurrent.token: Token returned by this controller’s `begin()` request, not a caller-created object or generation number.
True only while this exact token remains active and the controller is not disposed.
complete: Invalidates a matching token and cleans its timer and parent subscription without aborting the completed request’s signal.
complete.token: Exact token returned by the request created through this controller’s `begin()`.
True after completing the active token, false for stale/disposed tokens. Cleanup failure may throw after invalidation.
supersede: Invalidates and aborts the active generation without permanently disposing the controller; the caller may begin fresh work later.
supersede.reason: Optional caller-issued cancellation value forwarded unchanged to the active signal; omitted uses native abort semantics.
The current token is invalid and its owned timer/listener are released; cleanup failure can throw. A disposed controller does nothing.
adopt: Accepts a result only for the current token. Pair with `begin()`; stale values are released immediately, with asynchronous release rejection observed independently of newer work.
adopt.token: Token returned in the original `begin()` request that produced this result.
adopt.value: Result produced by caller-owned asynchronous work, passed unchanged to the stale-release callback.
adopt.release: Caller-authored `(value) => void | PromiseLike<void>` that releases only a stale result. The value is this adoption input; throws/rejections go to the selected release-error reporter.
adopt.onReleaseError: Optional synchronous `(error) => void` receiving the release failure; omitted uses the controller reporter. Return ignored; throws and rejections are contained.
True when the caller keeps the current result, false when stale release was attempted; false does not wait for asynchronous release.
dispose: Permanently prevents new generations and invalidates the active token before releasing cancellation resources; repeated calls do nothing.
dispose.reason: Optional caller-issued abort reason forwarded to the active request; omitted follows native abort semantics.
The controller is disposed and its active request aborted; cancellation cleanup failure can throw after state convergence.

members.name: begin
members.description: Starts a new generation, superseding whatever was active. Optionally auto-aborts after `timeoutMs`.

members.name: complete
members.description: Releases the matching current token's timer and parent subscription without aborting its signal. Returns false for stale/disposed tokens; cleanup failures retain cancellation codes and causes after invalidating the token.

members.name: supersede
members.description: Invalidates the current generation without disposing the controller — a later `begin()` still works.

members.name: adopt
members.signature: adopt<T>(token: IGenerationToken, value: T, release: (value: T) => void | PromiseLike<void>, onReleaseError?: (error: unknown) => void): boolean;
members.description: Adopts `value` under `token`'s generation. Returns `true` and keeps `value` with the caller if that generation is still current. Otherwise releases `value` via `release` and returns `false` (L-T6) — a release failure is funneled to `onReleaseError` (or the controller `report` when omitted) and never mutates controller state, so it cannot poison whichever generation is current now (L-T30).

members.name: parentSignal
members.description: When this aborts, the currently-active generation's `signal` aborts too (L-T31).

members.name: onSuperseded
members.description: Diagnostic channel fired from `adopt()` whenever `token` is no longer current — before the release attempt, regardless of whether it succeeds. The value is a `GENERATION_SUPERSEDED`-tagged error used purely as a `(source, code)`-bearing carrier; this is explicitly _not_ a failure signal (§4.10.2), just an observability hook for callers that want to notice the race without treating it as an error.

members.name: scheduler
members.description: Uses a runtime-neutral scheduler for `begin({ timeoutMs })` timing. Defaults to `systemScheduler`.

members.name: report
members.description: Last-boundary reporter for failures that have no caller to receive them: an `adopt()` release failure when that call passes no `onReleaseError`, and timer/parent cleanup failures raised by an asynchronous `begin({ timeoutMs })` timeout. Its own throws and rejections are contained. Without it those failures are dropped.

symbols.core:
retain: Adds one active lease for the caller-selected key. Pair with the returned `release()` function to decrement exactly once; sealed keys throw `QUIESCENCE_SEALED`.
retain.key: Caller-selected resource identity, reused unchanged for retain, sealing, counting and waiting.
An idempotent synchronous `IDisposer`; calling it returns this lease and may resolve zero-count waiters.
count: Reads the number of active leases for one key without allocating new state or preventing later retains.
count.key: Caller-selected resource identity, reused unchanged for retain, sealing, counting and waiting.
A nonnegative count; an unknown key returns zero.
whenZero: Waits for strict, exclusive draining of a sealed key. Pair with `seal()` first; otherwise it synchronously throws `QUIESCENCE_UNSEALED_WAIT`.
whenZero.key: Caller-selected resource identity, reused unchanged for retain, sealing, counting and waiting.
A `Promise<void>` fulfilled after the sealed key has no active lease; zero already fulfills immediately.
whenZeroOnce: Waits for the next observed zero count while allowing new leases. A fulfilled wait is a momentary observation, not an admission fence.
whenZeroOnce.key: Caller-selected resource identity, reused unchanged for retain, sealing, counting and waiting.
A `Promise<void>` that resolves immediately for an idle key or at the next zero transition.
seal: Permanently rejects new leases for this retained key until its zero-count state is forgotten. Pair with `whenZero()` for an exclusive drain.
seal.key: Caller-selected resource identity, reused unchanged for retain, sealing, counting and waiting.
The key is sealed; repeated sealing does not change its count.
isSealed: Reads whether this key currently carries an admission fence, including a sealed key whose count is already zero.
isSealed.key: Caller-selected resource identity, reused unchanged for retain, sealing, counting and waiting.
`true` for a sealed state entry; unknown or forgotten keys return `false`.
forget: Deletes a zero-count entry only when no zero-count waiter remains. Forgetting a sealed entry removes its admission fence.
forget.key: Caller-selected resource identity, reused unchanged for retain, sealing, counting and waiting.
`true` if a state entry was removed; `false` if missing, leased or still awaited.

边界行为：

items: `own(resource, descriptor)`：容器处于 `closing`/`terminal` 时抛 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_TERMINAL`；在 disposer 内部重入调用抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`；descriptor 形状非法（`order`/`custom`/`graceful`/`gracefulTimeoutMs`/`force`，规则同 dispose 时的 descriptor 校验）时在注册时就抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，访问器抛错则原样抛出。
`release(resource)`：反注册但不释放（调用方已自行释放），返回是否找到并移除了该条目；若曾设置 `gcFallback`，同时 unregister 对应的 `FinalizationRegistry` 条目。
`close()`：同步、幂等；`open → closing`。

`dispose()`：逆序（LIFO）释放全部已注册资源；并发多次调用复用同一个 Promise；需要在 disposer 中表达 owner self-join 时使用 `context.disposer.join()`，该操作抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE` 且不改变 canonical Promise；容器已 `terminal` 时仍返回首次 dispose Promise，保留原结果或 rejection。`errorPolicy: 'collect'` 时返回值为收集到的 `ICollectedError[]`；其余三种策略要么抛出要么内部上报，返回空数组。
提供 `[Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>`，可直接用于 `await using`（TypeScript 需包含 `ESNext.Disposable` 类型库）。

symbols.name: ILifecycleScope
symbols.purpose: Asynchronous resource owner returned by `createLifecycleScope()`, with distinct admission-close and release-completion phases.
symbols.core:
own: Registers one resource and an explicit release descriptor while the owner is open. The same resource identity may be registered more than once; no resource method is discovered automatically.
own.resource: Value allocated by the caller; keep this exact identity for a later unregister operation.
own.descriptor: Caller-authored `IReleaseDescriptor` declaring required `force` and optional graceful/custom release callbacks. Invalid fields fail registration.
The exact `resource` unchanged; closed and terminal owners throw `SCOPE_CLOSED` or `SCOPE_TERMINAL`.
release: Removes the earliest active registration of a resource without calling its descriptor. Use after independently releasing it; repeated calls can remove separate registrations of the same value.
release.resource: The exact resource identity previously passed to this scope’s `own()`.
`true` if one registration was removed; `false` if none remains.
lifecycle: Current survival state from `LifecycleState`; closing forbids new work and terminal is irreversible.
close: Stops ownership registration synchronously and aborts the scope’s closing signal with `SCOPE_CLOSED`; no resource release callback is invoked here.
Admission is closed; call `dispose()` to perform resource release.
dispose: Closes admission and releases the stable resource snapshot by descending priority with reverse-registration ties. External repeated calls share one promise; synchronous self-disposal throws `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`.
A promise of collected errors for `collect`, empty for other successful policies. Throw/first-error policies reject after release; the scope still reaches terminal.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Supports `await using` by awaiting the same asynchronous disposal and discarding its collected-error return value.
A `Promise<void>` settling with disposal; thrown-policy failures still reject.
symbols.advanced: Group resources whose release may await I/O and report all failures only after every release attempt.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.
examples:
import {
  createLifecycleScope,
  createSyncLifecycleScope,
  executeReleaseDescriptor,
  createDisposeTransaction,
  createSyncStartedDisposalLedger,
  type IReleaseDescriptor,
  type IDisposerContext,
  type IReleaseContext,
  type ILifecycleScope,
  type ILifecycleScopeOptions,
  type ISyncLifecycleScope,
  type ISyncLifecycleScopeOptions,
  type ISyncReleaseDescriptor,
  type IDisposeItem,
  type IDisposeTransaction,
  type IDisposeTransactionMode,
  type IDisposeTransactionOptions,
  type ISyncStartedDisposalLedger,
  type ISyncStartedDisposalOutcome
} from '@migaia/lifecycle'

function createLifecycleScope(options?: ILifecycleScopeOptions): ILifecycleScope

type ILifecycleScopeOptions = {
  readonly errorPolicy?: 'throw' | 'collect' | 'report' | 'firstError' // 默认 'throw'
  readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void
  readonly deadlineAt?: number
  readonly scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 systemScheduler
}

type ILifecycleScope = ILifecycleOwner & {
  readonly lifecycle: 'open' | 'closing' | 'terminal'
  own<T>(resource: T, descriptor: IReleaseDescriptor): T
  release(resource: unknown): boolean
  close(): void
  dispose(): Promise<readonly ICollectedError[]>
  [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> // await using；丢弃收集到的错误结果
}

members.name: release
members.description: Unregisters a resource without releasing it — the caller has already released it independently.

members.name: close
members.description: Synchronous, idempotent, never calls user code (L-T27).

members.name: dispose
members.description: Always asynchronous (D-1) — there is no synchronous `dispose()` on this type. Resolves to the collected errors for the `collect` policy (empty for the other three, which throw/report internally instead). Concurrent external calls reuse the same published Promise even while release is in flight. Only a synchronous call from an active disposer callback is rejected as reentrant, preventing that callback from self-awaiting the Promise it is currently helping to settle.

members.name: [Symbol.asyncDispose]
members.description: Awaits scope release for `await using`, discarding the collected-error result.

symbols.name: ILifecycleScopeOptions
symbols.purpose: Caller-owned configuration for asynchronous scope failure delivery and shared release timing.
symbols.core:
errorPolicy: Selects the release error outcome from `LifecycleErrorPolicy`. Every admitted item still receives its release attempt; `report` and `firstError` require a reporter when creating a scope or transaction.
`throw`: rethrow one original failure or aggregate several after release.
report: Receives each diagnostic or policy-routed `error` from lifecycle. Return nothing synchronously; accidental thenable rejections and synchronous throws are contained. A scope or transaction requires this callback for `report` and `firstError` policies.
report.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.
No value is consumed; callback failures do not replace the operation result.
Omitted: diagnostics have no sink; factories reject this omission for `report` and `firstError`.
deadlineAt: Absolute finite time in the selected scheduler clock. Every item sees the same `deadlineAt`; it caps graceful waiting only, so forced release can continue beyond it.
Omitted: no shared deadline; an individual descriptor may still set its own graceful budget.
scheduler: Clock and timer implementation from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`. Supply the same scheduler that produced every absolute deadline; lifecycle snapshots methods with their original receiver and rejects invalid shapes with `INVALID_OPTION`.
Omitted: use the admitted `systemScheduler` when a timed phase first needs it.

symbols.name: IErrorInfo
symbols.purpose: Local error projection on entry.error with native raw identity for console/custom sinks. HTTP and color JSON use the shared bounded source/code/name/message/stack/cause/errors projection without raw; unclassified business errors use diagnostic unknown/UNKNOWN placeholders.
symbols.core:
name: Error name such as `TypeError`.
message: Message text of the original error.
stack: Stack text, when available.
raw: The exact original Error for local inspection. Generic JSON may serialize enumerable own custom properties even though built-in native fields are usually non-enumerable. Built-in HTTP/color JSON deliberately omit raw and project the full bounded chain.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

members.name: raw
members.description: Reference to the original error, never a reconstructed object. JSON serialization does not preserve the native error type or its non-enumerable built-in fields. A plain error normally becomes `{}` under `raw`; enumerable custom properties can be serialized. Console and custom sinks use this reference for native stack inspection or APIs such as `Sentry.captureException()`. HTTP and color JSON sinks use the shared bounded serializeErrorChain projection of raw, preserving source/code/name/message/stack and cause/aggregate branches without serializing raw.

symbols.name: ILoggerCore
symbols.purpose: Core capabilities of a logger, also passed to plugins as `core` in `install(core)` (without `use` / `unUse`).
symbols.core:
config: Configuration store of the installed plugins. On a logger it is `ILoggerConfig` (`get(path)`, `update(name, recipe)`); inside a plugin `install(core)` it is a reader of that plugin configuration only (`get()`).
ctx: Frozen context of this logger: `id`, application `options`, default context `path`, `topic`, `createdAt` and `env`.
scheduler: Clock and timers used by `flush()`, `shutdown()` and batch deadlines; the `scheduler` option or `systemScheduler`.
runtimeManager: Host capabilities (stdout, UUID, scheduling, fetch, fs) captured at construction from the `runtimeManager` option or `getLoggerRuntimeManager()`; plugins use the same object.
log: Console-style entry point: builds an entry with this tag and message and dispatches it through pipeline, hooks and sinks. A trailing object stays an argument; it is not turned into `meta`. Never throws for sink failures.
log.tag: Entry tag such as `info` or `audit`; `level()` filters standard level tags.
log.message: Message text; `%s`, `%d`, `%o` placeholders are left for the console sink.
log.args: Extra values stored in `entry.args` in order.
No value. Shutdown handlers can still enqueue final structured entries; calls are ignored after draining closes dispatch admission.
dispatchRaw: Dispatches an entry with explicit fields (`meta`, `data`, `context`, `error`, `time`) for structured or audit logs.
dispatchRaw.input: `{ tag, message, args?, meta?, data?, context?, error?, time? }`; `context` defaults to the `context` option.
dispatchRaw.options: Optional `{ asyncOutput }`: `true` schedules the output with `defer()` so the call returns before any sink runs; default `false`.
Nothing; failures go to `onFailure()`.
raw: Writes text straight to stdout (or `console.log` without `process`), skipping pipeline and sinks; used for streaming output. Ignored once shutdown starts.
raw.text: Text passed unchanged to runtimeManager.write. A host stdout writer can preserve no-newline output; the default console.log fallback without process adds its own newline.
raw.options: Optional `{ asyncOutput }`: `true` schedules the output with `defer()` so the call returns before any sink runs; default `false`.
Nothing.
usePipeline: Registers a synchronous stage (entry, next, context?) => void in every pipeline mode. PluginHost lifts it into the selected mode; call next(entry) to continue or omit next to drop the entry.
usePipeline.stage: The stage function; call `next` at most once.
The same logger for chaining; synchronous registration works in all modes. Other stage registration methods follow the mode compatibility matrix.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers an async onion-style stage (mode `async` only): code after `await next(entry)` runs once the downstream finished.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (entry, next) => void`.
The same logger; other modes reject it at type level and at runtime.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator stage (modes `generator` and `async-generator`).
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: Generator (entry, context?), with optional pipeline context as the second argument, never next. Return a payload or GENERATOR_CONTINUE after yielding to continue; an implicit undefined return halts.
The same logger, for chaining.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers an async generator stage (mode `async-generator` only); each stage runs to its final value before the next.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: Async generator (entry, context?) with optional context as the second argument. Yield stores a candidate; return payload or GENERATOR_CONTINUE to continue. The logger explicitly delegates stage registration to its functional Host.
useSink: Registers an output that receives every entry passing the pipeline. Each sink gets its own shallow copy; a returned Promise is awaited by `flush()`; a throw goes to `onFailure()` with source `sink`.
useSink.sink: `(entry) => void | Promise<void>`.
A function that removes only this registration; calling it again does nothing.
hook: Registers a hook under a name: built-in `before`, `after`, `before:<tag>`, `after:<tag>`, or a name a plugin fires. Hooks receive the live entry and may change it.
hook.name: Hook name.
hook.fn: `(entry) => void | Promise<void>`; a returned Promise is awaited by `flush()`.
An idempotent off callback removing only this registration; registering the same function again creates an independent subscription.
fireHook: Runs every hook registered under `name` with the given entry now.
fireHook.name: Hook name to fire.
fireHook.entry: An entry, usually received in a sink or stage.
Nothing; hook failures go to `onFailure()`.
onFailure: Observes failures of sinks, hooks, pipeline, deferred tasks, flush, forwarding and shutdown. Logging calls never throw them, so register this in production. If the terminal runtime reporter throws, rejects or has a throwing then getter, the existing Utils host exception queue exposes that failure without recursion or changing the business result.
onFailure.fn: `({ source, error }) => void`; see `ILogFailure`.
defer: Runs a task after the current synchronous stack through the runtime manager; `flush()` and `shutdown()` wait for it.
defer.task: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
Nothing; the task is scheduled, not awaited.
onFlush: Registers a callback that empties a buffer on every `flush()`.
onFlush.fn: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
flush: Waits for deferred tasks, async sink results, `onFlush` callbacks, batches and forwarded loggers. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a stuck Promise is abandoned after about 3 seconds and reported with `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE`.
Resolves when the known work finished or the budget ran out.
onShutdown: Registers a cleanup handler run at the start of `shutdown()`; it may still write final logs.
onShutdown.fn: `(reason) => void | Promise<void>`; `reason` is the value passed to `shutdown()`.
shutdown: Closes the logger: runs shutdown handlers, flushes, then uninstalls all plugins. Reentrant and concurrent calls share the same Promise. Afterwards logs are silently ignored and the logger cannot be reopened.
shutdown.reason: Why it closes: `manual` from application code; `signal`, `uncaughtException`, `unhandledRejection` are passed by `process()`.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult` from `@migaia/plugin-host`; `cleanupErrors` lists plugin cleanup failures. A clock failure rejects this same published completion after attempting Host cleanup, retaining primary and cleanup causes. Persistent clock failure can also defeat the Host budget; cleanup or receipt success does not promise remote delivery.
dispose: Same as `shutdown("manual")`.
The disposal result of `shutdown()`.
use: Installs plugins after construction (also async ones), through the same checks as constructor plugins. Each call must use new plugin objects.
use.plugins: Plugin objects created by factories such as `level()` or `http(config)`.
A tuple of plugin handles in input order; `handle.extensions` holds the API the plugin added.
unUse: Uninstalls a plugin by name and releases what it registered (stages, sinks, hooks, flush and shutdown callbacks).
unUse.name: Plugin name, such as `LEVEL_PLUGIN_NAME` (`level`).
Resolves after the plugin is removed.
extends: Forwards every entry, after this logger processed it, through the whole pipeline and sinks of each target (their level filters apply). Self or cyclic forwarding throws `EXTENDS_SELF` / `EXTENDS_CYCLE`.
extends.others: Target loggers created by `new Logger()`.
This logger, for chaining.
unextend: Removes forwarding edges to the given loggers; the targets are not closed.
unextend.others: Loggers previously passed to `extends()`.
`true` when at least one edge was removed.
onDispose: Inside a plugin `install(core)` only: registers a cleanup run when the plugin is uninstalled.
onDispose.resource: A disposer function or an object with `dispose()`.
Nothing; the cleanup is registered.

One logging API across Node, Bun, Deno, browsers and workers, with only the plugins each environment needs.
Production pipelines that batch and upload entries, and must not lose them on exit (`flush()`, `shutdown()`).
Forwarding one logger into another (`extends()`), for example a module logger into an audit logger.

members.description: Registers a pipeline stage that can transform an entry, forward it with `next`, or drop it by omitting `next`. Supported methods follow the middleware-pipeline promotion table. Sync stages run in any mode. Generator stages also promote to `async-generator`. Other stages require their matching mode. An unresolved mode union retains all methods and leaves validation to runtime admission.

members.name: useSink
members.description: Registers a sink. Every registered sink processes entries that pass the full pipeline, such as console and HTTP sinks together.

members.name: hook
members.description: Registers a named lifecycle hook. Built-in names are `before`, `after`, `before:${tag}`, and `after:${tag}`. Plugins can also define their own hook names.

members.name: onFailure
members.description: Observes asynchronous output failures without changing normal log-call control flow.

members.name: defer
members.description: Schedules work outside the current synchronous stack through the runtime manager. `flush` and `shutdown` wait for this work. Plugins configured for async output use this path for rendering, stdout writes, or network requests.

members.name: onFlush
members.description: Registers a callback to empty a buffer during `flush()`. The core invokes these callbacks and also waits for unfinished `defer()` tasks and Promises returned by sinks. For example, an HTTP sink without batching still keeps each pending request in the drain wait.

members.name: onShutdown
members.description: Shutdown disposes installed plugins after draining; subsequent log calls are ignored.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Returns the same terminal completion as shutdown(manual).

members.name: use
members.signature: use<const NewP extends readonly ILoggerPluginConstraint[]>(...plugins: NewP): Promise<IPluginHandleTuple<NewP>>;
members.description: Installs plugins on an existing logger through the same host admission path used by constructor installation. Duplicate plugin names, extension conflicts, and dependency cycles are rejected by that host. Providers declare Feature names. Returns a Promise of plugin handles, preserving each plugin's extension types on its handle. The existing logger variable does not gain new TypeScript methods.

members.name: unUse
members.description: Removes an installed plugin by name through the owning host and releases its registered resources. This includes pipeline stages, sinks, hooks, flush callbacks, shutdown callbacks, and plugin extensions. Missing plugin names reject with `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`. Required Feature dependents can block removal.

members.name: raw
members.description: Writes raw text to stdout without passing through the pipeline or sinks. `asyncOutput: true` schedules the write through `defer`. Streaming plugins such as reasoning use this for token output without a complete log format per token.

members.name: extends
members.signature: extends(...others: readonly Omit<ILoggerCore<TMode, TShared>, 'config' | 'onDispose'>[]): ILoggerCore<TMode, TShared>;
members.description: Forwards entries to the full pipelines and sinks of each target after the current logger processes them. After `log1.extends(log2, log3)`, target level thresholds and filters still apply to forwarded entries. Each forwarding hop records its topic in internal forwarding state carried in `entry.data`. Registration detects cycles using logger context IDs. Runtime forwarding also skips IDs already present in the internal forwarding path. This composes forwarding behavior, not plugin extension types. The returned logger keeps the current logger's TypeScript capabilities; target-only methods are not added.

members.name: unextend
members.description: Removes named extension edges; returns true when at least one edge was removed.

symbols.whenToUse:
One logging API across Node, Bun, Deno, browsers and workers, with only the plugins each environment needs.
Production pipelines that batch and upload entries, and must not lose them on exit (`flush()`, `shutdown()`).
Forwarding one logger into another (`extends()`), for example a module logger into an audit logger.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Core capabilities of a logger, also passed to plugins as `core` in `install(core)` (without `use` / `unUse`).

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import ILoggerCore from @migaia/logger, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use ILoggerCore when its type contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when ILoggerCore does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained type example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
config: Configuration store of the installed plugins. On a logger it is `ILoggerConfig` (`get(path)`, `update(name, recipe)`); inside a plugin `install(core)` it is a reader of that plugin configuration only (`get()`).
ctx: Frozen context of this logger: `id`, application `options`, default context `path`, `topic`, `createdAt` and `env`.
scheduler: Clock and timers used by `flush()`, `shutdown()` and batch deadlines; the `scheduler` option or `systemScheduler`.
runtimeManager: Host capabilities (stdout, UUID, scheduling, fetch, fs) captured at construction from the `runtimeManager` option or `getLoggerRuntimeManager()`; plugins use the same object.
log: Console-style entry point: builds an entry with this tag and message and dispatches it through pipeline, hooks and sinks. A trailing object stays an argument; it is not turned into `meta`. Never throws for sink failures.
log.tag: Entry tag such as `info` or `audit`; `level()` filters standard level tags.
log.message: Message text; `%s`, `%d`, `%o` placeholders are left for the console sink.
log.args: Extra values stored in `entry.args` in order.
No value. Shutdown handlers can still enqueue final structured entries; calls are ignored after draining closes dispatch admission.
dispatchRaw: Dispatches an entry with explicit fields (`meta`, `data`, `context`, `error`, `time`) for structured or audit logs.
dispatchRaw.input: `{ tag, message, args?, meta?, data?, context?, error?, time? }`; `context` defaults to the `context` option.
dispatchRaw.options: Optional `{ asyncOutput }`: `true` schedules the output with `defer()` so the call returns before any sink runs; default `false`.
Nothing; failures go to `onFailure()`.
raw: Writes text straight to stdout (or `console.log` without `process`), skipping pipeline and sinks; used for streaming output. Ignored once shutdown starts.
raw.text: Text passed unchanged to runtimeManager.write. A host stdout writer can preserve no-newline output; the default console.log fallback without process adds its own newline.
raw.options: Optional `{ asyncOutput }`: `true` schedules the output with `defer()` so the call returns before any sink runs; default `false`.
Nothing.
usePipeline: Registers a synchronous stage (entry, next, context?) => void in every pipeline mode. PluginHost lifts it into the selected mode; call next(entry) to continue or omit next to drop the entry.
usePipeline.stage: The stage function; call `next` at most once.
The same logger for chaining; synchronous registration works in all modes. Other stage registration methods follow the mode compatibility matrix.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers an async onion-style stage (mode `async` only): code after `await next(entry)` runs once the downstream finished.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (entry, next) => void`.
The same logger; other modes reject it at type level and at runtime.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator stage (modes `generator` and `async-generator`).
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: Generator (entry, context?), with optional pipeline context as the second argument, never next. Return a payload or GENERATOR_CONTINUE after yielding to continue; an implicit undefined return halts.
The same logger, for chaining.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers an async generator stage (mode `async-generator` only); each stage runs to its final value before the next.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: Async generator (entry, context?) with optional context as the second argument. Yield stores a candidate; return payload or GENERATOR_CONTINUE to continue. The logger explicitly delegates stage registration to its functional Host.
useSink: Registers an output that receives every entry passing the pipeline. Each sink gets its own shallow copy; a returned Promise is awaited by `flush()`; a throw goes to `onFailure()` with source `sink`.
useSink.sink: `(entry) => void | Promise<void>`.
A function that removes only this registration; calling it again does nothing.
hook: Registers a hook under a name: built-in `before`, `after`, `before:<tag>`, `after:<tag>`, or a name a plugin fires. Hooks receive the live entry and may change it.
hook.name: Hook name.
hook.fn: `(entry) => void | Promise<void>`; a returned Promise is awaited by `flush()`.
An idempotent off callback removing only this registration; registering the same function again creates an independent subscription.
fireHook: Runs every hook registered under `name` with the given entry now.
fireHook.name: Hook name to fire.
fireHook.entry: An entry, usually received in a sink or stage.
Nothing; hook failures go to `onFailure()`.
onFailure: Observes failures of sinks, hooks, pipeline, deferred tasks, flush, forwarding and shutdown. Logging calls never throw them, so register this in production. If the terminal runtime reporter throws, rejects or has a throwing then getter, the existing Utils host exception queue exposes that failure without recursion or changing the business result.
onFailure.fn: `({ source, error }) => void`; see `ILogFailure`.
defer: Runs a task after the current synchronous stack through the runtime manager; `flush()` and `shutdown()` wait for it.
defer.task: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
Nothing; the task is scheduled, not awaited.
onFlush: Registers a callback that empties a buffer on every `flush()`.
onFlush.fn: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
flush: Waits for deferred tasks, async sink results, `onFlush` callbacks, batches and forwarded loggers. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a stuck Promise is abandoned after about 3 seconds and reported with `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE`.
Resolves when the known work finished or the budget ran out.
onShutdown: Registers a cleanup handler run at the start of `shutdown()`; it may still write final logs.
onShutdown.fn: `(reason) => void | Promise<void>`; `reason` is the value passed to `shutdown()`.
shutdown: Closes the logger: runs shutdown handlers, flushes, then uninstalls all plugins. Reentrant and concurrent calls share the same Promise. Afterwards logs are silently ignored and the logger cannot be reopened.
shutdown.reason: Why it closes: `manual` from application code; `signal`, `uncaughtException`, `unhandledRejection` are passed by `process()`.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult` from `@migaia/plugin-host`; `cleanupErrors` lists plugin cleanup failures. A clock failure rejects this same published completion after attempting Host cleanup, retaining primary and cleanup causes. Persistent clock failure can also defeat the Host budget; cleanup or receipt success does not promise remote delivery.
dispose: Same as `shutdown("manual")`.
The disposal result of `shutdown()`.
use: Installs plugins after construction (also async ones), through the same checks as constructor plugins. Each call must use new plugin objects.
use.plugins: Plugin objects created by factories such as `level()` or `http(config)`.
A tuple of plugin handles in input order; `handle.extensions` holds the API the plugin added.
unUse: Uninstalls a plugin by name and releases what it registered (stages, sinks, hooks, flush and shutdown callbacks).
unUse.name: Plugin name, such as `LEVEL_PLUGIN_NAME` (`level`).
Resolves after the plugin is removed.
extends: Forwards every entry, after this logger processed it, through the whole pipeline and sinks of each target (their level filters apply). Self or cyclic forwarding throws `EXTENDS_SELF` / `EXTENDS_CYCLE`.
extends.others: Target loggers created by `new Logger()`.
This logger, for chaining.
unextend: Removes forwarding edges to the given loggers; the targets are not closed.
unextend.others: Loggers previously passed to `extends()`.
`true` when at least one edge was removed.
onDispose: Inside a plugin `install(core)` only: registers a cleanup run when the plugin is uninstalled.
onDispose.resource: A disposer function or an object with `dispose()`.
Nothing; the cleanup is registered.

symbols.name: ILoggerPluginCore
symbols.purpose: The `core` a plugin receives in `install(core)`: the logger core without `use` / `unUse`, plus `onDispose()` for cleanup.
symbols.core:
config: Configuration store of the installed plugins. On a logger it is `ILoggerConfig` (`get(path)`, `update(name, recipe)`); inside a plugin `install(core)` it is a reader of that plugin configuration only (`get()`).
ctx: Frozen context of this logger: `id`, application `options`, default context `path`, `topic`, `createdAt` and `env`.
scheduler: Clock and timers used by `flush()`, `shutdown()` and batch deadlines; the `scheduler` option or `systemScheduler`.
runtimeManager: Host capabilities (stdout, UUID, scheduling, fetch, fs) captured at construction from the `runtimeManager` option or `getLoggerRuntimeManager()`; plugins use the same object.
log: Console-style entry point: builds an entry with this tag and message and dispatches it through pipeline, hooks and sinks. A trailing object stays an argument; it is not turned into `meta`. Never throws for sink failures.
log.tag: Entry tag such as `info` or `audit`; `level()` filters standard level tags.
log.message: Message text; `%s`, `%d`, `%o` placeholders are left for the console sink.
log.args: Extra values stored in `entry.args` in order.
No value. Shutdown handlers can still enqueue final structured entries; calls are ignored after draining closes dispatch admission.
dispatchRaw: Dispatches an entry with explicit fields (`meta`, `data`, `context`, `error`, `time`) for structured or audit logs.
dispatchRaw.input: `{ tag, message, args?, meta?, data?, context?, error?, time? }`; `context` defaults to the `context` option.
dispatchRaw.options: Optional `{ asyncOutput }`: `true` schedules the output with `defer()` so the call returns before any sink runs; default `false`.
Nothing; failures go to `onFailure()`.
raw: Writes text straight to stdout (or `console.log` without `process`), skipping pipeline and sinks; used for streaming output. Ignored once shutdown starts.
raw.text: Text passed unchanged to runtimeManager.write. A host stdout writer can preserve no-newline output; the default console.log fallback without process adds its own newline.
raw.options: Optional `{ asyncOutput }`: `true` schedules the output with `defer()` so the call returns before any sink runs; default `false`.
Nothing.
usePipeline: Registers a synchronous stage (entry, next, context?) => void in every pipeline mode. PluginHost lifts it into the selected mode; call next(entry) to continue or omit next to drop the entry.
usePipeline.stage: The stage function; call `next` at most once.
The same logger for chaining; synchronous registration works in all modes. Other stage registration methods follow the mode compatibility matrix.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers an async onion-style stage (mode `async` only): code after `await next(entry)` runs once the downstream finished.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (entry, next) => void`.
The same logger; other modes reject it at type level and at runtime.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator stage (modes `generator` and `async-generator`).
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: Generator (entry, context?), with optional pipeline context as the second argument, never next. Return a payload or GENERATOR_CONTINUE after yielding to continue; an implicit undefined return halts.
The same logger, for chaining.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers an async generator stage (mode `async-generator` only); each stage runs to its final value before the next.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: Async generator (entry, context?) with optional context as the second argument. Yield stores a candidate; return payload or GENERATOR_CONTINUE to continue. The logger explicitly delegates stage registration to its functional Host.
useSink: Registers an output that receives every entry passing the pipeline. Each sink gets its own shallow copy; a returned Promise is awaited by `flush()`; a throw goes to `onFailure()` with source `sink`.
useSink.sink: `(entry) => void | Promise<void>`.
A function that removes only this registration; calling it again does nothing.
hook: Registers a hook under a name: built-in `before`, `after`, `before:<tag>`, `after:<tag>`, or a name a plugin fires. Hooks receive the live entry and may change it.
hook.name: Hook name.
hook.fn: `(entry) => void | Promise<void>`; a returned Promise is awaited by `flush()`.
An idempotent off callback removing only this registration; registering the same function again creates an independent subscription.
fireHook: Runs every hook registered under `name` with the given entry now.
fireHook.name: Hook name to fire.
fireHook.entry: An entry, usually received in a sink or stage.
Nothing; hook failures go to `onFailure()`.
onFailure: Observes failures of sinks, hooks, pipeline, deferred tasks, flush, forwarding and shutdown. Logging calls never throw them, so register this in production. If the terminal runtime reporter throws, rejects or has a throwing then getter, the existing Utils host exception queue exposes that failure without recursion or changing the business result.
onFailure.fn: `({ source, error }) => void`; see `ILogFailure`.
defer: Runs a task after the current synchronous stack through the runtime manager; `flush()` and `shutdown()` wait for it.
defer.task: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
Nothing; the task is scheduled, not awaited.
onFlush: Registers a callback that empties a buffer on every `flush()`.
onFlush.fn: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
flush: Waits for deferred tasks, async sink results, `onFlush` callbacks, batches and forwarded loggers. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a stuck Promise is abandoned after about 3 seconds and reported with `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE`.
Resolves when the known work finished or the budget ran out.
onShutdown: Registers a cleanup handler run at the start of `shutdown()`; it may still write final logs.
onShutdown.fn: `(reason) => void | Promise<void>`; `reason` is the value passed to `shutdown()`.
shutdown: Closes the logger: runs shutdown handlers, flushes, then uninstalls all plugins. Reentrant and concurrent calls share the same Promise. Afterwards logs are silently ignored and the logger cannot be reopened.
shutdown.reason: Why it closes: `manual` from application code; `signal`, `uncaughtException`, `unhandledRejection` are passed by `process()`.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult` from `@migaia/plugin-host`; `cleanupErrors` lists plugin cleanup failures. A clock failure rejects this same published completion after attempting Host cleanup, retaining primary and cleanup causes. Persistent clock failure can also defeat the Host budget; cleanup or receipt success does not promise remote delivery.
dispose: Same as `shutdown("manual")`.
The disposal result of `shutdown()`.
use: Installs plugins after construction (also async ones), through the same checks as constructor plugins. Each call must use new plugin objects.
use.plugins: Plugin objects created by factories such as `level()` or `http(config)`.
A tuple of plugin handles in input order; `handle.extensions` holds the API the plugin added.
unUse: Uninstalls a plugin by name and releases what it registered (stages, sinks, hooks, flush and shutdown callbacks).
unUse.name: Plugin name, such as `LEVEL_PLUGIN_NAME` (`level`).
Resolves after the plugin is removed.
extends: Forwards every entry, after this logger processed it, through the whole pipeline and sinks of each target (their level filters apply). Self or cyclic forwarding throws `EXTENDS_SELF` / `EXTENDS_CYCLE`.
extends.others: Target loggers created by `new Logger()`.
This logger, for chaining.
unextend: Removes forwarding edges to the given loggers; the targets are not closed.
unextend.others: Loggers previously passed to `extends()`.
`true` when at least one edge was removed.
onDispose: Inside a plugin `install(core)` only: registers a cleanup run when the plugin is uninstalled.
onDispose.resource: A disposer function or an object with `dispose()`.
Nothing; the cleanup is registered.

members.name: scheduler
members.description: The logger's monotonic clock source (R-9). `flush`, `shutdown`, batch deadlines, and `boundedWait` use this scheduler. Defaults to utils/scheduler `systemScheduler`. Plugins use it to share the host's clock domain.

members.description: Host capabilities captured by this logger; plugins share the same instance owner.

members.name: log
members.signature: log(tag: string, message: string, ...args: unknown[]): void;
members.description: Synchronously constructs and dispatches an entry. Use `dispatchRaw` scheduling options for asynchronous output.

members.name: dispatchRaw
members.description: Dispatches explicit entry fields such as `meta`, `data`, and `context`.

members.name: usePipeline
members.description: Registers a pipeline stage that can transform an entry, forward it with `next`, or drop it by omitting `next`. Supported methods follow the middleware-pipeline promotion table. Sync stages run in any mode. Generator stages also promote to `async-generator`. Other stages require their matching mode. An unresolved mode union retains all methods and leaves validation to runtime admission.

members.name: useSink
members.description: Registers a sink. Every registered sink processes entries that pass the full pipeline, such as console and HTTP sinks together.

members.name: hook
members.description: Registers a named lifecycle hook. Built-in names are `before`, `after`, `before:${tag}`, and `after:${tag}`. Plugins can also define their own hook names.

members.name: onFailure
members.description: Observes asynchronous output failures without changing normal log-call control flow.

members.name: defer
members.description: Schedules work outside the current synchronous stack through the runtime manager. `flush` and `shutdown` wait for this work. Plugins configured for async output use this path for rendering, stdout writes, or network requests.

members.name: onFlush
members.description: Registers a callback to empty a buffer during `flush()`. The core invokes these callbacks and also waits for unfinished `defer()` tasks and Promises returned by sinks. For example, an HTTP sink without batching still keeps each pending request in the drain wait.

members.name: onShutdown
members.description: Shutdown disposes installed plugins after draining; subsequent log calls are ignored.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Returns the same terminal completion as shutdown(manual).

members.name: raw
members.description: Writes raw text to stdout without passing through the pipeline or sinks. `asyncOutput: true` schedules the write through `defer`. Streaming plugins such as reasoning use this for token output without a complete log format per token.

members.name: extends
members.signature: extends(...others: readonly Omit<ILoggerCore<TMode, TShared>, 'config' | 'onDispose'>[]): ILoggerCore<TMode, TShared>;
members.description: Forwards entries to the full pipelines and sinks of each target after the current logger processes them. After `log1.extends(log2, log3)`, target level thresholds and filters still apply to forwarded entries. Each forwarding hop records its topic in internal forwarding state carried in `entry.data`. Registration detects cycles using logger context IDs. Runtime forwarding also skips IDs already present in the internal forwarding path. This composes forwarding behavior, not plugin extension types. The returned logger keeps the current logger's TypeScript capabilities; target-only methods are not added.

members.name: unextend
members.description: Removes named extension edges; returns true when at least one edge was removed.

symbols.purpose: Creates a logger. Plugins in `plugins` are installed synchronously in array order; a plugin whose install returns a Promise makes the constructor throw (install those later with `use()`). The methods of installed plugins appear on the instance with full types.
symbols.core:
options: Construction options; see `ILoggerOptions` (`execution` is required).
A logger instance; invalid options throw `INVALID_OPTION`, a failing plugin rolls back the plugins installed before it and rethrows.

import { Logger, setLoggerRuntimeManager } from '@migaia/logger'
import { batch, color, http, level, process, reasoning, uuid } from '@migaia/logger/plugins'

const log = new Logger({
  execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false },
  context: ['app', 'api'],
  topic: 'gateway',
  options: { service: 'gateway' },
  on: { before: (entry) => {} },
  pipeline: { mode: 'sync' },
  plugins: [level(), color()]
})

import { Logger } from '@migaia/logger'
import { file } from '@migaia/logger/plugins/file'

const logger = new Logger({
  execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false },
  plugins: [file({ path: 'logs/app.jsonl', batch: { maxSize: 20 } })]
})
logger.log('info', 'ready')
await logger.flush()
await logger.shutdown('manual')

import { batch, color, http, level, process, uuid } from '@migaia/logger/plugins'

const log = new Logger({
  execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false },
  context: ['worker'],
  plugins: [
    level({ level: 'info' }),
    uuid({ display: true }),
    batch({ maxSize: 50, maxWaitMs: 1000 }),
    http({ url: 'https://logs.example/v1/entries', batch: { maxSize: 50 } }),
    color({ format: 'pretty' }),
    process()
  ]
})

log.onFailure(({ source, error }) => reportLoggerFailure(source, error))
log.info('job started', { jobId: 'j_1' })
await log.flush()

import { color, level } from '@migaia/logger/plugins'

  plugins: [level({ level: 'info' }), color({ format: 'pretty', color: 'auto' })]
})

log.info('server listening on %d', 3000)
log.error('request failed', new Error('timeout'))

await log.flush() // 确保上面这些日志真正落地了再退出/继续

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates a logger. Plugins in `plugins` are installed synchronously in array order; a plugin whose install returns a Promise makes the constructor throw (install those later with `use()`). The methods of installed plugins appear on the instance with full types.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import Logger from @migaia/logger, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use Logger when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when Logger does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
One logging API across Node, Bun, Deno, browsers and workers, with only the plugins each environment needs.
Production pipelines that batch and upload entries, and must not lose them on exit (`flush()`, `shutdown()`).
Forwarding one logger into another (`extends()`), for example a module logger into an audit logger.
Sharing one plugin object between loggers: create a new one per logger (`level()` twice), otherwise their state is mixed.

blocks.text: 不添加任何 logger 方法，只提供 shared 能力 `createBatcher(config, onBatch)`，供其他插件（如 `http()`）复用。

rows: 攒够这个数量就触发一次发送。
批次里第一项进入后的最长等待时间。
同时执行的批次数；必须是正安全整数。
排队中与执行中的批次总上限；满载时报告 `BATCH_OVERFLOW`；优先丢最老排队批次，若全在执行则丢新批次。
满批次的回调是否走 `defer` 调度。

blocks.text: Batcher 的 `push(item)` 收集条目，`flush()` 发送剩余条目并等待正在进行的回调完成；这个 batcher 会自动登记进宿主 Logger 的 `flush()` 追踪范围，不需要手动接入。
所有 Logger 自有错误都带 `source: '@migaia/logger'` 与下列稳定 `code`；业务日志入口通常不直接抛出 sink/plugin 失败，应通过 `onFailure()` 观察。

rows: 公开配置不可读或结构非法；修正配置，getter 原错误保留在 `cause`
pipeline 替换值的 time 非当前 realm Date；报告后交付原 entry
runtime 已进入 shutdown 后仍安装 process/logger；等待终结或不要安装 process plugin
process plugin 以不同配置重复安装；统一配置或卸载后重装
http plugin 找不到 `fetch`；注入 runtime fetch 或换宿主
HTTP payload 序列化失败；检查 `cause` 与待记录数据
非成功响应或可重试传输耗尽；检查 endpoint/网络并由业务决定补偿
retries 不是有限非负整数；构造前修正
flush/shutdown 到达绝对截止时间仍有工作；按降级交付处理，不要假设全部送达
process 安装失败且 listener 回滚也失败；展开 `AggregateError.errors`
plugin 最终卸载清理失败；检查 `cause`/`errors`，实例视为终结
shutdown 的 deadline task 或退出清理失败；保留 primary 与 cleanup 错误
failure hook 自身失败的诊断码；只走 runtime reporter，不递归抛给业务入口
logger 转发给自身；移除自引用
新 extends 边形成环；拆除环路
pending 满载：丢最老排队批次，全在途时丢新批次；检查 dropped 并按业务补偿
file 插件无注入的 `fs` 能力且无 Node 默认能力；注入 `fs` 或选择 Node 条件

blocks.text: 1. 构造函数只接受同步安装的插件。`new Logger({ plugins: [...] })` 里的插件必须能同步完成安装，需要异步安装的插件用 `await log.use(plugin)`。 2. 插件实例不能跨 logger 复用。每次安装都应该重新调用一次插件工厂函数（`level()`、`http()` 等），不要把同一个插件实例装到多个 `Logger`，否则内部状态可能串联。 3. `shutdown()` 之后日志被静默忽略，不会抛错也不会有任何提示——这是有意的（避免退出流程里到处加判断），需要感知的话订阅 `onFailure()` 或自行检查状态。 4. 日志系统内部的失败不会从业务调用抛出。`log.info()` 永远不会因为 sink 挂了而抛异常——务必用 `onFailure()` 观察，否则问题会悄悄消失。 5. `pipeline.mode` 构造后不可切换。sync stage 可提升到任意模式，generator stage 还可提升到 async-generator；其余不兼容组合会立即报 `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`，详见 USEGUIDE。 6. `http()` 通过 Feature 解析 batch provider：同批 `[batch(), http(...)]` 或反序均按依赖排序；跨调用晚装 batch 不会追溯重绑。 7. `extends()` 只转发运行时输出路径，不会把目标 logger 的 TypeScript 扩展方法合并进当前变量的类型。 8. 批处理队列有界且不会静默丢日志：`maxPendingBatches` 默认 `1024`，满载时抛出/上报 `BATCH_OVERFLOW`；生产环境应通过 `onFailure()` 监控并在下游恢复后再接纳新日志。

symbols.name: LoggerErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Table of the stable error codes of this package; values are the strings on `error.code`.
symbols.core:
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION`: an option is unreadable or invalid; fix it (`cause` keeps the getter error).
pipelineEntryInvalid: `PIPELINE_ENTRY_INVALID`: a stage replaced the entry without a valid `Date`; the original entry is delivered.
runtimeShuttingDown: `RUNTIME_SHUTTING_DOWN`: `process()` or a logger was installed while the process is shutting down.
pluginConfigConflict: `PLUGIN_CONFIG_CONFLICT`: `process()` installed again with a different configuration.
transportUnavailable: `TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE`: `http()` found no `fetch`; inject one in the runtime manager.
serializeFailed: `SERIALIZE_FAILED`: entries could not be turned into JSON; see `cause`.
deliveryFailed: `DELIVERY_FAILED`: upload got a failure response or ran out of retries, or a file write failed.
invalidRetryCount: `INVALID_RETRY_COUNT`: `retries` is not a finite non-negative integer.
lifecycleDeadline: `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE`: flush or shutdown reached its deadline with work left; delivery is not guaranteed.
processInstallRollbackFailed: `PROCESS_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`: `process()` install failed and removing its listeners failed too; read `errors`.
pluginUninstallCleanupFailed: `PLUGIN_UNINSTALL_CLEANUP_FAILED`: some cleanup of an uninstalled plugin failed; read `cause` / `errors`.
pluginShutdownCleanupFailed: `PLUGIN_SHUTDOWN_CLEANUP_FAILED`: cleanup during shutdown or exit failed; the primary error is kept.
hookFailed: `HOOK_FAILED`: an `onFailure` callback itself threw; reported to the console only, never thrown.
extendsSelf: `EXTENDS_SELF`: a logger was forwarded to itself.
extendsCycle: `EXTENDS_CYCLE`: a new `extends()` edge would form a cycle.
batchOverflow: `BATCH_OVERFLOW`: the pending batch limit was reached and the oldest queued batch was dropped.
fileSinkUnavailable: `FILE_SINK_UNAVAILABLE`: `file()` has no injected `fs` and no Node default.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Logger construction received an unreadable or structurally invalid public option. The caller * must fix the option; the native `TypeError` keeps the original accessor failure in `cause` when * one exists. Also rejects shutdown clock failure after admitted plugin cleanup has run.

members.name: pipelineEntryInvalid
members.description: A pipeline supplied a replacement without a current-realm Date time. Dispatch reports this * native TypeError and keeps delivering the original entry; the plugin must preserve its Date.

members.name: runtimeShuttingDown
members.description: Process plugin/logger installation is attempted while runtime shutdown is already in progress. * Enforces logger SDD §4.3 and §5.1: shutdown admission is terminal for that runtime. The caller * must wait for shutdown to settle or install the logger without the process plugin.

members.name: pluginConfigConflict
members.description: Thrown when the process plugin is installed again with a different configuration. * * Use the same configuration or uninstall the plugin before reinstalling.

members.name: transportUnavailable
members.description: Thrown when the host runtime has no HTTP transport (`fetch`). * * Supply a runtime manager with `fetch` or use the HTTP plugin on a host that supports fetch.

members.name: serializeFailed
members.description: Thrown when serializing HTTP log entries fails. * * `cause` retains the original serialization error. Inspect the logged payload.

members.name: deliveryFailed
members.description: HTTP delivery receives a non-success response or exhausts retryable transport attempts. * Enforces logger SDD §4.5 and §5.3 (LG-R6-4/LG-R18); callers must inspect the endpoint/transport * and apply their own delivery remediation while logger failure policy contains the sink * failure.

members.name: invalidRetryCount
members.description: HTTP plugin construction receives a retry count that is not a finite non-negative integer. * Enforces logger SDD §4.5 (LG-R6-8); callers must correct the plugin configuration before * constructing or installing the logger.

members.name: lifecycleDeadline
members.description: A bounded logger flush or shutdown phase reaches its absolute deadline with work unfinished. * Enforces logger SDD §4.2 and §5.2 (LG-R6-5); callers must treat delivery as degraded and * inspect the reported pending work instead of assuming every entry was delivered.

members.name: processInstallRollbackFailed
members.description: Process plugin installation fails and listener rollback reports one or more additional errors. * Enforces logger SDD §4.3 and §5.3 (LG-R11); callers must inspect `AggregateError.errors`, fix * the primary installation failure, and verify runtime listeners before retrying installation.

members.name: pluginUninstallCleanupFailed
members.description: Logger plugin final uninstall cleanup attempted every registered action but one or more actions * failed. Enforces logger SDD LG-R23/LG-R24 and §5.5; callers must inspect the cause or * `AggregateError.errors` and may create a fresh plugin instance after runtime state resets. A * batcher whose final drain left entries undelivered reports this code with `detail.dropped`.

members.name: pluginShutdownCleanupFailed
members.description: Logger shutdown cleanup failed while cancelling a deadline task or invoking the captured exit * path. Enforces logger SDD LG-R24 and §5.5; callers must inspect the primary and cleanup errors * before deciding whether the process can continue.

members.name: hookFailed
members.description: Diagnostic code reported when a failure hook throws. It is not thrown itself. * * The reporter uses only `runtime.console.error` or `runtime.write`, preventing recursive failure * reporting.

members.name: extendsSelf
members.description: Thrown when `extends()` receives the current logger itself. * * Do not add a logger to its own forwarding targets.

members.name: extendsCycle
members.description: Thrown when `extends()` would create a forwarding cycle. The target logger can already forward * through its own targets back to the current logger. * * Inspect the forwarding graph and remove the cycle.

members.name: batchOverflow
members.description: A bounded batch/direct-HTTP owner had no admission slot for another full batch, so it dropped * the oldest queued batch (or the incoming one when every pending batch is in flight). Reported * through the logger failure path, not thrown to the producer; `detail.dropped` is the dropped * entry count. Callers should raise `maxPendingBatches` or relieve the slow batch callback.

members.name: fileSinkUnavailable
members.description: File plugin installation found neither an injected file-system capability nor the supported * Node default. Enforces R1 BZ35; callers must inject `fs` or use the Node condition.

blocks.text: 所有 Logger 自有错误都带 `source: '@migaia/logger'` 与下列稳定 `code`；业务日志入口通常不直接抛出 sink/plugin 失败，应通过 `onFailure()` 观察。

rows: 公开配置不可读或结构非法；修正配置，getter 原错误保留在 `cause`
pipeline 替换值的 time 非当前 realm Date；报告后交付原 entry
runtime 已进入 shutdown 后仍安装 process/logger；等待终结或不要安装 process plugin
process plugin 以不同配置重复安装；统一配置或卸载后重装
http plugin 找不到 `fetch`；注入 runtime fetch 或换宿主
HTTP payload 序列化失败；检查 `cause` 与待记录数据
非成功响应或可重试传输耗尽；检查 endpoint/网络并由业务决定补偿
retries 不是有限非负整数；构造前修正
flush/shutdown 到达绝对截止时间仍有工作；按降级交付处理，不要假设全部送达
process 安装失败且 listener 回滚也失败；展开 `AggregateError.errors`
plugin 最终卸载清理失败；检查 `cause`/`errors`，实例视为终结
shutdown 的 deadline task 或退出清理失败；保留 primary 与 cleanup 错误
failure hook 自身失败的诊断码；只走 runtime reporter，不递归抛给业务入口
logger 转发给自身；移除自引用
新 extends 边形成环；拆除环路
pending 满载：丢最老排队批次，全在途时丢新批次；检查 dropped 并按业务补偿
file 插件无注入的 `fs` 能力且无 Node 默认能力；注入 `fs` 或选择 Node 条件
