symbols.name: batch
symbols.purpose: Plugin adding no logger methods; it provides batching for HTTP and file consumers. Same-batch plugins are sorted by Feature dependencies, independent of array order; a provider installed in a later use call does not retroactively rebind consumers.
symbols.core:
config: Optional default batch settings; see `IBatchPluginConfig`.
A plugin object for one logger.
maxSize: Sends a batch as soon as it holds this many entries.
`20`.
maxWaitMs: Sends a non-empty batch at most this many milliseconds after its first entry arrived.
`2000`.
maxConcurrentBatches: How many batch callbacks may run at once; a positive safe integer.
`1`: batches are delivered one after another, in order.
maxPendingBatches: Limit of queued plus running batches. When full, the oldest queued batch is dropped and `BATCH_OVERFLOW` (with the dropped count) is reported to `onFailure()`.
`1024`.
flushTimeoutMs: Time budget of one batch drain during `flush()` and uninstall; entries still waiting afterwards are reported as not delivered.
`3000`.
asyncOutput: Runs a size-triggered batch callback through `defer()` instead of inside the logging call.
`true`.
After installation `http()` and `file()` installed later send entries in batches; it adds no logger methods. Its `batch` Feature offers `createBatcher()` to custom plugins.

import { Logger, setLoggerRuntimeManager } from '@migaia/logger'
import { batch, color, http, level, process, reasoning, uuid } from '@migaia/logger/plugins'

import { Logger } from '@migaia/logger'
import { file } from '@migaia/logger/plugins/file'

const logger = new Logger({
  execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false },
  plugins: [file({ path: 'logs/app.jsonl', batch: { maxSize: 20 } })]
})
logger.log('info', 'ready')
await logger.flush()
await logger.shutdown('manual')

const log = new Logger({
  execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false },
  context: ['worker'],
  plugins: [
    level({ level: 'info' }),
    uuid({ display: true }),
    batch({ maxSize: 50, maxWaitMs: 1000 }),
    http({ url: 'https://logs.example/v1/entries', batch: { maxSize: 50 } }),
    color({ format: 'pretty' }),
    process()
  ]
})

log.onFailure(({ source, error }) => reportLoggerFailure(source, error))
log.info('job started', { jobId: 'j_1' })
await log.flush()

declaredConfiguration.name: maxConcurrentBatches
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum number of batches executing at once. Defaults to one for lossless delivery.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxPendingBatches
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum number of queued or executing batches. Defaults to 1024. A full batch beyond it drops the oldest queued batch and reports `BATCH_OVERFLOW` with `detail.dropped`.

declaredConfiguration.name: flushTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Time budget in milliseconds for one `flush()` drain, including the drain on dispose. Defaults to 3000. Entries still buffered or queued when dispose reaches it are dropped and reported.

declaredConfiguration.name: asyncOutput
declaredConfiguration.description: Schedules a full-batch callback asynchronously when enabled. Defaults to `true`; timer-triggered callbacks are already asynchronous.

blocks.text: Batcher 的 `push(item)` 收集条目，`flush()` 发送剩余条目并等待正在进行的回调完成；这个 batcher 会自动登记进宿主 Logger 的 `flush()` 追踪范围，不需要手动接入。

rows: 网络错误、429、5xx 情况下的额外重试次数。
单次请求最长等待时间；超时会 abort 当前请求并按网络错误处理。
覆盖传给 `batch()` shared factory 的配置。

blocks.text: 4xx 错误（429 除外）会直接失败、不重试；429 优先读取响应的 `Retry-After` 头部作为等待时间，没有该头部时退回指数退避。关闭先排空最终日志，再在 HTTP 插件释放时 abort 剩余请求；失败由 `onFailure()` 观察。同一批安装的 batch/http 按 Feature 依赖排序，`[http(...), batch()]` 同样生效；跨 use 调用晚装 provider 不会追溯重绑。没有 batch provider 时，指定 http.batch 仍启用本地有界队列，但强制 maxSize:1、asyncOutput:false。
所有 Logger 自有错误都带 `source: '@migaia/logger'` 与下列稳定 `code`；业务日志入口通常不直接抛出 sink/plugin 失败，应通过 `onFailure()` 观察。

rows: 公开配置不可读或结构非法；修正配置，getter 原错误保留在 `cause`
pipeline 替换值的 time 非当前 realm Date；报告后交付原 entry
runtime 已进入 shutdown 后仍安装 process/logger；等待终结或不要安装 process plugin
process plugin 以不同配置重复安装；统一配置或卸载后重装
http plugin 找不到 `fetch`；注入 runtime fetch 或换宿主
HTTP payload 序列化失败；检查 `cause` 与待记录数据
非成功响应或可重试传输耗尽；检查 endpoint/网络并由业务决定补偿
retries 不是有限非负整数；构造前修正
flush/shutdown 到达绝对截止时间仍有工作；按降级交付处理，不要假设全部送达
process 安装失败且 listener 回滚也失败；展开 `AggregateError.errors`
plugin 最终卸载清理失败；检查 `cause`/`errors`，实例视为终结
shutdown 的 deadline task 或退出清理失败；保留 primary 与 cleanup 错误
failure hook 自身失败的诊断码；只走 runtime reporter，不递归抛给业务入口
logger 转发给自身；移除自引用
新 extends 边形成环；拆除环路
pending 满载：丢最老排队批次，全在途时丢新批次；检查 dropped 并按业务补偿
file 插件无注入的 `fs` 能力且无 Node 默认能力；注入 `fs` 或选择 Node 条件

blocks.text: 1. 构造函数只接受同步安装的插件。`new Logger({ plugins: [...] })` 里的插件必须能同步完成安装，需要异步安装的插件用 `await log.use(plugin)`。 2. 插件实例不能跨 logger 复用。每次安装都应该重新调用一次插件工厂函数（`level()`、`http()` 等），不要把同一个插件实例装到多个 `Logger`，否则内部状态可能串联。 3. `shutdown()` 之后日志被静默忽略，不会抛错也不会有任何提示——这是有意的（避免退出流程里到处加判断），需要感知的话订阅 `onFailure()` 或自行检查状态。 4. 日志系统内部的失败不会从业务调用抛出。`log.info()` 永远不会因为 sink 挂了而抛异常——务必用 `onFailure()` 观察，否则问题会悄悄消失。 5. `pipeline.mode` 构造后不可切换。sync stage 可提升到任意模式，generator stage 还可提升到 async-generator；其余不兼容组合会立即报 `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`，详见 USEGUIDE。 6. `http()` 通过 Feature 解析 batch provider：同批 `[batch(), http(...)]` 或反序均按依赖排序；跨调用晚装 batch 不会追溯重绑。 7. `extends()` 只转发运行时输出路径，不会把目标 logger 的 TypeScript 扩展方法合并进当前变量的类型。 8. 批处理队列有界且不会静默丢日志：`maxPendingBatches` 默认 `1024`，满载时抛出/上报 `BATCH_OVERFLOW`；生产环境应通过 `onFailure()` 监控并在下游恢复后再接纳新日志。

symbols.name: color
symbols.purpose: Prints readable lines or JSON with optional ANSI colors, using captured runtimeManager.console in preference to write. To capture output replace that console or supply a pure write manager without console. It offers paint/dim to reasoning().
symbols.core:
config: Optional; see `IColorPluginConfig`.
A plugin object for one logger.
color: Whether ANSI colors are used.
`auto`.
format: Output format of each entry.
`LOG_FORMAT` if set; otherwise `pretty` in CI or a terminal, `json` when stdout is redirected.
One readable line: time, `[LEVEL]`, context, message and arguments.
One JSON object per line, for log collectors.
timestamp: Prefix pretty lines with the ISO time.
`true`.
colorMessage: Which part of the message and arguments is colored like the tag.
`none`.
Color the message text.
Color the last argument (or the message when there are no arguments).
Color the message and the last argument.
Color the message and every primitive argument.
Color nothing but the tag.
colorMap: Paint function per tag, for custom tags such as `audit`; unknown tags stay uncolored.
Built-in colors for the five levels.
After installation every entry is printed to the console (pretty or JSON, colored or not). Entries with `data.silent === true` are skipped. No methods are added; the `color` Feature offers `paint` and `dim`.

symbols.purpose: Sends POST { entries } JSON with retries, timeout and Retry-After. A batch provider installed earlier or in the same dependency-sorted batch enables shared batching. config: Required; see `IHttpPluginConfig` (`url` is required).
A plugin object; invalid `retries` throw `INVALID_RETRY_COUNT`.
url: Endpoint that receives the `POST { entries }` JSON requests.
authToken: Token issued by the log collector, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Not set: no authorization header.
headers: Extra request headers added to every upload request.
`{}`.
retries: Extra attempts after network errors, 429 and 5xx; other 4xx fail immediately. Waiting uses Retry-After or 200 ms × 2^attempt. Omitted config remains absent; the send path consumes retries ?? 2.

requestTimeoutMs: Maximum time of one request; on timeout it is aborted and handled like a network error.
`10000`.
batch: Upload queue settings. An earlier or same-batch Feature provider supplies shared batching regardless of input order. Without a provider, this option still creates a bounded local queue forced to maxSize:1 and asyncOutput:false; other queue bounds apply.
Not set: the `batch()` defaults.

`20`.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Sends POST { entries } JSON with retries, timeout and Retry-After. A batch provider installed earlier or in the same dependency-sorted batch enables shared batching. Without it, http.batch creates a bounded local queue forced to maxSize:1 and asyncOutput:false; no batch option uses a direct per-entry sink.

blocks.text: 4xx 错误（429 除外）会直接失败、不重试；429 优先读取响应的 `Retry-After` 头部作为等待时间，没有该头部时退回指数退避。关闭先排空最终日志，再在 HTTP 插件释放时 abort 剩余请求；失败由 `onFailure()` 观察。同一批安装的 batch/http 按 Feature 依赖排序，`[http(...), batch()]` 同样生效；跨 use 调用晚装 provider 不会追溯重绑。没有 batch provider 时，指定 http.batch 仍启用本地有界队列，但强制 maxSize:1、asyncOutput:false。
所有 Logger 自有错误都带 `source: '@migaia/logger'` 与下列稳定 `code`；业务日志入口通常不直接抛出 sink/plugin 失败，应通过 `onFailure()` 观察。

rows: 公开配置不可读或结构非法；修正配置，getter 原错误保留在 `cause`
pipeline 替换值的 time 非当前 realm Date；报告后交付原 entry
runtime 已进入 shutdown 后仍安装 process/logger；等待终结或不要安装 process plugin
process plugin 以不同配置重复安装；统一配置或卸载后重装
http plugin 找不到 `fetch`；注入 runtime fetch 或换宿主
HTTP payload 序列化失败；检查 `cause` 与待记录数据
非成功响应或可重试传输耗尽；检查 endpoint/网络并由业务决定补偿
retries 不是有限非负整数；构造前修正
flush/shutdown 到达绝对截止时间仍有工作；按降级交付处理，不要假设全部送达
process 安装失败且 listener 回滚也失败；展开 `AggregateError.errors`
plugin 最终卸载清理失败；检查 `cause`/`errors`，实例视为终结
shutdown 的 deadline task 或退出清理失败；保留 primary 与 cleanup 错误
failure hook 自身失败的诊断码；只走 runtime reporter，不递归抛给业务入口
logger 转发给自身；移除自引用
新 extends 边形成环；拆除环路
pending 满载：丢最老排队批次，全在途时丢新批次；检查 dropped 并按业务补偿
file 插件无注入的 `fs` 能力且无 Node 默认能力；注入 `fs` 或选择 Node 条件

blocks.text: 1. 构造函数只接受同步安装的插件。`new Logger({ plugins: [...] })` 里的插件必须能同步完成安装，需要异步安装的插件用 `await log.use(plugin)`。 2. 插件实例不能跨 logger 复用。每次安装都应该重新调用一次插件工厂函数（`level()`、`http()` 等），不要把同一个插件实例装到多个 `Logger`，否则内部状态可能串联。 3. `shutdown()` 之后日志被静默忽略，不会抛错也不会有任何提示——这是有意的（避免退出流程里到处加判断），需要感知的话订阅 `onFailure()` 或自行检查状态。 4. 日志系统内部的失败不会从业务调用抛出。`log.info()` 永远不会因为 sink 挂了而抛异常——务必用 `onFailure()` 观察，否则问题会悄悄消失。 5. `pipeline.mode` 构造后不可切换。sync stage 可提升到任意模式，generator stage 还可提升到 async-generator；其余不兼容组合会立即报 `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`，详见 USEGUIDE。 6. `http()` 通过 Feature 解析 batch provider：同批 `[batch(), http(...)]` 或反序均按依赖排序；跨调用晚装 batch 不会追溯重绑。 7. `extends()` 只转发运行时输出路径，不会把目标 logger 的 TypeScript 扩展方法合并进当前变量的类型。 8. 批处理队列有界且不会静默丢日志：`maxPendingBatches` 默认 `1024`，满载时抛出/上报 `BATCH_OVERFLOW`；生产环境应通过 `onFailure()` 监控并在下游恢复后再接纳新日志。

members.name: maxConcurrentBatches
members.description: Maximum number of batches executing at once. Defaults to one for lossless delivery.

members.name: maxPendingBatches
members.description: Maximum number of queued or executing batches. Defaults to 1024. A full batch beyond it drops the oldest queued batch and reports `BATCH_OVERFLOW` with `detail.dropped`.

members.name: flushTimeoutMs
members.description: Time budget in milliseconds for one `flush()` drain, including the drain on dispose. Defaults to 3000. Entries still buffered or queued when dispose reaches it are dropped and reported.

members.name: asyncOutput
members.description: Schedules a full-batch callback asynchronously when enabled. Defaults to `true`; timer-triggered callbacks are already asynchronous.

symbols.name: level
symbols.purpose: Plugin that adds `debug()` / `info()` / `warn()` / `error()` / `fatal()`, a minimum level and filters. Without it a logger only has `log(tag, message)`.
symbols.core:
config: Optional; see `ILevelPluginConfig`.
A plugin object for one logger.
level: Minimum level written; lower levels are dropped. Tags that are not level names always pass.
`debug`: everything passes.
filters: Filters `(entry) => boolean`; an entry passes only if all return `true`.
`[]`: no filters.
asyncOutput: Schedule entries created by `info()` and the other level methods with `defer()`.
`false`: output during the call.
Installs severity-based logging. debug(), info(), warn(), error() and fatal() create entries with the corresponding level. setLevel() changes the minimum level; addFilter() and removeFilter() register and remove output filters. Without this plugin, use the core log() method. Entries from debug(), info(), warn(), error() and fatal() reach output only when their level meets the configured minimum and every installed filter accepts them. Entries below the minimum or rejected by any filter are discarded. For all five methods, a string first argument becomes the message, while remaining arguments are kept for output. For example, info("Order %s", orderId) keeps the placeholder and orderId for the output handler. If the first argument is not a string, the message is empty and every argument is retained in the args array.
symbols.advanced: Level-based logging with runtime level changes.

blocks.text: `color` 会识别 `entry.data.silent === true` 并跳过打印这条 entry（但其他 sink，比如 HTTP，仍会正常接收它）——常用于"这条日志需要上报但不需要刷屏"的场景。

1. 构造函数只接受同步安装的插件。`new Logger({ plugins: [...] })` 里的插件必须能同步完成安装，需要异步安装的插件用 `await log.use(plugin)`。 2. 插件实例不能跨 logger 复用。每次安装都应该重新调用一次插件工厂函数（`level()`、`http()` 等），不要把同一个插件实例装到多个 `Logger`，否则内部状态可能串联。 3. `shutdown()` 之后日志被静默忽略，不会抛错也不会有任何提示——这是有意的（避免退出流程里到处加判断），需要感知的话订阅 `onFailure()` 或自行检查状态。 4. 日志系统内部的失败不会从业务调用抛出。`log.info()` 永远不会因为 sink 挂了而抛异常——务必用 `onFailure()` 观察，否则问题会悄悄消失。 5. `pipeline.mode` 构造后不可切换。sync stage 可提升到任意模式，generator stage 还可提升到 async-generator；其余不兼容组合会立即报 `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`，详见 USEGUIDE。 6. `http()` 通过 Feature 解析 batch provider：同批 `[batch(), http(...)]` 或反序均按依赖排序；跨调用晚装 batch 不会追溯重绑。 7. `extends()` 只转发运行时输出路径，不会把目标 logger 的 TypeScript 扩展方法合并进当前变量的类型。 8. 批处理队列有界且不会静默丢日志：`maxPendingBatches` 默认 `1024`，满载时抛出/上报 `BATCH_OVERFLOW`；生产环境应通过 `onFailure()` 监控并在下游恢复后再接纳新日志。

symbols.name: createPipeline
symbols.purpose: Creates a reusable, stateless middleware runner for one execution mode. The runner owns no stage list: each `run()` receives the stages, the input value and a final callback, so one pipeline can serve many hosts and concurrent runs. A sync/async stage continues by calling `next(value)`. Generator stages must return a payload, the configured continue signal (using the last yield), or the explicit undefined signal; yielding alone followed by an implicit undefined return halts without calling done.
symbols.core:
An `IMiddlewarePipeline` for the chosen mode and TSignals control domain, separate from TValue. Options are read once and frozen; invalid values or throwing option getters produce TypeError/INVALID_OPTION with the original getter failure on cause.
mode: Execution mode of every run. Stages must be written for this mode or converted with `lift()`.
onViolation: Receives `duplicate` or `late` when a stage misuses `next()`. The misuse never starts a second downstream run.
Not set: misuse is ignored silently.
assertActive: Called on entry and after each stage; throwing stops the run before the next stage starts. Hosts use it to stop runs once they are closing.
Not set: no lifecycle check.
signal: Default cancellation signal for every run; checked on entry, before and after each stage and before `done`. A run-level `signal` overrides it.
Not set: runs cannot be cancelled unless `run()` passes a signal.
signals: Replacement generator control signals `{ undefined, halt, continue }` for hosts with their own sentinels; three distinct symbols, read once at creation.
`MiddlewarePipelineGeneratorSignals` (the exported `GENERATOR_*` symbols).
combineStageAndDownstreamError: Only in async onion mode, combines independent stage and downstream failures. The same object propagated through await next is thrown once without calling the combiner; equal primitive values can still be independent failures. A successful custom result must retain both errors through cause/errors. If the combiner throws, its failure stays primary with both originals reachable.
Not set: an `AggregateError` with code `EXECUTION_FAILED` holds both errors.
symbols.advanced:
A logger runs filter, enrich and format stages before writing one entry.
A request client wraps each request in async onion middleware for auth, retry and timing.
A plugin host collects stages from installed plugins and runs them through one pipeline.
Every handler gets the same value and nobody transforms it: use `@migaia/event-subscriber`.

guidance.heading: 4. 取消与 host 生命周期

blocks.text: 四种 mode 都在进入 `run()`、每个 stage 开始前、每个 stage 返回后以及调用 `done` 前检查取消；generator 与 async-generator 还会在每次迭代后检查。已开始的 stage 不会被强制打断，应从收到的 `context.signal` 协作退出；原生 stage 与经 `lift()` 提升的 stage 收到同一个本次运行 signal。

取消错误保留原生类型、reason、`source`、`code` 和错误链。用户代码已经抛出或拒绝普通失败时，该失败保持为主错误，后续取消检查不会替换它。async stage 与下游分别出现两个独立普通失败时，仍由 `combineStageAndDownstreamError` 组合，未提供组合器时产生 `EXECUTION_FAILED`。pipeline 不拥有 controller，也不关闭 host；创建与处置这些资源仍是调用方职责。
自定义 `signal.reason` 的 getter 抛出时，抛出值按 reason 处理。

`assertActive`、stage、done 的 Error 在可附码时保留原对象/原生类型/stack；没有 semantic source/code 时附 EXECUTION_FAILED，已有外部身份不改写。不可修改错误或非 Error 值保留在包错误的 cause；abort reason 使用 ABORTED。它用于复用 host 已有的 generation、lease 或 scope 规则，而不是在本包中重新实现生命周期。

items: `run()` 的 `control.signal` 优先于构造时的 `signal`。
Error reason 尽量保留原生类型/对象；未分类 Error 附 ABORTED，已有外部 source/code 不改写；primitive/undefined reason 用普通 Error/ABORTED 的 cause 保留，未必是原生 AbortError。
四种 mode 都在进入 `run()`、每个 stage 开始前、每个 stage 返回后以及 `done` 前检查 signal；generator 类还会在每次迭代后检查。
已开始的 stage 不会被强制打断；它可以从 `context.signal` 读取本次运行实际采用的 signal 并协作退出。
用户代码已经抛出普通失败时，该失败保持为主错误，之后观察到的取消不会替换它；async stage 与下游分别失败时仍按组合器或 `EXECUTION_FAILED` 处理。
`assertActive` 在入口和每个 stage 之后执行，生命周期由 host 拥有。
同一 stage 重复或返回后调用 `next()` 会报告 `duplicate` 或 `late`；默认处理器为空操作。
同步与 generator 模式在调用栈内抛错；异步与 async-generator 模式返回 rejected Promise。

symbols.name: ICreatePipelineOptions
symbols.purpose: Options of createPipeline(); mode is required. Every public option and control getter is read once for its snapshot; getter failure becomes TypeError/INVALID_OPTION with cause. The validated mode is the value published by the runner.
symbols.core:
mode: Execution mode of every run. Stages must be written for this mode or converted with `lift()`.
onViolation: Receives `duplicate` or `late` when a stage misuses `next()`. The misuse never starts a second downstream run.
Not set: misuse is ignored silently.
assertActive: Called on entry and after each stage; throwing stops the run before the next stage starts. Hosts use it to stop runs once they are closing.
Not set: no lifecycle check.
signal: Default cancellation signal for every run; checked on entry, before and after each stage and before `done`. A run-level `signal` overrides it.
Not set: runs cannot be cancelled unless `run()` passes a signal.
signals: Replacement generator control signals `{ undefined, halt, continue }` for hosts with their own sentinels; three distinct symbols, read once at creation.
`MiddlewarePipelineGeneratorSignals` (the exported `GENERATOR_*` symbols).
combineStageAndDownstreamError: Only in async onion mode, combines independent stage and downstream failures. The same object propagated through await next is thrown once without calling the combiner; equal primitive values can still be independent failures. A successful custom result must retain both errors through cause/errors. If the combiner throws, its failure stays primary with both originals reachable.
Not set: an `AggregateError` with code `EXECUTION_FAILED` holds both errors.

symbols.name: IMiddlewarePipeline
symbols.purpose: The stateless runner returned by `createPipeline()`. It keeps only the mode and options; stages and values are supplied per run, so runs are isolated from each other.
symbols.core:
mode: The execution mode chosen at creation (`sync`, `async`, `generator`, `async-generator`); it never changes.
lift: Converts a stage written for another mode into this pipeline mode, in lossless directions only: sync into any mode, generator into async-generator. A lifted sync stage keeps its behaviour: code after `next()` still runs before downstream.
lift.stage: The stage to convert.
lift.from: Mode the stage was written for (`MiddlewarePipelineMode.*`).
A stage of this pipeline mode; same-mode lift preserves the stage. Sync-to-generator adapters use the configured runner halt/continue symbols, so no control symbol reaches done as payload and halt never calls done. Unsupported directions throw INVALID_OPTION.
Reuse simple sync stages (trim, validate, tag) in async or generator pipelines.
run: Runs `stages` in order on `value`. Each stage continues by calling `next(value)`; a stage that does not continue stops the run. After the last stage, `done(value)` receives the final value. In `sync` mode `next()` only hands the value over and downstream starts after the stage returns; in `async` mode `next()` starts downstream immediately and returns its Promise (onion model).
run.stages: Stages of this mode (lift others first); read only for this run.
run.value: Input value of the first stage.
run.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops or a generator returns `GENERATOR_HALT`.
run.control: `signal` for this run; it overrides the creation-time signal and is visible to stages as `context.signal`.
`void` in sync/generator and Promise<void> in async/async-generator. Error cancellation reasons retain native identity when writable; unclassified reasons receive ABORTED, foreign identities stay unchanged, and primitive or undefined reasons use ordinary Error with cause. Every async outer stage checks activity after returning, even after done; rejection does not undo done.

A logger runs filter, enrich and format stages before writing one entry.
A request client wraps each request in async onion middleware for auth, retry and timing.
A plugin host collects stages from installed plugins and runs them through one pipeline.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
mode: The execution mode chosen at creation (`sync`, `async`, `generator`, `async-generator`); it never changes.
lift: Converts a stage written for another mode into this pipeline mode, in lossless directions only: sync into any mode, generator into async-generator. A lifted sync stage keeps its behaviour: code after `next()` still runs before downstream.
lift.stage: The stage to convert.
lift.from: Mode the stage was written for (`MiddlewarePipelineMode.*`).
A stage of this pipeline mode; same-mode lift preserves the stage. Sync-to-generator adapters use the configured runner halt/continue symbols, so no control symbol reaches done as payload and halt never calls done. Unsupported directions throw INVALID_OPTION.
Reuse simple sync stages (trim, validate, tag) in async or generator pipelines.
run: Runs `stages` in order on `value`. Each stage continues by calling `next(value)`; a stage that does not continue stops the run. After the last stage, `done(value)` receives the final value. In `sync` mode `next()` only hands the value over and downstream starts after the stage returns; in `async` mode `next()` starts downstream immediately and returns its Promise (onion model).
run.stages: Stages of this mode (lift others first); read only for this run.
run.value: Input value of the first stage.
run.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops or a generator returns `GENERATOR_HALT`.
run.control: `signal` for this run; it overrides the creation-time signal and is visible to stages as `context.signal`.
`void` in sync/generator and Promise<void> in async/async-generator. Error cancellation reasons retain native identity when writable; unclassified reasons receive ABORTED, foreign identities stay unchanged, and primitive or undefined reasons use ordinary Error with cause. Every async outer stage checks activity after returning, even after done; rejection does not undo done.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
A logger runs filter, enrich and format stages before writing one entry.
A request client wraps each request in async onion middleware for auth, retry and timing.
A plugin host collects stages from installed plugins and runs them through one pipeline.

guidance.heading: 4. 取消与 host 生命周期

blocks.text: 四种 mode 都在进入 `run()`、每个 stage 开始前、每个 stage 返回后以及调用 `done` 前检查取消；generator 与 async-generator 还会在每次迭代后检查。已开始的 stage 不会被强制打断，应从收到的 `context.signal` 协作退出；原生 stage 与经 `lift()` 提升的 stage 收到同一个本次运行 signal。

取消错误保留原生类型、reason、`source`、`code` 和错误链。用户代码已经抛出或拒绝普通失败时，该失败保持为主错误，后续取消检查不会替换它。async stage 与下游分别出现两个独立普通失败时，仍由 `combineStageAndDownstreamError` 组合，未提供组合器时产生 `EXECUTION_FAILED`。pipeline 不拥有 controller，也不关闭 host；创建与处置这些资源仍是调用方职责。
自定义 `signal.reason` 的 getter 抛出时，抛出值按 reason 处理。

`assertActive`、stage、done 的 Error 在可附码时保留原对象/原生类型/stack；没有 semantic source/code 时附 EXECUTION_FAILED，已有外部身份不改写。不可修改错误或非 Error 值保留在包错误的 cause；abort reason 使用 ABORTED。它用于复用 host 已有的 generation、lease 或 scope 规则，而不是在本包中重新实现生命周期。

items: `run()` 的 `control.signal` 优先于构造时的 `signal`。
Error reason 尽量保留原生类型/对象；未分类 Error 附 ABORTED，已有外部 source/code 不改写；primitive/undefined reason 用普通 Error/ABORTED 的 cause 保留，未必是原生 AbortError。
四种 mode 都在进入 `run()`、每个 stage 开始前、每个 stage 返回后以及 `done` 前检查 signal；generator 类还会在每次迭代后检查。
已开始的 stage 不会被强制打断；它可以从 `context.signal` 读取本次运行实际采用的 signal 并协作退出。
用户代码已经抛出普通失败时，该失败保持为主错误，之后观察到的取消不会替换它；async stage 与下游分别失败时仍按组合器或 `EXECUTION_FAILED` 处理。
`assertActive` 在入口和每个 stage 之后执行，生命周期由 host 拥有。
同一 stage 重复或返回后调用 `next()` 会报告 `duplicate` 或 `late`；默认处理器为空操作。
同步与 generator 模式在调用栈内抛错；异步与 async-generator 模式返回 rejected Promise。

blocks.text: `PluginHostErrorCode` 导出以下稳定错误码，均可通过 `error.code` 分支处理：

rows: Host 已完成卸载，不能再访问或变更。
Host 正在卸载，不能开始新的变更。
插件已安装，或同一批次中出现重复名字。
目标插件未安装（`unUse`/`config.update` 找不到对应插件）。
句柄所指插件当前已禁用；先启用该插件再访问。
插件因必需 provider 不可用而挂起；恢复 provider，或显式卸载该插件。
惰性插件尚未激活；先执行 `await host.activate(name)`。
`getFeature(name)` 请求了插件未声明的 feature。
必需 feature provider 尚未安装。
feature 引用形成依赖环；本批次不会执行任何 install。
卸载或禁用 provider 时仍有必需依赖者；查看 `detail.blockedBy`，或使用 `policy: 'cascade'`、`policy: 'suspend'` 或 `dryRun`。
`replace(name, next)` 的两个插件名不一致。
`replace()` 已提交新实现，但需要重启的依赖者重装失败；它们保持卸载。`cause` 为 `AggregateError`（首项为重装失败），`detail.dependents` 列出受影响插件；修复后重新安装它们。
插件定义含已退役或不受支持的字段（例如 `shared`）。
插件安装失败；原始错误位于 `cause`。
`useSync()` 即时安装遇到声明了 setup 的插件；改用 `use()`。
诊断（非抛出）：插件安装失败且回滚清理也失败；原始安装错误保持 primary（顶层码 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`），回滚失败经 `diagnostic` 上报。
插件 `install()` 返回值自带 `then` key；同步 `useSync()` 与异步 `use()` 一致拒绝，不会发布可被误当作 Promise 的扩展。
`openComposition()` 的目标不是本包登记的托管宿主。托管协议只对本包构造出的宿主开放，普通对象、另一份包副本产出的宿主都会被拒绝；不公开身份登记 writer，`defineHost` 也不接受 `receiver` 身份别名选项；组合方应先用 `isManagedHost()` 判定。
插件 `beforeRelease` 或卸载步骤失败；原始错误位于 `cause`，后续清理继续。
extension key 已被其他扩展占用；Host 协议保留键优先归为 `EXTENSION_RESERVED`。
extension key 与 `Object.prototype` 上的成员冲突（如 `toString`）。
extension key 是 Host 保留成员（包括 `config`、`use`、`dispose`、`then`、`Symbol.dispose`、`asyncDisposeKey`）。
诊断（非抛出）：`install()` 返回值上的非枚举 key 被有意忽略，未挂载到 Host；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报。
feature provider 被禁用；可启用该插件后重试。
feature provider 已卸载；需重新安装 provider。
在允许的插件生命周期之外注册资源或 pipeline stage；setup 尝试关闭后的 `context.onDispose` 先释放有效资源再抛此码。
插件生命周期钩子内，或 setup / beforeRelease 等待期间尝试变更 Host；该期间的 `config.update` 也同步抛此码，见 §8。
构造时传入的 pipeline mode 无效。
stage 不能由 middleware-pipeline runner 提升到 Host mode；顶层为带 Host 身份的 `PluginHostError`，`cause` 保留上游 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`，source 为 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`）。
同一次 stage 调用里重复调用了 `next()`。
诊断（非抛出）：stage 已经返回/完成之后才调用 `next()`；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报，该次调用被忽略。
pipeline 执行期间尝试注册新 stage。
async pipeline 的 stage 与 downstream 同时失败，聚合为 `errors` 顺序固定为 `[stageError, downstreamError]` 的 `AggregateError`。
mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待超过已配置的 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 阈值后被拒绝（默认未配置该阈值，不会触发）；不会中断已经开始执行的插件代码。语义是终止：该 mutation 不会再被执行。
`beforeRelease` 或 disposal 期间单个 pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer 等待超过 `disposeStepTimeoutMs`（默认 5000ms）仍未完成（含自依赖等待）。语义是降级继续：该步骤被计为失败，disposal 事务继续推进直至收敛到 `disposed`。
已取得执行权的 lifecycle hook 超过 mutation 预算；提交资格已撤销，协作插件应停止并清理其 operation 资源。
已取出的 extension 函数所属 registration 已被卸载或替换（禁用时为 `PLUGIN_DISABLED`）；调用方应从当前句柄重新读取 extension。
Host 关闭或普通 `unUse` 的 active pipeline 未在 drain 预算内归零；`unUse` 继续有界清理，但返回 `ok: false`、`errors` 包含此码，并经 diagnostic 报告。Host disposal 的物理完成另见其结果。
逻辑关闭已提交，但清理发生错误或尚未完成。读取 `cleanupErrors`。`cleanupComplete: false` 时继续观察 `physicalCompletion`。
config 值不满足准入的 plain-data 语法（如 symbol、非法原型、危险键名、descriptor、thenable）；调用方需改用受支持的取值。
config 输入存在引用循环；调用方需提供无环的值图。
配置 recipe、插件 update 或 defineHost disposal 中间件抛出未分类失败。可写原生 Error 保持实例、类型和 stack 并附身份；不可写错误或非 Error 值通过 cause 保留；已有完整 source/code 的外包错误保持不变。
入参校验失败（`TypeError`）：插件名/配置路径/pipeline stage/extension/domain core/资源 disposer/构造选项等输入不满足契约，检查用 `error instanceof TypeError`，不按 `PluginHostError` 分支。

blocks.text: `diagnostic` 是构造 `PluginHost` 时可选传入的回调（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`：`(message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`；被吞下改为上报的错误会以原始对象经 `error` 送达），用于接收"不构成错误、但值得关注"的信息：`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`，以及未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 时的队列排队等待提示（这一条不携带错误码）。`MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` 与 `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` 是正式抛出/reject 的错误，不再只经 `diagnostic` 上报。diagnostic 回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主的正常执行流程。

symbols.purpose: Defines a Feature: a capability one plugin provides to other plugins. The factory receives the provider core (with `featureExpose`) and the outputs of the Features it depends on, and returns the Feature output.

factory: `(core, dependencies) => output`.

descriptor: Object form `{ factory, dependencies }`.
An `IFeature` to put in a plugin `features` record.
A Feature is a capability one plugin provides to other plugins, not to application code. Declared in a provider `features` record, consumers reference it with `provider.getFeature(name)`; the host then installs providers first, injects the output as `core.features.<name>`, and refuses to remove or disable a provider that is still required.

`host.use(consumer, provider)` installs in dependency order; a cycle throws `DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`.

`host.replace(provider)` rebinds consumers with `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others.
A `batch` plugin shares its scheduler with `http` and `file` sinks.
A storage backend provides a reactive adapter Feature consumed by a live-query plugin.

symbols.purpose: Creates one frozen managed handle without subclassing. TPublicSurface, the optional fourth generic, adds domain-owned surface descriptors before freezing; accessors stay live and fluent pipeline registration returns the same handle with its domain members and issued identity. Canonical Host keys take precedence. Domain core and disposal callbacks remain options.
symbols.core:
options: Host options plus the domain hooks; see the options table.
One canonical frozen IHostHandle carrying TPublicSurface (empty by default). Surface option/descriptor reads happen before Runtime acquisition; unclassified read failures carry CALLBACK_FAILED with the original error retained.
host: The same options a `PluginHost` constructor takes.
surface: Domain public members installed on the canonical handle using own descriptors captured once before Runtime creation. Accessors stay live; canonical Host keys, including identity, remain reserved and take precedence. TPublicSurface defaults to an empty object.
Absent: the handle has no additional domain public members.
domainCore: Creates the domain core each plugin install receives; replaces `createPluginDomainCore()`.
Not set: plugins receive an empty domain core.
translateDisposalError: Maps host disposal errors to a domain error type.
Not set: errors are kept as they are.
dispose: Wraps disposal: call next exactly once. Completion is published before middleware runs, so reentrant calls share it and middleware runs once. Unclassified callback failures receive CALLBACK_FAILED; native identity or original cause remains reachable.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates one frozen managed handle without subclassing. TPublicSurface, the optional fourth generic, adds domain-owned surface descriptors before freezing; accessors stay live and fluent pipeline registration returns the same handle with its domain members and issued identity. Canonical Host keys take precedence. Domain core and disposal callbacks remain options.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import defineHost from @migaia/plugin-host, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use defineHost when its function contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when defineHost does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained function example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
options: Host options plus the domain hooks; see the options table.
One canonical frozen IHostHandle carrying TPublicSurface (empty by default). Surface option/descriptor reads happen before Runtime acquisition; unclassified read failures carry CALLBACK_FAILED with the original error retained.
host: The same options a `PluginHost` constructor takes.
surface: Domain public members installed on the canonical handle using own descriptors captured once before Runtime creation. Accessors stay live; canonical Host keys, including identity, remain reserved and take precedence. TPublicSurface defaults to an empty object.
Absent: the handle has no additional domain public members.
domainCore: Creates the domain core each plugin install receives; replaces `createPluginDomainCore()`.
Not set: plugins receive an empty domain core.
translateDisposalError: Maps host disposal errors to a domain error type.
Not set: errors are kept as they are.
dispose: Wraps disposal: call next exactly once. Completion is published before middleware runs, so reentrant calls share it and middleware runs once. Unclassified callback failures receive CALLBACK_FAILED; native identity or original cause remains reachable.
Not set: plain host disposal.

`replace(name, next)` 的两个插件名不一致。
`replace()` 已提交新实现，但需要重启的依赖者重装失败；它们保持卸载。`cause` 为 `AggregateError`（首项为重装失败），`detail.dependents` 列出受影响插件；修复后重新安装它们。

`useSync()` 即时安装遇到声明了 setup 的插件；改用 `use()`。
诊断（非抛出）：插件安装失败且回滚清理也失败；原始安装错误保持 primary（顶层码 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`），回滚失败经 `diagnostic` 上报。
插件 `install()` 返回值自带 `then` key；同步 `useSync()` 与异步 `use()` 一致拒绝，不会发布可被误当作 Promise 的扩展。
`openComposition()` 的目标不是本包登记的托管宿主。托管协议只对本包构造出的宿主开放，普通对象、另一份包副本产出的宿主都会被拒绝；不公开身份登记 writer，`defineHost` 也不接受 `receiver` 身份别名选项；组合方应先用 `isManagedHost()` 判定。
插件 `beforeRelease` 或卸载步骤失败；原始错误位于 `cause`，后续清理继续。
extension key 已被其他扩展占用；Host 协议保留键优先归为 `EXTENSION_RESERVED`。
extension key 与 `Object.prototype` 上的成员冲突（如 `toString`）。
extension key 是 Host 保留成员（包括 `config`、`use`、`dispose`、`then`、`Symbol.dispose`、`asyncDisposeKey`）。
诊断（非抛出）：`install()` 返回值上的非枚举 key 被有意忽略，未挂载到 Host；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报。
feature provider 被禁用；可启用该插件后重试。
feature provider 已卸载；需重新安装 provider。
在允许的插件生命周期之外注册资源或 pipeline stage；setup 尝试关闭后的 `context.onDispose` 先释放有效资源再抛此码。
插件生命周期钩子内，或 setup / beforeRelease 等待期间尝试变更 Host；该期间的 `config.update` 也同步抛此码，见 §8。

stage 不能由 middleware-pipeline runner 提升到 Host mode；顶层为带 Host 身份的 `PluginHostError`，`cause` 保留上游 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`，source 为 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`）。
同一次 stage 调用里重复调用了 `next()`。
诊断（非抛出）：stage 已经返回/完成之后才调用 `next()`；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报，该次调用被忽略。
pipeline 执行期间尝试注册新 stage。
async pipeline 的 stage 与 downstream 同时失败，聚合为 `errors` 顺序固定为 `[stageError, downstreamError]` 的 `AggregateError`。
mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待超过已配置的 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 阈值后被拒绝（默认未配置该阈值，不会触发）；不会中断已经开始执行的插件代码。语义是终止：该 mutation 不会再被执行。
`beforeRelease` 或 disposal 期间单个 pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer 等待超过 `disposeStepTimeoutMs`（默认 5000ms）仍未完成（含自依赖等待）。语义是降级继续：该步骤被计为失败，disposal 事务继续推进直至收敛到 `disposed`。
已取得执行权的 lifecycle hook 超过 mutation 预算；提交资格已撤销，协作插件应停止并清理其 operation 资源。
已取出的 extension 函数所属 registration 已被卸载或替换（禁用时为 `PLUGIN_DISABLED`）；调用方应从当前句柄重新读取 extension。
Host 关闭或普通 `unUse` 的 active pipeline 未在 drain 预算内归零；`unUse` 继续有界清理，但返回 `ok: false`、`errors` 包含此码，并经 diagnostic 报告。Host disposal 的物理完成另见其结果。
逻辑关闭已提交，但清理发生错误或尚未完成。读取 `cleanupErrors`。`cleanupComplete: false` 时继续观察 `physicalCompletion`。
config 值不满足准入的 plain-data 语法（如 symbol、非法原型、危险键名、descriptor、thenable）；调用方需改用受支持的取值。
config 输入存在引用循环；调用方需提供无环的值图。
配置 recipe、插件 update 或 defineHost disposal 中间件抛出未分类失败。可写原生 Error 保持实例、类型和 stack 并附身份；不可写错误或非 Error 值通过 cause 保留；已有完整 source/code 的外包错误保持不变。
入参校验失败（`TypeError`）：插件名/配置路径/pipeline stage/extension/domain core/资源 disposer/构造选项等输入不满足契约，检查用 `error instanceof TypeError`，不按 `PluginHostError` 分支。

blocks.text: `diagnostic` 是构造 `PluginHost` 时可选传入的回调（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`：`(message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`；被吞下改为上报的错误会以原始对象经 `error` 送达），用于接收"不构成错误、但值得关注"的信息：`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`，以及未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 时的队列排队等待提示（这一条不携带错误码）。`MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` 与 `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` 是正式抛出/reject 的错误，不再只经 `diagnostic` 上报。diagnostic 回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主的正常执行流程。

guidance.heading: Host 构造与生命周期 API

blocks.code: import { PluginHost, type IPluginHostOptions } from '@migaia/plugin-host'

blocks.text: `new Host(options)` —— `options` 必填。`TValue` 泛型不为 `never` 时才需要用到 pipeline。全部选项字段（`IPluginHostOptions`）：

items: `execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: number | false; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: number | false }`（必填）—— 分别限制一次 mutation 的执行时间和 pipeline 租约排空时间。两项均须显式提供。`false` 表示无限等待。
`pipeline?: { mode?: 'sync' | 'async' | 'generator' | 'async-generator' }` —— 默认 `'sync'`；运行期不能切换，非法值抛 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。

`diagnostic?: (message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`）—— 接收"不构成错误但值得关注"的信号（如 `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、队列等待）；被吞下而改为上报的错误（回滚/清理失败、换绑钩子失败、Feature 异步拒绝）会以原始对象经第三个参数送达，可沿 `cause`/`errors` 追溯；

`onDiagnosticFailure?: (error: unknown) => void` —— 诊断回调自身抛错或 reject 时收到那个失败对象；未提供（或它也抛错）时交给运行时的 `globalThis.reportError`（浏览器/Deno/Bun；Node 没有该接口，需要在 Node 观测时请显式提供）。不是函数抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；不是函数会抛 `TypeError`；诊断回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主正常执行流程。
`scheduler?: IScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间源，默认内部 `systemScheduler`；传入的对象必须提供 `now()`/`schedule()`，否则抛 `TypeError`。

`queueAdmissionTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待被拒绝的阈值。默认 `undefined`：只诊断、不拒绝（即默认情况下排队再久也不会触发 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`）；传 `false` 关闭一切队列等待相关的计时器和诊断；传具体数值后，等待超过该阈值会被移出队列并以 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` reject。
`queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs?: number | false` —— 未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`（拒绝阈值）时使用的诊断阈值，默认 `1000`；传 `false` 关闭该诊断计时器。

`disposeStepTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— 单个 disposer 步骤（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer）的最长等待时间，默认 `5000`；传 `false` 关闭普通步骤预算；managed removal 的有限 `pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 仍会限制其步骤等待。

blocks.text: 超时类选项传入非 `false` 的非有限非负数（负数、`NaN`、`Infinity`、非 `number`）一律抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）。
Host 实例方法/属性：

rows: 按 Feature 依赖拓扑安装；返回与输入同序的插件句柄 tuple。
依赖安全地卸载插件；执行结果的冻结 `affected` 只含实际生效步骤；drain 超时仍清理，但 `ok: false` 且记录 `PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT`。
永久关闭宿主并返回清理结果；重复调用及同步重入复用同一 Promise，defineHost disposal 中间件只运行一次。
`path: string`——插件名，或 `插件名.键` / `插件名.[下标].键`
同步读取；对象/数组返回冻结的只读快照；未知插件或路径返回 `undefined`。见下方说明。
Copy-on-Write 合并 patch，跑 `plugin.update(next, core)` 成功才提交。
构造时固定的 pipeline 模式。
sync stage 可提升到任意 Host mode。
仅 async mode 可用；`next()` 返回 Promise。
可用于 generator 与 async-generator mode，后者由 runner 提升。

blocks.text: 无法提升的组合会同步抛顶层 `PluginHostError`，`code === 'PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH'`；其 `cause` 是 middleware-pipeline 原始 `TypeError`，携带 `code === 'INVALID_OPTION'` 与 `source === '@migaia/middleware-pipeline'`。

`host.config.get(path)` 的路径语义：`path` 可以是"插件名"本身（返回该插件整份只读配置），也可以是 `插件名.键`（可继续 `.` 或 `.[下标]` 深入嵌套）。找不到匹配的插件、或路径中途缺失，返回 `undefined`（不抛错——读取是探测性操作）；`config.update(name, ...)` 对不存在的插件则抛 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`（写入是明确的意图表达，语义不对称）。以上两个方法都要求 Host 处于 `active` 状态，否则抛 `HOST_DISPOSING`/`HOST_DISPOSED`。

构造函数只接受同步安装的插件：`new Host({ plugins: ... })` 这种写法不存在——构造期插件走的是子类内部调用受保护的 `useSync(plugins)`，其中任何一个插件的 `install()` 返回 Promise 都会立即抛错；立即安装且声明 `setup` 的插件在任何 hook 执行前抛 `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`。需要准备阶段的插件应在宿主构造完成后用 `await host.use(plugin)`；惰性插件可先由 `useSync` 登记，再由 `activate()` 异步运行 setup。

items: `PluginHostError`：本包语义化错误的基类，`extends Error`，携带只读 `source`（恒为 `'@migaia/plugin-host'`）、`code: IPluginHostErrorCode`、可选 `detail`（结构化诊断字段，如队列超时的 `owner`/`waitedMs`）。常规插件名/配置路径/pipeline stage/extension/domain core/资源 disposer 等校验使用原生 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；退役定义字段使用原生 `TypeError`（`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`）；配置值和循环错误分别为 `PluginHostError`（`INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE` / `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`）。按具体 source/code 与原生类型分支。配置 recipe、update 和 defineHost disposal 中间件的未分类错误附 `CALLBACK_FAILED`；可写原生 Error 保持实例、类型、stack，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause；已有完整语义身份保持不变。
`PluginHostErrorCode`：稳定错误码常量对象，取值见 USEGUIDE §9。

句柄与依赖图新增的稳定码包括：`PLUGIN_DISABLED`、`PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`、`PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`、`FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`、`PREREQUISITE_MISSING`、`DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`、`DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`、`REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`、`DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`、`REGISTRATION_REVOKED`。其余生命周期、pipeline、配置与组合错误码及完整处理建议见 USEGUIDE §9。

blocks.text: 完整稳定码集合：`CALLBACK_FAILED`、`HOST_DISPOSED`、`HOST_DISPOSING`、`PLUGIN_DUPLICATE`、`PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`、`PLUGIN_DISABLED`、`PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`、`PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`、`FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`、`PREREQUISITE_MISSING`、`DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`、`DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`、`REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`、`DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`、`SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`、`PLUGIN_DISPOSE_FAILED`、`EXTENSION_DUPLICATE`、`EXTENSION_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE`、`EXTENSION_RESERVED`、`PREREQUISITE_DISABLED`、`PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`、`RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL`、`LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`、`INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`、`PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`、`PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE`、`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`PIPELINE_EXECUTING`、`PIPELINE_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、`MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`、`DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT`、`INVALID_OPTION`、`INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE`、`CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`、`MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT`、`REGISTRATION_REVOKED`、`INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE`、`PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT`、`CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE`、`COMPOSITION_TARGET_UNMANAGED`。

items: `ERROR_TEXT`（根入口的命名导出）：本包稳定的英文错误文案表，主要供内部构造错误消息使用；对外暴露是为了让下游包在自定义 `diagnostic` 回调里复用同一套措辞，一般无需直接调用。
`PluginHostStatus`：`{ active, closing, disposed }`——Host 的三态生命周期，`closing` 是 `dispose()` 已开始、尚未收敛的窗口。
`MiddlewarePipelineMode`：由 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline` 定义的模式常量；`host.pipelineMode` 返回其中之一。
`PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle`：`{ idle, install, dispose }`——单个插件注册记录当前所处的阶段，决定 `onDispose()`/pipeline 注册是否合法（只在 `install` 阶段允许）。一般只在自定义诊断/调试时需要引用。
`MiddlewarePipelineViolation`：由 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline` 定义的 `next()` 违规分类。

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Defines a plugin without installing it. Function form `definePlugin(name, (core) => ({ install, expose, featureExpose }), features?)` builds a fresh descriptor per install; object form `definePlugin({ name, config, setup, install, features, update, dispose, ... })` also declares configuration and lifecycle hooks. Nothing runs until `host.use(plugin)`.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import definePlugin from @migaia/plugin-host, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use definePlugin when its function contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when definePlugin does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained function example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
name: Plugin name (function form).
descriptorFactory: Function form: receives the install core and returns `{ install, expose?, featureExpose? }` for one installation.
featureRecord: Function form: Features this plugin provides or consumes.
definition: Object form: the whole plugin definition.
A plugin definition (`IDefinedPluginConstraint`) with `name`, the declared fields, and `getFeature(name)` for consumers. Invalid fields throw `INVALID_OPTION`; retired fields such as `shared` throw `PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`.
A plugin definition does nothing until installed. After `host.use(plugin)` the host gains: the object returned by `install` (and `expose`) on `handle.extensions` (derived hosts such as Logger also put these methods on the host itself); the pipeline stages the plugin registered; its Features for other plugins; its configuration under `host.config`; and cleanup of every resource it registered when it is removed.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
Stages registered with `core.usePipeline*` join every later host pipeline run in first-registration order.
Resources registered with `core.onDispose` or `context.onDispose` are released in reverse order when the plugin is removed or the host is disposed.
Package an optional capability (colored output, remote sink, cache) that users install only when needed.
Open a connection in async `setup`, publish typed methods in `install`, and let removal close it.

blocks.text: recipe 或插件 `update` 的未分类失败会附 `CALLBACK_FAILED`；已有完整语义身份保持不变，失败不提交配置。合法 PromiseLike 生命周期结果只同化一次。

`recipe` 必须同步返回 plain record（`readPlainDataRecord`：普通对象、非数组、可枚举 data property；`symbol` 键、`__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype` 键一律拒绝，抛 `TypeError`）。Host 对 patch 做 Copy-on-Write：只复制新增或替换的分支，未修改分支继续共享 Host 持有的不可变快照。`update()` 失败（插件 `update` 钩子抛错/拒绝）时旧配置保持不变，patch 不会被提交。插件在 `update(next)` 里通过只读参数 `next` 读取候选配置，而 `core.config.get()` 返回的始终是已提交的配置，两者在 `update` 执行期间可能不同。

`host.config.get(path)` 与 `host.config.update()` 都要求 Host 处于 active 状态；Host 开始卸载或卸载完成后会分别抛出 `HOST_DISPOSING` 或 `HOST_DISPOSED`。`get(path)` 对不存在的插件或缺失路径返回 `undefined`，而 `update(name, ...)` 对不存在的插件抛出 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`——两者的"找不到"语义不对称，是有意的：读取是探测性操作，写入是明确的意图表达。

members.name: DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT
members.signature: readonly DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT: (phase: string, waitedMs: number) => string;
members.description: 正式 SLA：单个 disposer（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer） 等待超过阈值仍未 settle，包括该 * disposer 反过来 await 了同一次 dispose() 调用自身这种 循环等待。不会中断 disposer 的执行（JS 无法安全撤销已经在跑的 Promise 链），只是停止 * 等待并把这一步计为失败，让整个 dispose 事务仍能收敛到 disposed。

members.description: Stable text for a callable captured from a logically revoked registration.

members.name: CAUSE_ATTACH_FAILED
members.description: Diagnostic text preserves failed secondary attachment without replacing the primary error.

members.name: PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT
members.description: Stable diagnostic text for an active pipeline that missed the disposal drain budget.

members.name: CLEANUP_FENCE_REJECTED
members.description: A composition fence rejection is reported while cleanup still proceeds after settlement.

members.name: BEFORE_CLEANUP_THENABLE
members.description: Composition cleanup fences accept PromiseLike values from any JavaScript realm.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Canonical English error text and message factories exported by the root entry. Downstream diagnostic adapters can reuse stable Host wording; error handling still branches on source/code rather than comparing message text.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import ERROR_TEXT from @migaia/plugin-host, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use ERROR_TEXT when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when ERROR_TEXT does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

items: `PluginHostError`：本包语义化错误的基类，`extends Error`，携带只读 `source`（恒为 `'@migaia/plugin-host'`）、`code: IPluginHostErrorCode`、可选 `detail`（结构化诊断字段，如队列超时的 `owner`/`waitedMs`）。常规插件名/配置路径/pipeline stage/extension/domain core/资源 disposer 等校验使用原生 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；退役定义字段使用原生 `TypeError`（`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`）；配置值和循环错误分别为 `PluginHostError`（`INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE` / `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`）。按具体 source/code 与原生类型分支。配置 recipe、update 和 defineHost disposal 中间件的未分类错误附 `CALLBACK_FAILED`；可写原生 Error 保持实例、类型、stack，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause；已有完整语义身份保持不变。
`PluginHostErrorCode`：稳定错误码常量对象，取值见 USEGUIDE §9。

句柄与依赖图新增的稳定码包括：`PLUGIN_DISABLED`、`PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`、`PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`、`FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`、`PREREQUISITE_MISSING`、`DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`、`DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`、`REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`、`DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`、`REGISTRATION_REVOKED`。其余生命周期、pipeline、配置与组合错误码及完整处理建议见 USEGUIDE §9。

`PluginHostStatus`：`{ active, closing, disposed }`——Host 的三态生命周期，`closing` 是 `dispose()` 已开始、尚未收敛的窗口。
`MiddlewarePipelineMode`：由 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline` 定义的模式常量；`host.pipelineMode` 返回其中之一。
`PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle`：`{ idle, install, dispose }`——单个插件注册记录当前所处的阶段，决定 `onDispose()`/pipeline 注册是否合法（只在 `install` 阶段允许）。一般只在自定义诊断/调试时需要引用。
`MiddlewarePipelineViolation`：由 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline` 定义的 `next()` 违规分类。

symbols.name: IDefinedPluginConstraint
symbols.purpose: The definition returned by `definePlugin()`: every `IPlugin` field plus `getFeature(name)` for consumers that depend on this plugin.
symbols.core:
name: Unique plugin name within a host. It addresses the plugin in `unUse`, `replace`, `config.get("name.key")` and Feature references, so it must not contain `.`.
config: Initial configuration. The host deep-copies and freezes it at install; read it with `core.config.get()` and change it with `host.config.update(name, recipe)`. Only plain data is accepted (`INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE`, `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`).
features: Features this plugin provides (defined with `defineFeature()`) and Features it consumes (references from `provider.getFeature(name)`). The host installs providers first and injects outputs as `core.features.<name>`.
activation: When the plugin installs: `eager` installs during `use()`; `lazy` only registers it and installs on `host.activate(name)` or when an eager plugin requires it.
`eager`: installed by `use()`.
Install immediately in `use()`.
Register only; install on first `activate()` or when required.
update: Called by `host.config.update(name, recipe)` with the candidate configuration `next` (read-only). Returning normally commits `next`; throwing or rejecting keeps the old configuration.
onEnable: Notification after the plugin becomes reachable: once after install, then after every real `enable`. Failures are only reported through `diagnostic`.
onDisable: Notification after the plugin was disabled (resources are kept). Failures are only reported.
onDependencyReplaced: Called on a dependent when a provider it requires was replaced with `host.replace()`. Rebinding to the new `outputs` here avoids a restart; without this hook (or when it throws) the dependent is restarted.
dispose: Plugin-level cleanup run on removal or host disposal, after `beforeRelease` and before resources registered with `onDispose` are released. Bounded by `disposeStepTimeoutMs`.
beforeRelease: Called once before an installed generation is released, while it can still serve calls; use it to flush or hand off work. `context.signal`, `deadlineAt` and `remainingMs()` describe the time budget. Failures are collected and release continues.
getFeature: Creates a reference to one Feature this plugin declares, for use in another plugin `defineFeature(factory, { name: reference })`. The reference makes this plugin a provider the consumer depends on.
getFeature.name: Name of a Feature in this plugin `features` record.
getFeature.options: `{ optional: true }` makes the dependency optional: the consumer installs even without this provider.
An `IFeatureReference` (provider name, feature name, optional flag). Unknown names throw `FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`.

symbols.name: IDefineHostOptions
symbols.purpose: Options of `defineHost()`.
symbols.core:
host: The same options a `PluginHost` constructor takes.
surface: Domain public members installed on the canonical handle using own descriptors captured once before Runtime creation. Accessors stay live; canonical Host keys, including identity, remain reserved and take precedence. TPublicSurface defaults to an empty object.
Absent: the handle has no additional domain public members.
domainCore: Creates the domain core each plugin install receives; replaces `createPluginDomainCore()`.
Not set: plugins receive an empty domain core.
translateDisposalError: Maps host disposal errors to a domain error type.
Not set: errors are kept as they are.
dispose: Wraps disposal: call next exactly once. Completion is published before middleware runs, so reentrant calls share it and middleware runs once. Unclassified callback failures receive CALLBACK_FAILED; native identity or original cause remains reachable.
Not set: plain host disposal.

symbols.name: IHostHandle
symbols.purpose: The object returned by defineHost, combining host operations with the application members supplied through surface. It is frozen, so callers cannot add, remove or reassign its own properties. Getters still run on each read and can show current state. TPublicSurface, the fourth generic parameter, describes application members and defaults to no additional members. The host identity belongs to this same object, and use*Pipeline methods return it for chaining. A stage is one function in the host processing pipeline. Stages registered by the host stay until host disposal removes them. Register stages before running the pipeline; registration during a run throws PIPELINE_EXECUTING, meaning that the active pipeline cannot be changed.
symbols.core:
identity: Immutable host identity `{ name, id }`: `name` from the `identity` option, `id` unique per host; used in errors and diagnostics.
plugin: Enable/disable controls: `plugin.disable(name)` hides a plugin (extensions, Features, stages) without releasing resources, `plugin.enable(name)` restores it in place, `plugin.disabled()` lists disabled names.
pipelineMode: Pipeline mode fixed at construction: `sync`, `async`, `generator` or `async-generator`.
revision: Counter of committed installation, removal, replacement, configuration, enablement, stage-registration and terminal changes. Composition owners compare revision to detect stale snapshots; it remains readable after disposal.
config: Per-plugin configuration store. `config.get("plugin.key")` reads a frozen snapshot (unknown paths return `undefined`); `config.update(name, recipe)` merges a patch copy-on-write and commits only after the plugin `update` hook succeeds.
useSync: Installs synchronously and returns handles in input order. A declared setup immediately throws SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL. A thenable install result rejects as PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause; its later rejection is reported through the diagnostic third argument, not inserted retroactively into the immediate cause chain.
useSync.plugins: Plugin definitions with synchronous install.
The handle tuple in input order.
Building a host that must be usable right after construction.
use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
dispose: Closes permanently: stops new changes, drains pipelines and releases plugins with dependents first. The completion Promise is published before callbacks or abort listeners run; concurrent or reentrant disposal shares it, so cleanup middleware runs once. The lifecycle abort reason and later admission failure can be distinct instances with the same source/code.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult`: `cleanupErrors` lists cleanup failures; `cleanupComplete: false` means some cleanup is still running, observe `physicalCompletion`.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Adds an asynchronous processing function. Call await next(value) to wait for later functions, then perform any work that must happen after them. This is often called onion-style execution because functions wrap later work. The host must use async mode; another mode makes registration throw PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Adds a synchronous generator: a function that produces values step by step with yield. Use it when processing is written in that form. The host accepts it in generator mode and adapts it in async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Adds an asynchronous generator, which can wait for asynchronous work and produce values with yield. Use it for processing written as async function*. The host must use async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: The object returned by defineHost, combining host operations with the application members supplied through surface. It is frozen, so callers cannot add, remove or reassign its own properties. Getters still run on each read and can show current state. TPublicSurface, the fourth generic parameter, describes application members and defaults to no additional members. The host identity belongs to this same object, and use*Pipeline methods return it for chaining. A stage is one function in the host processing pipeline. Stages registered by the host stay until host disposal removes them. Register stages before running the pipeline; registration during a run throws PIPELINE_EXECUTING, meaning that the active pipeline cannot be changed.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
identity: Immutable host identity `{ name, id }`: `name` from the `identity` option, `id` unique per host; used in errors and diagnostics.
plugin: Enable/disable controls: `plugin.disable(name)` hides a plugin (extensions, Features, stages) without releasing resources, `plugin.enable(name)` restores it in place, `plugin.disabled()` lists disabled names.
pipelineMode: Pipeline mode fixed at construction: `sync`, `async`, `generator` or `async-generator`.
revision: Counter of committed installation, removal, replacement, configuration, enablement, stage-registration and terminal changes. Composition owners compare revision to detect stale snapshots; it remains readable after disposal.
config: Per-plugin configuration store. `config.get("plugin.key")` reads a frozen snapshot (unknown paths return `undefined`); `config.update(name, recipe)` merges a patch copy-on-write and commits only after the plugin `update` hook succeeds.
useSync: Installs synchronously and returns handles in input order. A declared setup immediately throws SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL. A thenable install result rejects as PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause; its later rejection is reported through the diagnostic third argument, not inserted retroactively into the immediate cause chain.
useSync.plugins: Plugin definitions with synchronous install.
The handle tuple in input order.
Building a host that must be usable right after construction.
use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
dispose: Closes permanently: stops new changes, drains pipelines and releases plugins with dependents first. The completion Promise is published before callbacks or abort listeners run; concurrent or reentrant disposal shares it, so cleanup middleware runs once. The lifecycle abort reason and later admission failure can be distinct instances with the same source/code.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult`: `cleanupErrors` lists cleanup failures; `cleanupComplete: false` means some cleanup is still running, observe `physicalCompletion`.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Adds an asynchronous processing function. Call await next(value) to wait for later functions, then perform any work that must happen after them. This is often called onion-style execution because functions wrap later work. The host must use async mode; another mode makes registration throw PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Adds a synchronous generator: a function that produces values step by step with yield. Use it when processing is written in that form. The host accepts it in generator mode and adapts it in async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Adds an asynchronous generator, which can wait for asynchronous work and produce values with yield. Use it for processing written as async function*. The host must use async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.

blocks.text: `PluginHostErrorCode` 导出以下稳定错误码，均可通过 `error.code` 分支处理：

rows: Host 已完成卸载，不能再访问或变更。
Host 正在卸载，不能开始新的变更。
插件已安装，或同一批次中出现重复名字。
目标插件未安装（`unUse`/`config.update` 找不到对应插件）。
句柄所指插件当前已禁用；先启用该插件再访问。
插件因必需 provider 不可用而挂起；恢复 provider，或显式卸载该插件。
惰性插件尚未激活；先执行 `await host.activate(name)`。
`getFeature(name)` 请求了插件未声明的 feature。
必需 feature provider 尚未安装。
feature 引用形成依赖环；本批次不会执行任何 install。
卸载或禁用 provider 时仍有必需依赖者；查看 `detail.blockedBy`，或使用 `policy: 'cascade'`、`policy: 'suspend'` 或 `dryRun`。
`replace(name, next)` 的两个插件名不一致。
`replace()` 已提交新实现，但需要重启的依赖者重装失败；它们保持卸载。`cause` 为 `AggregateError`（首项为重装失败），`detail.dependents` 列出受影响插件；修复后重新安装它们。
插件定义含已退役或不受支持的字段（例如 `shared`）。
插件安装失败；原始错误位于 `cause`。
`useSync()` 即时安装遇到声明了 setup 的插件；改用 `use()`。
诊断（非抛出）：插件安装失败且回滚清理也失败；原始安装错误保持 primary（顶层码 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`），回滚失败经 `diagnostic` 上报。
插件 `install()` 返回值自带 `then` key；同步 `useSync()` 与异步 `use()` 一致拒绝，不会发布可被误当作 Promise 的扩展。
`openComposition()` 的目标不是本包登记的托管宿主。托管协议只对本包构造出的宿主开放，普通对象、另一份包副本产出的宿主都会被拒绝；不公开身份登记 writer，`defineHost` 也不接受 `receiver` 身份别名选项；组合方应先用 `isManagedHost()` 判定。
插件 `beforeRelease` 或卸载步骤失败；原始错误位于 `cause`，后续清理继续。
extension key 已被其他扩展占用；Host 协议保留键优先归为 `EXTENSION_RESERVED`。
extension key 与 `Object.prototype` 上的成员冲突（如 `toString`）。
extension key 是 Host 保留成员（包括 `config`、`use`、`dispose`、`then`、`Symbol.dispose`、`asyncDisposeKey`）。
诊断（非抛出）：`install()` 返回值上的非枚举 key 被有意忽略，未挂载到 Host；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报。
feature provider 被禁用；可启用该插件后重试。
feature provider 已卸载；需重新安装 provider。
在允许的插件生命周期之外注册资源或 pipeline stage；setup 尝试关闭后的 `context.onDispose` 先释放有效资源再抛此码。
插件生命周期钩子内，或 setup / beforeRelease 等待期间尝试变更 Host；该期间的 `config.update` 也同步抛此码，见 §8。
构造时传入的 pipeline mode 无效。
stage 不能由 middleware-pipeline runner 提升到 Host mode；顶层为带 Host 身份的 `PluginHostError`，`cause` 保留上游 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`，source 为 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`）。
同一次 stage 调用里重复调用了 `next()`。
诊断（非抛出）：stage 已经返回/完成之后才调用 `next()`；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报，该次调用被忽略。
pipeline 执行期间尝试注册新 stage。
async pipeline 的 stage 与 downstream 同时失败，聚合为 `errors` 顺序固定为 `[stageError, downstreamError]` 的 `AggregateError`。
mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待超过已配置的 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 阈值后被拒绝（默认未配置该阈值，不会触发）；不会中断已经开始执行的插件代码。语义是终止：该 mutation 不会再被执行。
`beforeRelease` 或 disposal 期间单个 pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer 等待超过 `disposeStepTimeoutMs`（默认 5000ms）仍未完成（含自依赖等待）。语义是降级继续：该步骤被计为失败，disposal 事务继续推进直至收敛到 `disposed`。
已取得执行权的 lifecycle hook 超过 mutation 预算；提交资格已撤销，协作插件应停止并清理其 operation 资源。
已取出的 extension 函数所属 registration 已被卸载或替换（禁用时为 `PLUGIN_DISABLED`）；调用方应从当前句柄重新读取 extension。
Host 关闭或普通 `unUse` 的 active pipeline 未在 drain 预算内归零；`unUse` 继续有界清理，但返回 `ok: false`、`errors` 包含此码，并经 diagnostic 报告。Host disposal 的物理完成另见其结果。
逻辑关闭已提交，但清理发生错误或尚未完成。读取 `cleanupErrors`。`cleanupComplete: false` 时继续观察 `physicalCompletion`。
config 值不满足准入的 plain-data 语法（如 symbol、非法原型、危险键名、descriptor、thenable）；调用方需改用受支持的取值。
config 输入存在引用循环；调用方需提供无环的值图。
配置 recipe、插件 update 或 defineHost disposal 中间件抛出未分类失败。可写原生 Error 保持实例、类型和 stack 并附身份；不可写错误或非 Error 值通过 cause 保留；已有完整 source/code 的外包错误保持不变。
入参校验失败（`TypeError`）：插件名/配置路径/pipeline stage/extension/domain core/资源 disposer/构造选项等输入不满足契约，检查用 `error instanceof TypeError`，不按 `PluginHostError` 分支。

blocks.text: `diagnostic` 是构造 `PluginHost` 时可选传入的回调（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`：`(message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`；被吞下改为上报的错误会以原始对象经 `error` 送达），用于接收"不构成错误、但值得关注"的信息：`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`，以及未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 时的队列排队等待提示（这一条不携带错误码）。`MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` 与 `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` 是正式抛出/reject 的错误，不再只经 `diagnostic` 上报。diagnostic 回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主的正常执行流程。

guidance.heading: Host 构造与生命周期 API

blocks.code: import { PluginHost, type IPluginHostOptions } from '@migaia/plugin-host'

blocks.text: `new Host(options)` —— `options` 必填。`TValue` 泛型不为 `never` 时才需要用到 pipeline。全部选项字段（`IPluginHostOptions`）：

items: `execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: number | false; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: number | false }`（必填）—— 分别限制一次 mutation 的执行时间和 pipeline 租约排空时间。两项均须显式提供。`false` 表示无限等待。
`pipeline?: { mode?: 'sync' | 'async' | 'generator' | 'async-generator' }` —— 默认 `'sync'`；运行期不能切换，非法值抛 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。

`diagnostic?: (message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`）—— 接收"不构成错误但值得关注"的信号（如 `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、队列等待）；被吞下而改为上报的错误（回滚/清理失败、换绑钩子失败、Feature 异步拒绝）会以原始对象经第三个参数送达，可沿 `cause`/`errors` 追溯；

`onDiagnosticFailure?: (error: unknown) => void` —— 诊断回调自身抛错或 reject 时收到那个失败对象；未提供（或它也抛错）时交给运行时的 `globalThis.reportError`（浏览器/Deno/Bun；Node 没有该接口，需要在 Node 观测时请显式提供）。不是函数抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；不是函数会抛 `TypeError`；诊断回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主正常执行流程。
`scheduler?: IScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间源，默认内部 `systemScheduler`；传入的对象必须提供 `now()`/`schedule()`，否则抛 `TypeError`。

`queueAdmissionTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待被拒绝的阈值。默认 `undefined`：只诊断、不拒绝（即默认情况下排队再久也不会触发 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`）；传 `false` 关闭一切队列等待相关的计时器和诊断；传具体数值后，等待超过该阈值会被移出队列并以 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` reject。
`queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs?: number | false` —— 未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`（拒绝阈值）时使用的诊断阈值，默认 `1000`；传 `false` 关闭该诊断计时器。

`disposeStepTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— 单个 disposer 步骤（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer）的最长等待时间，默认 `5000`；传 `false` 关闭普通步骤预算；managed removal 的有限 `pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 仍会限制其步骤等待。

blocks.text: 超时类选项传入非 `false` 的非有限非负数（负数、`NaN`、`Infinity`、非 `number`）一律抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）。
Host 实例方法/属性：

blocks.text: 无法提升的组合会同步抛顶层 `PluginHostError`，`code === 'PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH'`；其 `cause` 是 middleware-pipeline 原始 `TypeError`，携带 `code === 'INVALID_OPTION'` 与 `source === '@migaia/middleware-pipeline'`。

`host.config.get(path)` 的路径语义：`path` 可以是"插件名"本身（返回该插件整份只读配置），也可以是 `插件名.键`（可继续 `.` 或 `.[下标]` 深入嵌套）。找不到匹配的插件、或路径中途缺失，返回 `undefined`（不抛错——读取是探测性操作）；`config.update(name, ...)` 对不存在的插件则抛 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`（写入是明确的意图表达，语义不对称）。以上两个方法都要求 Host 处于 `active` 状态，否则抛 `HOST_DISPOSING`/`HOST_DISPOSED`。

构造函数只接受同步安装的插件：`new Host({ plugins: ... })` 这种写法不存在——构造期插件走的是子类内部调用受保护的 `useSync(plugins)`，其中任何一个插件的 `install()` 返回 Promise 都会立即抛错；立即安装且声明 `setup` 的插件在任何 hook 执行前抛 `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`。需要准备阶段的插件应在宿主构造完成后用 `await host.use(plugin)`；惰性插件可先由 `useSync` 登记，再由 `activate()` 异步运行 setup。

items: `PluginHostError`：本包语义化错误的基类，`extends Error`，携带只读 `source`（恒为 `'@migaia/plugin-host'`）、`code: IPluginHostErrorCode`、可选 `detail`（结构化诊断字段，如队列超时的 `owner`/`waitedMs`）。常规插件名/配置路径/pipeline stage/extension/domain core/资源 disposer 等校验使用原生 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；退役定义字段使用原生 `TypeError`（`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`）；配置值和循环错误分别为 `PluginHostError`（`INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE` / `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`）。按具体 source/code 与原生类型分支。配置 recipe、update 和 defineHost disposal 中间件的未分类错误附 `CALLBACK_FAILED`；可写原生 Error 保持实例、类型、stack，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause；已有完整语义身份保持不变。
`PluginHostErrorCode`：稳定错误码常量对象，取值见 USEGUIDE §9。

句柄与依赖图新增的稳定码包括：`PLUGIN_DISABLED`、`PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`、`PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`、`FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`、`PREREQUISITE_MISSING`、`DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`、`DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`、`REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`、`DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`、`REGISTRATION_REVOKED`。其余生命周期、pipeline、配置与组合错误码及完整处理建议见 USEGUIDE §9。

blocks.text: 完整稳定码集合：`CALLBACK_FAILED`、`HOST_DISPOSED`、`HOST_DISPOSING`、`PLUGIN_DUPLICATE`、`PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`、`PLUGIN_DISABLED`、`PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`、`PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`、`FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`、`PREREQUISITE_MISSING`、`DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`、`DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`、`REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`、`DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`、`SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`、`PLUGIN_DISPOSE_FAILED`、`EXTENSION_DUPLICATE`、`EXTENSION_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE`、`EXTENSION_RESERVED`、`PREREQUISITE_DISABLED`、`PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`、`RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL`、`LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`、`INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`、`PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`、`PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE`、`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`PIPELINE_EXECUTING`、`PIPELINE_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、`MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`、`DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT`、`INVALID_OPTION`、`INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE`、`CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`、`MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT`、`REGISTRATION_REVOKED`、`INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE`、`PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT`、`CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE`、`COMPOSITION_TARGET_UNMANAGED`。

items: `ERROR_TEXT`（根入口的命名导出）：本包稳定的英文错误文案表，主要供内部构造错误消息使用；对外暴露是为了让下游包在自定义 `diagnostic` 回调里复用同一套措辞，一般无需直接调用。
`PluginHostStatus`：`{ active, closing, disposed }`——Host 的三态生命周期，`closing` 是 `dispose()` 已开始、尚未收敛的窗口。
`MiddlewarePipelineMode`：由 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline` 定义的模式常量；`host.pipelineMode` 返回其中之一。
`PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle`：`{ idle, install, dispose }`——单个插件注册记录当前所处的阶段，决定 `onDispose()`/pipeline 注册是否合法（只在 `install` 阶段允许）。一般只在自定义诊断/调试时需要引用。
`MiddlewarePipelineViolation`：由 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline` 定义的 `next()` 违规分类。

symbols.name: IPluginConstraint
symbols.purpose: Structural constraint every installable plugin satisfies.
symbols.core:
name: Unique plugin name within a host. It addresses the plugin in `unUse`, `replace`, `config.get("name.key")` and Feature references, so it must not contain `.`.
config: Initial configuration. The host deep-copies and freezes it at install; read it with `core.config.get()` and change it with `host.config.update(name, recipe)`. Only plain data is accepted (`INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE`, `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`).
features: Features this plugin provides (defined with `defineFeature()`) and Features it consumes (references from `provider.getFeature(name)`). The host installs providers first and injects outputs as `core.features.<name>`.

guidance.heading: Host 构造与生命周期 API

blocks.code: import { PluginHost, type IPluginHostOptions } from '@migaia/plugin-host'

blocks.text: `new Host(options)` —— `options` 必填。`TValue` 泛型不为 `never` 时才需要用到 pipeline。全部选项字段（`IPluginHostOptions`）：

items: `execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: number | false; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: number | false }`（必填）—— 分别限制一次 mutation 的执行时间和 pipeline 租约排空时间。两项均须显式提供。`false` 表示无限等待。
`pipeline?: { mode?: 'sync' | 'async' | 'generator' | 'async-generator' }` —— 默认 `'sync'`；运行期不能切换，非法值抛 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。

`diagnostic?: (message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`）—— 接收"不构成错误但值得关注"的信号（如 `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、队列等待）；被吞下而改为上报的错误（回滚/清理失败、换绑钩子失败、Feature 异步拒绝）会以原始对象经第三个参数送达，可沿 `cause`/`errors` 追溯；

`onDiagnosticFailure?: (error: unknown) => void` —— 诊断回调自身抛错或 reject 时收到那个失败对象；未提供（或它也抛错）时交给运行时的 `globalThis.reportError`（浏览器/Deno/Bun；Node 没有该接口，需要在 Node 观测时请显式提供）。不是函数抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；不是函数会抛 `TypeError`；诊断回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主正常执行流程。
`scheduler?: IScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间源，默认内部 `systemScheduler`；传入的对象必须提供 `now()`/`schedule()`，否则抛 `TypeError`。

`queueAdmissionTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待被拒绝的阈值。默认 `undefined`：只诊断、不拒绝（即默认情况下排队再久也不会触发 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`）；传 `false` 关闭一切队列等待相关的计时器和诊断；传具体数值后，等待超过该阈值会被移出队列并以 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` reject。
`queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs?: number | false` —— 未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`（拒绝阈值）时使用的诊断阈值，默认 `1000`；传 `false` 关闭该诊断计时器。

`disposeStepTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— 单个 disposer 步骤（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer）的最长等待时间，默认 `5000`；传 `false` 关闭普通步骤预算；managed removal 的有限 `pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 仍会限制其步骤等待。

blocks.text: 超时类选项传入非 `false` 的非有限非负数（负数、`NaN`、`Infinity`、非 `number`）一律抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）。
Host 实例方法/属性：

rows: 按 Feature 依赖拓扑安装；返回与输入同序的插件句柄 tuple。
依赖安全地卸载插件；执行结果的冻结 `affected` 只含实际生效步骤；drain 超时仍清理，但 `ok: false` 且记录 `PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT`。
永久关闭宿主并返回清理结果；重复调用及同步重入复用同一 Promise，defineHost disposal 中间件只运行一次。
`path: string`——插件名，或 `插件名.键` / `插件名.[下标].键`
同步读取；对象/数组返回冻结的只读快照；未知插件或路径返回 `undefined`。见下方说明。
Copy-on-Write 合并 patch，跑 `plugin.update(next, core)` 成功才提交。
构造时固定的 pipeline 模式。
sync stage 可提升到任意 Host mode。
仅 async mode 可用；`next()` 返回 Promise。
可用于 generator 与 async-generator mode，后者由 runner 提升。

blocks.text: 无法提升的组合会同步抛顶层 `PluginHostError`，`code === 'PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH'`；其 `cause` 是 middleware-pipeline 原始 `TypeError`，携带 `code === 'INVALID_OPTION'` 与 `source === '@migaia/middleware-pipeline'`。

`host.config.get(path)` 的路径语义：`path` 可以是"插件名"本身（返回该插件整份只读配置），也可以是 `插件名.键`（可继续 `.` 或 `.[下标]` 深入嵌套）。找不到匹配的插件、或路径中途缺失，返回 `undefined`（不抛错——读取是探测性操作）；`config.update(name, ...)` 对不存在的插件则抛 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`（写入是明确的意图表达，语义不对称）。以上两个方法都要求 Host 处于 `active` 状态，否则抛 `HOST_DISPOSING`/`HOST_DISPOSED`。

构造函数只接受同步安装的插件：`new Host({ plugins: ... })` 这种写法不存在——构造期插件走的是子类内部调用受保护的 `useSync(plugins)`，其中任何一个插件的 `install()` 返回 Promise 都会立即抛错；立即安装且声明 `setup` 的插件在任何 hook 执行前抛 `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`。需要准备阶段的插件应在宿主构造完成后用 `await host.use(plugin)`；惰性插件可先由 `useSync` 登记，再由 `activate()` 异步运行 setup。
