`onDiagnosticFailure?: (error: unknown) => void` —— 诊断回调自身抛错或 reject 时收到那个失败对象；未提供（或它也抛错）时交给运行时的 `globalThis.reportError`（浏览器/Deno/Bun；Node 没有该接口，需要在 Node 观测时请显式提供）。不是函数抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；不是函数会抛 `TypeError`；诊断回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主正常执行流程。
`scheduler?: IScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间源，默认内部 `systemScheduler`；传入的对象必须提供 `now()`/`schedule()`，否则抛 `TypeError`。

`queueAdmissionTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待被拒绝的阈值。默认 `undefined`：只诊断、不拒绝（即默认情况下排队再久也不会触发 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`）；传 `false` 关闭一切队列等待相关的计时器和诊断；传具体数值后，等待超过该阈值会被移出队列并以 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` reject。
`queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs?: number | false` —— 未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`（拒绝阈值）时使用的诊断阈值，默认 `1000`；传 `false` 关闭该诊断计时器。

`disposeStepTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— 单个 disposer 步骤（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer）的最长等待时间，默认 `5000`；传 `false` 关闭普通步骤预算；managed removal 的有限 `pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 仍会限制其步骤等待。

blocks.text: 超时类选项传入非 `false` 的非有限非负数（负数、`NaN`、`Infinity`、非 `number`）一律抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）。
Host 实例方法/属性：

rows: 按 Feature 依赖拓扑安装；返回与输入同序的插件句柄 tuple。
依赖安全地卸载插件；执行结果的冻结 `affected` 只含实际生效步骤；drain 超时仍清理，但 `ok: false` 且记录 `PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT`。
永久关闭宿主并返回清理结果；重复调用及同步重入复用同一 Promise，defineHost disposal 中间件只运行一次。
`path: string`——插件名，或 `插件名.键` / `插件名.[下标].键`
同步读取；对象/数组返回冻结的只读快照；未知插件或路径返回 `undefined`。见下方说明。
Copy-on-Write 合并 patch，跑 `plugin.update(next, core)` 成功才提交。
构造时固定的 pipeline 模式。
sync stage 可提升到任意 Host mode。
仅 async mode 可用；`next()` 返回 Promise。
可用于 generator 与 async-generator mode，后者由 runner 提升。

blocks.text: 无法提升的组合会同步抛顶层 `PluginHostError`，`code === 'PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH'`；其 `cause` 是 middleware-pipeline 原始 `TypeError`，携带 `code === 'INVALID_OPTION'` 与 `source === '@migaia/middleware-pipeline'`。

`host.config.get(path)` 的路径语义：`path` 可以是"插件名"本身（返回该插件整份只读配置），也可以是 `插件名.键`（可继续 `.` 或 `.[下标]` 深入嵌套）。找不到匹配的插件、或路径中途缺失，返回 `undefined`（不抛错——读取是探测性操作）；`config.update(name, ...)` 对不存在的插件则抛 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`（写入是明确的意图表达，语义不对称）。以上两个方法都要求 Host 处于 `active` 状态，否则抛 `HOST_DISPOSING`/`HOST_DISPOSED`。

构造函数只接受同步安装的插件：`new Host({ plugins: ... })` 这种写法不存在——构造期插件走的是子类内部调用受保护的 `useSync(plugins)`，其中任何一个插件的 `install()` 返回 Promise 都会立即抛错；立即安装且声明 `setup` 的插件在任何 hook 执行前抛 `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`。需要准备阶段的插件应在宿主构造完成后用 `await host.use(plugin)`；惰性插件可先由 `useSync` 登记，再由 `activate()` 异步运行 setup。

symbols.name: IPluginHostCore
symbols.purpose: The core argument passed to a plugin during install(core) and update(next, core). It combines application services supplied by the host with that plugin's configuration, current-operation information, and methods for registering resources and processing functions. It does not expose use, unUse or dispose, so the plugin cannot manage the host through this argument. A plugin can register processing functions only inside its install callback. The host owns those registrations and removes them when that plugin is uninstalled. Registering later throws RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL, meaning that resource registration is outside the installation period.

operation: Current operation: `signal` and absolute `deadlineAt`.
lifecycle: Registration lifecycle; its `signal` aborts when this registration ends.
onDispose: Transfers a resource to the registration during install, for reverse-order cleanup. Outside this core window RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL rejects without taking ownership or releasing it; the caller retains ownership. Only a late setup-context onDispose attempts release before rejecting.
onDispose.resource: Cleanup function or disposable object.
Nothing; the resource is now owned by the registration.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.

useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Adds an asynchronous generator, which can wait for asynchronous work and produce values with yield. Use it for processing written as async function*. The host must use async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Describes the core argument a plugin receives from a particular host. Use it in plugin type annotations to retain that host's application services together with plugin configuration and registration methods. A plugin can register processing functions only inside its install callback. The host owns those registrations and removes them when that plugin is uninstalled. Registering later throws RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL, meaning that resource registration is outside the installation period.

blocks.text: `PluginHostErrorCode` 导出以下稳定错误码，均可通过 `error.code` 分支处理：

rows: Host 已完成卸载，不能再访问或变更。
Host 正在卸载，不能开始新的变更。
插件已安装，或同一批次中出现重复名字。
目标插件未安装（`unUse`/`config.update` 找不到对应插件）。
句柄所指插件当前已禁用；先启用该插件再访问。
插件因必需 provider 不可用而挂起；恢复 provider，或显式卸载该插件。
惰性插件尚未激活；先执行 `await host.activate(name)`。
`getFeature(name)` 请求了插件未声明的 feature。
必需 feature provider 尚未安装。
feature 引用形成依赖环；本批次不会执行任何 install。
卸载或禁用 provider 时仍有必需依赖者；查看 `detail.blockedBy`，或使用 `policy: 'cascade'`、`policy: 'suspend'` 或 `dryRun`。
`replace(name, next)` 的两个插件名不一致。
`replace()` 已提交新实现，但需要重启的依赖者重装失败；它们保持卸载。`cause` 为 `AggregateError`（首项为重装失败），`detail.dependents` 列出受影响插件；修复后重新安装它们。
插件定义含已退役或不受支持的字段（例如 `shared`）。
插件安装失败；原始错误位于 `cause`。
`useSync()` 即时安装遇到声明了 setup 的插件；改用 `use()`。
诊断（非抛出）：插件安装失败且回滚清理也失败；原始安装错误保持 primary（顶层码 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`），回滚失败经 `diagnostic` 上报。
插件 `install()` 返回值自带 `then` key；同步 `useSync()` 与异步 `use()` 一致拒绝，不会发布可被误当作 Promise 的扩展。
`openComposition()` 的目标不是本包登记的托管宿主。托管协议只对本包构造出的宿主开放，普通对象、另一份包副本产出的宿主都会被拒绝；不公开身份登记 writer，`defineHost` 也不接受 `receiver` 身份别名选项；组合方应先用 `isManagedHost()` 判定。
插件 `beforeRelease` 或卸载步骤失败；原始错误位于 `cause`，后续清理继续。
extension key 已被其他扩展占用；Host 协议保留键优先归为 `EXTENSION_RESERVED`。
extension key 与 `Object.prototype` 上的成员冲突（如 `toString`）。
extension key 是 Host 保留成员（包括 `config`、`use`、`dispose`、`then`、`Symbol.dispose`、`asyncDisposeKey`）。
诊断（非抛出）：`install()` 返回值上的非枚举 key 被有意忽略，未挂载到 Host；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报。
feature provider 被禁用；可启用该插件后重试。
feature provider 已卸载；需重新安装 provider。
在允许的插件生命周期之外注册资源或 pipeline stage；setup 尝试关闭后的 `context.onDispose` 先释放有效资源再抛此码。
插件生命周期钩子内，或 setup / beforeRelease 等待期间尝试变更 Host；该期间的 `config.update` 也同步抛此码，见 §8。
构造时传入的 pipeline mode 无效。
stage 不能由 middleware-pipeline runner 提升到 Host mode；顶层为带 Host 身份的 `PluginHostError`，`cause` 保留上游 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`，source 为 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`）。
同一次 stage 调用里重复调用了 `next()`。
诊断（非抛出）：stage 已经返回/完成之后才调用 `next()`；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报，该次调用被忽略。
pipeline 执行期间尝试注册新 stage。
async pipeline 的 stage 与 downstream 同时失败，聚合为 `errors` 顺序固定为 `[stageError, downstreamError]` 的 `AggregateError`。
mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待超过已配置的 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 阈值后被拒绝（默认未配置该阈值，不会触发）；不会中断已经开始执行的插件代码。语义是终止：该 mutation 不会再被执行。
`beforeRelease` 或 disposal 期间单个 pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer 等待超过 `disposeStepTimeoutMs`（默认 5000ms）仍未完成（含自依赖等待）。语义是降级继续：该步骤被计为失败，disposal 事务继续推进直至收敛到 `disposed`。
已取得执行权的 lifecycle hook 超过 mutation 预算；提交资格已撤销，协作插件应停止并清理其 operation 资源。
已取出的 extension 函数所属 registration 已被卸载或替换（禁用时为 `PLUGIN_DISABLED`）；调用方应从当前句柄重新读取 extension。
Host 关闭或普通 `unUse` 的 active pipeline 未在 drain 预算内归零；`unUse` 继续有界清理，但返回 `ok: false`、`errors` 包含此码，并经 diagnostic 报告。Host disposal 的物理完成另见其结果。
逻辑关闭已提交，但清理发生错误或尚未完成。读取 `cleanupErrors`。`cleanupComplete: false` 时继续观察 `physicalCompletion`。
config 值不满足准入的 plain-data 语法（如 symbol、非法原型、危险键名、descriptor、thenable）；调用方需改用受支持的取值。
config 输入存在引用循环；调用方需提供无环的值图。
配置 recipe、插件 update 或 defineHost disposal 中间件抛出未分类失败。可写原生 Error 保持实例、类型和 stack 并附身份；不可写错误或非 Error 值通过 cause 保留；已有完整 source/code 的外包错误保持不变。
入参校验失败（`TypeError`）：插件名/配置路径/pipeline stage/extension/domain core/资源 disposer/构造选项等输入不满足契约，检查用 `error instanceof TypeError`，不按 `PluginHostError` 分支。

blocks.text: `diagnostic` 是构造 `PluginHost` 时可选传入的回调（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`：`(message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`；被吞下改为上报的错误会以原始对象经 `error` 送达），用于接收"不构成错误、但值得关注"的信息：`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`，以及未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 时的队列排队等待提示（这一条不携带错误码）。`MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` 与 `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` 是正式抛出/reject 的错误，不再只经 `diagnostic` 上报。diagnostic 回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主的正常执行流程。

guidance.heading: Host 构造与生命周期 API

blocks.code: import { PluginHost, type IPluginHostOptions } from '@migaia/plugin-host'

blocks.text: `new Host(options)` —— `options` 必填。`TValue` 泛型不为 `never` 时才需要用到 pipeline。全部选项字段（`IPluginHostOptions`）：

items: `execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: number | false; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: number | false }`（必填）—— 分别限制一次 mutation 的执行时间和 pipeline 租约排空时间。两项均须显式提供。`false` 表示无限等待。
`pipeline?: { mode?: 'sync' | 'async' | 'generator' | 'async-generator' }` —— 默认 `'sync'`；运行期不能切换，非法值抛 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。

`diagnostic?: (message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`）—— 接收"不构成错误但值得关注"的信号（如 `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、队列等待）；被吞下而改为上报的错误（回滚/清理失败、换绑钩子失败、Feature 异步拒绝）会以原始对象经第三个参数送达，可沿 `cause`/`errors` 追溯；

`onDiagnosticFailure?: (error: unknown) => void` —— 诊断回调自身抛错或 reject 时收到那个失败对象；未提供（或它也抛错）时交给运行时的 `globalThis.reportError`（浏览器/Deno/Bun；Node 没有该接口，需要在 Node 观测时请显式提供）。不是函数抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；不是函数会抛 `TypeError`；诊断回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主正常执行流程。
`scheduler?: IScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间源，默认内部 `systemScheduler`；传入的对象必须提供 `now()`/`schedule()`，否则抛 `TypeError`。

`queueAdmissionTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待被拒绝的阈值。默认 `undefined`：只诊断、不拒绝（即默认情况下排队再久也不会触发 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`）；传 `false` 关闭一切队列等待相关的计时器和诊断；传具体数值后，等待超过该阈值会被移出队列并以 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` reject。
`queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs?: number | false` —— 未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`（拒绝阈值）时使用的诊断阈值，默认 `1000`；传 `false` 关闭该诊断计时器。

`disposeStepTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— 单个 disposer 步骤（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer）的最长等待时间，默认 `5000`；传 `false` 关闭普通步骤预算；managed removal 的有限 `pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 仍会限制其步骤等待。

blocks.text: 超时类选项传入非 `false` 的非有限非负数（负数、`NaN`、`Infinity`、非 `number`）一律抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）。
Host 实例方法/属性：

rows: 按 Feature 依赖拓扑安装；返回与输入同序的插件句柄 tuple。
依赖安全地卸载插件；执行结果的冻结 `affected` 只含实际生效步骤；drain 超时仍清理，但 `ok: false` 且记录 `PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT`。
永久关闭宿主并返回清理结果；重复调用及同步重入复用同一 Promise，defineHost disposal 中间件只运行一次。
`path: string`——插件名，或 `插件名.键` / `插件名.[下标].键`
同步读取；对象/数组返回冻结的只读快照；未知插件或路径返回 `undefined`。见下方说明。
Copy-on-Write 合并 patch，跑 `plugin.update(next, core)` 成功才提交。
构造时固定的 pipeline 模式。
sync stage 可提升到任意 Host mode。
仅 async mode 可用；`next()` 返回 Promise。
可用于 generator 与 async-generator mode，后者由 runner 提升。

blocks.text: 无法提升的组合会同步抛顶层 `PluginHostError`，`code === 'PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH'`；其 `cause` 是 middleware-pipeline 原始 `TypeError`，携带 `code === 'INVALID_OPTION'` 与 `source === '@migaia/middleware-pipeline'`。

`host.config.get(path)` 的路径语义：`path` 可以是"插件名"本身（返回该插件整份只读配置），也可以是 `插件名.键`（可继续 `.` 或 `.[下标]` 深入嵌套）。找不到匹配的插件、或路径中途缺失，返回 `undefined`（不抛错——读取是探测性操作）；`config.update(name, ...)` 对不存在的插件则抛 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`（写入是明确的意图表达，语义不对称）。以上两个方法都要求 Host 处于 `active` 状态，否则抛 `HOST_DISPOSING`/`HOST_DISPOSED`。

构造函数只接受同步安装的插件：`new Host({ plugins: ... })` 这种写法不存在——构造期插件走的是子类内部调用受保护的 `useSync(plugins)`，其中任何一个插件的 `install()` 返回 Promise 都会立即抛错；立即安装且声明 `setup` 的插件在任何 hook 执行前抛 `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`。需要准备阶段的插件应在宿主构造完成后用 `await host.use(plugin)`；惰性插件可先由 `useSync` 登记，再由 `activate()` 异步运行 setup。

`scheduler?: IScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间源，默认内部 `systemScheduler`；传入的对象必须提供 `now()`/`schedule()`，否则抛 `TypeError`。

`queueAdmissionTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待被拒绝的阈值。默认 `undefined`：只诊断、不拒绝（即默认情况下排队再久也不会触发 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`）；传 `false` 关闭一切队列等待相关的计时器和诊断；传具体数值后，等待超过该阈值会被移出队列并以 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` reject。
`queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs?: number | false` —— 未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`（拒绝阈值）时使用的诊断阈值，默认 `1000`；传 `false` 关闭该诊断计时器。

`disposeStepTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— 单个 disposer 步骤（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer）的最长等待时间，默认 `5000`；传 `false` 关闭普通步骤预算；managed removal 的有限 `pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 仍会限制其步骤等待。

blocks.text: `PluginHostErrorCode` 导出以下稳定错误码，均可通过 `error.code` 分支处理：

rows: Host 已完成卸载，不能再访问或变更。
Host 正在卸载，不能开始新的变更。
插件已安装，或同一批次中出现重复名字。
目标插件未安装（`unUse`/`config.update` 找不到对应插件）。
句柄所指插件当前已禁用；先启用该插件再访问。
插件因必需 provider 不可用而挂起；恢复 provider，或显式卸载该插件。
惰性插件尚未激活；先执行 `await host.activate(name)`。
`getFeature(name)` 请求了插件未声明的 feature。
必需 feature provider 尚未安装。
feature 引用形成依赖环；本批次不会执行任何 install。
卸载或禁用 provider 时仍有必需依赖者；查看 `detail.blockedBy`，或使用 `policy: 'cascade'`、`policy: 'suspend'` 或 `dryRun`。
`replace(name, next)` 的两个插件名不一致。
`replace()` 已提交新实现，但需要重启的依赖者重装失败；它们保持卸载。`cause` 为 `AggregateError`（首项为重装失败），`detail.dependents` 列出受影响插件；修复后重新安装它们。
插件定义含已退役或不受支持的字段（例如 `shared`）。
插件安装失败；原始错误位于 `cause`。
`useSync()` 即时安装遇到声明了 setup 的插件；改用 `use()`。
诊断（非抛出）：插件安装失败且回滚清理也失败；原始安装错误保持 primary（顶层码 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`），回滚失败经 `diagnostic` 上报。
插件 `install()` 返回值自带 `then` key；同步 `useSync()` 与异步 `use()` 一致拒绝，不会发布可被误当作 Promise 的扩展。
`openComposition()` 的目标不是本包登记的托管宿主。托管协议只对本包构造出的宿主开放，普通对象、另一份包副本产出的宿主都会被拒绝；不公开身份登记 writer，`defineHost` 也不接受 `receiver` 身份别名选项；组合方应先用 `isManagedHost()` 判定。
插件 `beforeRelease` 或卸载步骤失败；原始错误位于 `cause`，后续清理继续。
extension key 已被其他扩展占用；Host 协议保留键优先归为 `EXTENSION_RESERVED`。
extension key 与 `Object.prototype` 上的成员冲突（如 `toString`）。
extension key 是 Host 保留成员（包括 `config`、`use`、`dispose`、`then`、`Symbol.dispose`、`asyncDisposeKey`）。
诊断（非抛出）：`install()` 返回值上的非枚举 key 被有意忽略，未挂载到 Host；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报。
feature provider 被禁用；可启用该插件后重试。
feature provider 已卸载；需重新安装 provider。
在允许的插件生命周期之外注册资源或 pipeline stage；setup 尝试关闭后的 `context.onDispose` 先释放有效资源再抛此码。
插件生命周期钩子内，或 setup / beforeRelease 等待期间尝试变更 Host；该期间的 `config.update` 也同步抛此码，见 §8。
构造时传入的 pipeline mode 无效。
stage 不能由 middleware-pipeline runner 提升到 Host mode；顶层为带 Host 身份的 `PluginHostError`，`cause` 保留上游 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`，source 为 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`）。
同一次 stage 调用里重复调用了 `next()`。
诊断（非抛出）：stage 已经返回/完成之后才调用 `next()`；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报，该次调用被忽略。
pipeline 执行期间尝试注册新 stage。
async pipeline 的 stage 与 downstream 同时失败，聚合为 `errors` 顺序固定为 `[stageError, downstreamError]` 的 `AggregateError`。
mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待超过已配置的 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 阈值后被拒绝（默认未配置该阈值，不会触发）；不会中断已经开始执行的插件代码。语义是终止：该 mutation 不会再被执行。
`beforeRelease` 或 disposal 期间单个 pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer 等待超过 `disposeStepTimeoutMs`（默认 5000ms）仍未完成（含自依赖等待）。语义是降级继续：该步骤被计为失败，disposal 事务继续推进直至收敛到 `disposed`。
已取得执行权的 lifecycle hook 超过 mutation 预算；提交资格已撤销，协作插件应停止并清理其 operation 资源。
已取出的 extension 函数所属 registration 已被卸载或替换（禁用时为 `PLUGIN_DISABLED`）；调用方应从当前句柄重新读取 extension。
Host 关闭或普通 `unUse` 的 active pipeline 未在 drain 预算内归零；`unUse` 继续有界清理，但返回 `ok: false`、`errors` 包含此码，并经 diagnostic 报告。Host disposal 的物理完成另见其结果。
逻辑关闭已提交，但清理发生错误或尚未完成。读取 `cleanupErrors`。`cleanupComplete: false` 时继续观察 `physicalCompletion`。
config 值不满足准入的 plain-data 语法（如 symbol、非法原型、危险键名、descriptor、thenable）；调用方需改用受支持的取值。
config 输入存在引用循环；调用方需提供无环的值图。
配置 recipe、插件 update 或 defineHost disposal 中间件抛出未分类失败。可写原生 Error 保持实例、类型和 stack 并附身份；不可写错误或非 Error 值通过 cause 保留；已有完整 source/code 的外包错误保持不变。
入参校验失败（`TypeError`）：插件名/配置路径/pipeline stage/extension/domain core/资源 disposer/构造选项等输入不满足契约，检查用 `error instanceof TypeError`，不按 `PluginHostError` 分支。

guidance.heading: Host 构造与生命周期 API

blocks.code: import { PluginHost, type IPluginHostOptions } from '@migaia/plugin-host'

blocks.text: `new Host(options)` —— `options` 必填。`TValue` 泛型不为 `never` 时才需要用到 pipeline。全部选项字段（`IPluginHostOptions`）：

items: `execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: number | false; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: number | false }`（必填）—— 分别限制一次 mutation 的执行时间和 pipeline 租约排空时间。两项均须显式提供。`false` 表示无限等待。
`pipeline?: { mode?: 'sync' | 'async' | 'generator' | 'async-generator' }` —— 默认 `'sync'`；运行期不能切换，非法值抛 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。

`diagnostic?: (message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`）—— 接收"不构成错误但值得关注"的信号（如 `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、队列等待）；被吞下而改为上报的错误（回滚/清理失败、换绑钩子失败、Feature 异步拒绝）会以原始对象经第三个参数送达，可沿 `cause`/`errors` 追溯；

`onDiagnosticFailure?: (error: unknown) => void` —— 诊断回调自身抛错或 reject 时收到那个失败对象；未提供（或它也抛错）时交给运行时的 `globalThis.reportError`（浏览器/Deno/Bun；Node 没有该接口，需要在 Node 观测时请显式提供）。不是函数抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；不是函数会抛 `TypeError`；诊断回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主正常执行流程。
`scheduler?: IScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间源，默认内部 `systemScheduler`；传入的对象必须提供 `now()`/`schedule()`，否则抛 `TypeError`。

`queueAdmissionTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待被拒绝的阈值。默认 `undefined`：只诊断、不拒绝（即默认情况下排队再久也不会触发 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`）；传 `false` 关闭一切队列等待相关的计时器和诊断；传具体数值后，等待超过该阈值会被移出队列并以 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` reject。
`queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs?: number | false` —— 未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`（拒绝阈值）时使用的诊断阈值，默认 `1000`；传 `false` 关闭该诊断计时器。

`disposeStepTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— 单个 disposer 步骤（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer）的最长等待时间，默认 `5000`；传 `false` 关闭普通步骤预算；managed removal 的有限 `pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 仍会限制其步骤等待。

blocks.text: 超时类选项传入非 `false` 的非有限非负数（负数、`NaN`、`Infinity`、非 `number`）一律抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）。
Host 实例方法/属性：

rows: 按 Feature 依赖拓扑安装；返回与输入同序的插件句柄 tuple。
依赖安全地卸载插件；执行结果的冻结 `affected` 只含实际生效步骤；drain 超时仍清理，但 `ok: false` 且记录 `PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT`。
永久关闭宿主并返回清理结果；重复调用及同步重入复用同一 Promise，defineHost disposal 中间件只运行一次。
`path: string`——插件名，或 `插件名.键` / `插件名.[下标].键`
同步读取；对象/数组返回冻结的只读快照；未知插件或路径返回 `undefined`。见下方说明。
Copy-on-Write 合并 patch，跑 `plugin.update(next, core)` 成功才提交。
构造时固定的 pipeline 模式。
sync stage 可提升到任意 Host mode。
仅 async mode 可用；`next()` 返回 Promise。
可用于 generator 与 async-generator mode，后者由 runner 提升。

blocks.text: 无法提升的组合会同步抛顶层 `PluginHostError`，`code === 'PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH'`；其 `cause` 是 middleware-pipeline 原始 `TypeError`，携带 `code === 'INVALID_OPTION'` 与 `source === '@migaia/middleware-pipeline'`。

`host.config.get(path)` 的路径语义：`path` 可以是"插件名"本身（返回该插件整份只读配置），也可以是 `插件名.键`（可继续 `.` 或 `.[下标]` 深入嵌套）。找不到匹配的插件、或路径中途缺失，返回 `undefined`（不抛错——读取是探测性操作）；`config.update(name, ...)` 对不存在的插件则抛 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`（写入是明确的意图表达，语义不对称）。以上两个方法都要求 Host 处于 `active` 状态，否则抛 `HOST_DISPOSING`/`HOST_DISPOSED`。

构造函数只接受同步安装的插件：`new Host({ plugins: ... })` 这种写法不存在——构造期插件走的是子类内部调用受保护的 `useSync(plugins)`，其中任何一个插件的 `install()` 返回 Promise 都会立即抛错；立即安装且声明 `setup` 的插件在任何 hook 执行前抛 `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`。需要准备阶段的插件应在宿主构造完成后用 `await host.use(plugin)`；惰性插件可先由 `useSync` 登记，再由 `activate()` 异步运行 setup。

guidance.heading: Host 构造与生命周期 API

blocks.code: import { PluginHost, type IPluginHostOptions } from '@migaia/plugin-host'

blocks.text: `new Host(options)` —— `options` 必填。`TValue` 泛型不为 `never` 时才需要用到 pipeline。全部选项字段（`IPluginHostOptions`）：

items: `execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: number | false; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: number | false }`（必填）—— 分别限制一次 mutation 的执行时间和 pipeline 租约排空时间。两项均须显式提供。`false` 表示无限等待。
`pipeline?: { mode?: 'sync' | 'async' | 'generator' | 'async-generator' }` —— 默认 `'sync'`；运行期不能切换，非法值抛 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。

`diagnostic?: (message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`）—— 接收"不构成错误但值得关注"的信号（如 `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、队列等待）；被吞下而改为上报的错误（回滚/清理失败、换绑钩子失败、Feature 异步拒绝）会以原始对象经第三个参数送达，可沿 `cause`/`errors` 追溯；

`onDiagnosticFailure?: (error: unknown) => void` —— 诊断回调自身抛错或 reject 时收到那个失败对象；未提供（或它也抛错）时交给运行时的 `globalThis.reportError`（浏览器/Deno/Bun；Node 没有该接口，需要在 Node 观测时请显式提供）。不是函数抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；不是函数会抛 `TypeError`；诊断回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主正常执行流程。
`scheduler?: IScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间源，默认内部 `systemScheduler`；传入的对象必须提供 `now()`/`schedule()`，否则抛 `TypeError`。

`queueAdmissionTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待被拒绝的阈值。默认 `undefined`：只诊断、不拒绝（即默认情况下排队再久也不会触发 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`）；传 `false` 关闭一切队列等待相关的计时器和诊断；传具体数值后，等待超过该阈值会被移出队列并以 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` reject。
`queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs?: number | false` —— 未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`（拒绝阈值）时使用的诊断阈值，默认 `1000`；传 `false` 关闭该诊断计时器。

`disposeStepTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— 单个 disposer 步骤（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer）的最长等待时间，默认 `5000`；传 `false` 关闭普通步骤预算；managed removal 的有限 `pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 仍会限制其步骤等待。

blocks.text: 超时类选项传入非 `false` 的非有限非负数（负数、`NaN`、`Infinity`、非 `number`）一律抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）。
Host 实例方法/属性：

rows: 按 Feature 依赖拓扑安装；返回与输入同序的插件句柄 tuple。
依赖安全地卸载插件；执行结果的冻结 `affected` 只含实际生效步骤；drain 超时仍清理，但 `ok: false` 且记录 `PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT`。
永久关闭宿主并返回清理结果；重复调用及同步重入复用同一 Promise，defineHost disposal 中间件只运行一次。
`path: string`——插件名，或 `插件名.键` / `插件名.[下标].键`
同步读取；对象/数组返回冻结的只读快照；未知插件或路径返回 `undefined`。见下方说明。
Copy-on-Write 合并 patch，跑 `plugin.update(next, core)` 成功才提交。
构造时固定的 pipeline 模式。
sync stage 可提升到任意 Host mode。
仅 async mode 可用；`next()` 返回 Promise。
可用于 generator 与 async-generator mode，后者由 runner 提升。

blocks.text: 无法提升的组合会同步抛顶层 `PluginHostError`，`code === 'PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH'`；其 `cause` 是 middleware-pipeline 原始 `TypeError`，携带 `code === 'INVALID_OPTION'` 与 `source === '@migaia/middleware-pipeline'`。

`host.config.get(path)` 的路径语义：`path` 可以是"插件名"本身（返回该插件整份只读配置），也可以是 `插件名.键`（可继续 `.` 或 `.[下标]` 深入嵌套）。找不到匹配的插件、或路径中途缺失，返回 `undefined`（不抛错——读取是探测性操作）；`config.update(name, ...)` 对不存在的插件则抛 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`（写入是明确的意图表达，语义不对称）。以上两个方法都要求 Host 处于 `active` 状态，否则抛 `HOST_DISPOSING`/`HOST_DISPOSED`。

构造函数只接受同步安装的插件：`new Host({ plugins: ... })` 这种写法不存在——构造期插件走的是子类内部调用受保护的 `useSync(plugins)`，其中任何一个插件的 `install()` 返回 Promise 都会立即抛错；立即安装且声明 `setup` 的插件在任何 hook 执行前抛 `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`。需要准备阶段的插件应在宿主构造完成后用 `await host.use(plugin)`；惰性插件可先由 `useSync` 登记，再由 `activate()` 异步运行 setup。

symbols.name: PluginHost
symbols.purpose: Base class of a plugin-capable host. A new host only manages plugins (install, remove, disable, replace, configure, dispose) and pipeline stages; every domain capability arrives through plugins. Subclasses provide the domain core plugins receive by overriding `createPluginDomainCore()`.
symbols.core:
options: Required IPluginHostOptions, including explicit mutation and pipeline-drain execution budgets; optional identity, pipeline and diagnostics configure this Host only.
A new empty PluginHost instance; install plugins to obtain domain capabilities and await dispose() when its lifetime ends. Invalid configuration throws before the instance is published.
identity: Immutable host identity `{ name, id }`: `name` from the `identity` option, `id` unique per host; used in errors and diagnostics.
plugin: Enable/disable controls: `plugin.disable(name)` hides a plugin (extensions, Features, stages) without releasing resources, `plugin.enable(name)` restores it in place, `plugin.disabled()` lists disabled names.
pipelineMode: Pipeline mode fixed at construction: `sync`, `async`, `generator` or `async-generator`.
revision: Counter of committed installation, removal, replacement, configuration, enablement, stage-registration and terminal changes. Composition owners compare revision to detect stale snapshots; it remains readable after disposal.
config: Per-plugin configuration store. `config.get("plugin.key")` reads a frozen snapshot (unknown paths return `undefined`); `config.update(name, recipe)` merges a patch copy-on-write and commits only after the plugin `update` hook succeeds.
useSync: Installs synchronously and returns handles in input order. A declared setup immediately throws SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL. A thenable install result rejects as PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause; its later rejection is reported through the diagnostic third argument, not inserted retroactively into the immediate cause chain.
useSync.plugins: Plugin definitions with synchronous install.
The handle tuple in input order.
Building a host that must be usable right after construction.
use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
dispose: Closes permanently: stops new changes, drains pipelines and releases plugins with dependents first. The completion Promise is published before callbacks or abort listeners run; concurrent or reentrant disposal shares it, so cleanup middleware runs once. The lifecycle abort reason and later admission failure can be distinct instances with the same source/code.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult`: `cleanupErrors` lists cleanup failures; `cleanupComplete: false` means some cleanup is still running, observe `physicalCompletion`.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Adds an asynchronous processing function. Call await next(value) to wait for later functions, then perform any work that must happen after them. This is often called onion-style execution because functions wrap later work. The host must use async mode; another mode makes registration throw PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Adds a synchronous generator: a function that produces values step by step with yield. Use it when processing is written in that form. The host accepts it in generator mode and adapts it in async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Adds an asynchronous generator, which can wait for asynchronous work and produce values with yield. Use it for processing written as async function*. The host must use async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
identity: Readable host name `{ name }`; a unique id is added by the runtime.
Not set: the host is unnamed and identified only by its id.
identity.name: Readable host name used in errors and diagnostics.
Omission uses DEFAULT as the name. The generated id combines that name with a sequence number, allowing diagnostics to distinguish host instances.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Mutation budget for installation/setup and update hooks; expiry aborts the operation and rolls back with MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. Removal hooks and disposers instead use disposeStepTimeoutMs, while pipeline draining uses its separate budget. false disables this mutation deadline.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Maximum time to wait for running pipelines before removal or replacement continues; `false` waits until none are running.
execution: Required execution budgets: mutationTimeoutMs bounds setup/install/update; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs bounds pipeline draining and is a shared managed-removal cleanup deadline. Ordinary removal steps use disposeStepTimeoutMs. false disables the corresponding deadline.
pipeline: Pipeline mode `{ mode }`; fixed after construction.
`{ mode: "sync" }`.
diagnostic: Receives notable events that are not errors (`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`, `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`, rollback failures, queue waits) as `(message, code?, error?)`. Its own failures never affect the host.
Not set: diagnostics are dropped.
onDiagnosticFailure: Receives the error when `diagnostic` itself throws or rejects.
Not set: the failure goes to `globalThis.reportError` when it exists.
scheduler: Clock and timers for queue and disposal timeouts; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
The system scheduler.
queueAdmissionTimeoutMs: How long a change may wait in the FIFO queue. A number rejects waiting work with `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` (running work is not interrupted); `false` disables queue timers and diagnostics.
Not set: long waits are only reported through `diagnostic`, never rejected.
queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs: Wait time after which a queued change is reported through `diagnostic` (only when `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` is not set); `false` disables it.
`1000` milliseconds.
disposeStepTimeoutMs: Maximum wait for one cleanup step (a stage disposer, a plugin `dispose`, a resource). A timed-out step is recorded as `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` and cleanup continues; `false` waits forever.
`5000` milliseconds per step.

An application composes cache, auth and telemetry as plugins that share capabilities through Features and are removed with full cleanup.
There are only one or two fixed extension points that never change at runtime: plain options or function composition are simpler.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Base class of a plugin-capable host. A new host only manages plugins (install, remove, disable, replace, configure, dispose) and pipeline stages; every domain capability arrives through plugins. Subclasses provide the domain core plugins receive by overriding `createPluginDomainCore()`.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import PluginHost from @migaia/plugin-host, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use PluginHost when its class contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when PluginHost does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained class example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
options: Required IPluginHostOptions, including explicit mutation and pipeline-drain execution budgets; optional identity, pipeline and diagnostics configure this Host only.
A new empty PluginHost instance; install plugins to obtain domain capabilities and await dispose() when its lifetime ends. Invalid configuration throws before the instance is published.
identity: Immutable host identity `{ name, id }`: `name` from the `identity` option, `id` unique per host; used in errors and diagnostics.
plugin: Enable/disable controls: `plugin.disable(name)` hides a plugin (extensions, Features, stages) without releasing resources, `plugin.enable(name)` restores it in place, `plugin.disabled()` lists disabled names.
pipelineMode: Pipeline mode fixed at construction: `sync`, `async`, `generator` or `async-generator`.
revision: Counter of committed installation, removal, replacement, configuration, enablement, stage-registration and terminal changes. Composition owners compare revision to detect stale snapshots; it remains readable after disposal.
config: Per-plugin configuration store. `config.get("plugin.key")` reads a frozen snapshot (unknown paths return `undefined`); `config.update(name, recipe)` merges a patch copy-on-write and commits only after the plugin `update` hook succeeds.
useSync: Installs synchronously and returns handles in input order. A declared setup immediately throws SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL. A thenable install result rejects as PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause; its later rejection is reported through the diagnostic third argument, not inserted retroactively into the immediate cause chain.
useSync.plugins: Plugin definitions with synchronous install.
The handle tuple in input order.
Building a host that must be usable right after construction.
use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
dispose: Closes permanently: stops new changes, drains pipelines and releases plugins with dependents first. The completion Promise is published before callbacks or abort listeners run; concurrent or reentrant disposal shares it, so cleanup middleware runs once. The lifecycle abort reason and later admission failure can be distinct instances with the same source/code.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult`: `cleanupErrors` lists cleanup failures; `cleanupComplete: false` means some cleanup is still running, observe `physicalCompletion`.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Adds an asynchronous processing function. Call await next(value) to wait for later functions, then perform any work that must happen after them. This is often called onion-style execution because functions wrap later work. The host must use async mode; another mode makes registration throw PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Adds a synchronous generator: a function that produces values step by step with yield. Use it when processing is written in that form. The host accepts it in generator mode and adapts it in async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Adds an asynchronous generator, which can wait for asynchronous work and produce values with yield. Use it for processing written as async function*. The host must use async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
identity: Readable host name `{ name }`; a unique id is added by the runtime.
Not set: the host is unnamed and identified only by its id.
identity.name: Readable host name used in errors and diagnostics.
Omission uses DEFAULT as the name. The generated id combines that name with a sequence number, allowing diagnostics to distinguish host instances.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Mutation budget for installation/setup and update hooks; expiry aborts the operation and rolls back with MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. Removal hooks and disposers instead use disposeStepTimeoutMs, while pipeline draining uses its separate budget. false disables this mutation deadline.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Maximum time to wait for running pipelines before removal or replacement continues; `false` waits until none are running.
execution: Required execution budgets: mutationTimeoutMs bounds setup/install/update; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs bounds pipeline draining and is a shared managed-removal cleanup deadline. Ordinary removal steps use disposeStepTimeoutMs. false disables the corresponding deadline.
pipeline: Pipeline mode `{ mode }`; fixed after construction.
`{ mode: "sync" }`.
diagnostic: Receives notable events that are not errors (`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`, `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`, rollback failures, queue waits) as `(message, code?, error?)`. Its own failures never affect the host.
Not set: diagnostics are dropped.
onDiagnosticFailure: Receives the error when `diagnostic` itself throws or rejects.
Not set: the failure goes to `globalThis.reportError` when it exists.
scheduler: Clock and timers for queue and disposal timeouts; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
The system scheduler.
queueAdmissionTimeoutMs: How long a change may wait in the FIFO queue. A number rejects waiting work with `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` (running work is not interrupted); `false` disables queue timers and diagnostics.
Not set: long waits are only reported through `diagnostic`, never rejected.
queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs: Wait time after which a queued change is reported through `diagnostic` (only when `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` is not set); `false` disables it.
`1000` milliseconds.
disposeStepTimeoutMs: Maximum wait for one cleanup step (a stage disposer, a plugin `dispose`, a resource). A timed-out step is recorded as `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` and cleanup continues; `false` waits forever.
`5000` milliseconds per step.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
A library (logger, store, RPC peer) extends `PluginHost` so users add optional plugins instead of more constructor options.
An application composes cache, auth and telemetry as plugins that share capabilities through Features and are removed with full cleanup.
There are only one or two fixed extension points that never change at runtime: plain options or function composition are simpler.

declaredConfiguration.name: identity
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional human-readable Host identity label; uniqueness is supplied by the runtime id.

declaredConfiguration.name: identity.name
declaredConfiguration.description: Public, immutable identity assigned by this module to one Host surface. */ export type IPluginHostIdentity = Readonly<{ /** Human-readable label supplied by the caller, or `DEFAULT` when omitted.

declaredConfiguration.name: execution
declaredConfiguration.type: { /** * Maximum time for one admitted install, update, or removal hook; `false` waits without a * deadline. */ readonly mutationTimeoutMs: number | false; /** * Maximum time to drain active pipeline leases before logical removal continues; `false` waits * until zero. */ readonly pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: number | false; }
declaredConfiguration.description: Explicit operation and pipeline drain budgets; `false` opts into unbounded waiting.

declaredConfiguration.name: execution.mutationTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum time for one admitted install, update, or removal hook; `false` waits without a * deadline.

declaredConfiguration.name: execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum time to drain active pipeline leases before logical removal continues; `false` waits * until zero.

declaredConfiguration.name: onDiagnosticFailure
declaredConfiguration.description: Terminal sink for failures of `diagnostic` itself (it threw or rejected). Receives the exact failure object; when absent, or when it throws too, the failure goes to the runtime's `globalThis.reportError` if one exists. Never affects Host control flow.

declaredConfiguration.name: scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Clock and scheduling source shared by the queue watchdog and disposal timeouts. Defaults to lifecycle `systemScheduler`.

declaredConfiguration.name: queueAdmissionTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Admission wait limit. `undefined` reports without rejecting; `false` disables timers, reports, and rejection; a number rejects and removes timed-out work.

declaredConfiguration.name: queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Diagnostic wait threshold when `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` is omitted. `false` disables its timer.

declaredConfiguration.name: disposeStepTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum wait for one disposal step. `false` waits indefinitely without triggering forced release.

blocks.text: recipe 或插件 `update` 的未分类失败会附 `CALLBACK_FAILED`；已有完整语义身份保持不变，失败不提交配置。合法 PromiseLike 生命周期结果只同化一次。

`recipe` 必须同步返回 plain record（`readPlainDataRecord`：普通对象、非数组、可枚举 data property；`symbol` 键、`__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype` 键一律拒绝，抛 `TypeError`）。Host 对 patch 做 Copy-on-Write：只复制新增或替换的分支，未修改分支继续共享 Host 持有的不可变快照。`update()` 失败（插件 `update` 钩子抛错/拒绝）时旧配置保持不变，patch 不会被提交。插件在 `update(next)` 里通过只读参数 `next` 读取候选配置，而 `core.config.get()` 返回的始终是已提交的配置，两者在 `update` 执行期间可能不同。

`host.config.get(path)` 与 `host.config.update()` 都要求 Host 处于 active 状态；Host 开始卸载或卸载完成后会分别抛出 `HOST_DISPOSING` 或 `HOST_DISPOSED`。`get(path)` 对不存在的插件或缺失路径返回 `undefined`，而 `update(name, ...)` 对不存在的插件抛出 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`——两者的"找不到"语义不对称，是有意的：读取是探测性操作，写入是明确的意图表达。

guidance.heading: 遍历中途 dispose 与生命周期 signal

blocks.text: 四种模式的 stage 都会在最后一个参数收到 `context`（generator 类 stage 是第二个参数），其中 `context.signal` 就是 host 的生命周期 signal：`dispose()` 开始时被中止，`reason` 是 Host 发出的取消错误。它与后续公开准入检查产生的 `PluginHostError` 可有相同 source/code，但不承诺同一对象；应按语义身份分类，不能用 `===` 判断它们属于同一次关闭。等待外部 I/O 的 stage 应监听或轮询它，以便及时退出。

遍历期间 `dispose()` 被调用后，遍历会在下一个协作检查点（进入 stage 前、stage 返回后、`next()` 派发时）中止：sync/generator 同步抛出，async/async-generator 的 Promise reject，错误为 `PluginHostError('HOST_DISPOSING', ...)`（仍在 `closing` 窗口）或 `PluginHostError('HOST_DISPOSED', ...)`（已到达 terminal）。两种都可能出现，调用方应统一按 `instanceof PluginHostError` 处理，不要依赖某个固定的 code。
中止与 stage 或下游的普通失败同时发生时，普通失败优先；只有一个普通失败时，原错误实例即为拒绝值。

1. `use()` 逐个安装批次内的插件；任一安装失败会把这次批次里已安装的插件按逆序回滚。 2. `unUse()` 先运行该代可选的 `beforeRelease(context)`。钩子运行时发布仍可用。随后等待 pipeline 租约，并撤销注册与 stage 可见性。最后运行插件 disposer，再逆序释放资源。`context.signal` 表示该代生命周期。`deadlineAt` 与 `remainingMs()` 使用 Host 调度器和 `disposeStepTimeoutMs`。每代最多运行一次钩子。钩子失败不会阻止后续释放。 3. 插件 lifecycle hook（包括 setup、beforeRelease）内禁止调用当前 Host 的 `use`、`unUse`、`config.update` 或 `dispose`；setup 或 beforeRelease 等待期间外部代码调用 Host mutation 或 `config.update` 也同步抛 `LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`。应用组合层负责维护插件之间的安装/卸载拓扑。 4. cleanup 报错时，Host 仍会撤销该插件的可发现状态。`unUse()` 返回 `{ ok: false, errors, affected }`。`dispose()` 在 `cleanupErrors` 中返回错误。两者都继续清理剩余资源。 5. Host 被 dispose 后，所有访问/变更 API 都会以 `PluginHostError` reject 或抛出；入口守卫（如内部的 `#assertActive()`）同步抛出，队列内运行时失败以 rejected Promise 返回。

安装失败统一以 `PluginHostError`（`PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`）返回，实际的插件安装错误位于 `cause`——原始安装错误恒为 primary，不会被后续的回滚失败覆盖。错误的 `detail` 同时保留失败插件名 `failedName` 与按回滚顺序排列的原始错误身份 `rollbackErrors`；异步 `use()` 的 detail 已完成，`useSync()` 的 detail 是不可变快照，完整 secondary identity 通过 `detail.completion` 的最终冻结结果取得。调用方应按身份处理，不应解析诊断文本。若回滚过程本身也失败，回滚失败仍经 `diagnostic` 回调上报（`code: 'PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED'`），是诊断信号，不是抛出的错误，也不会改写 primary 错误的 `cause`。
`PluginHostErrorCode` 导出以下稳定错误码，均可通过 `error.code` 分支处理：

rows: Host 已完成卸载，不能再访问或变更。
Host 正在卸载，不能开始新的变更。
插件已安装，或同一批次中出现重复名字。
目标插件未安装（`unUse`/`config.update` 找不到对应插件）。
句柄所指插件当前已禁用；先启用该插件再访问。
插件因必需 provider 不可用而挂起；恢复 provider，或显式卸载该插件。
惰性插件尚未激活；先执行 `await host.activate(name)`。
`getFeature(name)` 请求了插件未声明的 feature。
必需 feature provider 尚未安装。
feature 引用形成依赖环；本批次不会执行任何 install。
卸载或禁用 provider 时仍有必需依赖者；查看 `detail.blockedBy`，或使用 `policy: 'cascade'`、`policy: 'suspend'` 或 `dryRun`。
`replace(name, next)` 的两个插件名不一致。
`replace()` 已提交新实现，但需要重启的依赖者重装失败；它们保持卸载。`cause` 为 `AggregateError`（首项为重装失败），`detail.dependents` 列出受影响插件；修复后重新安装它们。
插件定义含已退役或不受支持的字段（例如 `shared`）。
插件安装失败；原始错误位于 `cause`。
`useSync()` 即时安装遇到声明了 setup 的插件；改用 `use()`。
诊断（非抛出）：插件安装失败且回滚清理也失败；原始安装错误保持 primary（顶层码 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`），回滚失败经 `diagnostic` 上报。
插件 `install()` 返回值自带 `then` key；同步 `useSync()` 与异步 `use()` 一致拒绝，不会发布可被误当作 Promise 的扩展。
`openComposition()` 的目标不是本包登记的托管宿主。托管协议只对本包构造出的宿主开放，普通对象、另一份包副本产出的宿主都会被拒绝；不公开身份登记 writer，`defineHost` 也不接受 `receiver` 身份别名选项；组合方应先用 `isManagedHost()` 判定。
插件 `beforeRelease` 或卸载步骤失败；原始错误位于 `cause`，后续清理继续。
extension key 已被其他扩展占用；Host 协议保留键优先归为 `EXTENSION_RESERVED`。
extension key 与 `Object.prototype` 上的成员冲突（如 `toString`）。
extension key 是 Host 保留成员（包括 `config`、`use`、`dispose`、`then`、`Symbol.dispose`、`asyncDisposeKey`）。
诊断（非抛出）：`install()` 返回值上的非枚举 key 被有意忽略，未挂载到 Host；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报。
feature provider 被禁用；可启用该插件后重试。
feature provider 已卸载；需重新安装 provider。
在允许的插件生命周期之外注册资源或 pipeline stage；setup 尝试关闭后的 `context.onDispose` 先释放有效资源再抛此码。
插件生命周期钩子内，或 setup / beforeRelease 等待期间尝试变更 Host；该期间的 `config.update` 也同步抛此码，见 §8。
构造时传入的 pipeline mode 无效。
stage 不能由 middleware-pipeline runner 提升到 Host mode；顶层为带 Host 身份的 `PluginHostError`，`cause` 保留上游 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`，source 为 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`）。
同一次 stage 调用里重复调用了 `next()`。
诊断（非抛出）：stage 已经返回/完成之后才调用 `next()`；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报，该次调用被忽略。
pipeline 执行期间尝试注册新 stage。
async pipeline 的 stage 与 downstream 同时失败，聚合为 `errors` 顺序固定为 `[stageError, downstreamError]` 的 `AggregateError`。
mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待超过已配置的 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 阈值后被拒绝（默认未配置该阈值，不会触发）；不会中断已经开始执行的插件代码。语义是终止：该 mutation 不会再被执行。
`beforeRelease` 或 disposal 期间单个 pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer 等待超过 `disposeStepTimeoutMs`（默认 5000ms）仍未完成（含自依赖等待）。语义是降级继续：该步骤被计为失败，disposal 事务继续推进直至收敛到 `disposed`。
已取得执行权的 lifecycle hook 超过 mutation 预算；提交资格已撤销，协作插件应停止并清理其 operation 资源。
已取出的 extension 函数所属 registration 已被卸载或替换（禁用时为 `PLUGIN_DISABLED`）；调用方应从当前句柄重新读取 extension。
Host 关闭或普通 `unUse` 的 active pipeline 未在 drain 预算内归零；`unUse` 继续有界清理，但返回 `ok: false`、`errors` 包含此码，并经 diagnostic 报告。Host disposal 的物理完成另见其结果。
逻辑关闭已提交，但清理发生错误或尚未完成。读取 `cleanupErrors`。`cleanupComplete: false` 时继续观察 `physicalCompletion`。
config 值不满足准入的 plain-data 语法（如 symbol、非法原型、危险键名、descriptor、thenable）；调用方需改用受支持的取值。
config 输入存在引用循环；调用方需提供无环的值图。
配置 recipe、插件 update 或 defineHost disposal 中间件抛出未分类失败。可写原生 Error 保持实例、类型和 stack 并附身份；不可写错误或非 Error 值通过 cause 保留；已有完整 source/code 的外包错误保持不变。
入参校验失败（`TypeError`）：插件名/配置路径/pipeline stage/extension/domain core/资源 disposer/构造选项等输入不满足契约，检查用 `error instanceof TypeError`，不按 `PluginHostError` 分支。

blocks.code: import { PluginHost, type IPluginHostOptions } from '@migaia/plugin-host'

blocks.text: `new Host(options)` —— `options` 必填。`TValue` 泛型不为 `never` 时才需要用到 pipeline。全部选项字段（`IPluginHostOptions`）：

items: `execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: number | false; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: number | false }`（必填）—— 分别限制一次 mutation 的执行时间和 pipeline 租约排空时间。两项均须显式提供。`false` 表示无限等待。
`pipeline?: { mode?: 'sync' | 'async' | 'generator' | 'async-generator' }` —— 默认 `'sync'`；运行期不能切换，非法值抛 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。

`diagnostic?: (message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`）—— 接收"不构成错误但值得关注"的信号（如 `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、队列等待）；被吞下而改为上报的错误（回滚/清理失败、换绑钩子失败、Feature 异步拒绝）会以原始对象经第三个参数送达，可沿 `cause`/`errors` 追溯；

`onDiagnosticFailure?: (error: unknown) => void` —— 诊断回调自身抛错或 reject 时收到那个失败对象；未提供（或它也抛错）时交给运行时的 `globalThis.reportError`（浏览器/Deno/Bun；Node 没有该接口，需要在 Node 观测时请显式提供）。不是函数抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；不是函数会抛 `TypeError`；诊断回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主正常执行流程。
`scheduler?: IScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间源，默认内部 `systemScheduler`；传入的对象必须提供 `now()`/`schedule()`，否则抛 `TypeError`。

`queueAdmissionTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待被拒绝的阈值。默认 `undefined`：只诊断、不拒绝（即默认情况下排队再久也不会触发 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`）；传 `false` 关闭一切队列等待相关的计时器和诊断；传具体数值后，等待超过该阈值会被移出队列并以 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` reject。
`queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs?: number | false` —— 未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`（拒绝阈值）时使用的诊断阈值，默认 `1000`；传 `false` 关闭该诊断计时器。

`disposeStepTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— 单个 disposer 步骤（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer）的最长等待时间，默认 `5000`；传 `false` 关闭普通步骤预算；managed removal 的有限 `pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 仍会限制其步骤等待。

blocks.text: 超时类选项传入非 `false` 的非有限非负数（负数、`NaN`、`Infinity`、非 `number`）一律抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）。

blocks.text: 无法提升的组合会同步抛顶层 `PluginHostError`，`code === 'PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH'`；其 `cause` 是 middleware-pipeline 原始 `TypeError`，携带 `code === 'INVALID_OPTION'` 与 `source === '@migaia/middleware-pipeline'`。

`host.config.get(path)` 的路径语义：`path` 可以是"插件名"本身（返回该插件整份只读配置），也可以是 `插件名.键`（可继续 `.` 或 `.[下标]` 深入嵌套）。找不到匹配的插件、或路径中途缺失，返回 `undefined`（不抛错——读取是探测性操作）；`config.update(name, ...)` 对不存在的插件则抛 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`（写入是明确的意图表达，语义不对称）。以上两个方法都要求 Host 处于 `active` 状态，否则抛 `HOST_DISPOSING`/`HOST_DISPOSED`。

构造函数只接受同步安装的插件：`new Host({ plugins: ... })` 这种写法不存在——构造期插件走的是子类内部调用受保护的 `useSync(plugins)`，其中任何一个插件的 `install()` 返回 Promise 都会立即抛错；立即安装且声明 `setup` 的插件在任何 hook 执行前抛 `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`。需要准备阶段的插件应在宿主构造完成后用 `await host.use(plugin)`；惰性插件可先由 `useSync` 登记，再由 `activate()` 异步运行 setup。

items: `PluginHostError`：本包语义化错误的基类，`extends Error`，携带只读 `source`（恒为 `'@migaia/plugin-host'`）、`code: IPluginHostErrorCode`、可选 `detail`（结构化诊断字段，如队列超时的 `owner`/`waitedMs`）。常规插件名/配置路径/pipeline stage/extension/domain core/资源 disposer 等校验使用原生 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；退役定义字段使用原生 `TypeError`（`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`）；配置值和循环错误分别为 `PluginHostError`（`INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE` / `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`）。按具体 source/code 与原生类型分支。配置 recipe、update 和 defineHost disposal 中间件的未分类错误附 `CALLBACK_FAILED`；可写原生 Error 保持实例、类型、stack，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause；已有完整语义身份保持不变。
`PluginHostErrorCode`：稳定错误码常量对象，取值见 USEGUIDE §9。

句柄与依赖图新增的稳定码包括：`PLUGIN_DISABLED`、`PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`、`PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`、`FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`、`PREREQUISITE_MISSING`、`DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`、`DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`、`REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`、`DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`、`REGISTRATION_REVOKED`。其余生命周期、pipeline、配置与组合错误码及完整处理建议见 USEGUIDE §9。

blocks.text: 完整稳定码集合：`CALLBACK_FAILED`、`HOST_DISPOSED`、`HOST_DISPOSING`、`PLUGIN_DUPLICATE`、`PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`、`PLUGIN_DISABLED`、`PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`、`PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`、`FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`、`PREREQUISITE_MISSING`、`DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`、`DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`、`REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`、`DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`、`SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`、`PLUGIN_DISPOSE_FAILED`、`EXTENSION_DUPLICATE`、`EXTENSION_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE`、`EXTENSION_RESERVED`、`PREREQUISITE_DISABLED`、`PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`、`RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL`、`LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`、`INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`、`PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`、`PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE`、`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`PIPELINE_EXECUTING`、`PIPELINE_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、`MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`、`DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT`、`INVALID_OPTION`、`INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE`、`CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`、`MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT`、`REGISTRATION_REVOKED`、`INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE`、`PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT`、`CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE`、`COMPOSITION_TARGET_UNMANAGED`。

items: `ERROR_TEXT`（根入口的命名导出）：本包稳定的英文错误文案表，主要供内部构造错误消息使用；对外暴露是为了让下游包在自定义 `diagnostic` 回调里复用同一套措辞，一般无需直接调用。
`PluginHostStatus`：`{ active, closing, disposed }`——Host 的三态生命周期，`closing` 是 `dispose()` 已开始、尚未收敛的窗口。
`MiddlewarePipelineMode`：由 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline` 定义的模式常量；`host.pipelineMode` 返回其中之一。
`PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle`：`{ idle, install, dispose }`——单个插件注册记录当前所处的阶段，决定 `onDispose()`/pipeline 注册是否合法（只在 `install` 阶段允许）。一般只在自定义诊断/调试时需要引用。
`MiddlewarePipelineViolation`：由 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline` 定义的 `next()` 违规分类。

configuration.name: pipeline.mode
configuration.description: sync 是扁平转换管道：`next()` 只记录下一个值，下游 stage 在当前 stage 返回之后才执行，因此当前 stage 在调用 `next()` 之后无法观察到下游处理结果。async 是洋葱模型：`await next(value)` 会等待整个下游链执行完毕才继续，所以当前 stage 可以在 `next()` 之后写"后置逻辑"，且这段逻辑能看到下游已经处理完的效果。这个执行顺序差异是切换 pipeline mode 时最容易让人困惑的地方，务必注意。`async-generator` 既不是洋葱模型也不是流式管道，是纯粹的"stage 顺序执行、每个 stage 各自异步跑完取一个终值"，介于 `async` 与 `generator` 之间。

symbols.name: PluginHostError
symbols.purpose: Host state/protocol error class, also used for invalid configuration data (INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE) and cycles (CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED). Ordinary name/path/stage/extension/domain-core/resource validation uses native TypeError/INVALID_OPTION; retired definition fields use TypeError/PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID. Branch on source/code and native type; cause and detail retain originals and structured context.
symbols.core:
code: Stable IPluginHostErrorCode selected from PluginHostErrorCode for the actual Host failure.
message: Caller-authored concrete diagnostic text passed to the native Error constructor.
A PluginHostError carrying the package source, selected code, original cause and optional detail. Construction returns the error without throwing it.
source: Always `@migaia/plugin-host`.
code: A `PluginHostErrorCode` value; branch on it.
detail: Structured data for some codes, e.g. `failedName`, `blockedBy`, `dependents`.
cause: Pass the value caught from an earlier failure when creating a more specific PluginHostError. It is stored unchanged in the native cause property. For an object input, error.cause is that exact object, so callers can inspect the earlier failure without losing its details.
Omit cause when there is no earlier failure. No original failure is then attached through cause.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Host state/protocol error class, also used for invalid configuration data (INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE) and cycles (CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED). Ordinary name/path/stage/extension/domain-core/resource validation uses native TypeError/INVALID_OPTION; retired definition fields use TypeError/PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID. Branch on source/code and native type; cause and detail retain originals and structured context.
