guidance.heading: 遍历中途 dispose 与生命周期 signal

blocks.text: 四种模式的 stage 都会在最后一个参数收到 `context`（generator 类 stage 是第二个参数），其中 `context.signal` 就是 host 的生命周期 signal：`dispose()` 开始时被中止，`reason` 是 Host 发出的取消错误。它与后续公开准入检查产生的 `PluginHostError` 可有相同 source/code，但不承诺同一对象；应按语义身份分类，不能用 `===` 判断它们属于同一次关闭。等待外部 I/O 的 stage 应监听或轮询它，以便及时退出。

遍历期间 `dispose()` 被调用后，遍历会在下一个协作检查点（进入 stage 前、stage 返回后、`next()` 派发时）中止：sync/generator 同步抛出，async/async-generator 的 Promise reject，错误为 `PluginHostError('HOST_DISPOSING', ...)`（仍在 `closing` 窗口）或 `PluginHostError('HOST_DISPOSED', ...)`（已到达 terminal）。两种都可能出现，调用方应统一按 `instanceof PluginHostError` 处理，不要依赖某个固定的 code。
中止与 stage 或下游的普通失败同时发生时，普通失败优先；只有一个普通失败时，原错误实例即为拒绝值。

1. `use()` 逐个安装批次内的插件；任一安装失败会把这次批次里已安装的插件按逆序回滚。 2. `unUse()` 先运行该代可选的 `beforeRelease(context)`。钩子运行时发布仍可用。随后等待 pipeline 租约，并撤销注册与 stage 可见性。最后运行插件 disposer，再逆序释放资源。`context.signal` 表示该代生命周期。`deadlineAt` 与 `remainingMs()` 使用 Host 调度器和 `disposeStepTimeoutMs`。每代最多运行一次钩子。钩子失败不会阻止后续释放。 3. 插件 lifecycle hook（包括 setup、beforeRelease）内禁止调用当前 Host 的 `use`、`unUse`、`config.update` 或 `dispose`；setup 或 beforeRelease 等待期间外部代码调用 Host mutation 或 `config.update` 也同步抛 `LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`。应用组合层负责维护插件之间的安装/卸载拓扑。 4. cleanup 报错时，Host 仍会撤销该插件的可发现状态。`unUse()` 返回 `{ ok: false, errors, affected }`。`dispose()` 在 `cleanupErrors` 中返回错误。两者都继续清理剩余资源。 5. Host 被 dispose 后，所有访问/变更 API 都会以 `PluginHostError` reject 或抛出；入口守卫（如内部的 `#assertActive()`）同步抛出，队列内运行时失败以 rejected Promise 返回。

安装失败统一以 `PluginHostError`（`PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`）返回，实际的插件安装错误位于 `cause`——原始安装错误恒为 primary，不会被后续的回滚失败覆盖。错误的 `detail` 同时保留失败插件名 `failedName` 与按回滚顺序排列的原始错误身份 `rollbackErrors`；异步 `use()` 的 detail 已完成，`useSync()` 的 detail 是不可变快照，完整 secondary identity 通过 `detail.completion` 的最终冻结结果取得。调用方应按身份处理，不应解析诊断文本。若回滚过程本身也失败，回滚失败仍经 `diagnostic` 回调上报（`code: 'PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED'`），是诊断信号，不是抛出的错误，也不会改写 primary 错误的 `cause`。
`PluginHostErrorCode` 导出以下稳定错误码，均可通过 `error.code` 分支处理：

rows: Host 已完成卸载，不能再访问或变更。
Host 正在卸载，不能开始新的变更。
插件已安装，或同一批次中出现重复名字。
目标插件未安装（`unUse`/`config.update` 找不到对应插件）。
句柄所指插件当前已禁用；先启用该插件再访问。
插件因必需 provider 不可用而挂起；恢复 provider，或显式卸载该插件。
惰性插件尚未激活；先执行 `await host.activate(name)`。
`getFeature(name)` 请求了插件未声明的 feature。
必需 feature provider 尚未安装。
feature 引用形成依赖环；本批次不会执行任何 install。
卸载或禁用 provider 时仍有必需依赖者；查看 `detail.blockedBy`，或使用 `policy: 'cascade'`、`policy: 'suspend'` 或 `dryRun`。
`replace(name, next)` 的两个插件名不一致。
`replace()` 已提交新实现，但需要重启的依赖者重装失败；它们保持卸载。`cause` 为 `AggregateError`（首项为重装失败），`detail.dependents` 列出受影响插件；修复后重新安装它们。
插件定义含已退役或不受支持的字段（例如 `shared`）。
插件安装失败；原始错误位于 `cause`。
`useSync()` 即时安装遇到声明了 setup 的插件；改用 `use()`。
诊断（非抛出）：插件安装失败且回滚清理也失败；原始安装错误保持 primary（顶层码 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`），回滚失败经 `diagnostic` 上报。
插件 `install()` 返回值自带 `then` key；同步 `useSync()` 与异步 `use()` 一致拒绝，不会发布可被误当作 Promise 的扩展。
`openComposition()` 的目标不是本包登记的托管宿主。托管协议只对本包构造出的宿主开放，普通对象、另一份包副本产出的宿主都会被拒绝；不公开身份登记 writer，`defineHost` 也不接受 `receiver` 身份别名选项；组合方应先用 `isManagedHost()` 判定。
插件 `beforeRelease` 或卸载步骤失败；原始错误位于 `cause`，后续清理继续。
extension key 已被其他扩展占用；Host 协议保留键优先归为 `EXTENSION_RESERVED`。
extension key 与 `Object.prototype` 上的成员冲突（如 `toString`）。
extension key 是 Host 保留成员（包括 `config`、`use`、`dispose`、`then`、`Symbol.dispose`、`asyncDisposeKey`）。
诊断（非抛出）：`install()` 返回值上的非枚举 key 被有意忽略，未挂载到 Host；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报。
feature provider 被禁用；可启用该插件后重试。
feature provider 已卸载；需重新安装 provider。
在允许的插件生命周期之外注册资源或 pipeline stage；setup 尝试关闭后的 `context.onDispose` 先释放有效资源再抛此码。
插件生命周期钩子内，或 setup / beforeRelease 等待期间尝试变更 Host；该期间的 `config.update` 也同步抛此码，见 §8。
构造时传入的 pipeline mode 无效。
stage 不能由 middleware-pipeline runner 提升到 Host mode；顶层为带 Host 身份的 `PluginHostError`，`cause` 保留上游 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`，source 为 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`）。
同一次 stage 调用里重复调用了 `next()`。
诊断（非抛出）：stage 已经返回/完成之后才调用 `next()`；通过 `diagnostic` 回调上报，该次调用被忽略。
pipeline 执行期间尝试注册新 stage。
async pipeline 的 stage 与 downstream 同时失败，聚合为 `errors` 顺序固定为 `[stageError, downstreamError]` 的 `AggregateError`。
mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待超过已配置的 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 阈值后被拒绝（默认未配置该阈值，不会触发）；不会中断已经开始执行的插件代码。语义是终止：该 mutation 不会再被执行。
`beforeRelease` 或 disposal 期间单个 pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer 等待超过 `disposeStepTimeoutMs`（默认 5000ms）仍未完成（含自依赖等待）。语义是降级继续：该步骤被计为失败，disposal 事务继续推进直至收敛到 `disposed`。
已取得执行权的 lifecycle hook 超过 mutation 预算；提交资格已撤销，协作插件应停止并清理其 operation 资源。
已取出的 extension 函数所属 registration 已被卸载或替换（禁用时为 `PLUGIN_DISABLED`）；调用方应从当前句柄重新读取 extension。
Host 关闭或普通 `unUse` 的 active pipeline 未在 drain 预算内归零；`unUse` 继续有界清理，但返回 `ok: false`、`errors` 包含此码，并经 diagnostic 报告。Host disposal 的物理完成另见其结果。
逻辑关闭已提交，但清理发生错误或尚未完成。读取 `cleanupErrors`。`cleanupComplete: false` 时继续观察 `physicalCompletion`。
config 值不满足准入的 plain-data 语法（如 symbol、非法原型、危险键名、descriptor、thenable）；调用方需改用受支持的取值。
config 输入存在引用循环；调用方需提供无环的值图。
配置 recipe、插件 update 或 defineHost disposal 中间件抛出未分类失败。可写原生 Error 保持实例、类型和 stack 并附身份；不可写错误或非 Error 值通过 cause 保留；已有完整 source/code 的外包错误保持不变。
入参校验失败（`TypeError`）：插件名/配置路径/pipeline stage/extension/domain core/资源 disposer/构造选项等输入不满足契约，检查用 `error instanceof TypeError`，不按 `PluginHostError` 分支。

blocks.code:
import { PluginHostErrorCode, type IPluginHostErrorCode } from '@migaia/plugin-host'

PluginHostErrorCode.mutationQueueTimeout // 'MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT'

blocks.text: `diagnostic` 是构造 `PluginHost` 时可选传入的回调（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`：`(message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`；被吞下改为上报的错误会以原始对象经 `error` 送达），用于接收"不构成错误、但值得关注"的信息：`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`，以及未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 时的队列排队等待提示（这一条不携带错误码）。`MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` 与 `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` 是正式抛出/reject 的错误，不再只经 `diagnostic` 上报。diagnostic 回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主的正常执行流程。

guidance.heading: Host 构造与生命周期 API

blocks.code: import { PluginHost, type IPluginHostOptions } from '@migaia/plugin-host'

blocks.text: `new Host(options)` —— `options` 必填。`TValue` 泛型不为 `never` 时才需要用到 pipeline。全部选项字段（`IPluginHostOptions`）：

items: `execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: number | false; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: number | false }`（必填）—— 分别限制一次 mutation 的执行时间和 pipeline 租约排空时间。两项均须显式提供。`false` 表示无限等待。
`pipeline?: { mode?: 'sync' | 'async' | 'generator' | 'async-generator' }` —— 默认 `'sync'`；运行期不能切换，非法值抛 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。

`diagnostic?: (message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`）—— 接收"不构成错误但值得关注"的信号（如 `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、队列等待）；被吞下而改为上报的错误（回滚/清理失败、换绑钩子失败、Feature 异步拒绝）会以原始对象经第三个参数送达，可沿 `cause`/`errors` 追溯；

`onDiagnosticFailure?: (error: unknown) => void` —— 诊断回调自身抛错或 reject 时收到那个失败对象；未提供（或它也抛错）时交给运行时的 `globalThis.reportError`（浏览器/Deno/Bun；Node 没有该接口，需要在 Node 观测时请显式提供）。不是函数抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；不是函数会抛 `TypeError`；诊断回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主正常执行流程。
`scheduler?: IScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间源，默认内部 `systemScheduler`；传入的对象必须提供 `now()`/`schedule()`，否则抛 `TypeError`。

`queueAdmissionTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待被拒绝的阈值。默认 `undefined`：只诊断、不拒绝（即默认情况下排队再久也不会触发 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`）；传 `false` 关闭一切队列等待相关的计时器和诊断；传具体数值后，等待超过该阈值会被移出队列并以 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` reject。
`queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs?: number | false` —— 未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`（拒绝阈值）时使用的诊断阈值，默认 `1000`；传 `false` 关闭该诊断计时器。

`disposeStepTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— 单个 disposer 步骤（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer）的最长等待时间，默认 `5000`；传 `false` 关闭普通步骤预算；managed removal 的有限 `pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 仍会限制其步骤等待。

blocks.text: 超时类选项传入非 `false` 的非有限非负数（负数、`NaN`、`Infinity`、非 `number`）一律抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）。
Host 实例方法/属性：

rows: 按 Feature 依赖拓扑安装；返回与输入同序的插件句柄 tuple。
依赖安全地卸载插件；执行结果的冻结 `affected` 只含实际生效步骤；drain 超时仍清理，但 `ok: false` 且记录 `PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT`。
永久关闭宿主并返回清理结果；重复调用及同步重入复用同一 Promise，defineHost disposal 中间件只运行一次。
`path: string`——插件名，或 `插件名.键` / `插件名.[下标].键`
同步读取；对象/数组返回冻结的只读快照；未知插件或路径返回 `undefined`。见下方说明。
Copy-on-Write 合并 patch，跑 `plugin.update(next, core)` 成功才提交。
构造时固定的 pipeline 模式。
sync stage 可提升到任意 Host mode。
仅 async mode 可用；`next()` 返回 Promise。
可用于 generator 与 async-generator mode，后者由 runner 提升。

blocks.text: 无法提升的组合会同步抛顶层 `PluginHostError`，`code === 'PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH'`；其 `cause` 是 middleware-pipeline 原始 `TypeError`，携带 `code === 'INVALID_OPTION'` 与 `source === '@migaia/middleware-pipeline'`。

`host.config.get(path)` 的路径语义：`path` 可以是"插件名"本身（返回该插件整份只读配置），也可以是 `插件名.键`（可继续 `.` 或 `.[下标]` 深入嵌套）。找不到匹配的插件、或路径中途缺失，返回 `undefined`（不抛错——读取是探测性操作）；`config.update(name, ...)` 对不存在的插件则抛 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`（写入是明确的意图表达，语义不对称）。以上两个方法都要求 Host 处于 `active` 状态，否则抛 `HOST_DISPOSING`/`HOST_DISPOSED`。

构造函数只接受同步安装的插件：`new Host({ plugins: ... })` 这种写法不存在——构造期插件走的是子类内部调用受保护的 `useSync(plugins)`，其中任何一个插件的 `install()` 返回 Promise 都会立即抛错；立即安装且声明 `setup` 的插件在任何 hook 执行前抛 `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`。需要准备阶段的插件应在宿主构造完成后用 `await host.use(plugin)`；惰性插件可先由 `useSync` 登记，再由 `activate()` 异步运行 setup。

items: `PluginHostError`：本包语义化错误的基类，`extends Error`，携带只读 `source`（恒为 `'@migaia/plugin-host'`）、`code: IPluginHostErrorCode`、可选 `detail`（结构化诊断字段，如队列超时的 `owner`/`waitedMs`）。常规插件名/配置路径/pipeline stage/extension/domain core/资源 disposer 等校验使用原生 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；退役定义字段使用原生 `TypeError`（`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`）；配置值和循环错误分别为 `PluginHostError`（`INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE` / `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`）。按具体 source/code 与原生类型分支。配置 recipe、update 和 defineHost disposal 中间件的未分类错误附 `CALLBACK_FAILED`；可写原生 Error 保持实例、类型、stack，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause；已有完整语义身份保持不变。
`PluginHostErrorCode`：稳定错误码常量对象，取值见 USEGUIDE §9。

句柄与依赖图新增的稳定码包括：`PLUGIN_DISABLED`、`PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`、`PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`、`FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`、`PREREQUISITE_MISSING`、`DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`、`DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`、`REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`、`DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`、`REGISTRATION_REVOKED`。其余生命周期、pipeline、配置与组合错误码及完整处理建议见 USEGUIDE §9。

blocks.text: 完整稳定码集合：`CALLBACK_FAILED`、`HOST_DISPOSED`、`HOST_DISPOSING`、`PLUGIN_DUPLICATE`、`PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`、`PLUGIN_DISABLED`、`PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`、`PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`、`FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`、`PREREQUISITE_MISSING`、`DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`、`DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`、`REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`、`DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`、`SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`、`PLUGIN_DISPOSE_FAILED`、`EXTENSION_DUPLICATE`、`EXTENSION_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE`、`EXTENSION_RESERVED`、`PREREQUISITE_DISABLED`、`PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`、`RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL`、`LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`、`INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`、`PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`、`PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE`、`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`PIPELINE_EXECUTING`、`PIPELINE_FAILED`、`PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、`MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`、`DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT`、`INVALID_OPTION`、`INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE`、`CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`、`MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT`、`REGISTRATION_REVOKED`、`INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE`、`PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT`、`CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE`、`COMPOSITION_TARGET_UNMANAGED`。

items: `ERROR_TEXT`（根入口的命名导出）：本包稳定的英文错误文案表，主要供内部构造错误消息使用；对外暴露是为了让下游包在自定义 `diagnostic` 回调里复用同一套措辞，一般无需直接调用。
`PluginHostStatus`：`{ active, closing, disposed }`——Host 的三态生命周期，`closing` 是 `dispose()` 已开始、尚未收敛的窗口。
`MiddlewarePipelineMode`：由 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline` 定义的模式常量；`host.pipelineMode` 返回其中之一。
`PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle`：`{ idle, install, dispose }`——单个插件注册记录当前所处的阶段，决定 `onDispose()`/pipeline 注册是否合法（只在 `install` 阶段允许）。一般只在自定义诊断/调试时需要引用。
`MiddlewarePipelineViolation`：由 `@migaia/middleware-pipeline` 定义的 `next()` 违规分类。

configuration.name: detail
configuration.description: 安装失败统一以 `PluginHostError`（`PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`）返回，实际的插件安装错误位于 `cause`——原始安装错误恒为 primary，不会被后续的回滚失败覆盖。错误的 `detail` 同时保留失败插件名 `failedName` 与按回滚顺序排列的原始错误身份 `rollbackErrors`；异步 `use()` 的 detail 已完成，`useSync()` 的 detail 是不可变快照，完整 secondary identity 通过 `detail.completion` 的最终冻结结果取得。调用方应按身份处理，不应解析诊断文本。若回滚过程本身也失败，回滚失败仍经 `diagnostic` 回调上报（`code: 'PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED'`），是诊断信号，不是抛出的错误，也不会改写 primary 错误的 `cause`。
configuration.descriptionEn: Structured diagnostics, such as queue timeout `owner` and `waitedMs`, kept separate from `cause`.
configuration.descriptionZh: 安装失败统一以 `PluginHostError`（`PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`）返回，实际的插件安装错误位于 `cause`——原始安装错误恒为 primary，不会被后续的回滚失败覆盖。错误的 `detail` 同时保留失败插件名 `failedName` 与按回滚顺序排列的原始错误身份 `rollbackErrors`；异步 `use()` 的 detail 已完成，`useSync()` 的 detail 是不可变快照，完整 secondary identity 通过 `detail.completion` 的最终冻结结果取得。调用方应按身份处理，不应解析诊断文本。若回滚过程本身也失败，回滚失败仍经 `diagnostic` 回调上报（`code: 'PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED'`），是诊断信号，不是抛出的错误，也不会改写 primary 错误的 `cause`。

symbols.name: PluginHostErrorCode
symbols.purpose: The 44 Host error and diagnostic codes. Host protocol and configuration-domain failures use PluginHostError; input/definition validation preserves native TypeError. CALLBACK_FAILED classifies otherwise unowned callback or surface-descriptor failures while preserving writable native identity, immutable/non-Error cause and existing foreign ownership. Diagnostic-only codes reach diagnostic instead of being thrown.
symbols.core:
hostDisposed: `HOST_DISPOSED`: the host finished disposal; create a new host.
hostDisposing: `HOST_DISPOSING`: disposal started; no new change can start.
pluginDuplicate: `PLUGIN_DUPLICATE`: the plugin is installed, or a batch repeats a name.
pluginNotInstalled: `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`: no plugin of that name (`unUse`, `config.update`, handle access).
pluginDisabled: `PLUGIN_DISABLED`: the plugin is disabled; enable it first.
pluginSuspended: `PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`: suspended because a required provider is unavailable.
pluginNotActivated: `PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`: a lazy plugin was used before `activate()`.
featureNotDeclared: `FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`: `getFeature(name)` asked for an undeclared Feature.
prerequisiteMissing: `PREREQUISITE_MISSING`: a required provider was never installed.
dependencyCycle: `DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`: Feature references form a cycle; nothing was installed.
dependencyBlocked: `DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`: required dependents block removal or disabling; see `detail.blockedBy`.
replaceNameMismatch: `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`: `replace(name, next)` got a different plugin name.
dependentRestartFailed: `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`: the replacement took effect but restarting dependents failed.
pluginDefinitionInvalid: `PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`: the definition uses retired or unsupported fields.
pluginInstallFailed: `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`: install failed; the original error is on `cause`.
setupRequiresAsyncInstall: `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`: `useSync()` met a plugin with `setup`; use `use()`.
pluginDisposeFailed: `PLUGIN_DISPOSE_FAILED`: `beforeRelease` or a cleanup step failed; cleanup continued.
extensionDuplicate: `EXTENSION_DUPLICATE`: an extension key clashes with an existing member.
extensionObjectPrototype: `EXTENSION_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE`: an extension key clashes with `Object.prototype` (e.g. `toString`).
extensionReserved: EXTENSION_RESERVED: a key belongs to the canonical Host protocol, including config/use/dispose, then or disposal symbols. This check precedes duplicate detection; other occupied extension keys use EXTENSION_DUPLICATE. Install failures retain the validation error on cause.
prerequisiteDisabled: `PREREQUISITE_DISABLED`: a required provider is disabled; enable it and retry.
prerequisiteRemoved: `PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`: a required provider was removed; install it again.
resourceOutsideInstall: `RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL`: a resource or stage was registered outside the allowed hook.
lifecycleMutation: `LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`: a hook (or a waiting setup/beforeRelease) tried to change the host.
invalidPipelineMode: `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`: the constructor got an invalid pipeline mode.
pipelineModeMismatch: `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`: a stage cannot be lifted to the host mode.
pipelineNextDuplicate: `PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE`: `next()` was called twice in one stage.
pipelineNextLate: `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE` (diagnostic): `next()` was called after the stage returned and was ignored.
pipelineExecuting: `PIPELINE_EXECUTING`: a stage was registered while a pipeline was running.
pipelineFailed: `PIPELINE_FAILED`: in async mode a stage and its downstream both failed.
pluginInstallRollbackFailed: `PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED` (diagnostic): rolling back a failed install also failed.
extensionNonEnumerableIgnored: `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED` (diagnostic): non-enumerable install keys were ignored.
mutationQueueTimeout: `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`: a change waited longer than `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` and was dropped.
disposeStepTimeout: `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT`: one cleanup step exceeded `disposeStepTimeoutMs`; cleanup continued.
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION` (on `TypeError`): an argument or option has an invalid shape.
invalidConfigValue: `INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE`: configuration contains unsupported values (symbols, class instances).
configCycleRejected: `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`: configuration contains a reference cycle.
mutationExecutionTimeout: `MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT`: a running hook exceeded `mutationTimeoutMs`; the change was rolled back.
registrationRevoked: `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`: an extracted extension function belongs to a removed or replaced registration.
installResultThenable: `INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE`: the `install` result has a `then` key and would be mistaken for a Promise.
pipelineDrainTimeout: PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT: pipelines did not drain in budget. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup, reports through diagnostic, and returns ok:false with the error in errors; it does not acquire the Host disposal physicalCompletion protocol.
callbackFailed: CALLBACK_FAILED: an unclassified configuration recipe/update, functional disposal middleware, or domain-surface option/descriptor read failed. Writable native errors keep identity and stack; immutable or non-Error values remain on cause, and complete foreign identities are preserved.
cleanupIncomplete: `CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE`: disposal committed but cleanup failed or is still running.
compositionTargetUnmanaged: `COMPOSITION_TARGET_UNMANAGED`: `openComposition()` got a value that is not a managed host.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.
examples:
import { PluginHostErrorCode, type IPluginHostErrorCode } from '@migaia/plugin-host'

PluginHostErrorCode.mutationQueueTimeout // 'MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT'

members.name: hostDisposed
members.description: Thrown when a mutation or registration targets a host after disposal completes. * * The terminal state is irreversible. Create a new host instead of reviving this one. Enforces * the terminal boundary of the two-phase lifecycle contract.

members.name: hostDisposing
members.description: Thrown when a mutation targets a closing host after `dispose()` starts but before the terminal * state. * * This differs from `HOST_DISPOSED` so diagnostics distinguish disposal in progress from * completed disposal. Retrying later cannot reopen either host.

members.name: pluginDuplicate
members.description: Thrown when installing a plugin whose `name` is already occupied. * * Plugin names are unique host keys. Rename the plugin or `unUse()` the previous plugin first.

members.name: pluginNotInstalled
members.description: Thrown when `unUse()` or another operation targets an uninstalled plugin name. * * Check for repeated removal or a misspelled name. Host state stays unchanged. Prepared removals * also reject this code when their exact generation is no longer current; no cleanup may repeat * and a replacement registration stays live.

members.name: pluginDisabled
members.description: A handle member, or an extension taken from it, is used while that plugin is disabled; also * thrown by `activate()` on a disabled lazy plugin. Enforces per-registration liveness (R2); the * caller should `enable` the plugin (or its restore token) before retrying.

members.name: pluginSuspended
members.description: A dependent plugin is temporarily suspended because one of its required providers is inactive. * The caller must restore or reinstall the provider and wait for automatic resume before * retrying. Enforces the R3 suspend dependency policy without treating the registration as * removed.

members.name: pluginNotActivated
members.description: A lazy plugin is accessed synchronously before activation, or a synchronous install needs an * inactive lazy provider. Activation is an explicit async step (R9); the caller should `await * host.activate(name)` or install through the async `use()` path.

members.name: featureNotDeclared
members.description: `definition.getFeature(name)` or `handle.getFeature(name)` named a Feature the plugin does not * declare. Lookups never return `undefined` (R4); the caller has a wrong name or wrong plugin.

members.name: prerequisiteMissing
members.description: A required Feature provider was never installed in this host (a removed one reports * `PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`). Thrown before any install hook runs (R5); install the provider first * or in the same batch.

members.name: dependencyCycle
members.description: Cross-plugin Feature references inside one batch form a cycle. Detected before any install hook * runs (R5); the caller must break the cycle in its plugin definitions.

members.name: dependencyBlocked
members.description: `unUse`/`disable` (or a managed removal) would leave required dependents behind and cascade was * not requested. State is unchanged (R6); `detail.blockedBy` lists every transitive dependent in * cascade order — pass `policy: 'cascade'`, include them, or inspect `dryRun` first.

members.name: replaceNameMismatch
members.description: `replace(name, next)` received a candidate whose name differs from `name`. Nothing is installed * (R8); the caller passed the wrong definition.

members.name: dependentRestartFailed
members.description: `replace()` published the new provider, but at least one dependent that had to restart (no * `onDependencyReplaced`, or the hook threw) failed to reinstall. The replacement stays * committed, the previous provider is disposed, and the failed restart closure stays uninstalled. * `cause` is an `AggregateError` whose first entry is the restart failure, followed by the hook * and cleanup errors; the caller should reinstall the listed dependents after fixing them.

members.name: pluginDefinitionInvalid
members.description: A plugin definition carries a retired or unsupported field (for example `shared`), or its * dependency data is structurally invalid, or runtime integration is requested from an object * that is not a canonical package-minted core. Definition admission and the D9 integration port * reject these inputs; migrate to Feature dependencies or use the original install core.

members.name: pluginInstallFailed
members.description: Thrown when plugin installation or publication fails. Native shared-publication TypeErrors * retain their runtime type with this code. The original installation error always remains * primary and is reachable by identity through `cause`, as required by the error-code contract * §3.2. * * `detail` retains the failed plugin name and original rollback failures in rollback order. Async * `use()` publishes the completed frozen detail directly. Sync `useSync()` publishes a frozen * snapshot and exposes the final frozen detail through `detail.completion`. Rollback or cleanup * failures use the diagnostic code `PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`. They never replace the * original construction failure (L-T39 / `docs/lifecycle/migration.sdd.md` §3.7.4 M-T44). Await * completion before converting errors that require complete secondary failure identities.

members.name: setupRequiresAsyncInstall
members.description: A plugin selected for immediate `useSync()` installation declares async setup (R5). The caller * must install it through `use()` so setup can settle before features and install run.

members.name: pluginDisposeFailed
members.description: Thrown when a cleanup step fails during one plugin's `unUse()` or `beforeRelease()`. * * Failures are aggregated after unloading finishes. One disposer failure does not stop remaining * releases. Treat this as a resource-leak warning, not a signal that host state rolls back.

members.name: extensionDuplicate
members.description: Thrown when an extension returned by `install()` conflicts with an existing host property. A * shared slot accepts only canonical contributions from registrations in the same family. * Ordinary extensions and other families cannot occupy the same key. * * Ordinary extension properties remain exclusive. Rename the property or use a canonical * same-family contribution. Conflict detection happens before mounting, so no partially mounted * state is published.

members.name: extensionObjectPrototype
members.description: Thrown when an extension name conflicts with an `Object.prototype` key such as `toString` or * `constructor`. * * Rejecting it before mounting preserves prototype lookup and prevents a prototype-pollution * entry point.

members.name: extensionReserved
members.description: Thrown when an extension uses a reserved host key such as `config`, `onDispose`, or * `usePipeline`. * * Reserved keys belong to the host protocol. Overwriting them would let plugins disrupt each * other. Choose another extension name.

members.name: prerequisiteDisabled
members.description: A Feature prerequisite exists but its owner is temporarily disabled. The caller may enable that * owner and retry the same lookup.

members.name: prerequisiteRemoved
members.description: A previously published Feature prerequisite lost its owner through removal. The caller must * install a provider again; retrying the unchanged lookup cannot recover it.

members.name: resourceOutsideInstall
members.description: Thrown when a plugin context registers an `onDispose()` resource outside installation or after * setup ends. * * Resources belong to the current attempt. Late resources are released before this error is * thrown. Register resources during the active setup or installation phase.

members.name: lifecycleMutation
members.description: Thrown when a plugin lifecycle callback (`setup`, `install`, `dispose`, `update`, or * `beforeRelease`) reenters a host mutation API, or an external `config.update()` runs during * setup or `beforeRelease`. A synchronous `activate()` reentry rejects before sharing an existing * activation. After an await, same-name activation callers share that Promise regardless of * origin; callers must avoid awaiting their own activation. * * Reentrancy makes installation rollback boundaries ambiguous. Move later mutations outside * lifecycle callbacks.

members.name: invalidPipelineMode
members.description: Thrown during host construction for a pipeline mode outside `sync`, `async`, `generator`, or * `async-generator`. * * Configuration validation rejects the input before the host is constructed.

members.name: pipelineModeMismatch
members.description: Thrown when a registered stage is incompatible with the host's pipeline mode. * * For example, a sync host cannot accept a generator stage. Modes define execution and error * semantics and cannot be mixed. The message identifies both the host and stage modes.

members.name: pipelineNextDuplicate
members.description: Thrown when `next()` is called twice within one pipeline step. * * A step can advance only once. Repeated calls would process the same value downstream more than * once. Check stage branches for a missing `return`.

members.name: pipelineNextLate
members.description: Reports a `next()` call after the stage returns or completes. * * The value can no longer enter the pipeline safely, so the call is ignored. An async branch that * is not awaited is a common cause.

members.name: pipelineExecuting
members.description: Thrown when a stage is registered while the pipeline is executing. * * Changing stages during execution would make behavior depend on registration timing. Complete * stage registration before execution starts.

members.name: pipelineFailed
members.description: Thrown when an async stage and its downstream both fail. An `AggregateError` retains `errors` * in the fixed order `[stageError, downstreamError]`. * * Enforces the boundary error identity contract in `docs/contracts/error-codes.md` §2 and §3.2. * Both original errors remain reachable by identity in `errors`. Handle each failure rather than * retrying it as one stage failure.

members.name: pluginInstallRollbackFailed
members.description: Diagnostic code that is reported, never thrown. * * Reports through `diagnostic` when `install()` fails and rollback also fails. The primary error * retains `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` and `cause` equal to the original installation error. See L-T39 * / `docs/lifecycle/migration.sdd.md` §3.7.4 M-T44. This additional signal never rewrites or * replaces the primary error. Some installed plugins may remain incompletely unloaded, leaving * inconsistent host state. Treat the failure as unrecoverable and rebuild the host.

members.name: extensionNonEnumerableIgnored
members.description: Diagnostic code that is reported, never thrown. * * Reports a non-enumerable property intentionally skipped when mounting an `install()` result. * Ignoring such keys is part of the contract, but reporting explains why they are absent from the * host. Make the property enumerable to expose it.

members.name: mutationQueueTimeout
members.description: Thrown when a mutation exceeds its configured FIFO admission wait and is removed and rejected. * * The caller configures this admission limit. Without a limit, the host reports waits without * rejecting them. This code wraps lifecycle `QUEUE_ADMISSION_TIMEOUT` at the plugin-host * boundary. `cause` retains the original lifecycle error. * * The mutation is terminated and never executes. This differs from `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT`, which * stops waiting and continues disposal.

members.name: disposeStepTimeout
members.description: Reported when one disposer exceeds its wait limit without settling. This includes pipeline * disposers, plugin `dispose` or `beforeRelease` hooks, and resource disposers. * * A disposer that awaits the `host.dispose()` call responsible for running it cannot settle on * its own. * * Disposal continues after recording the step as failed and ending the wait. The running disposer * is not cancelled because JavaScript cannot safely revoke an active Promise chain. The * transaction can still reach disposed state. This differs from `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`, which * terminates the queued mutation.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Thrown as a native `TypeError` with an attached code when input violates its contract. Inputs * include plugin names, configuration paths, stages, extensions, domain cores, and resource * disposers. * * Enforces the untagged-error gate in `docs/contracts/error-codes.md` §7 and input-validation * rules in `error-code-rollout.sdd.md` §3. Correct the input before retrying. This is a * programming error, not a runtime state failure.

members.name: invalidConfigValue
members.description: Config value violates the admitted plain-data grammar; caller must supply an allowed value.

members.name: callbackFailed
members.description: A public configuration recipe/update, domain-surface descriptor read, or factory disposal * callback failed without a semantic identity. Native mutable errors keep their instance, type, * and stack; immutable/non-Error values stay on cause. Existing upstream source/code stays owned * there. Inspect the callback failure; a rejected configuration patch was not committed and a * disposal completion remains terminal.

members.name: configCycleRejected
members.description: Config input contains a reference cycle; caller must supply an acyclic value graph.

members.name: mutationExecutionTimeout
members.description: A lifecycle hook exceeded the admitted mutation budget and lost commit authority.

members.name: registrationRevoked
members.description: A previously published view was logically revoked by removal or disposal.

members.name: installResultThenable
members.description: Plugin install returned an own `then` key, which is never a publishable extension result.

members.name: pipelineDrainTimeout
members.description: Active pipeline work exceeded the admitted drain budget; ordinary unUse reports it and returns * ok:false while bounded cleanup continues.

members.name: cleanupIncomplete
members.description: Logical disposal completed while one or more physical cleanup tasks remain unsettled.

members.name: compositionTargetUnmanaged
members.description: `openComposition` was given a target this package never registered as a managed host. * * The managed protocol is reached through the composition entry rather than off the host * instance, so the only admissible targets are the ones the host registers at construction. A * caller that gets this has an object that is not a host of this package — a plain object, a host * from a different copy of the package, or a value that was never constructed at all.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: The 44 Host error and diagnostic codes. Host protocol and configuration-domain failures use PluginHostError; input/definition validation preserves native TypeError. CALLBACK_FAILED classifies otherwise unowned callback or surface-descriptor failures while preserving writable native identity, immutable/non-Error cause and existing foreign ownership. Diagnostic-only codes reach diagnostic instead of being thrown.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import PluginHostErrorCode from @migaia/plugin-host, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use PluginHostErrorCode when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when PluginHostErrorCode does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
hostDisposed: `HOST_DISPOSED`: the host finished disposal; create a new host.
hostDisposing: `HOST_DISPOSING`: disposal started; no new change can start.
pluginDuplicate: `PLUGIN_DUPLICATE`: the plugin is installed, or a batch repeats a name.
pluginNotInstalled: `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`: no plugin of that name (`unUse`, `config.update`, handle access).
pluginDisabled: `PLUGIN_DISABLED`: the plugin is disabled; enable it first.
pluginSuspended: `PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`: suspended because a required provider is unavailable.
pluginNotActivated: `PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`: a lazy plugin was used before `activate()`.
featureNotDeclared: `FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`: `getFeature(name)` asked for an undeclared Feature.
prerequisiteMissing: `PREREQUISITE_MISSING`: a required provider was never installed.
dependencyCycle: `DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`: Feature references form a cycle; nothing was installed.
dependencyBlocked: `DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`: required dependents block removal or disabling; see `detail.blockedBy`.
replaceNameMismatch: `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`: `replace(name, next)` got a different plugin name.
dependentRestartFailed: `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`: the replacement took effect but restarting dependents failed.
pluginDefinitionInvalid: `PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`: the definition uses retired or unsupported fields.
pluginInstallFailed: `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`: install failed; the original error is on `cause`.
setupRequiresAsyncInstall: `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`: `useSync()` met a plugin with `setup`; use `use()`.
pluginDisposeFailed: `PLUGIN_DISPOSE_FAILED`: `beforeRelease` or a cleanup step failed; cleanup continued.
extensionDuplicate: `EXTENSION_DUPLICATE`: an extension key clashes with an existing member.
extensionObjectPrototype: `EXTENSION_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE`: an extension key clashes with `Object.prototype` (e.g. `toString`).
extensionReserved: EXTENSION_RESERVED: a key belongs to the canonical Host protocol, including config/use/dispose, then or disposal symbols. This check precedes duplicate detection; other occupied extension keys use EXTENSION_DUPLICATE. Install failures retain the validation error on cause.
prerequisiteDisabled: `PREREQUISITE_DISABLED`: a required provider is disabled; enable it and retry.
prerequisiteRemoved: `PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`: a required provider was removed; install it again.
resourceOutsideInstall: `RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL`: a resource or stage was registered outside the allowed hook.
lifecycleMutation: `LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`: a hook (or a waiting setup/beforeRelease) tried to change the host.
invalidPipelineMode: `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`: the constructor got an invalid pipeline mode.
pipelineModeMismatch: `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`: a stage cannot be lifted to the host mode.
pipelineNextDuplicate: `PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE`: `next()` was called twice in one stage.
pipelineNextLate: `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE` (diagnostic): `next()` was called after the stage returned and was ignored.
pipelineExecuting: `PIPELINE_EXECUTING`: a stage was registered while a pipeline was running.
pipelineFailed: `PIPELINE_FAILED`: in async mode a stage and its downstream both failed.
pluginInstallRollbackFailed: `PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED` (diagnostic): rolling back a failed install also failed.
extensionNonEnumerableIgnored: `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED` (diagnostic): non-enumerable install keys were ignored.
mutationQueueTimeout: `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`: a change waited longer than `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` and was dropped.
disposeStepTimeout: `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT`: one cleanup step exceeded `disposeStepTimeoutMs`; cleanup continued.
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION` (on `TypeError`): an argument or option has an invalid shape.
invalidConfigValue: `INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE`: configuration contains unsupported values (symbols, class instances).
configCycleRejected: `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`: configuration contains a reference cycle.
mutationExecutionTimeout: `MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT`: a running hook exceeded `mutationTimeoutMs`; the change was rolled back.
registrationRevoked: `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`: an extracted extension function belongs to a removed or replaced registration.
installResultThenable: `INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE`: the `install` result has a `then` key and would be mistaken for a Promise.
pipelineDrainTimeout: PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT: pipelines did not drain in budget. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup, reports through diagnostic, and returns ok:false with the error in errors; it does not acquire the Host disposal physicalCompletion protocol.
callbackFailed: CALLBACK_FAILED: an unclassified configuration recipe/update, functional disposal middleware, or domain-surface option/descriptor read failed. Writable native errors keep identity and stack; immutable or non-Error values remain on cause, and complete foreign identities are preserved.
cleanupIncomplete: `CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE`: disposal committed but cleanup failed or is still running.
compositionTargetUnmanaged: `COMPOSITION_TARGET_UNMANAGED`: `openComposition()` got a value that is not a managed host.

blocks.text: `PluginHostErrorCode` 导出以下稳定错误码，均可通过 `error.code` 分支处理：

rows: Host 已完成卸载，不能再访问或变更。
Host 正在卸载，不能开始新的变更。
插件已安装，或同一批次中出现重复名字。
目标插件未安装（`unUse`/`config.update` 找不到对应插件）。
句柄所指插件当前已禁用；先启用该插件再访问。
插件因必需 provider 不可用而挂起；恢复 provider，或显式卸载该插件。
惰性插件尚未激活；先执行 `await host.activate(name)`。
`getFeature(name)` 请求了插件未声明的 feature。
必需 feature provider 尚未安装。
feature 引用形成依赖环；本批次不会执行任何 install。
卸载或禁用 provider 时仍有必需依赖者；查看 `detail.blockedBy`，或使用 `policy: 'cascade'`、`policy: 'suspend'` 或 `dryRun`。
`replace(name, next)` 的两个插件名不一致。
`replace()` 已提交新实现，但需要重启的依赖者重装失败；它们保持卸载。`cause` 为 `AggregateError`（首项为重装失败），`detail.dependents` 列出受影响插件；修复后重新安装它们。
插件定义含已退役或不受支持的字段（例如 `shared`）。
插件安装失败；原始错误位于 `cause`。
`useSync()` 即时安装遇到声明了 setup 的插件；改用 `use()`。
诊断（非抛出）：插件安装失败且回滚清理也失败；原始安装错误保持 primary（顶层码 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`），回滚失败经 `diagnostic` 上报。

guidance.heading: Host 构造与生命周期 API

blocks.code: import { PluginHost, type IPluginHostOptions } from '@migaia/plugin-host'

blocks.text: `new Host(options)` —— `options` 必填。`TValue` 泛型不为 `never` 时才需要用到 pipeline。全部选项字段（`IPluginHostOptions`）：

items: `execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: number | false; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: number | false }`（必填）—— 分别限制一次 mutation 的执行时间和 pipeline 租约排空时间。两项均须显式提供。`false` 表示无限等待。
`pipeline?: { mode?: 'sync' | 'async' | 'generator' | 'async-generator' }` —— 默认 `'sync'`；运行期不能切换，非法值抛 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。

`diagnostic?: (message: string, code?: IPluginHostErrorCode, error?: unknown) => void`（`IPluginHostDiagnostic`）—— 接收"不构成错误但值得关注"的信号（如 `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`、`EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`、队列等待）；被吞下而改为上报的错误（回滚/清理失败、换绑钩子失败、Feature 异步拒绝）会以原始对象经第三个参数送达，可沿 `cause`/`errors` 追溯；

`onDiagnosticFailure?: (error: unknown) => void` —— 诊断回调自身抛错或 reject 时收到那个失败对象；未提供（或它也抛错）时交给运行时的 `globalThis.reportError`（浏览器/Deno/Bun；Node 没有该接口，需要在 Node 观测时请显式提供）。不是函数抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）；不是函数会抛 `TypeError`；诊断回调自身抛出的异常永远不会影响宿主正常执行流程。
`scheduler?: IScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间源，默认内部 `systemScheduler`；传入的对象必须提供 `now()`/`schedule()`，否则抛 `TypeError`。

`queueAdmissionTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— mutation 在 FIFO 队列中等待被拒绝的阈值。默认 `undefined`：只诊断、不拒绝（即默认情况下排队再久也不会触发 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`）；传 `false` 关闭一切队列等待相关的计时器和诊断；传具体数值后，等待超过该阈值会被移出队列并以 `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` reject。
`queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs?: number | false` —— 未配置 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`（拒绝阈值）时使用的诊断阈值，默认 `1000`；传 `false` 关闭该诊断计时器。

`disposeStepTimeoutMs?: number | false` —— 单个 disposer 步骤（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer）的最长等待时间，默认 `5000`；传 `false` 关闭普通步骤预算；managed removal 的有限 `pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 仍会限制其步骤等待。

`host.config.get(path)` 的路径语义：`path` 可以是"插件名"本身（返回该插件整份只读配置），也可以是 `插件名.键`（可继续 `.` 或 `.[下标]` 深入嵌套）。找不到匹配的插件、或路径中途缺失，返回 `undefined`（不抛错——读取是探测性操作）；`config.update(name, ...)` 对不存在的插件则抛 `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`（写入是明确的意图表达，语义不对称）。以上两个方法都要求 Host 处于 `active` 状态，否则抛 `HOST_DISPOSING`/`HOST_DISPOSED`。

构造函数只接受同步安装的插件：`new Host({ plugins: ... })` 这种写法不存在——构造期插件走的是子类内部调用受保护的 `useSync(plugins)`，其中任何一个插件的 `install()` 返回 Promise 都会立即抛错；立即安装且声明 `setup` 的插件在任何 hook 执行前抛 `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`。需要准备阶段的插件应在宿主构造完成后用 `await host.use(plugin)`；惰性插件可先由 `useSync` 登记，再由 `activate()` 异步运行 setup。

blocks.text: `PluginHostErrorCode` 导出以下稳定错误码，均可通过 `error.code` 分支处理：

rows: Host 已完成卸载，不能再访问或变更。
Host 正在卸载，不能开始新的变更。
插件已安装，或同一批次中出现重复名字。
目标插件未安装（`unUse`/`config.update` 找不到对应插件）。
句柄所指插件当前已禁用；先启用该插件再访问。
插件因必需 provider 不可用而挂起；恢复 provider，或显式卸载该插件。
惰性插件尚未激活；先执行 `await host.activate(name)`。
`getFeature(name)` 请求了插件未声明的 feature。
必需 feature provider 尚未安装。
feature 引用形成依赖环；本批次不会执行任何 install。
卸载或禁用 provider 时仍有必需依赖者；查看 `detail.blockedBy`，或使用 `policy: 'cascade'`、`policy: 'suspend'` 或 `dryRun`。
`replace(name, next)` 的两个插件名不一致。
`replace()` 已提交新实现，但需要重启的依赖者重装失败；它们保持卸载。`cause` 为 `AggregateError`（首项为重装失败），`detail.dependents` 列出受影响插件；修复后重新安装它们。
插件定义含已退役或不受支持的字段（例如 `shared`）。
插件安装失败；原始错误位于 `cause`。
`useSync()` 即时安装遇到声明了 setup 的插件；改用 `use()`。
诊断（非抛出）：插件安装失败且回滚清理也失败；原始安装错误保持 primary（顶层码 `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`），回滚失败经 `diagnostic` 上报。
插件 `install()` 返回值自带 `then` key；同步 `useSync()` 与异步 `use()` 一致拒绝，不会发布可被误当作 Promise 的扩展。
`openComposition()` 的目标不是本包登记的托管宿主。托管协议只对本包构造出的宿主开放，普通对象、另一份包副本产出的宿主都会被拒绝；不公开身份登记 writer，`defineHost` 也不接受 `receiver` 身份别名选项；组合方应先用 `isManagedHost()` 判定。

symbols.name: createRuntime
symbols.signature: export declare function createRuntime(options?: IRuntimeOptions): IRuntime;
symbols.purpose: Creates an isolated reactive runtime: its own dependency graph, version clock and scheduler. Nodes created by one runtime cannot be read by computed values or effects of another (`CROSS_RUNTIME`). Create one per SSR request, per test, or per worker instead of sharing `defaultRuntime`.
symbols.core:
options: Runtime options; all optional, see the options table.
An `IRuntime`. Invalid options throw a `TypeError` or `RangeError` with code `INVALID_OPTION`.
adapter: Host capabilities: `scheduleMicrotask`, `now` (monotonic time), `timestamp` (epoch time) and `reportError`. Each missing entry falls back to the default.
`queueMicrotask`, `performance.now()`, `Date.now()` and a reporter that does nothing.
onError: Receives errors that the runtime cannot throw to a caller (effect failures during an async flush, lifecycle hook failures, trace listener failures) with a `phase` context. Synchronous reporter failures and returned thenable rejections reach the shared utils host exception queue, without changing graph operations.
Not set: errors go to `adapter.reportError`.
onTrace: Receives every trace event from creation on, same as calling `subscribeTrace` immediately.
Not set: no trace events are produced unless `subscribeTrace` is used.
maxFlushPasses: Maximum runs of one effect within one flush. Exceeding it is treated as a self-triggering loop: the queue is cleared and `FLUSH_LOOP` is thrown with the dropped node names. Must be a positive integer.
`100` runs per effect per flush.
scheduleIdle: Schedules cleanup work, such as suspending computed values nobody observes. Use it to align cleanup with animation frames or idle callbacks.
Uses `adapter.scheduleMicrotask`.
schedulerStrategy: Decides when pending effects flush: receives a `flush` function and calls it when appropriate (for example in `requestAnimationFrame`). It must call synchronously or schedule; returning a thenable falls back to the safe default and reports `INVALID_OPTION`.
Merge all writes of the current task into one microtask flush.
symbols.advanced:
SSR creates one runtime per request so state never leaks between users.
Each test owns a runtime and calls `flush()` for deterministic effect timing.
A store library builds collections and resources on `signal` / `computed` / `effect`.
You only need local component state: use the framework state instead.
parameters: options: IRuntimeOptions (optional)
symbols.returns: IRuntime

const runtime = createRuntime()
const count = runtime.signal(1)
count.value // 1，在 Computed/Effect 内读取会建立依赖

count.peek() // 2，不建立依赖
count.dispose()
count.value // 抛 NODE_DISPOSED

blocks.text: 1. 不要跨 `Runtime` 混用节点——一个 `Runtime` 创建的 `Signal` 被另一个 `Runtime` 的 `Computed`/`Effect` 读取会直接抛错。 2. 统一经 Runtime 工厂创建节点：`runtime.signal(value, options?)`、`runtime.computed(fn, config?)`、`runtime.effect(fn, options?)`，均支持 `dispose()`/`disposed`。 3. `runtime.effect(...)` 创建时会同步立即执行一次，不是等到依赖变化才第一次运行。 4. `Signal.value = 相同值`（`Object.is` 判定）不会触发任何通知，也不会推进版本号。 5. 没有订阅者的 `Computed` 会被自动挂起（断开依赖；下次读取先验证版本/拓扑，未变可复用缓存），需要"即使暂时没人订阅也保持热态"时传 `{ keepAlive: true }`。 6. `dispose()` 之后的节点读取会立刻抛错，不会静默返回旧值——这是有意设计，避免"看起来能用但永不更新"的幽灵状态。 7. `defaultRuntime` 是进程级单例，请求隔离（SSR）、单测互不污染、Worker 独立场景都应该显式 `createRuntime()`。

`@migaia/reactive/extension` provides `getDefaultRuntime()` for adapters that must stay cold on import. It constructs the shared default on first call and returns the exact same object as the root `defaultRuntime` binding. Importing the root convenience binding keeps its existing eager behavior. `ReactiveErrorPhase` is also available from the pure extension entry, with the same canonical object as the root export.

`deferRuntimeCleanup(runtime, task)` from `@migaia/reactive/extension` schedules synchronous adapter cleanup on that Runtime's `scheduleIdle` channel (the default uses microtasks). Thrown cleanup errors reach its `reportError` sink. It returns no mutable scheduler or graph capability and does not own asynchronous resources.

blocks.text: 副作用——唯一真正"被执行"的观察者（`Computed` 只标脏不重跑，只有 `Effect` 会被调度器实际 `tick`）：
边界行为：

items: 构造时立即同步执行一次，不是等到依赖变化才第一次运行。
`fn()` 可选返回一个清理函数（`IDisposer`），会在下次重跑前、以及 `dispose()` 时被调用（`runtime.untracked()` 包裹执行，不建立新依赖）；旧 cleanup 会先被摘掉（置空）再执行，避免新 `fn()` 抛错时下次重跑/dispose 重复执行旧 cleanup。

默认微任务策略下依赖变化不会立即重跑，而是被 `Scheduler.enqueue()` 标脏排队，由 `flush()`（自动或手动）驱动 `tick()`；`tick()` 内部会先确认依赖确实变化（`hasStaleDependencies`）才真正 `run()`。注入 `flush => flush()` 这类同步策略时，setter 可在完整 fan-out 后立即重跑 Effect。
依赖节点被 `dispose()`/`disconnectObservable` 断开时，会强制下次 `tick()` 无条件重跑（不看是否真的脏）。

computed: Creates a lazy, cached derived value. It computes on first read, recomputes only after a dependency changed, and when nobody observes it any more it suspends itself at idle time (unless `keepAlive`).
computed.fn: Pure derivation; every node read inside becomes a dependency. It must not write signals.
computed.config: Either an `equals(a, b)` function, or `{ equals, keepAlive, debugName }`. `equals` decides whether dependents see a change (default `Object.is`); `keepAlive: true` keeps the value warm without observers.
An `IReactiveComputed` whose `.value` is read-only.
Any value that can be derived from other nodes. Use an effect only for side effects.

effect.fn: Effect body; may return a cleanup function.
effect.options: `debugName`: label for traces.

batch: Runs `fn` and merges every write inside it into one flush when the outermost `batch` returns, so effects never see a half-applied update. Nested calls only increase the depth.
batch.fn: Code that writes several nodes.
What `fn` returns. If `fn` throws and the final flush also throws, both errors are kept (see `ACTION_FLUSH_FAILED`).
untracked: Runs `fn` with dependency tracking turned off: nodes read inside are not recorded as dependencies of the current computed or effect.
untracked.fn: Code whose reads must not subscribe.
What `fn` returns.
Read configuration or context inside an effect without rerunning when it changes. For one node, `node.peek()` is shorter.
flush: Runs the pending effects now, synchronously. Production code normally relies on the scheduler strategy (merged microtasks by default); tests, SSR and explicit commit points call it directly.

What `fn` returns; an error of `fn` is rethrown after the error record.

symbols.name: ReactiveErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Every error code this package throws or reports. Branch on `error.code === ReactiveErrorCode.x` instead of the message text.
symbols.core:
callbackFailed: `CALLBACK_FAILED`: an unclassified callback failure. Writable native errors retain identity; primitive or immutable failures remain on cause, including undefined. Valid external identities and non-Error object control values pass through unchanged, without then probing.
nodeDisposed: `NODE_DISPOSED`: a disposed signal, computed or source was read or written.
circularDependency: `CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY`: a computed read itself while being computed.
crossRuntime: `CROSS_RUNTIME`: a node of one runtime was used by another runtime.
notRuntimeOwned: `NOT_RUNTIME_OWNED`: the object is not a runtime (or node) registered by this package.
ownershipConflict: `OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT`: one object was registered to two runtimes.
copyConflict: `COPY_CONFLICT`: multiple copies registered at a correctness boundary, or a foreign branded node crossed a local boundary. Cold imports alone need not register.
brandCorrupted: `BRAND_CORRUPTED`: the cross-copy diagnostic marker has an unexpected shape.
versionExhausted: `VERSION_EXHAUSTED`: the version clock reached its upper limit.
flushLoop: `FLUSH_LOOP`: one effect ran more than `maxFlushPasses` times in one flush.
observerFailed: `OBSERVER_FAILED`: several observers or hooks failed in one flush; an `AggregateError` holds them.
actionFlushFailed: `ACTION_FLUSH_FAILED`: a batch body and its final flush both failed.
schedulerFailed: `SCHEDULER_FAILED`: reserved code for scheduler strategy failures reported by adapters.
captureInvalid: `CAPTURE_INVALID`: a capture token was already used, belongs elsewhere, or its observer is gone.
bindingDuplicate: `BINDING_DUPLICATE`: `observe()` was called twice on one binding.
graphNodeRegistered: `GRAPH_NODE_REGISTERED`: a source or observer binding targeted an already registered node.
internalsRegistered: `INTERNALS_REGISTERED`: internal services were registered twice for one runtime.

members.name: callbackFailed
members.description: An unclassified action, batch, untracked, or tracked derivation callback threw. Annotatable * native errors keep identity and stack; immutable and primitive values remain on cause. Existing * package identities are preserved. Handle the callback failure before retrying the operation.

members.name: nodeDisposed
members.description: Thrown when a read or write operation targets a disposed `Signal`, `Computed`, or custom * source. * * Value access rejects after disposal to prevent reading stale values from disconnected nodes. * Stop using the disposed node and create a replacement instance.

members.name: circularDependency
members.description: Thrown when evaluating a `Computed` directly or indirectly reads its own pending result. * * A cycle cannot produce a determinate value. Further evaluation loops or returns incomplete * stale data. Inspect the dependency graph and remove the cycle.

members.name: crossRuntime
members.description: Thrown when a node from one `Runtime` is read, subscribed, or checked at another runtime's * boundary. * * Each `Runtime` owns an independent dependency graph and ownership table. Cross-graph operations * cannot preserve consistency and can leave stale dependency edges. Ensure the node and its * consumer belong to the same `Runtime`. Do not share nodes across runtimes.

members.name: notRuntimeOwned
members.description: Thrown when an object lacks the internal registration supplied by this library's runtime or * node factories. * * The kernel trusts only registered runtimes and nodes. It rejects unregistered objects at the * entry boundary instead of allowing later failures that obscure their source. Use an object from * this library's factories.

members.name: ownershipConflict
members.description: Thrown at the second registration when the same node object is assigned to different runtimes. * * A node cannot belong to two dependency graphs without invalidating ownership checks. Create * independent nodes for each `Runtime` instead of reusing an object across runtimes.

members.name: copyConflict
members.description: Reports multiple library copies, such as duplicate installations, bundled and CDN copies, or * separate microfrontend bundles. Also thrown when `assertSingleRuntimeCopy()` finds more than * one copy. * * Copies do not share ownership tables or synchronous tracking contexts. Cross-copy reads can * therefore return stale data without detection. Deduplicate dependencies to keep one library * copy in the process. Use `assertSingleRuntimeCopy()` when the deployment must reject multiple * copies.

members.name: brandCorrupted
members.description: Thrown when a cross-copy diagnostic brand has an unexpected shape. * * `Object.defineProperty` installs this read-only internal marker. An invalid brand indicates * modification outside the supported path and invalidates ownership checks. Do not modify * internal properties on managed objects.

members.name: versionExhausted
members.description: Thrown when a new version is requested after the monotonic clock reaches its configured limit. * The production default is `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`. * * Resetting the counter would collide with versions held by live nodes and cause missed updates. * The clock therefore stops on exhaustion. Dispose all nodes owned by the current `Runtime`, * discard that runtime, and create a new one instead of reusing the graph.

members.name: flushLoop
members.description: Thrown when one observer executes more than `maxFlushPasses` times in one flush. The default is * 100. * * This usually indicates an effect writes to its own dependency and triggers itself. The * scheduler clears pending work and ends the flush to prevent a synchronous infinite loop. * Inspect the discarded items in the error message to locate and remove the cycle.

members.name: observerFailed
members.description: Thrown or reported as an `AggregateError` when multiple observer `tick()` calls fail in a * flush, or multiple observable lifecycle hooks (`onObserved` or `onUnobserved`) fail. * * Inspect each entry in `error.errors`. A single observer failure retains the original error * without this code.

members.name: actionFlushFailed
members.description: Tags the aggregate when both the business action and final flush fail in `runBatched()`. If * reading the business error's `cause` fails, all three original failures enter * `AggregateError.errors`. * * A writable business error remains the top-level error, with the flush failure attached through * `cause`. Inspect the top-level error and its `cause` or `errors`.

members.name: schedulerFailed
members.description: Reserved diagnostic code for unhandled failures in an async scheduling callback or * `reportError()`. * * The default `adapter.reportError` is a no-op, so no default throw or report site uses this * code. The code remains stable for custom `onAsyncError` or `onError` handlers that need * scheduler-failure semantics.

members.name: captureInvalid
members.description: Thrown when `commitCapture()` receives an invalid or consumed token, a token from another * tracker, or a token whose observer is disposed. * * A capture token can be validated and committed only once. Reevaluate instead of reusing the * token, for example during a Concurrent React render.

members.name: bindingDuplicate
members.description: Thrown when `observe` is called on an `IObserverBinding` that already owns an active observer. * * `observe` is not idempotent. Duplicate calls indicate a repeated state-machine transition. * Ensure the previous observation ends before calling `observe` again.

members.name: graphNodeRegistered
members.description: Thrown when an extension binding targets a node with existing graph bookkeeping. Replacing its * sets would orphan live edges. Bind a fresh custom node once; do not rebind a Signal, Computed, * Effect, Resource, or an already bound custom node.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
callbackFailed: `CALLBACK_FAILED`: an unclassified callback failure. Writable native errors retain identity; primitive or immutable failures remain on cause, including undefined. Valid external identities and non-Error object control values pass through unchanged, without then probing.
nodeDisposed: `NODE_DISPOSED`: a disposed signal, computed or source was read or written.
circularDependency: `CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY`: a computed read itself while being computed.
crossRuntime: `CROSS_RUNTIME`: a node of one runtime was used by another runtime.
notRuntimeOwned: `NOT_RUNTIME_OWNED`: the object is not a runtime (or node) registered by this package.
ownershipConflict: `OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT`: one object was registered to two runtimes.
copyConflict: `COPY_CONFLICT`: multiple copies registered at a correctness boundary, or a foreign branded node crossed a local boundary. Cold imports alone need not register.
brandCorrupted: `BRAND_CORRUPTED`: the cross-copy diagnostic marker has an unexpected shape.
versionExhausted: `VERSION_EXHAUSTED`: the version clock reached its upper limit.
flushLoop: `FLUSH_LOOP`: one effect ran more than `maxFlushPasses` times in one flush.
observerFailed: `OBSERVER_FAILED`: several observers or hooks failed in one flush; an `AggregateError` holds them.
actionFlushFailed: `ACTION_FLUSH_FAILED`: a batch body and its final flush both failed.
schedulerFailed: `SCHEDULER_FAILED`: reserved code for scheduler strategy failures reported by adapters.
captureInvalid: `CAPTURE_INVALID`: a capture token was already used, belongs elsewhere, or its observer is gone.
bindingDuplicate: `BINDING_DUPLICATE`: `observe()` was called twice on one binding.
graphNodeRegistered: `GRAPH_NODE_REGISTERED`: a source or observer binding targeted an already registered node.
internalsRegistered: `INTERNALS_REGISTERED`: internal services were registered twice for one runtime.
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION`: a runtime option or argument has an invalid value.

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，18 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，`source` 恒为 `'@migaia/reactive'`。（迁移背景：原属于本包的 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`/`SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`/`GENERATION_DISPOSED`/`SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 五个码已随生命周期原语迁出，归属 `@migaia/lifecycle`，不在本表。）

rows: 未分类 action/batch/untracked/tracked derivation callback 失败；native 尽量原位附码，primitive（含 undefined）/不可变 native 原错保留 cause，已有 semantic identity 不变；非 Error 对象 throw 保留控制身份，供 Resource/Suspense owner 单次准入
在已 dispose 的 `Signal`/`Computed`/自定义 Source 上调用读取或写入方法
求值 `Computed` 时检测到它（直接或间接）读取了自己正在求值的结果
一个属于某 `Runtime` 的节点在另一个 `Runtime` 的追踪/所有权边界上被读取、订阅或校验
传入的对象不是由 `createRuntime()` 创建、或不携带内部所有权登记
同一个节点对象被重复登记到不同的 `Runtime`
检测到本库存在多份运行时副本，或 `assertSingleRuntimeCopy()` 校验到副本数大于一
跨副本诊断品牌被发现处于非预期形状
单调版本时钟达到配置上限（默认 `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`）后再次申请新版本号
一次冲刷内的重算轮数超过 `maxFlushPasses`（默认 100）
一次冲刷中多个 observer 的 `tick()` 失败、或多个 observable 生命周期钩子失败，作为 `AggregateError` 外壳
`runBatched()` 内业务动作与收尾 flush 同时失败；普通可写错误在 `cause` 附加聚合结果，不可读 `cause` 的三个原值直接置于 `AggregateError.errors`
预留：异步调度策略回调或 `reportError()` 捕获到未处理错误的诊断通道码（默认无内置抛出/上报点）
`capture()` 产生的 token 在 `commitCapture()` 时已失效、已被消费、属于另一个 tracker，或对应 observer 已 dispose
同一个 `IObserverBinding` 被重复调用 `observe()`（已处于 observed 状态）
source/observer binding尝试替换已有graph node的集合，须创建新节点
同一个 `Runtime` 对象被重复注册内部面（`registerInternals()`）
构造 `Runtime`/`Scheduler`/`VersionClock` 时传入的选项不满足取值要求

function createObserverBinding(runtime: IRuntime): IObserverBinding

type IObserverBinding = {
  capture<R>(read: () => R): ICapture<R>
  observe(fn: () => void | IDisposer, options?: IReactiveNodeOptions): IDisposer
  commit(capture: ICapture<unknown>): IObserverCommitResult
  retrack(): IObserverRetrackResult
}

type IObserverCommitResult = 'committed' | 'stale' | 'no-observer'
type IObserverRetrackResult = 'changed' | 'unchanged' | 'no-observer'

blocks.text: 为一个订阅者建立三段式绑定：render 期只读地捕获依赖，commit 期才把依赖装到订阅者上，中间的渲染可能被并发渲染丢弃，捕获阶段绝不建边。绑定自持一个内部 `Effect`：适配层能完成 capture/observe/commit/retrack，却拿不到 `deps`、版本或强制调度入口：
四个成员逐一说明：

items: `capture<R>(read: () => R): ICapture<R>` —— 渲染期捕获：只记录本次读到了哪些依赖节点及其当时版本，不建立依赖边、不推进版本、不排 idle 工作。读取 dirty Computed 复用其 speculative preview，所需已求值图保留在同一个 token 内，commit 先验证完整依赖树，再接纳图/缓存，不重跑 derivation 或 comparer；被丢弃的渲染不会留下订阅残留。`ICapture<R>` 是带品牌的不透明 token，`result: R` 是 `read()` 的返回值；依赖集合存在 tracker 私有 `WeakMap` 里，拿到 token 既读不出依赖也改不了版本。
`observe(fn, options?): IDisposer` —— 安装绑定持有的内部 `Effect`（具体类保持私有，适配层拿不到它去改 `deps`/版本或调用 `run`/`markDirty`）。同一个 binding 重复调用（当前订阅者仍处于已观察状态时再次调用）抛 `BINDING_DUPLICATE`。返回的 disposer 幂等。

`commit(capture): IObserverCommitResult` —— 提交期安装依赖，把 `capture` 装到创建绑定时指定的那个 observer 上。`'committed'`：依赖边已安装；`'stale'`：捕获后依赖已变化，token 已消费，必须重新捕获——调用方只应在此时作废快照并重新取值，不应该在 commit 阶段去 pull 脏节点（那会把用户的求值错误抛在 commit 里，绕过 Error Boundary）；`'no-observer'`：提交目标尚不存在（还未 `observe()` 或已 dispose），token 未消费，可在 observer 就绪后重试。
`retrack(): IObserverRetrackResult` —— 强制当前已提交的 observer 重跑一次，并报告其依赖集合或记录版本是否发生变化（`'changed'`/`'unchanged'`），无 observer 时返回 `'no-observer'`。

blocks.text: 1. 不要跨 `Runtime` 混用节点——一个 `Runtime` 创建的 `Signal` 被另一个 `Runtime` 的 `Computed`/`Effect` 读取会直接抛错。 2. 统一经 Runtime 工厂创建节点：`runtime.signal(value, options?)`、`runtime.computed(fn, config?)`、`runtime.effect(fn, options?)`，均支持 `dispose()`/`disposed`。 3. `runtime.effect(...)` 创建时会同步立即执行一次，不是等到依赖变化才第一次运行。 4. `Signal.value = 相同值`（`Object.is` 判定）不会触发任何通知，也不会推进版本号。 5. 没有订阅者的 `Computed` 会被自动挂起（断开依赖；下次读取先验证版本/拓扑，未变可复用缓存），需要"即使暂时没人订阅也保持热态"时传 `{ keepAlive: true }`。 6. `dispose()` 之后的节点读取会立刻抛错，不会静默返回旧值——这是有意设计，避免"看起来能用但永不更新"的幽灵状态。 7. `defaultRuntime` 是进程级单例，请求隔离（SSR）、单测互不污染、Worker 独立场景都应该显式 `createRuntime()`。
更完整的 API 参考、生命周期细节、错误处理与调度语义、扩展 API 说明见 USEGUIDE.md。

`@migaia/reactive/extension` provides `getDefaultRuntime()` for adapters that must stay cold on import. It constructs the shared default on first call and returns the exact same object as the root `defaultRuntime` binding. Importing the root convenience binding keeps its existing eager behavior. `ReactiveErrorPhase` is also available from the pure extension entry, with the same canonical object as the root export.

`deferRuntimeCleanup(runtime, task)` from `@migaia/reactive/extension` schedules synchronous adapter cleanup on that Runtime's `scheduleIdle` channel (the default uses microtasks). Thrown cleanup errors reach its `reportError` sink. It returns no mutable scheduler or graph capability and does not own asynchronous resources.

symbols.name: IInternalRuntime
symbols.purpose: Graph view of a runtime returned by `internalRuntimeOf()`: `signal()` and `computed()` return nodes that also expose `IObservable` / `IObserver`.
symbols.core:
signal: Creates a writable node. Reading `.value` inside a computed or an effect records a dependency; assigning a value that is not `Object.is`-equal advances its version and marks dependents dirty.
signal.value: Initial value.
signal.options: `debugName`: label used in trace events and errors.
A signal that is also an `IObservable`.
computed: Creates a lazy, cached derived value. It computes on first read, recomputes only after a dependency changed, and when nobody observes it any more it suspends itself at idle time (unless `keepAlive`).
computed.fn: Pure derivation; every node read inside becomes a dependency. It must not write signals.
computed.config: Either an `equals(a, b)` function, or `{ equals, keepAlive, debugName }`. `equals` decides whether dependents see a change (default `Object.is`); `keepAlive: true` keeps the value warm without observers.
A computed value that is also an `IObservable` and an `IObserver`.
Any value that can be derived from other nodes. Use an effect only for side effects.
effect: Creates a side effect that runs once immediately, records the nodes it reads, and runs again at the next flush after any of them changed. A function returned by `fn` is called before each rerun and on dispose.
effect.fn: Effect body; may return a cleanup function.
effect.options: `debugName`: label for traces.
An `IReactiveEffect` handle; `dispose()` removes dependencies and runs the last cleanup.
batch: Runs `fn` and merges every write inside it into one flush when the outermost `batch` returns, so effects never see a half-applied update. Nested calls only increase the depth.
batch.fn: Code that writes several nodes.
What `fn` returns. If `fn` throws and the final flush also throws, both errors are kept (see `ACTION_FLUSH_FAILED`).
untracked: Runs `fn` with dependency tracking turned off: nodes read inside are not recorded as dependencies of the current computed or effect.
untracked.fn: Code whose reads must not subscribe.
What `fn` returns.
Read configuration or context inside an effect without rerunning when it changes. For one node, `node.peek()` is shorter.
flush: Runs the pending effects now, synchronously. Production code normally relies on the scheduler strategy (merged microtasks by default); tests, SSR and explicit commit points call it directly.
`completed` from the outermost call after the queue is empty; `deferred` when called from inside an effect (the outer flush continues). More than `maxFlushPasses` reruns of one effect throw `FLUSH_LOOP` and drop the rest of the queue.

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，18 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，`source` 恒为 `'@migaia/reactive'`。（迁移背景：原属于本包的 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`/`SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`/`GENERATION_DISPOSED`/`SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 五个码已随生命周期原语迁出，归属 `@migaia/lifecycle`，不在本表。）

rows: 未分类 action/batch/untracked/tracked derivation callback 失败；native 尽量原位附码，primitive（含 undefined）/不可变 native 原错保留 cause，已有 semantic identity 不变；非 Error 对象 throw 保留控制身份，供 Resource/Suspense owner 单次准入
在已 dispose 的 `Signal`/`Computed`/自定义 Source 上调用读取或写入方法
求值 `Computed` 时检测到它（直接或间接）读取了自己正在求值的结果
一个属于某 `Runtime` 的节点在另一个 `Runtime` 的追踪/所有权边界上被读取、订阅或校验
传入的对象不是由 `createRuntime()` 创建、或不携带内部所有权登记
同一个节点对象被重复登记到不同的 `Runtime`
检测到本库存在多份运行时副本，或 `assertSingleRuntimeCopy()` 校验到副本数大于一
跨副本诊断品牌被发现处于非预期形状
单调版本时钟达到配置上限（默认 `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`）后再次申请新版本号
一次冲刷内的重算轮数超过 `maxFlushPasses`（默认 100）
一次冲刷中多个 observer 的 `tick()` 失败、或多个 observable 生命周期钩子失败，作为 `AggregateError` 外壳
`runBatched()` 内业务动作与收尾 flush 同时失败；普通可写错误在 `cause` 附加聚合结果，不可读 `cause` 的三个原值直接置于 `AggregateError.errors`
预留：异步调度策略回调或 `reportError()` 捕获到未处理错误的诊断通道码（默认无内置抛出/上报点）
`capture()` 产生的 token 在 `commitCapture()` 时已失效、已被消费、属于另一个 tracker，或对应 observer 已 dispose
同一个 `IObserverBinding` 被重复调用 `observe()`（已处于 observed 状态）
source/observer binding尝试替换已有graph node的集合，须创建新节点
同一个 `Runtime` 对象被重复注册内部面（`registerInternals()`）
构造 `Runtime`/`Scheduler`/`VersionClock` 时传入的选项不满足取值要求

symbols.purpose: Render/commit binding returned by `createObserverBinding()`. It owns one internal effect; the adapter can capture, observe, commit and retrack but cannot reach its dependencies.
symbols.core:
capture: Runs `read` with opaque capture and computed previews, without adding edges, advancing versions or scheduling work, including nested computed reads.
capture.read: Render-time read function.
An `ICapture` token with `result`.
observe: Installs the internal effect that reruns when committed dependencies change. Calling it again while observed throws `BINDING_DUPLICATE`.
observe.fn: The subscriber body (usually a rerender request).
observe.options: `debugName` for traces.
An idempotent disposer.
commit: Recursively validates the evaluated capture tree, then lets the canonical tracker adopt its dependencies and preview cache. It does not rerun derivations or comparers.
commit.capture: Token from `capture()`; consumed when committed.
`committed` (edges installed), `stale` (a dependency changed since capture; read again) or `no-observer` (call `observe()` first; the token is kept).
retrack: Forces the committed observer to rerun once.
`changed` or `unchanged` (whether its dependency set or recorded versions changed), or `no-observer`.

type IObserverBinding = {
  capture<R>(read: () => R): ICapture<R>
  observe(fn: () => void | IDisposer, options?: IReactiveNodeOptions): IDisposer
  commit(capture: ICapture<unknown>): IObserverCommitResult

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，18 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，`source` 恒为 `'@migaia/reactive'`。（迁移背景：原属于本包的 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`/`SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`/`GENERATION_DISPOSED`/`SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 五个码已随生命周期原语迁出，归属 `@migaia/lifecycle`，不在本表。）

rows: 未分类 action/batch/untracked/tracked derivation callback 失败；native 尽量原位附码，primitive（含 undefined）/不可变 native 原错保留 cause，已有 semantic identity 不变；非 Error 对象 throw 保留控制身份，供 Resource/Suspense owner 单次准入
在已 dispose 的 `Signal`/`Computed`/自定义 Source 上调用读取或写入方法
求值 `Computed` 时检测到它（直接或间接）读取了自己正在求值的结果
一个属于某 `Runtime` 的节点在另一个 `Runtime` 的追踪/所有权边界上被读取、订阅或校验
传入的对象不是由 `createRuntime()` 创建、或不携带内部所有权登记
同一个节点对象被重复登记到不同的 `Runtime`
检测到本库存在多份运行时副本，或 `assertSingleRuntimeCopy()` 校验到副本数大于一
跨副本诊断品牌被发现处于非预期形状
单调版本时钟达到配置上限（默认 `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`）后再次申请新版本号
一次冲刷内的重算轮数超过 `maxFlushPasses`（默认 100）
一次冲刷中多个 observer 的 `tick()` 失败、或多个 observable 生命周期钩子失败，作为 `AggregateError` 外壳
`runBatched()` 内业务动作与收尾 flush 同时失败；普通可写错误在 `cause` 附加聚合结果，不可读 `cause` 的三个原值直接置于 `AggregateError.errors`
预留：异步调度策略回调或 `reportError()` 捕获到未处理错误的诊断通道码（默认无内置抛出/上报点）
`capture()` 产生的 token 在 `commitCapture()` 时已失效、已被消费、属于另一个 tracker，或对应 observer 已 dispose
同一个 `IObserverBinding` 被重复调用 `observe()`（已处于 observed 状态）
source/observer binding尝试替换已有graph node的集合，须创建新节点
同一个 `Runtime` 对象被重复注册内部面（`registerInternals()`）
构造 `Runtime`/`Scheduler`/`VersionClock` 时传入的选项不满足取值要求

blocks.text: 调用方应始终以 `error.code === ReactiveErrorCode.xxx` 判别，不要硬编码码值字符串。逐条设计动机见源码 `src/error-code.ts` 的 JSDoc。

symbols.name: IRuntimeFieldSource
symbols.purpose: Controlled source returned by `createFieldSource()` for a value stored outside the graph.
symbols.core:
track: Records this source as a dependency of the current computed or effect.
Nothing; after dispose it throws `NODE_DISPOSED`.
notify: Publishes a change that already happened outside the graph (advances the version and notifies dependents).
Nothing; dependents are marked dirty.
commit: Reserves a version, runs `write`, then publishes using the greater of the reservation and this source’s already-published version. Reentrant notify cannot roll the version backward; callback ordering stays unchanged.
commit.write: Function that changes the external value.
What `write` returns.
observed: `true` while at least one observer depends on the source.
disposed: `true` after `dispose()`; a disposed node can no longer be read or written.
dispose: Releases the node: removes its dependency edges and stops notifications. Calling it again does nothing.
Nothing; afterwards `disposed` is `true` and reading the node throws `NODE_DISPOSED`.

blocks.text: 1. 不要跨 `Runtime` 混用节点——一个 `Runtime` 创建的 `Signal` 被另一个 `Runtime` 的 `Computed`/`Effect` 读取会直接抛错。 2. 统一经 Runtime 工厂创建节点：`runtime.signal(value, options?)`、`runtime.computed(fn, config?)`、`runtime.effect(fn, options?)`，均支持 `dispose()`/`disposed`。 3. `runtime.effect(...)` 创建时会同步立即执行一次，不是等到依赖变化才第一次运行。 4. `Signal.value = 相同值`（`Object.is` 判定）不会触发任何通知，也不会推进版本号。 5. 没有订阅者的 `Computed` 会被自动挂起（断开依赖；下次读取先验证版本/拓扑，未变可复用缓存），需要"即使暂时没人订阅也保持热态"时传 `{ keepAlive: true }`。 6. `dispose()` 之后的节点读取会立刻抛错，不会静默返回旧值——这是有意设计，避免"看起来能用但永不更新"的幽灵状态。 7. `defaultRuntime` 是进程级单例，请求隔离（SSR）、单测互不污染、Worker 独立场景都应该显式 `createRuntime()`。

`@migaia/reactive/extension` provides `getDefaultRuntime()` for adapters that must stay cold on import. It constructs the shared default on first call and returns the exact same object as the root `defaultRuntime` binding. Importing the root convenience binding keeps its existing eager behavior. `ReactiveErrorPhase` is also available from the pure extension entry, with the same canonical object as the root export.

`deferRuntimeCleanup(runtime, task)` from `@migaia/reactive/extension` schedules synchronous adapter cleanup on that Runtime's `scheduleIdle` channel (the default uses microtasks). Thrown cleanup errors reach its `reportError` sink. It returns no mutable scheduler or graph capability and does not own asynchronous resources.

type IResourceOptions<T = unknown> = {
  debugName?: string
  ttl?: number // 默认 Infinity（永不过期，除非依赖变化/手动刷新）
  autoStart?: boolean // 默认 true
  staleWhileRevalidate?: boolean // 默认 false
  retry?: IResourceRetryPolicy // 默认 0（不重试）
  retryDelay?: number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => number) // 默认 0
  keepAlive?: boolean // 默认 false
  initialSnapshot?: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>
  scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 @migaia/utils/scheduler 的 systemScheduler
}

type IResourceRetryPolicy = number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => boolean)

blocks.text: 逐项语义与校验：

items: `ttl?: number` —— 成功值的新鲜时长（毫秒）。`0` 与 `Infinity`（默认）表示永不因时间过期，只会因依赖变化/`refetch()`/`invalidate()` 而刷新。非 `Infinity` 时必须是有限非负数，否则抛贴 `INVALID_OPTION` 码的 `RangeError`；`updatedAt + ttl` 运算结果非有限（数值溢出）同样抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。
`autoStart?: boolean` —— 是否在构造函数内立即发起首次请求。默认 `true`。若同时提供了新鲜的 `initialSnapshot`，即使 `autoStart: true` 也不会立即再发一次请求。
`staleWhileRevalidate?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`。为 `true` 时，刷新期间继续展示旧的 `success` 数据（附带 `refreshing: true`），而不是回退到 `pending`。

`retry?: number | (failureCount, error) => boolean` —— 固定次数或自定义判断函数。数字必须是非负整数，否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。函数形式在每次失败后被调用一次，用第几次失败（从 1 开始）与错误对象决定是否重试；Suspense 抛出的 thenable 值不计入失败次数（`fetcher` 内部同步抛出一个 thenable 是被当作"需要等待后重跑"处理的，不是一次真实失败）。

`retryDelay?: number | (failureCount, error) => number` —— 固定延迟或按失败次数计算的函数，单位毫秒。数字必须是有限非负数；函数返回非数字时以原生 `TypeError`/`INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝；返回负数/非有限数字则为 `RangeError`/`INVALID_OPTION`。策略抛错或返回非法值时保留触发重试的 fetch 主因，原生策略 Error 尽量原样附码，已有外部身份不改写。
`keepAlive?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`：长时间无人观察 `state` 会在下一个 idle 时机自动休眠（断开上游边、保留依赖版本与缓存），下次读取核对版本；依赖未变且缓存新鲜时继续复用，变更时重拉。设为 `true` 时禁用自动休眠。
`initialSnapshot?: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>` —— SSR/持久化恢复用的初始成功快照；构造期即 `hydrate()`，格式非法抛 `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`（详见快照类型）。

`scheduler?: IScheduler`（`@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间域与排程来源：TTL/`updatedAt`/`expiresAt`/重试延迟全部走同一个调度器，默认 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 的 `systemScheduler`（单调时钟）。传入的值必须满足 `{ now(): number; schedule(cb, delayMs): IScheduledTask }` 契约（内部用 `snapshotScheduler` 校验），否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`；缺宿主能力时该 scheduler 在被调用时才 fail-fast，不会静默降级成微任务。

symbols.name: IResourceOptions
symbols.purpose: Options of `new Resource()`: caching, retries, start-up and snapshots.
symbols.core:
debugName: Label shown in reactive diagnostics and in request error context.
Not set: diagnostics show no label.
ttl: Success lifetime in milliseconds; positive finite lifetimes revalidate on an expired read. `0` and `Infinity` disable time expiration, but changed dependencies, including after suspension, still trigger refetching. Must be ≥ 0 or `Infinity`.
`Infinity`: fresh until a dependency changes or `refetch()` is called.
autoStart: Start the first request in the constructor.
`true`: starts immediately unless the initial snapshot is fresh.
staleWhileRevalidate: Keep showing expired success data while the refresh runs (`refreshing` is `true`) instead of switching to `pending`.
`false`: an expired value is replaced by `pending`.
retry: Retry policy after a failure: a non-negative integer of extra attempts, or `(failureCount, error) => boolean` deciding each retry. A Promise thrown for Suspense does not count as a failure. A throwing policy or invalid result yields `INVALID_OPTION`; the triggering fetch failure stays reachable through `cause` or `errors`, and existing external identity is preserved.
`0`: no retry.
retryDelay: Wait before each retry in milliseconds, or `(failureCount, error) => ms` for backoff. Throwing callbacks or invalid results retain the fetch failure in `cause` or `errors`; policy errors receive `INVALID_OPTION` unless already classified externally.
`0`: retry immediately.
keepAlive: Keep upstream dependencies connected while nothing reads `state`, so changes are still tracked.
`false`: unobserved resources disconnect upstream.
initialSnapshot: Success snapshot from `dehydrate()` (server rendering or persistence) used as the initial state; it is revalidated when expired.
Not set: start from `idle`.
scheduler: Clock and timers for `ttl`, `updatedAt`, `expiresAt` and retry delays; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
`systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.

  readonly runtime: IRuntime
  debugName?: string
  readonly deps: ReadonlySet<IObservable>
  readonly depVersions: ReadonlyMap<IObservable, number>

  readonly state: IResourceState<T>
  readonly promise: Promise<T>
  readonly disposed: boolean
  readonly refreshing: boolean
  readonly fetchStatus: ResourceFetchStatus
  readonly isStale: boolean
  readonly observed: boolean

  read(): T
  peek(): T
  peekState(): IResourceState<T>
  reset(): void
  refetch(): Promise<T>
  invalidate(): Promise<T>
  cancel(): void
  dehydrate(): IResourceCacheSnapshot<T> | undefined
  hydrate(snapshot: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>): void
  dispose(): void

  // IObserver 接口成员：由 @migaia/reactive 的依赖图在内部调用，一般不需要手动调用
  markDirty(): void
  onDependencyDisconnected(): void
}

type IResourceOptions<T = unknown> = {
  debugName?: string
  ttl?: number // 默认 Infinity（永不过期，除非依赖变化/手动刷新）
  autoStart?: boolean // 默认 true
  staleWhileRevalidate?: boolean // 默认 false
  retry?: IResourceRetryPolicy // 默认 0（不重试）
  retryDelay?: number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => number) // 默认 0
  keepAlive?: boolean // 默认 false
  initialSnapshot?: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>
  scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 @migaia/utils/scheduler 的 systemScheduler
}

type IResourceRetryPolicy = number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => boolean)
