sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
debugName: Label shown in reactive diagnostics and in request error context.
Not set: diagnostics show no label.
ttl: Success lifetime in milliseconds; positive finite lifetimes revalidate on an expired read. `0` and `Infinity` disable time expiration, but changed dependencies, including after suspension, still trigger refetching. Must be ≥ 0 or `Infinity`.
`Infinity`: fresh until a dependency changes or `refetch()` is called.
autoStart: Start the first request in the constructor.
`true`: starts immediately unless the initial snapshot is fresh.
staleWhileRevalidate: Keep showing expired success data while the refresh runs (`refreshing` is `true`) instead of switching to `pending`.
`false`: an expired value is replaced by `pending`.
retry: Retry policy after a failure: a non-negative integer of extra attempts, or `(failureCount, error) => boolean` deciding each retry. A Promise thrown for Suspense does not count as a failure. A throwing policy or invalid result yields `INVALID_OPTION`; the triggering fetch failure stays reachable through `cause` or `errors`, and existing external identity is preserved.
`0`: no retry.
retryDelay: Wait before each retry in milliseconds, or `(failureCount, error) => ms` for backoff. Throwing callbacks or invalid results retain the fetch failure in `cause` or `errors`; policy errors receive `INVALID_OPTION` unless already classified externally.
`0`: retry immediately.
keepAlive: Keep upstream dependencies connected while nothing reads `state`, so changes are still tracked.
`false`: unobserved resources disconnect upstream.
initialSnapshot: Success snapshot from `dehydrate()` (server rendering or persistence) used as the initial state; it is revalidated when expired.
Not set: start from `idle`.
scheduler: Clock and timers for `ttl`, `updatedAt`, `expiresAt` and retry delays; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
`systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.

type IResourceRetryPolicy = number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => boolean)

blocks.text: 逐项语义与校验：

items: `ttl?: number` —— 成功值的新鲜时长（毫秒）。`0` 与 `Infinity`（默认）表示永不因时间过期，只会因依赖变化/`refetch()`/`invalidate()` 而刷新。非 `Infinity` 时必须是有限非负数，否则抛贴 `INVALID_OPTION` 码的 `RangeError`；`updatedAt + ttl` 运算结果非有限（数值溢出）同样抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。
`autoStart?: boolean` —— 是否在构造函数内立即发起首次请求。默认 `true`。若同时提供了新鲜的 `initialSnapshot`，即使 `autoStart: true` 也不会立即再发一次请求。
`staleWhileRevalidate?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`。为 `true` 时，刷新期间继续展示旧的 `success` 数据（附带 `refreshing: true`），而不是回退到 `pending`。

`retry?: number | (failureCount, error) => boolean` —— 固定次数或自定义判断函数。数字必须是非负整数，否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。函数形式在每次失败后被调用一次，用第几次失败（从 1 开始）与错误对象决定是否重试；Suspense 抛出的 thenable 值不计入失败次数（`fetcher` 内部同步抛出一个 thenable 是被当作"需要等待后重跑"处理的，不是一次真实失败）。

`retryDelay?: number | (failureCount, error) => number` —— 固定延迟或按失败次数计算的函数，单位毫秒。数字必须是有限非负数；函数返回非数字时以原生 `TypeError`/`INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝；返回负数/非有限数字则为 `RangeError`/`INVALID_OPTION`。策略抛错或返回非法值时保留触发重试的 fetch 主因，原生策略 Error 尽量原样附码，已有外部身份不改写。
`keepAlive?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`：长时间无人观察 `state` 会在下一个 idle 时机自动休眠（断开上游边、保留依赖版本与缓存），下次读取核对版本；依赖未变且缓存新鲜时继续复用，变更时重拉。设为 `true` 时禁用自动休眠。
`initialSnapshot?: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>` —— SSR/持久化恢复用的初始成功快照；构造期即 `hydrate()`，格式非法抛 `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`（详见快照类型）。

`scheduler?: IScheduler`（`@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间域与排程来源：TTL/`updatedAt`/`expiresAt`/重试延迟全部走同一个调度器，默认 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 的 `systemScheduler`（单调时钟）。传入的值必须满足 `{ now(): number; schedule(cb, delayMs): IScheduledTask }` 契约（内部用 `snapshotScheduler` 校验），否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`；缺宿主能力时该 scheduler 在被调用时才 fail-fast，不会静默降级成微任务。

symbols.name: Resource
symbols.purpose: Creates one async data source bound to a reactive runtime. Every request gets a generation; only the result of the newest generation is written to `state`, and replaced requests receive an aborted `signal`. With `autoStart` (default) the first request starts in the constructor unless `initialSnapshot` is fresh.
symbols.core:
fetcher: Function `(context) => value | Promise` that loads the data. `context` comes from the resource for each request: `signal` aborts when the request is replaced, reset, cancelled or disposed; `generation` is the request number; `token` stays the same across retries of one request. Reactive values read synchronously (before the first `await`) become dependencies. Final unclassified fetch failures receive `FETCH_FAILED`; existing external error identity stays intact, and immutable errors or primitive failures remain reachable through `cause`.
runtime: Reactive runtime returned by `createRuntime()` from `@migaia/reactive`; the same runtime must own the signals the fetcher reads and the effects that read `state`. `dispose()` does not dispose it.
A `Resource` instance; invalid options throw `INVALID_OPTION`, an invalid `initialSnapshot` throws `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`.
deps: Reactive values the last request read synchronously; a change in any of them schedules a new request. Read-only, for diagnostics.
depVersions: Version of each dependency seen by the last request, used by the reactive runtime to skip refreshes when nothing really changed.
runtime: The runtime passed to the constructor; the resource registers itself there as an observer.
debugName: Label given by the `debugName` option, shown in reactive diagnostics and request error context.
state: Current state as a reactive read: an effect that reads it reruns when the state changes. Reading an expired success value starts a revalidation. Throws `RESOURCE_DISPOSED` after `dispose()`.
promise: Promise of the current request, or a resolved Promise of a fresh cached value. Readers share the latest published request Promise; a reentrant fetcher cannot overwrite a Promise of a newer request. Reading it starts work only when idle or stale.
disposed: `true` after `dispose()`; still readable afterwards, unlike most members.
refreshing: `true` while a background refresh runs and the previous success data stays visible (`staleWhileRevalidate`).
fetchStatus: `fetching` while any request runs, otherwise `idle`; separate from `state.status`.
isStale: `true` when the cached success value is older than `ttl`; `false` for any other state.
observed: `true` while some effect or computed currently reads `state`; without observers and without `keepAlive` the resource drops its upstream dependencies.
read: Suspense-style read with tracking: returns the data on success, throws the pending Promise while loading, and throws the error after failure or cancellation.
The data of the current success state.
peek: Materializes the current state without tracking, starting work or revalidating TTL. Pending throws its Promise; normal `autoStart: false` idle with no Promise throws `NO_ACTIVE_PROMISE`. Inspect `peekState()` or explicitly start work first.
peekState: Returns the state without tracking, without starting work and without checking `ttl`.
An `IResourceState` snapshot: branch on `status` (`idle`, `pending`, `success` with `data`, `error` / `cancelled` with `error`).
reset: Cancels the running request, drops cached data and returns to `idle`; the next read starts again.
Nothing; the state is now `idle`.
refetch: Starts a new request even if the cache is fresh, aborting the running one.
Promise of the new request result.
invalidate: Marks the cached data as expired and starts a replacement request at once.
Promise of the replacement request result.
cancel: With an active request, aborts it and pauses passive restarts. Pending becomes `cancelled` (`REQUEST_CANCELLED`); a stale-while-revalidate refresh keeps its success data. Without active work this is a no-op; explicit `refetch()` resumes work.
Nothing; active work is cancelled while cached success data may remain.
dehydrate: Captures a v2 success snapshot with portable durations and unchanged caller-owned data. Only time metadata is directly JSON-encodable: BigInt or cyclic data needs caller serialization. Use safe transport or HTML-context encoding; never insert raw JSON into a script element.
An `IResourceCacheSnapshot`, or `undefined` when the state is not `success`.
hydrate: Replaces the state with a success snapshot produced by `dehydrate()`, cancelling any running request. An expired snapshot is revalidated on the next read. Durations are rebased to the receiving scheduler; callers add known transport/storage time to `ageMs` and subtract it from finite `remainingTtlMs` (minimum zero). Old v1 snapshots are rejected.
hydrate.snapshot: Snapshot returned by `dehydrate()` (often on the server); malformed snapshots throw `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`.
Nothing; the state is now `success`.
markDirty: The reactive runtime calls this when a value read by the Resource request changes. It schedules a refresh and groups repeated notifications into that scheduled refresh. Application code changes the input, such as userId.value, and lets the runtime send this notification; it does not need to call markDirty().
Nothing; a refresh is scheduled.
onDependencyDisconnected: The reactive runtime calls this when an input used by the Resource has been disposed and can no longer supply a value. It schedules another request even without an ordinary input change. If that request fails while reading the disposed input, the failure becomes visible in the Resource error state. Application code disposes the input and lets the runtime call this method.
Nothing; a forced refresh is scheduled.
dispose: Ends the resource: cancels the request, removes dependencies and subscriptions. Calling it again does nothing; afterwards data reads and operations throw `RESOURCE_DISPOSED`, while `disposed`, `refreshing` and `observed` stay readable. The runtime is not disposed.
Nothing; the resource is terminal.
debugName: Label shown in reactive diagnostics and in request error context.
Not set: diagnostics show no label.
ttl: Success lifetime in milliseconds; positive finite lifetimes revalidate on an expired read. `0` and `Infinity` disable time expiration, but changed dependencies, including after suspension, still trigger refetching. Must be ≥ 0 or `Infinity`.
`Infinity`: fresh until a dependency changes or `refetch()` is called.
autoStart: Start the first request in the constructor.
`true`: starts immediately unless the initial snapshot is fresh.
staleWhileRevalidate: Keep showing expired success data while the refresh runs (`refreshing` is `true`) instead of switching to `pending`.

examples:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { Resource } from '@migaia/resource'

const value = new Resource(({ generation }) => generation, createRuntime(), { autoStart: false })

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates one async data source bound to a reactive runtime. Every request gets a generation; only the result of the newest generation is written to `state`, and replaced requests receive an aborted `signal`. With `autoStart` (default) the first request starts in the constructor unless `initialSnapshot` is fresh.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import Resource from @migaia/resource, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use Resource when its class contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when Resource does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained class example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
fetcher: Function `(context) => value | Promise` that loads the data. `context` comes from the resource for each request: `signal` aborts when the request is replaced, reset, cancelled or disposed; `generation` is the request number; `token` stays the same across retries of one request. Reactive values read synchronously (before the first `await`) become dependencies. Final unclassified fetch failures receive `FETCH_FAILED`; existing external error identity stays intact, and immutable errors or primitive failures remain reachable through `cause`.
runtime: Reactive runtime returned by `createRuntime()` from `@migaia/reactive`; the same runtime must own the signals the fetcher reads and the effects that read `state`. `dispose()` does not dispose it.
A `Resource` instance; invalid options throw `INVALID_OPTION`, an invalid `initialSnapshot` throws `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`.
deps: Reactive values the last request read synchronously; a change in any of them schedules a new request. Read-only, for diagnostics.
depVersions: Version of each dependency seen by the last request, used by the reactive runtime to skip refreshes when nothing really changed.
runtime: The runtime passed to the constructor; the resource registers itself there as an observer.
debugName: Label given by the `debugName` option, shown in reactive diagnostics and request error context.
state: Current state as a reactive read: an effect that reads it reruns when the state changes. Reading an expired success value starts a revalidation. Throws `RESOURCE_DISPOSED` after `dispose()`.
promise: Promise of the current request, or a resolved Promise of a fresh cached value. Readers share the latest published request Promise; a reentrant fetcher cannot overwrite a Promise of a newer request. Reading it starts work only when idle or stale.
disposed: `true` after `dispose()`; still readable afterwards, unlike most members.
refreshing: `true` while a background refresh runs and the previous success data stays visible (`staleWhileRevalidate`).
fetchStatus: `fetching` while any request runs, otherwise `idle`; separate from `state.status`.
isStale: `true` when the cached success value is older than `ttl`; `false` for any other state.
observed: `true` while some effect or computed currently reads `state`; without observers and without `keepAlive` the resource drops its upstream dependencies.
read: Suspense-style read with tracking: returns the data on success, throws the pending Promise while loading, and throws the error after failure or cancellation.
The data of the current success state.
peek: Materializes the current state without tracking, starting work or revalidating TTL. Pending throws its Promise; normal `autoStart: false` idle with no Promise throws `NO_ACTIVE_PROMISE`. Inspect `peekState()` or explicitly start work first.
peekState: Returns the state without tracking, without starting work and without checking `ttl`.
An `IResourceState` snapshot: branch on `status` (`idle`, `pending`, `success` with `data`, `error` / `cancelled` with `error`).
reset: Cancels the running request, drops cached data and returns to `idle`; the next read starts again.
Nothing; the state is now `idle`.
refetch: Starts a new request even if the cache is fresh, aborting the running one.
Promise of the new request result.
invalidate: Marks the cached data as expired and starts a replacement request at once.
Promise of the replacement request result.
cancel: With an active request, aborts it and pauses passive restarts. Pending becomes `cancelled` (`REQUEST_CANCELLED`); a stale-while-revalidate refresh keeps its success data. Without active work this is a no-op; explicit `refetch()` resumes work.
Nothing; active work is cancelled while cached success data may remain.
dehydrate: Captures a v2 success snapshot with portable durations and unchanged caller-owned data. Only time metadata is directly JSON-encodable: BigInt or cyclic data needs caller serialization. Use safe transport or HTML-context encoding; never insert raw JSON into a script element.
An `IResourceCacheSnapshot`, or `undefined` when the state is not `success`.
hydrate: Replaces the state with a success snapshot produced by `dehydrate()`, cancelling any running request. An expired snapshot is revalidated on the next read. Durations are rebased to the receiving scheduler; callers add known transport/storage time to `ageMs` and subtract it from finite `remainingTtlMs` (minimum zero). Old v1 snapshots are rejected.
hydrate.snapshot: Snapshot returned by `dehydrate()` (often on the server); malformed snapshots throw `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`.
Nothing; the state is now `success`.
markDirty: The reactive runtime calls this when a value read by the Resource request changes. It schedules a refresh and groups repeated notifications into that scheduled refresh. Application code changes the input, such as userId.value, and lets the runtime send this notification; it does not need to call markDirty().
Nothing; a refresh is scheduled.
onDependencyDisconnected: The reactive runtime calls this when an input used by the Resource has been disposed and can no longer supply a value. It schedules another request even without an ordinary input change. If that request fails while reading the disposed input, the failure becomes visible in the Resource error state. Application code disposes the input and lets the runtime call this method.
Nothing; a forced refresh is scheduled.
dispose: Ends the resource: cancels the request, removes dependencies and subscriptions. Calling it again does nothing; afterwards data reads and operations throw `RESOURCE_DISPOSED`, while `disposed`, `refreshing` and `observed` stay readable. The runtime is not disposed.
Nothing; the resource is terminal.
debugName: Label shown in reactive diagnostics and in request error context.
Not set: diagnostics show no label.
ttl: Success lifetime in milliseconds; positive finite lifetimes revalidate on an expired read. `0` and `Infinity` disable time expiration, but changed dependencies, including after suspension, still trigger refetching. Must be ≥ 0 or `Infinity`.
`Infinity`: fresh until a dependency changes or `refetch()` is called.
autoStart: Start the first request in the constructor.
`true`: starts immediately unless the initial snapshot is fresh.
staleWhileRevalidate: Keep showing expired success data while the refresh runs (`refreshing` is `true`) instead of switching to `pending`.
`false`: an expired value is replaced by `pending`.
retry: Retry policy after a failure: a non-negative integer of extra attempts, or `(failureCount, error) => boolean` deciding each retry. A Promise thrown for Suspense does not count as a failure. A throwing policy or invalid result yields `INVALID_OPTION`; the triggering fetch failure stays reachable through `cause` or `errors`, and existing external identity is preserved.
`0`: no retry.
retryDelay: Wait before each retry in milliseconds, or `(failureCount, error) => ms` for backoff. Throwing callbacks or invalid results retain the fetch failure in `cause` or `errors`; policy errors receive `INVALID_OPTION` unless already classified externally.
`0`: retry immediately.
keepAlive: Keep upstream dependencies connected while nothing reads `state`, so changes are still tracked.
`false`: unobserved resources disconnect upstream.
initialSnapshot: Success snapshot from `dehydrate()` (server rendering or persistence) used as the initial state; it is revalidated when expired.
Not set: start from `idle`.
scheduler: Clock and timers for `ttl`, `updatedAt`, `expiresAt` and retry delays; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
`systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.

blocks.code:
type IResourceOptions<T = unknown> = {
  debugName?: string
  ttl?: number // 默认 Infinity（永不过期，除非依赖变化/手动刷新）
  autoStart?: boolean // 默认 true
  staleWhileRevalidate?: boolean // 默认 false
  retry?: IResourceRetryPolicy // 默认 0（不重试）
  retryDelay?: number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => number) // 默认 0
  keepAlive?: boolean // 默认 false
  initialSnapshot?: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>
  scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 @migaia/utils/scheduler 的 systemScheduler
}

type IResourceRetryPolicy = number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => boolean)

blocks.text: 逐项语义与校验：

items: `ttl?: number` —— 成功值的新鲜时长（毫秒）。`0` 与 `Infinity`（默认）表示永不因时间过期，只会因依赖变化/`refetch()`/`invalidate()` 而刷新。非 `Infinity` 时必须是有限非负数，否则抛贴 `INVALID_OPTION` 码的 `RangeError`；`updatedAt + ttl` 运算结果非有限（数值溢出）同样抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。
`autoStart?: boolean` —— 是否在构造函数内立即发起首次请求。默认 `true`。若同时提供了新鲜的 `initialSnapshot`，即使 `autoStart: true` 也不会立即再发一次请求。
`staleWhileRevalidate?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`。为 `true` 时，刷新期间继续展示旧的 `success` 数据（附带 `refreshing: true`），而不是回退到 `pending`。

`retry?: number | (failureCount, error) => boolean` —— 固定次数或自定义判断函数。数字必须是非负整数，否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。函数形式在每次失败后被调用一次，用第几次失败（从 1 开始）与错误对象决定是否重试；Suspense 抛出的 thenable 值不计入失败次数（`fetcher` 内部同步抛出一个 thenable 是被当作"需要等待后重跑"处理的，不是一次真实失败）。

`retryDelay?: number | (failureCount, error) => number` —— 固定延迟或按失败次数计算的函数，单位毫秒。数字必须是有限非负数；函数返回非数字时以原生 `TypeError`/`INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝；返回负数/非有限数字则为 `RangeError`/`INVALID_OPTION`。策略抛错或返回非法值时保留触发重试的 fetch 主因，原生策略 Error 尽量原样附码，已有外部身份不改写。
`keepAlive?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`：长时间无人观察 `state` 会在下一个 idle 时机自动休眠（断开上游边、保留依赖版本与缓存），下次读取核对版本；依赖未变且缓存新鲜时继续复用，变更时重拉。设为 `true` 时禁用自动休眠。
`initialSnapshot?: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>` —— SSR/持久化恢复用的初始成功快照；构造期即 `hydrate()`，格式非法抛 `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`（详见快照类型）。

`scheduler?: IScheduler`（`@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间域与排程来源：TTL/`updatedAt`/`expiresAt`/重试延迟全部走同一个调度器，默认 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 的 `systemScheduler`（单调时钟）。传入的值必须满足 `{ now(): number; schedule(cb, delayMs): IScheduledTask }` 契约（内部用 `snapshotScheduler` 校验），否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`；缺宿主能力时该 scheduler 在被调用时才 fail-fast，不会静默降级成微任务。

guidance.id: 底层依赖-lifecycle-原语的使用方式
guidance.heading: 底层依赖：lifecycle 原语的使用方式

blocks.text: `Resource` 内部直接组合 `@migaia/lifecycle` 与 `@migaia/reactive` 的原语，理解这层有助于诊断边界行为：

items: `createGenerationController()`（来自 `@migaia/lifecycle`）——每次 `#startRequest()` 调用 `begin()` 开一代新请求；`refetch()`/`invalidate()`/依赖变化都会使旧一代失效（`supersede()`），只有 `isCurrent(token)` 为真的那一代结果才会写回 `#stateSignal`。`dispose()` 时调用其 `dispose()` 终结控制器。
`createTerminalController()`（来自 `@migaia/lifecycle`）——驱动 `Resource` 自身的容器存活轴（`open → closing → terminal`）；`disposed` getter 直接读它的 `lifecycle === 'terminal'`。
`probeThenable()` / `assimilateCapturedThen()`（来自 `@migaia/utils/function`）——用于安全探测 `fetcher` 同步抛出的值是否是 thenable（Suspense 抛 Promise 模式），只读一次 `.then`，避免 hostile getter 被读取两次或异常被吞掉。
`systemScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）/ `snapshotScheduler()`（来自 `@migaia/lifecycle`）——`scheduler` 选项的默认值与校验函数；TTL 到期判定、重试延迟计时都通过它，不直接使用宿主 `setTimeout`/`Date.now`。
`internalRuntimeOf()` / `createTrackedObserver()`（来自 `@migaia/reactive/extension`）——Resource作为IObserver接入图，仅获得绑定自身的追踪、挂起、重验证与idle能力；依赖集合由reactive内部维护，请求、取消与资源释放仍由Resource负责。

blocks.code: import { RESOURCE_SOURCE, ResourceErrorCode, type IResourceErrorCode } from '@migaia/resource'

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，9 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，包自身错误的 `source` 为 `'@migaia/resource'`；已有完整外部身份的错误保留原包身份。 `RESOURCE_SOURCE` 导出这个稳定 source，跨包分类错误时应比较它与 `ResourceErrorCode`，不要复制字符串字面量。

rows: 在已 `dispose()` 的 `Resource` 上调用任意读取/操作方法
请求停止时的原生 AbortError；Resource 主动取消时与 signal.reason 同一，lifecycle replacement reason 保留在 cause
调用方显式 `cancel()` 导致当前 pending 请求被取消，`state` 落入 `cancelled` 所携带的 `DOMException`
请求取消已完成状态收敛，但取消期间的 timer/listener cleanup 失败
读取 `promise`，或 `pending`/`idle` 状态下内部 `#materialize()` 时，没有一个正在进行或已缓存的 Promise 可返回
非 v2 快照、负/非有限时长（remaining 可为 null）、本地重建时间戳溢出或 getter 失败
构造/调用时传入的选项（`ttl`、`retry`、`retryDelay`、`scheduler` 等）不满足取值要求
`fetcher` 抛出用于 Suspense 的值，但探测其 `.then` 时 getter 本身抛错，无法判定是否为 thenable
重试耗尽后的未分类 fetch 失败；原生错误尽量保留身份，冻结错误/非 Error 值保留在 cause，已有外部身份不改写

blocks.text: `requestAborted`/`requestCancelled` 抛出/落入状态的值始终是原生 `DOMException`（`name === 'AbortError'`），调用方通常按 `error.name === 'AbortError'` 判定并静默处理，而不是当作真实失败；`code` 只作为附加字段挂上，不改变类型。调用方应始终以 `error.code === ResourceErrorCode.xxx` 判别，不要硬编码码值字符串。

guidance.id: 高阶组合示例-1-suspense-兼容读取-error-boundary
guidance.heading: 高阶组合示例 · 1. Suspense 兼容读取 + Error Boundary

blocks.text: 1. 依赖追踪只认"首次 `await` 之前的同步读取"。`await` 之后再读响应式值不会被自动追踪，需要的话应该把这部分读取挪进一个 `Computed` 或在 `await` 之前先读入局部变量。 2. `fetcher` 必须把 `signal` 交给真正可取消的 I/O（比如 `fetch(url, { signal })`），否则 `cancel()`/依赖变化引发的取消只是让 `Resource` 忽略这次结果，底层请求仍会跑完。 3. `refetch()` 总是发起新请求，被动读取（`state`/`promise`/`read()`）只在过期或 idle 时才发起——想强制刷新用 `refetch()` 或 `invalidate()`，不要指望重复读 `state` 能触发。 4. 不再使用必须 `dispose()`，否则订阅、在途请求和依赖登记会一直存在；释放后数据读取和请求操作抛 `RESOURCE_DISPOSED`；`disposed`、`refreshing`、`observed` 仍可读，`markDirty()`、`onDependencyDisconnected()` 与再次 `dispose()` 是安全空操作。 5. 默认 `keepAlive: false` 时，Resource 长时间无人观察会自动休眠（断开上游边、保留依赖版本与缓存），下次读取先核对依赖；依赖未变且缓存新鲜时复用原值和 Promise，依赖已变则重拉；需要"没人看也保持热数据"就显式传 `keepAlive: true`。
更完整的配置项、每个 API 的精确语义、错误与异常的完整表格、生产级示例，见 USEGUIDE.md。
同一请求在所有 Suspense 等待阶段复用同一个 pending Promise。fetcher 抛出的 thenable 完成后，经注入 scheduler 的 0ms 任务继续执行；Suspense 不计入 retry 次数，也不设计数上限。即使 fetcher 连续抛立即完成的 thenable，取消任务仍可执行，cancel/dispose 会停止后续调用。

状态类型迁移：`ResourceStatus.fetching` 改为 `ResourceFetchStatus.fetching`；旧 `IResourceStatus` / `IResourceFetchStatus` 类型改用与常量同名的 `ResourceStatus` / `ResourceFetchStatus` key union。运行时的状态字符串与 SWR 数据/传输语义保持不变。

configuration.name: debugName
configuration.description: Human-readable owner label used in reactive diagnostics and request error context.
configuration.descriptionEn: Human-readable owner label used in reactive diagnostics and request error context.

configuration.name: ttl
configuration.description: `dehydrate()`：非 `success` 时返回 `undefined`；否则原样保留业务 `data`，同时捕获非负时长 `ageMs` 与 `remainingTtlMs`。后者为 `null` 表示无时间过期（`ttl: 0` 或无限 TTL）。任意 `T` 不保证 JSON 可序列化，BigInt/循环对象仍由调用方处理。
configuration.descriptionEn: Successful values remain fresh for this many milliseconds. `0` and `Infinity` keep them fresh until a dependency changes or `refetch()` is called.
configuration.descriptionZh: `dehydrate()`：非 `success` 时返回 `undefined`；否则原样保留业务 `data`，同时捕获非负时长 `ageMs` 与 `remainingTtlMs`。后者为 `null` 表示无时间过期（`ttl: 0` 或无限 TTL）。任意 `T` 不保证 JSON 可序列化，BigInt/循环对象仍由调用方处理。

configuration.name: autoStart
configuration.description: 若提供了 `initialSnapshot`，构造期会先 `hydrate()` 它；随后若 `autoStart`（默认 `true`）为真且（没有初始快照，或初始快照已过期），立即发起首次请求。
configuration.descriptionEn: Start the first request in the constructor. Defaults to true.
configuration.descriptionZh: 若提供了 `initialSnapshot`，构造期会先 `hydrate()` 它；随后若 `autoStart`（默认 `true`）为真且（没有初始快照，或初始快照已过期），立即发起首次请求。

configuration.name: staleWhileRevalidate
configuration.description: `refreshing: boolean` —— 是否正在后台刷新（`staleWhileRevalidate: true` 且当前展示的仍是旧成功值时为真）；已释放时返回 `false`（不抛错）。
configuration.descriptionEn: Keep stale success data visible while a background refresh runs.
configuration.descriptionZh: `refreshing: boolean` —— 是否正在后台刷新（`staleWhileRevalidate: true` 且当前展示的仍是旧成功值时为真）；已释放时返回 `false`（不抛错）。

configuration.name: retry
configuration.description: `retry?: number | (failureCount, error) => boolean` —— 固定次数或自定义判断函数。数字必须是非负整数，否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。函数形式在每次失败后被调用一次，用第几次失败（从 1 开始）与错误对象决定是否重试；Suspense 抛出的 thenable 值不计入失败次数（`fetcher` 内部同步抛出一个 thenable 是被当作"需要等待后重跑"处理的，不是一次真实失败）。
configuration.descriptionEn: Retry count or predicate. Suspense Promise throws do not count.
configuration.descriptionZh: `retry?: number | (failureCount, error) => boolean` —— 固定次数或自定义判断函数。数字必须是非负整数，否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。函数形式在每次失败后被调用一次，用第几次失败（从 1 开始）与错误对象决定是否重试；Suspense 抛出的 thenable 值不计入失败次数（`fetcher` 内部同步抛出一个 thenable 是被当作"需要等待后重跑"处理的，不是一次真实失败）。

configuration.name: retryDelay
configuration.description: `retryDelay?: number | (failureCount, error) => number` —— 固定延迟或按失败次数计算的函数，单位毫秒。数字必须是有限非负数；函数返回非数字时以原生 `TypeError`/`INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝；返回负数/非有限数字则为 `RangeError`/`INVALID_OPTION`。策略抛错或返回非法值时保留触发重试的 fetch 主因，原生策略 Error 尽量原样附码，已有外部身份不改写。
configuration.descriptionZh: `retryDelay?: number | (failureCount, error) => number` —— 固定延迟或按失败次数计算的函数，单位毫秒。数字必须是有限非负数；函数返回非数字时以原生 `TypeError`/`INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝；返回负数/非有限数字则为 `RangeError`/`INVALID_OPTION`。策略抛错或返回非法值时保留触发重试的 fetch 主因，原生策略 Error 尽量原样附码，已有外部身份不改写。

configuration.name: keepAlive
configuration.description: `keepAlive?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`：长时间无人观察 `state` 会在下一个 idle 时机自动休眠（断开上游边、保留依赖版本与缓存），下次读取核对版本；依赖未变且缓存新鲜时继续复用，变更时重拉。设为 `true` 时禁用自动休眠。
configuration.descriptionEn: Keep upstream reactive edges while no state consumer exists.
configuration.descriptionZh: `keepAlive?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`：长时间无人观察 `state` 会在下一个 idle 时机自动休眠（断开上游边、保留依赖版本与缓存），下次读取核对版本；依赖未变且缓存新鲜时继续复用，变更时重拉。设为 `true` 时禁用自动休眠。

configuration.name: initialSnapshot
configuration.description: 若提供了 `initialSnapshot`，构造期会先 `hydrate()` 它；随后若 `autoStart`（默认 `true`）为真且（没有初始快照，或初始快照已过期），立即发起首次请求。
configuration.descriptionEn: SSR/persisted success cache used before optional revalidation.
configuration.descriptionZh: 若提供了 `initialSnapshot`，构造期会先 `hydrate()` 它；随后若 `autoStart`（默认 `true`）为真且（没有初始快照，或初始快照已过期），立即发起首次请求。

configuration.name: scheduler
configuration.description: `hydrate(snapshot)`：先验证 v2，再按接收端 scheduler.now() 重建内部时间戳，作废当前请求并清空依赖，恢复 `success`。剩余寿命从 hydration 继续计时；调用方若需计入传输/存储耗时，应把已知耗时加到 `ageMs`，并从有限的 `remainingTtlMs` 扣除（最低为 0）。两端无需共享单调时钟原点。格式不是 v2、时长为负/非有限（仅 remaining 允许 null），或重建时间戳溢出时抛 `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`；getter 失败保留 cause。旧 v1 绝对时间格式明确拒绝，应在知道旧时钟基准的地方转换，接收端不能猜测。
configuration.descriptionEn: Supplies one scheduler for TTL, `updatedAt`, `expiresAt`, and retry delays (`runtime-neutrality.sdd.md` R-9 / AR-02). Defaults to utils/scheduler `systemScheduler`. Missing host capabilities fail immediately instead of silently falling back to microtasks.
configuration.descriptionZh: `hydrate(snapshot)`：先验证 v2，再按接收端 scheduler.now() 重建内部时间戳，作废当前请求并清空依赖，恢复 `success`。剩余寿命从 hydration 继续计时；调用方若需计入传输/存储耗时，应把已知耗时加到 `ageMs`，并从有限的 `remainingTtlMs` 扣除（最低为 0）。两端无需共享单调时钟原点。格式不是 v2、时长为负/非有限（仅 remaining 允许 null），或重建时间戳溢出时抛 `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`；getter 失败保留 cause。旧 v1 绝对时间格式明确拒绝，应在知道旧时钟基准的地方转换，接收端不能猜测。

blocks.code: import { RESOURCE_SOURCE, ResourceErrorCode, type IResourceErrorCode } from '@migaia/resource'

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，9 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，包自身错误的 `source` 为 `'@migaia/resource'`；已有完整外部身份的错误保留原包身份。 `RESOURCE_SOURCE` 导出这个稳定 source，跨包分类错误时应比较它与 `ResourceErrorCode`，不要复制字符串字面量。

rows: 在已 `dispose()` 的 `Resource` 上调用任意读取/操作方法
请求停止时的原生 AbortError；Resource 主动取消时与 signal.reason 同一，lifecycle replacement reason 保留在 cause
调用方显式 `cancel()` 导致当前 pending 请求被取消，`state` 落入 `cancelled` 所携带的 `DOMException`
请求取消已完成状态收敛，但取消期间的 timer/listener cleanup 失败
读取 `promise`，或 `pending`/`idle` 状态下内部 `#materialize()` 时，没有一个正在进行或已缓存的 Promise 可返回
非 v2 快照、负/非有限时长（remaining 可为 null）、本地重建时间戳溢出或 getter 失败
构造/调用时传入的选项（`ttl`、`retry`、`retryDelay`、`scheduler` 等）不满足取值要求
`fetcher` 抛出用于 Suspense 的值，但探测其 `.then` 时 getter 本身抛错，无法判定是否为 thenable
重试耗尽后的未分类 fetch 失败；原生错误尽量保留身份，冻结错误/非 Error 值保留在 cause，已有外部身份不改写

blocks.text: `requestAborted`/`requestCancelled` 抛出/落入状态的值始终是原生 `DOMException`（`name === 'AbortError'`），调用方通常按 `error.name === 'AbortError'` 判定并静默处理，而不是当作真实失败；`code` 只作为附加字段挂上，不改变类型。调用方应始终以 `error.code === ResourceErrorCode.xxx` 判别，不要硬编码码值字符串。

symbols.name: ResourceErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Table of the stable error codes of this package. Each key names one failure; the values are the strings found on `error.code`.
symbols.core:
resourceDisposed: `RESOURCE_DISPOSED`: a member was used after `dispose()`; create a new resource.
requestAborted: `REQUEST_ABORTED`: Resource-initiated cancellation uses the same native AbortError as its signal reason and rejection. Lifecycle replacement can supply a different signal reason, retained on the `cause` of the Resource AbortError.
requestCancelled: `REQUEST_CANCELLED`: the `AbortError` stored in the `cancelled` state after `cancel()`.
cancellationCleanupFailed: `CANCELLATION_CLEANUP_FAILED`: a timer or listener could not be cleaned after cancellation; the resource still counts as cancelled.
noActivePromise: `NO_ACTIVE_PROMISE`: no request Promise is available, including a valid `autoStart: false` idle `peek()`; inspect `peekState()` or explicitly start a request.
invalidSnapshot: `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`: snapshot version is not `2`, durations are negative/non-finite (only remaining lifetime permits `null`), or rebased local timestamps overflow. Getter failures retain their cause.
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION`: an option such as `ttl`, `retry` or `retryDelay` is invalid; fix the options.
fetchFailed: `FETCH_FAILED`: final unclassified fetch failure after retries. Native errors keep identity when writable; immutable errors and primitive values stay reachable through `cause`. Existing foreign source/code is preserved.
suspenseProbeFailed: `SUSPENSE_PROBE_FAILED`: a value thrown by the fetcher has a throwing `then` getter; both errors are kept in `errors`.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.
examples: import { RESOURCE_SOURCE, ResourceErrorCode, type IResourceErrorCode } from '@migaia/resource'

members.name: resourceDisposed
members.description: Rejects operations guarded by `#assertUsable()` after the `Resource` is disposed. This prevents * reading stale state after tracking stops. Repeated `dispose()` remains a no-op, and lifecycle * inspection getters remain available. Use a new `Resource` for further data reads or * operations.

members.name: requestAborted
members.description: Identifies the native AbortError for a stopped request. Resource-initiated cancellation uses * this same error as signal.reason; lifecycle-owned replacement reasons remain on its cause. * Callers usually recognize `error.name === 'AbortError'` and handle cancellation quietly.

members.name: requestCancelled
members.description: Identifies the `DOMException` in the `cancelled` state when explicit `cancel()` cancels a * pending request. Preserves the native `AbortError` type. Unlike `REQUEST_ABORTED`, which * identifies request rejection, this code identifies explicit cancellation state.

members.name: cancellationCleanupFailed
members.description: Reports timer or listener cleanup failure after request cancellation converges state. * `REQUEST_CANCELLED` identifies the `AbortError` stored in the cancelled state. This code * separates cleanup failures from state errors under `migration.sdd.md` §3.7.2. Record the * cleanup failure and continue treating the `Resource` as cancelled.

members.name: noActivePromise
members.description: Reports a missing active or cached Promise when reading `promise` or materializing `pending` or * `idle`. This usually indicates inconsistent intermediate state. Check for internal state * changes that bypass the normal `refetch()` or `invalidate()` paths.

members.name: invalidSnapshot
members.description: Rejects a version other than 2, negative/nonfinite age or remaining lifetime, or durations that * cannot be rebased into finite local scheduler timestamps. Accessor failures retain their cause. * `remainingTtlMs: null` means unbounded lifetime. Migrate old absolute-time snapshots * explicitly; their sender clock origin cannot be inferred on the receiver.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Rejects construction or operation options such as invalid `ttl`, retry counts, or `retryDelay`. * Validation rejects invalid configuration before it enters the state machine. Correct the * supplied options. Retry policy failures retain the triggering fetch error in their chain.

members.name: suspenseProbeFailed
members.description: Reports a throwing `.then` getter on a value the `fetcher` throws for Suspense. The probe * cannot determine whether the value is a thenable. `AggregateError.errors` retains both the * original thrown value and getter failure by identity. Enforces `error-codes.md` §2 and §3.2. * Inspect the hostile getter instead of silently retrying it as an ordinary fetch failure.

members.name: fetchFailed
members.description: A fetcher failure exhausted retry without an existing semantic identity. Mutable native errors * retain type, identity, and stack; immutable errors/non-Error values stay reachable on cause. * Already classified failures retain their originating package. Inspect the request failure * instead of treating it as cancellation or an invalid option.

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，9 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，包自身错误的 `source` 为 `'@migaia/resource'`；已有完整外部身份的错误保留原包身份。 `RESOURCE_SOURCE` 导出这个稳定 source，跨包分类错误时应比较它与 `ResourceErrorCode`，不要复制字符串字面量。

rows: 在已 `dispose()` 的 `Resource` 上调用任意读取/操作方法
请求停止时的原生 AbortError；Resource 主动取消时与 signal.reason 同一，lifecycle replacement reason 保留在 cause
调用方显式 `cancel()` 导致当前 pending 请求被取消，`state` 落入 `cancelled` 所携带的 `DOMException`
请求取消已完成状态收敛，但取消期间的 timer/listener cleanup 失败
读取 `promise`，或 `pending`/`idle` 状态下内部 `#materialize()` 时，没有一个正在进行或已缓存的 Promise 可返回
非 v2 快照、负/非有限时长（remaining 可为 null）、本地重建时间戳溢出或 getter 失败
构造/调用时传入的选项（`ttl`、`retry`、`retryDelay`、`scheduler` 等）不满足取值要求
`fetcher` 抛出用于 Suspense 的值，但探测其 `.then` 时 getter 本身抛错，无法判定是否为 thenable
重试耗尽后的未分类 fetch 失败；原生错误尽量保留身份，冻结错误/非 Error 值保留在 cause，已有外部身份不改写

blocks.text: 1. 依赖追踪只认"首次 `await` 之前的同步读取"。`await` 之后再读响应式值不会被自动追踪，需要的话应该把这部分读取挪进一个 `Computed` 或在 `await` 之前先读入局部变量。 2. `fetcher` 必须把 `signal` 交给真正可取消的 I/O（比如 `fetch(url, { signal })`），否则 `cancel()`/依赖变化引发的取消只是让 `Resource` 忽略这次结果，底层请求仍会跑完。 3. `refetch()` 总是发起新请求，被动读取（`state`/`promise`/`read()`）只在过期或 idle 时才发起——想强制刷新用 `refetch()` 或 `invalidate()`，不要指望重复读 `state` 能触发。 4. 不再使用必须 `dispose()`，否则订阅、在途请求和依赖登记会一直存在；释放后数据读取和请求操作抛 `RESOURCE_DISPOSED`；`disposed`、`refreshing`、`observed` 仍可读，`markDirty()`、`onDependencyDisconnected()` 与再次 `dispose()` 是安全空操作。 5. 默认 `keepAlive: false` 时，Resource 长时间无人观察会自动休眠（断开上游边、保留依赖版本与缓存），下次读取先核对依赖；依赖未变且缓存新鲜时复用原值和 Promise，依赖已变则重拉；需要"没人看也保持热数据"就显式传 `keepAlive: true`。
更完整的配置项、每个 API 的精确语义、错误与异常的完整表格、生产级示例，见 USEGUIDE.md。
同一请求在所有 Suspense 等待阶段复用同一个 pending Promise。fetcher 抛出的 thenable 完成后，经注入 scheduler 的 0ms 任务继续执行；Suspense 不计入 retry 次数，也不设计数上限。即使 fetcher 连续抛立即完成的 thenable，取消任务仍可执行，cancel/dispose 会停止后续调用。

状态类型迁移：`ResourceStatus.fetching` 改为 `ResourceFetchStatus.fetching`；旧 `IResourceStatus` / `IResourceFetchStatus` 类型改用与常量同名的 `ResourceStatus` / `ResourceFetchStatus` key union。运行时的状态字符串与 SWR 数据/传输语义保持不变。

symbols.name: createBrowserPeer
symbols.purpose: Creates a browser Runtime Peer. Connect resolves after the real handshake/directory exchange; listen returns an accept facade, and each incoming SharedWorker port has its own handshake. Supply exactly one supported source and pair both sides with `createBrowserPeer`.
symbols.core:
options: See `IRuntimeBrowserPeerOptions`. Besides `connect` / `listen` / `signal` it accepts the Core Peer options: `provide` (methods this side offers), `defaultTimeoutMs`, `report`, `probe`, `providerLimits`, `authentication`, `contract`, `self`.
An `IRuntimePeer` from `@migaia/rpc-core`: `request` / `notify` / `stream` / `group` / `outcome` call the other side, `on("ready")` observes reconnection, `describe()` reads the directory, `close()` (or `await using`) ends the logical connection without closing the carrier. Typed by `TRemote` when given.
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.
No result is used; reporter errors are contained by the reporting boundary.
Omitted: defaultRpcReporter reports to console.error.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
connect: Carrier to connect over: `{ window, origin }`, `{ sharedWorker }` or `{ rtcDataChannel }`.
Not set: then `listen` is required.
listen: SharedWorker global scope (`self`) that accepts one Peer per actual port in each `connect` event; binding the same scope twice throws `LISTENER_ALREADY_BOUND`.
Not set: then `connect` is required.
signal: Cancels unfinished connection work; in listen mode it also closes the listener and its accepted logical peers. Borrowed native carriers stay application-owned.
Absent: no caller cancellation signal; existing Core deadlines still apply.

symbols.name: IRuntimeBrowserPeerOptions
symbols.purpose: Options of `createBrowserPeer()`: the browser source plus the Core Peer options.
symbols.core:
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.
No result is used; reporter errors are contained by the reporting boundary.
Omitted: defaultRpcReporter reports to console.error.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
connect: Carrier to connect over: `{ window, origin }`, `{ sharedWorker }` or `{ rtcDataChannel }`.
Not set: then `listen` is required.
listen: SharedWorker global scope (`self`) that accepts one Peer per actual port in each `connect` event; binding the same scope twice throws `LISTENER_ALREADY_BOUND`.
Not set: then `connect` is required.
signal: Cancels unfinished connection work; in listen mode it also closes the listener and its accepted logical peers. Borrowed native carriers stay application-owned.
Absent: no caller cancellation signal; existing Core deadlines still apply.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

blocks.text: 浏览器 Peer 自身错误的 source 为 `RPC_BROWSER_ERROR_SOURCE`（`@migaia/rpc/browser`），code 从 `RpcBrowserErrorCode` 读取。

rows: Window Peer 未显式提供非空 origin；填写固定对端源。
RTCDataChannel 无序或配置了有限重传；使用默认可靠有序频道。
同一个 SharedWorker scope 已绑定监听器；关闭原监听器再绑定。
connect/listen 来源或选项组合非法；选择一个受支持的真实载体。
RTC 消息无法解码；排查双方发送的数据，原失败保留在 cause。

blocks.text: Core / Remote 继续拥有握手、目录、调用、取消与超时错误。现有 transport 的非法配置为 Core `INVALID_CONFIG`，物理载体失败为 Core `TRANSPORT`；调用 deadline 使用既有 Core code。已有完整外部语义身份的 I/O Error 保持原身份；未分类的可变原生 Error/DOMException 原位附 Core `TRANSPORT`，不可附加身份的值保留在 cause。RTC 错误事件的原 error 保留在 cause。WebTransport send 返回处理写入拒绝后的 Promise，不保证与 native writer.write 的 Promise 引用相同。不要把远端传回的 source/code 当成本地控制权限。
关闭与竞争： `close()` 可重复调用；初始化中可用 signal 取消握手并释放已安装的监听器。close 后不再接纳晚到的业务消息。窗口导航/卸载、页面静默关闭 SharedWorker 端口没有可靠的远端关闭事件，pending 调用沿用 Core deadline；未配置有效等待上限时不能承诺及时发现断开。
调用一直超时： 检查固定 origin、真实来源窗口、对端是否已经启动 Peer，以及两端实际方法目录。Endpoint 用户还需检查中间件与 provide。
页面退出： 在本地 `pagehide` 中调用 `peer.close()` 或 `endpoint.dispose()`；借用端口与频道仍由创建者关闭。
二进制： Window / SharedWorker / Service Worker transport 使用结构化克隆；RTC 以 JSON 字符串传输，二进制需应用选择合适的编码。Runtime payload 仍受 Core 的公共可移植值契约约束。

Peer 配置与载体解码错误使用 `RPC_BROWSER_ERROR_SOURCE`（`@migaia/rpc/browser`）及 `RpcBrowserErrorCode`：`WINDOW_ORIGIN_REQUIRED`、`RTC_CHANNEL_UNRELIABLE`、`LISTENER_ALREADY_BOUND`、`INVALID_PEER_SOURCE`、`MESSAGE_DECODE_FAILED`。错误保持原生类型与 cause。握手、调用、取消、超时沿用 Core / Remote 的错误身份；现有 transport 配置错误与载体失败继续使用 Core 的 `INVALID_CONFIG` / `TRANSPORT`。

members.name: windowOriginRequired
members.description: BP-R2 requires a nonempty explicit Window origin; provide the destination origin before * connecting.

members.name: rtcChannelUnreliable
members.description: BP-R5 requires ordered reliable RTC delivery; use a reliable channel or the Endpoint API.

members.name: listenerAlreadyBound
members.description: BP-R3 allows one active listener per SharedWorker scope; close or reuse that listener first.

members.name: invalidPeerSource
members.description: BP-R1 rejects conflicting or unsupported sources; supply one concrete connect source or listen * scope.

members.name: messageDecodeFailed
members.description: BP-R5 rejects malformed RTC JSON and retains the decoder cause; correct the remote wire input.

symbols.name: captureRpcBinaryData
symbols.purpose: Synchronously captures the original protocol graph and backing references at the caller-selected snapshot point. Pair with restoreRpcBinary for a complete inline round trip; preparation can finish later.
symbols.core:
message: Normalized IRpcRuntimeEnvelope from the canonical runtime constructor or strict normalizer, containing actual business binary roots.
storage: Application-selected inline or native RpcBinaryStorage matching the negotiated carrier capability.
limit: Optional binary allocation budget, default `16777216` bytes: native storage charges the full backing; inline storage charges offset plus visible bytes. Codec/prehash and the outer carrier own any complete physical-frame limit.
digest: Optional IRpcBinaryDigest; native mode requires it. The asynchronous callback receives each complete original ArrayBuffer and resolves SHA-256 text; rejection fails preparation.
codec: Optional application-held IRpcBinaryDataCodec owns representation encoding and optional inline capture; its throws fail the original preparation; the native prehash path checks encoded physical size, while other representations retain their codec or outer-carrier limit responsibility.
IRpcCapturedBinaryData; malformed graph, backing or budget throws INVALID_ENVELOPE synchronously.
parameters: message: IRpcRuntimeEnvelope
storage: RpcBinaryStorage
limit: number (optional)
digest: IRpcBinaryDigest (optional)
codec: IRpcBinaryDataCodec (optional)
symbols.returns: IRpcCapturedBinaryData

symbols.name: prepareRpcBinary
symbols.purpose: Captures one canonical runtime envelope before yielding, then finishes manifest encoding and complete-backing digests. Pair with restoreRpcBinary; no endpoint, replay or execution state is changed.
symbols.core:
message: Normalized IRpcRuntimeEnvelope from the canonical runtime constructor or strict normalizer, containing actual business binary roots.
storage: Application-selected inline or native RpcBinaryStorage matching the negotiated carrier capability.
limit: Optional binary allocation budget, default `16777216` bytes: native storage charges the full backing; inline storage charges offset plus visible bytes. Codec/prehash and the outer carrier own any complete physical-frame limit.
digest: Optional IRpcBinaryDigest; native mode requires it. The asynchronous callback receives each complete original ArrayBuffer and resolves SHA-256 text; rejection fails preparation.
codec: Optional application-held IRpcBinaryDataCodec owns representation encoding and optional inline capture; its throws fail the original preparation; the native prehash path checks encoded physical size, while other representations retain their codec or outer-carrier limit responsibility.
Promise of IRpcPreparedBinary; failures reject with native coded INVALID_ENVELOPE and retained cause.
parameters: message: IRpcRuntimeEnvelope
storage: RpcBinaryStorage
limit: number (optional)
digest: IRpcBinaryDigest (optional)
codec: IRpcBinaryDataCodec (optional)
symbols.returns: Promise<IRpcPreparedBinary>

guidance.heading: 9. 高阶用法：跨进程与跨语言传递错误 · 识别本包抛出的错误

blocks.text: `classifyRpcContractError(error)` 判断一个错误是否确实由本包在本地抛出（按对象引用识别，复制的错误或来自其它进程的错误返回 `undefined`），并返回其 code 与对外消息：

guidance.id: 9-高阶用法-跨进程与跨语言传递错误-序列化与还原
guidance.heading: 9. 高阶用法：跨进程与跨语言传递错误 · 序列化与还原

items: 错误树必有 `source`、`code`、`name`、`message`、`stack`；可选 `cause`、`errors`（`AggregateError`）、可移植的 `data`、路由信息 `route`，以及表示被截断的 `truncated: true`。
序列化受深度、节点数和字节数上限约束（`RpcWireErrorLimit`），超出部分可能截断并设置 truncated；预算或文本截断不保证逐次调用 report。读取属性失败或规范化失败会经 report 报告，不会中断序列化，不能以 report 次数统计所有截断。
`normalizeRpcSerializedError(value)` 校验收到的错误树；`reachRpcError(error, { report: failure => console.error(failure) })` 遍历本地错误的 `cause` 与 `errors`，按引用去重。

JSON Schema 随包发布在 `@migaia/rpc-contract/schema/wire-error`，可作结构校验起点；它不等价于完整有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 也有区别。

blocks.text: 脱敏：可以给 `serializeRpcError` 传第三个参数 `{ summaries, routes }`（两个以 Error 对象为键的 `WeakMap`），为指定的错误提供对外展示的摘要（例如统一的 code 与消息），隐藏内部细节与 `cause`。

guidance.id: 9-高阶用法-跨进程与跨语言传递错误-序列化与还原
guidance.heading: 9. 高阶用法：跨进程与跨语言传递错误 · 序列化与还原

items: 错误树必有 `source`、`code`、`name`、`message`、`stack`；可选 `cause`、`errors`（`AggregateError`）、可移植的 `data`、路由信息 `route`，以及表示被截断的 `truncated: true`。
序列化受深度、节点数和字节数上限约束（`RpcWireErrorLimit`），超出部分可能截断并设置 truncated；预算或文本截断不保证逐次调用 report。读取属性失败或规范化失败会经 report 报告，不会中断序列化，不能以 report 次数统计所有截断。
`normalizeRpcSerializedError(value)` 校验收到的错误树；`reachRpcError(error, { report: failure => console.error(failure) })` 遍历本地错误的 `cause` 与 `errors`，按引用去重。

JSON Schema 随包发布在 `@migaia/rpc-contract/schema/wire-error`，可作结构校验起点；它不等价于完整有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 也有区别。

blocks.text: 脱敏：可以给 `serializeRpcError` 传第三个参数 `{ summaries, routes }`（两个以 Error 对象为键的 `WeakMap`），为指定的错误提供对外展示的摘要（例如统一的 code 与消息），隐藏内部细节与 `cause`。

guidance.heading: 9. 高阶用法：跨进程与跨语言传递错误 · 序列化与还原

items: 错误树必有 `source`、`code`、`name`、`message`、`stack`；可选 `cause`、`errors`（`AggregateError`）、可移植的 `data`、路由信息 `route`，以及表示被截断的 `truncated: true`。
序列化受深度、节点数和字节数上限约束（`RpcWireErrorLimit`），超出部分可能截断并设置 truncated；预算或文本截断不保证逐次调用 report。读取属性失败或规范化失败会经 report 报告，不会中断序列化，不能以 report 次数统计所有截断。
`normalizeRpcSerializedError(value)` 校验收到的错误树；`reachRpcError(error, { report: failure => console.error(failure) })` 遍历本地错误的 `cause` 与 `errors`，按引用去重。

guidance.id: 9-高阶用法-跨进程与跨语言传递错误-序列化与还原
guidance.heading: 9. 高阶用法：跨进程与跨语言传递错误 · 序列化与还原

items: 错误树必有 `source`、`code`、`name`、`message`、`stack`；可选 `cause`、`errors`（`AggregateError`）、可移植的 `data`、路由信息 `route`，以及表示被截断的 `truncated: true`。
序列化受深度、节点数和字节数上限约束（`RpcWireErrorLimit`），超出部分可能截断并设置 truncated；预算或文本截断不保证逐次调用 report。读取属性失败或规范化失败会经 report 报告，不会中断序列化，不能以 report 次数统计所有截断。
`normalizeRpcSerializedError(value)` 校验收到的错误树；`reachRpcError(error, { report: failure => console.error(failure) })` 遍历本地错误的 `cause` 与 `errors`，按引用去重。

JSON Schema 随包发布在 `@migaia/rpc-contract/schema/wire-error`，可作结构校验起点；它不等价于完整有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 也有区别。

blocks.text: 脱敏：可以给 `serializeRpcError` 传第三个参数 `{ summaries, routes }`（两个以 Error 对象为键的 `WeakMap`），为指定的错误提供对外展示的摘要（例如统一的 code 与消息），隐藏内部细节与 `cause`。

sections.content:
major: Positive protocol major version; peers must share a major version to negotiate.
minor: Nonnegative highest compatible minor version; agreement selects the lower shared value.
codec: Negotiated lowercase codec identity selected from both peers’ actual offers.
capabilities: Independent versioned capability declarations; only actual shared offers enable a feature.
peer: Remote diagnostic peer identity retained from the received handshake, without runtime rights.
error: Original or serialized failure carried by this failed result, preserving its causal diagnostics.
versions: Unique supported major versions and each highest compatible minor version, supplied by the application.
codecs: Ordered unique codec identities offered by the application; json is the mandatory baseline.
auth: Optional application portable authentication data; keep tokens out of diagnostic output.
kind: Wire discriminator selected by the producing protocol owner, not by transport or application payload shape.
Treat this record as first-channel negotiation, never business traffic.
step: Selects hello proposal, accept agreement or serialized rejection.
protocol: Exact protocol identity migaia.rpc; unsupported identities cannot complete negotiation.

symbols.name: RpcCapability
symbols.purpose: Independent negotiated capabilities; a declaration never implies its dependencies. Each stable key below identifies one wire choice or diagnostic bound.
symbols.core:
abort: `abort@1` permits ordinary correlated cancellation messages.
ping: `ping@1` permits liveness ping and pong controls.
close: `close@1` permits orderly peer close control.
deadline: `deadline@1` permits relative operation deadlines.
idempotency: `idempotency@1` permits legacy request replay keys.
trace: `trace@1` permits bounded diagnostic trace metadata.
stream: `stream@1` permits pull-credit stream exchanges.
runtimeApi: `runtime-api@1` enables the symmetric runtime application directory when both actual offers include it.
forwardRoute: `forward-route@1` permits signed Host routes and synchronous loop checks.
generation: `generation@1` fences actual accepted execution/session generations.
order: `order@1` requires the complete provider admission port for arrival ordering.
group: `group@1` reserves every request step before any provider starts.
cancelBeforeStart: `cancel-before-start@1` lets the final provider arbitrate cancellation before actual execution.
outcome: `outcome@1` allows read-only pending/done/unknown lookup in the original store.
portableBinary: `portable-binary@1` restores native bytes through the closed binary manifest grammar.
nativeBinary: Native authenticated manifests verify full backing integrity before authentication replay commit.
transfer: `transfer@1` transfers only explicitly supplied original backings on real transfer carriers.
batch: `batch@1` groups physical envelopes without adding a semantic envelope kind.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.

symbols.core:
profile: Fixed protocol-owned profile marker that separates this grammar from application records.
kind: Wire discriminator selected by the producing protocol owner, not by transport or application payload shape.
id: Application or protocol-owner correlation identifier; preserve it on replies and controls for the same task.
route: Contract-owned routing data kept separate from the application payload.
task: Original runtime task tuple containing mode, caller and exact target generation.
payload: Optional application data admitted through portable normalization, never routing or connection authority.
options: Explicit runtime operation options; absence of a field never infers permission or capability.
steps: Ordered group methods reserved before execution; failure stops later steps without rollback.
operation: Control operation selected by the owning protocol grammar.
reason: Optional serialized cancellation or terminal reason preserving the original failure diagnostics.
stream: Original stream event record carrying its sequence and permitted item or error fields.
completion: Actual original operation success/result or serialized failure, never an execution guess.
idempotencyKey: Application-issued stable operation key reused only when requesting the same business effect.
state: Actual result classification selected by the operation or store owner.
store: Actual final provider store identity and continuity facts, not inferred from a missing key.
outcome: Retained original business completion and target generation from the provider idempotency store.
mode: Original logical operation mode retained across controls and results.
callerId: Caller instance identifier obtained from the actual runtime peer identity.
callerGeneration: Caller-owned generation obtained from its actual accepted runtime identity.
targetGeneration: Exact target generation obtained from the accepted provider binding and preserved across controls.
method: Application method name chosen from the provider or remote contract being invoked.
value: Generation owner-issued nonnegative safe integer, not a supervisor attempt ordinal.
providerId: Identifier issued by the generation owner and obtained from the accepted provider binding.
orderKey: Application-issued ordering lane key; the final provider owns arrival ordering for equal keys.
cancel: Explicit before-start cancellation policy selected by the original caller.
timeoutMs: Optional relative operation deadline in integer milliseconds from `0` through `2147483647`; zero is allowed.
ok: Boolean discriminator separating successful completion from serialized failure.
result: Portable business result present only when the associated completion or step succeeds.
error: Original or serialized failure carried by this failed result, preserving its causal diagnostics.
event: Protocol-owned discriminator for the selected runtime semantic variant.
seq: Nonnegative stream sequence owned by the stream protocol; initial open uses zero.
epoch: Original idempotency-store incarnation identifier issued by the store owner.
continuity: Original store owner-issued continuity fact, never inferred from a missing key.

symbols.name: IRpcFramerOptions
symbols.purpose: Snapshot of bounded fragment-retention policy captured by each fragment framer constructor.
symbols.core:
chunkBytes: Positive safe-integer fragment size: byte count for binary, UTF-16 code-unit count for string framing.
`16384` units per fragment.
maxMessageBytes: Positive safe-integer size ceiling for complete inbound/outbound values and reassembly; string counts UTF-16 code units, binary counts bytes. Cannot exceed maxBufferedBytes.
`16777216` encoded units per message.
maxChunks: Positive safe-integer maximum declared fragments for one message.
`4096` fragments per message.
maxBufferedBytes: Positive safe-integer total retained incomplete data across all source/message pairs.
`67108864` retained encoded units.
maxConcurrentMessages: Positive safe-integer maximum simultaneous incomplete source/message assemblies.
`256` concurrent incomplete messages.
assemblyTimeoutMs: Positive safe-integer timer deadline after the first fragment before marking its assembly expired.
`30000` milliseconds from first fragment.
now: Optional synchronous application clock callback returning a numeric time; current implementation snapshots but never invokes it.
Absent; current framing does not read this option.
schedule: Optional synchronous timer adapter receives a no-argument expiry callback and delayMs; returns the opaque handle passed to cancel. A failed scheduler keeps prior semantic identity or gains `CALLBACK_FAILED`; unattachable failures remain on `cause`.
Host setTimeout when available; no timer when the host lacks it.
cancel: Optional synchronous timer cancellation receives the original handle returned by schedule; cleanup failure is observed through host `reportError` or terminal host reporting. A reporter failure stays secondary; the frame result is preserved.
Host clearTimeout when available.

symbols.name: RpcRouteField
symbols.purpose: Canonical property names for routing metadata validation. Each stable key below identifies one wire choice or diagnostic bound.
symbols.core:
profile: Fixed protocol-owned profile marker that separates this grammar from application records.
type: Protocol-specific form that selects the legal fields in this data record.
applicationVersion: Application protocol version chosen by the endpoint owner, separate from wire protocol version.
senderId: Source endpoint identifier issued by its endpoint factory and copied into outgoing routing metadata.
targetId: Target endpoint identifier received through discovery or explicitly assigned by the application.
sentAt: Sender-owned timestamp for this request, preserved during forwarding.
receiverId: Final receiver identifier obtained from the selected remote binding or discovery result.
dispatchOnly: Optional true routes one-way work without awaiting a business response.
method: Application method name chosen from the provider or remote contract being invoked.
manual: Optional connection-owner flag marking explicit rather than automatic control.
resolvedTargetId: Final target identifier returned by discovery resolution, rather than an unresolved selector.
platform: Optional diagnostic platform label supplied by the endpoint owner.
accepted: Optional response flag indicating whether the corresponding control was accepted.
message: Diagnostic message preserved with the owning failure; never use it as an authorization decision.
operation: Control operation selected by the owning protocol grammar.
variation: Application variation/control subtype chosen by the original endpoint owner.
timeoutMs: Optional relative operation deadline in integer milliseconds from `0` through `2147483647`; zero is allowed.
idempotencyKey: Application-issued stable operation key reused only when requesting the same business effect.
trace: Optional caller-issued bounded diagnostic trace string preserved across hops.
forwardRoute: Optional ordered origin/forwarder node IDs supplied by the actual forwarding owner.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.

guidance.heading: 13.2 View 生命周期与内容捕获

blocks.text: 每个 emitter 复用固定形状的 `IRpcProbeEventView`。只能在同步 `emit` 中读取它；需要稍后读取时使用快照：

`snapshotProbeEvent` 是显式复制请求（SC9c）：复制并冻结顶层字段，保留 `detail`、`error` 与 `content` 的引用和所有权。它防止复用 view 改写快照的顶层元数据，不固定这些引用对象的内容。按照 SC9，普通捕获与存储保留引用；调用方发送后修改 `detail`、错误或未被转移的 content 对象，后续读取仍可见修改。只有实际 transfer 会分离的字节缓冲、真实 codec/序列化边界（SC9b），或显式快照 API 才复制必要数据。未知 `sizeBytes`、未分块的 chunk 字段、非批次的 `members` 与未结算的 `durationMs` 都使用 `-1`。
`protected` 仅在认证保护路径存在时产生；没有该能力的路径不会伪造该阶段。内容捕获包括 protected 内容都必须显式启用。Descriptor 的 `stageMask` 描述 endpoint 能产生且当前已订阅的阶段，不证明所有路径都会经历每个阶段。

`sizeBytes` 只读取已知的原生字节 backing/view 长度。所有字符串与 opaque container 均为 `-1`，包括 string transport；metadata 不扫描、编码或规范化 payload。Byte carrier 复用其现成 frame 长度。各载体与 Core 复用 `adapter/internal-advanced` 的 `carrierSizeBytes` owner。

`setStages([])` 允许暂停，之后可以设置其它已知阶段。它更新私有状态的阶段选择，保留定义时的 `captureMask`；host 上不可写的 `stageMask` 仍为初始定义值，独立 handle 的 `stageMask` getter 反映当前私有值。非法阶段会抛出 `INVALID_CONFIG` 并保留旧 mask。`readProbeStages(probe)` 读取当前有效 mask；`subscribeProbeStages(probe, listener)` 在每次实际变更后通知一次，返回可重复调用的释放函数。两者用于冷控制边界，不加入消息热路径。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
config: Application configuration documented by IRpcContractConfig; factory returns a definition, installation occurs in createEndpoint middlewares.
Immutable IRpcPlugin definition; unsupported or unreadable fields fail the original installation with INVALID_CONFIG and retained cause.
version: Application contract version used for compatibility checks, independent of wire/package version.
Absent: discovery uses 1.0.0 while outbound routing uses 1.0; configure explicitly for a consistent version.
acceptVersions: Application-compatible contract versions accepted in the declared order.
Absent: accept the configured application version.
maxIdentifierLength: Optional positive safe-integer ceiling for `targetId`, `receiverId`, `uniqueTargetId` and variation IDs; it does not limit method names and remains within the fixed wire bound.
`128` characters at endpoint admission.
schemas: Application map from method to synchronous params/result parse adapters; missing methods are not schema-validated.
Absent: no application params/result schemas are installed.
Installs the original contract capability into one canonical endpoint construction transaction; it has no standalone network effect.

declaredConfiguration.name: protocol
declaredConfiguration.description: Semantic descriptor feeding the codec edge in the canonical endpoint pipeline.

declaredConfiguration.name: codec
declaredConfiguration.description: Codec whose output must match the selected framer input exactly.

declaredConfiguration.name: framer
declaredConfiguration.description: Framer whose output is the value delivered to the selected transport.

declaredConfiguration.name: features
declaredConfiguration.description: Finite immutable tuple of user-defined features installed by the canonical Host batch.

declaredConfiguration.name: transport
declaredConfiguration.type: Omit<IRpcTransport<unknown>, 'send'> & { readonly send: (value: IRpcEnvelope, options?: IRpcSendOptions) => void | Promise<void>; }

declaredConfiguration.name: id
declaredConfiguration.description: Stable local endpoint identity included in every routed protocol envelope.

declaredConfiguration.name: scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Endpoint monotonic clock and timers; the same injected instance also drives PluginHost deadlines. `now()` must return finite non-negative milliseconds and is never read as an epoch.

declaredConfiguration.name: wallClock
declaredConfiguration.description: Endpoint wall clock; only produces wire `sentAt` and hook event `at` diagnostics. `timestamp()` must return non-negative safe-integer epoch milliseconds. Defaults to the host wall clock.

declaredConfiguration.name: targetIds
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional known-peer seed; automatic discovery may resolve additional target ids lazily.

declaredConfiguration.name: provider
declaredConfiguration.description: Initial provider methods registered before endpoint construction completes.

declaredConfiguration.name: providerLimits
declaredConfiguration.description: Provider concurrency budgets; defaults to 256 global and 64 per peer.

declaredConfiguration.name: idempotency
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional store and session scope used only for keyed provider requests.

declaredConfiguration.name: idempotency.scope
declaredConfiguration.type: (admission: Readonly<{ token: string; senderId: string; }>) => string

declaredConfiguration.name: replay
declaredConfiguration.type: { /** Maximum retained outbound request identifiers; defaults to 4096. */ readonly maxEntries?: number; /** Retention time for outbound request identifiers; defaults to 310 seconds. */ readonly ttlMs?: number; }
declaredConfiguration.description: Bounds outbound identifier replay reservations for this endpoint.

declaredConfiguration.name: replay.maxEntries
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum retained outbound request identifiers; defaults to 4096.

declaredConfiguration.name: replay.ttlMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Retention time for outbound request identifiers; defaults to 310 seconds.

declaredConfiguration.name: middlewares
declaredConfiguration.description: Ordered middleware tuple installed atomically during endpoint construction.

declaredConfiguration.name: construction
declaredConfiguration.type: { /** Aborts construction while still rolling back every installed middleware. */ readonly signal?: IAbortSignal; /** Bounds endpoint construction, or disables the deadline when explicitly `false`. */ readonly timeoutMs?: number | false; }
declaredConfiguration.description: Cancellation and deadline controls for middleware installation and rollback.

declaredConfiguration.name: construction.signal
declaredConfiguration.description: Aborts construction while still rolling back every installed middleware.

declaredConfiguration.name: construction.timeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Bounds endpoint construction, or disables the deadline when explicitly `false`.

symbols.name: createRpcIdempotencyStore
symbols.purpose: Creates a bounded in-memory execution/outcome store with post-settlement retention. Byte pressure evicts completed bodies while retaining execution tombstones, so missing bodies do not authorize re-execution.
symbols.core:
IRpcIdempotencyStore with no timers or dispose obligation; the session/provider owner controls scope/key admission.
retentionMs: Positive safe-integer milliseconds retained after settlement; pending execution does not expire by this policy.
Default 300000; invalid nonpositive or unsafe integers fail INVALID_CONFIG.
maxEntries: Positive safe-integer total original entry capacity.
Default 1024; invalid nonpositive or unsafe integers fail INVALID_CONFIG.
maxEntriesPerScope: Positive safe-integer original entry capacity in each actual scope.
Default 256; invalid nonpositive or unsafe integers fail INVALID_CONFIG.
maxBytes: Positive safe-integer total retained portable-outcome byte budget.
Default 8388608; invalid nonpositive or unsafe integers fail INVALID_CONFIG.
maxOutcomeBytes: Positive safe-integer per-outcome retention budget; larger results leave an unavailable tombstone.
Default 1048576; invalid nonpositive or unsafe integers fail INVALID_CONFIG.
parameters: options: { readonly retentionMs?: number; readonly maxEntries?: number; readonly maxEntriesPerScope?: number; readonly maxBytes?: number; readonly maxOutcomeBytes?: number; } (optional)

symbols.name: createRuntimeApiEndpoint
symbols.purpose: Creates the runtime API boundary over an actual held binding, or config/channel plus original provider admission scope. It never creates a worker or process and repeated and synchronously reentrant disposal joins one cached facade Promise; it does not promise identity with the underlying binding Promise.
symbols.core:
config: Either { binding } with actual held runtime call operations, or actual IRpcFactoryConfig for the original channel construction overload.
channel: Actual internal runtime channel supplied by the original adapter; not a caller-asserted wire identity.
admission: Optional actual shared handle returned by createProviderAdmissionScope.
Held-operation binding or actual runtime API endpoint, matching the selected overload; original construction and close failures stay reachable.
id: Application-assigned stable local endpoint identifier included in outgoing routes.
scheduler: Application monotonic IScheduler shared by endpoint deadlines and PluginHost; now must be finite nonnegative milliseconds.
systemScheduler uses host monotonic time and timers.
wallClock: Application IWallClock supplies only wire sentAt and hook timestamps as nonnegative safe-integer epoch milliseconds.
systemWallClock uses the host epoch clock.
transport: Actual application adapter selected by top-level config or native connect middleware; native source evidence remains adapter-owned.
Absent: use the selected connect middleware transport; otherwise construction fails.
protocol: Canonical semantic IRpcProtocol descriptor selected independently of codec encoding.
rpcProtocolV1 is the default canonical protocol.
codec: ICodec from @migaia/serialize/codec whose encoded output exactly matches the selected framer input.
identityCodecV1 preserves the canonical semantic envelope.
framer: IRpcFramer from rpc-contract/framing whose actual output is accepted by the selected transport.
messageFramerV1 uses complete unfragmented messages.
targetIds: Optional known-peer base identifiers issued by application deployment configuration; automatic discovery can resolve more later.
Empty seed list; discovery remains available.
provider: Application map of unique method names to IRpcProvider callbacks installed before endpoint construction returns.
Absent: register providers later through provide.
providerLimits: Optional IRpcProviderLimits applied to the existing shared execution/replay admission owner.
Global 256, per-peer 64, replay per-peer 1024.
idempotency: Optional actual original result store and authenticated scope function for keyed provider work.
Absent: use the endpoint-owned canonical keyed replay policy.
idempotency.store: Optional caller-held IRpcIdempotencyStore shared only across actual intended sessions.
Absent: use the original endpoint-local store.
idempotency.scope: Synchronous application callback receives actual admitted token and senderId, returns a stable scope string; it must not treat arbitrary wire claims as identity.
Absent: canonical admitted-session scope is used.
replay: Outbound active identifiers plus settled tombstone retention, separate from business result storage.
Use maxEntries 4096 and ttlMs 310000.
replay.maxEntries: Maximum retained outbound request identities including active operations and settled tombstones.
`4096` retained outbound identities.
replay.ttlMs: Scheduler milliseconds to retain settled outbound request identity tombstones.
`310000` milliseconds after settlement.
middlewares: Required ordered finite tuple of actual middleware definitions installed atomically by PluginHost.
features: Optional finite immutable tuple of actual native IRpcFeature roots; dependencies remain private and only selected public surfaces are projected.
Empty tuple adds no user-defined features.
construction: Caller construction cancellation/deadline; failure still rolls back every installed middleware in original lifecycle order.
Absent: no caller abort or construction deadline.
construction.signal: Optional caller cancellation signal controlling construction and its complete rollback.
Absent: construction has an uncancelled native signal.
construction.timeoutMs: Finite nonnegative construction deadline or false to disable; rollback retains the primary failure and cleanup failures.
Absent or false: no construction deadline.
Disable only the construction deadline.
binding: Actual held runtime operations with original ready/request/notify/stream/dispose ownership; forwarding them grants only already-held rights.

config: IRpcFactoryConfig
channel: IRuntimeEndpointChannel
admission: IProviderAdmissionScope (optional)

encrypt: Outbound sync/async encryption runs after the endpoint wraps its encoded value with replay metadata and before signing. Throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with its cause.
encrypt.value: Replay-bound authentication envelope produced by the endpoint, including its encoded payload; not the bare application payload.
encrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.

decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.
decrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.

verify: Runs actual configured inbound identification, preserving asynchronous verification and original read-failure reporting.
