sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Receives background errors that no call can reject with.
`console.error`.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
connect: Application-supplied Core source callback that opens a borrowed channel; select exactly one source.
Omitted: no custom connection source.
listen: Application-supplied Core source callback accepting channel sessions; cannot be combined with another source.
Omitted: no custom listening source.
spawn: Worker to start: `URL`, path string (relative to the main entry directory), `true` (the current entry), `{ entry, base?, name?, data?, limits? }`, or a full source.
Not set: inside a library Worker connects to the parent; otherwise `connect` is needed.

symbols.name: IRuntimeTypedPeer
symbols.purpose: A Runtime Peer typed by `TRemote`: method names, payloads and results are checked against the other side API. Also has `self`, `describe()`, `outcome()`, `on()` and `close()`.
symbols.core:
self: Frozen local peer name and instanceId minted or supplied during this connection construction; it is not a remote authentication principal.
outcome: Queries the original remote operation ledger for a prior idempotency key, without dispatching that operation again.
outcome.idempotencyKey: The caller-issued key supplied as options.idempotencyKey on an earlier request to this connection.
Promise of IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult; support and availability come from the accepted remote runtime contract.
describe: Queries the local accepted peer detail asynchronously. Without format returns IRuntimeDetail; json, yaml or toml returns the admitted text projection. It does not claim unavailable physical metrics.
describe.options: Optional query format from IRuntimeQueryOptions; omitted returns the object snapshot.
Promise of local detail or formatted text, following the selected query format.
on: Registers a future RuntimeEventName listener after construction; factory resolution already represents initial readiness. Listener return is ignored and failures are contained by the runtime reporter.
on.event: A RuntimeEventName value such as ready or exit; it selects future connection lifecycle notifications.
on.listener: Callback receives IRuntimeEvent from this connection; return is ignored and throws or rejected thenables are reported.
Idempotent removal function for this registration; closing the peer clears its publisher.
close: Ends this logical connection and releases its owned channel resources; platform factories also terminate a worker or child they spawned.
Shared completion Promise retaining the original close operation identity; no new calls are admitted once closing begins.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Scoped asynchronous cleanup is the exact original close operation, including its Promise identity.
The same completion Promise as close(), including platform-owned resource cleanup.
request: Calls a method the other side provides and waits for its result. Default deadline 30000 ms (`defaultTimeoutMs`); errors keep their native type and `(source, code)`.
request.method: Dotted path of a method in the other side `provide`, e.g. `math.double`.
request.args: `(payload?, options?)`: one payload and call options (`timeoutMs`, `signal`, `transfer`, `idempotencyKey`).
The method result, typed from `TRemote`.
notify: Sends a one-way call; no result comes back.
notify.method: Dotted method path provided by the other side.
notify.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
Resolves once the call was sent.
stream: Calls a method that returns an iterable and yields its items as they arrive.
stream.method: Dotted path of an iterator method provided by the other side.
stream.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
An async iterator of the yielded items.
group: Sends several calls as one batch and returns the outcome of each step in order.
group.steps: Steps `{ method, payload? }` in order.
group.options: Batch options such as `timeoutMs` and `signal`.
One outcome per step (success value or error).
symbols.advanced:
Call worker or child process functions as if they were local, with types.
Retry a non-idempotent call safely with `idempotencyKey` and `outcome(key)`.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: A Runtime Peer typed by `TRemote`: method names, payloads and results are checked against the other side API. Also has `self`, `describe()`, `outcome()`, `on()` and `close()`.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import IRuntimeTypedPeer from @migaia/rpc-threads, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use IRuntimeTypedPeer when its type contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when IRuntimeTypedPeer does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained type example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
self: Frozen local peer name and instanceId minted or supplied during this connection construction; it is not a remote authentication principal.
outcome: Queries the original remote operation ledger for a prior idempotency key, without dispatching that operation again.
outcome.idempotencyKey: The caller-issued key supplied as options.idempotencyKey on an earlier request to this connection.
Promise of IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult; support and availability come from the accepted remote runtime contract.
describe: Queries the local accepted peer detail asynchronously. Without format returns IRuntimeDetail; json, yaml or toml returns the admitted text projection. It does not claim unavailable physical metrics.
describe.options: Optional query format from IRuntimeQueryOptions; omitted returns the object snapshot.
Promise of local detail or formatted text, following the selected query format.
on: Registers a future RuntimeEventName listener after construction; factory resolution already represents initial readiness. Listener return is ignored and failures are contained by the runtime reporter.
on.event: A RuntimeEventName value such as ready or exit; it selects future connection lifecycle notifications.
on.listener: Callback receives IRuntimeEvent from this connection; return is ignored and throws or rejected thenables are reported.
Idempotent removal function for this registration; closing the peer clears its publisher.
close: Ends this logical connection and releases its owned channel resources; platform factories also terminate a worker or child they spawned.
Shared completion Promise retaining the original close operation identity; no new calls are admitted once closing begins.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Scoped asynchronous cleanup is the exact original close operation, including its Promise identity.
The same completion Promise as close(), including platform-owned resource cleanup.
request: Calls a method the other side provides and waits for its result. Default deadline 30000 ms (`defaultTimeoutMs`); errors keep their native type and `(source, code)`.
request.method: Dotted path of a method in the other side `provide`, e.g. `math.double`.
request.args: `(payload?, options?)`: one payload and call options (`timeoutMs`, `signal`, `transfer`, `idempotencyKey`).
The method result, typed from `TRemote`.
notify: Sends a one-way call; no result comes back.
notify.method: Dotted method path provided by the other side.
notify.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
Resolves once the call was sent.
stream: Calls a method that returns an iterable and yields its items as they arrive.
stream.method: Dotted path of an iterator method provided by the other side.
stream.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
An async iterator of the yielded items.
group: Sends several calls as one batch and returns the outcome of each step in order.
group.steps: Steps `{ method, payload? }` in order.
group.options: Batch options such as `timeoutMs` and `signal`.
One outcome per step (success value or error).

symbols.name: createPortableWalker
symbols.purpose: Creates a synchronous specialized walker with policy callbacks captured once. The returned callable projects a value and byte metadata; its value method avoids metadata collection. Policy callbacks own validation and coded errors, and traversal owns cycle tracking.
symbols.core:
strategy: Caller-owned IPortableWalkerStrategy with scalar, binary, record and violation hooks. Optional array, field-write and finish hooks specialize projection; callbacks are synchronous and throwing stops traversal.
A callable walker(value, active?, initialDepth?, beforeNativeBinary?) returning { value, byteUpperBound, hasBinary }, plus walker.value with the same arguments returning only the projection. Input is caller-owned, active is an optional enclosing ancestor Set, initialDepth defaults to zero, and beforeNativeBinary is an optional no-argument throwing guard exposed to policy context rather than automatically called. byteUpperBound is conservative JSON/native-byte accounting, not an encoded measurement; hasBinary records inline or native binary presence. scalar.value: Primitive node supplied by traversal from the caller input graph.

Projected scalar or deferred scalar result; a throw aborts the traversal.
record: Synchronous hook receiving an object and context. Return undefined for array handling, or entries with optional output. binary: Synchronous hook receiving an object and context before record or array handling. Return inline text or native storage for an atomic binary node, or undefined for ordinary traversal.
binary.value: Object candidate supplied by traversal before container admission.
binary.context: Current rejection, ancestor, byte detection and canonical base64url helper tools.

array.context: Current invocation rejection and binary helper tools.

blocks.text: `tagSerializeError` 的行为要点（只读附加字段，不重建、不替换、不覆盖 `stack`）：

items: 未标记过的错误：调用 `attachErrorIdentity` 附加 `source: '@migaia/serialize'`、`code`，`context` 若提供则一并写入

declaredConfiguration.name: maxInFlight
declaredConfiguration.description: Backpressure limit for concurrent requests. Defaults to 1, waiting for each encoded slice before encoding the next. Only one slice is in flight at that setting. Higher limits overlap encoding with worker processing at the cost of retaining more slices in memory.

declaredConfiguration.name: targetMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Target duration per slice. Defaults to 8 ms, leaving about half a 16.7 ms frame at 60 fps for rendering and other work.

declaredConfiguration.name: minItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Minimum slice size to keep per-message overhead from dominating processing.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum slice size to limit how long one slice can occupy the main thread.

declaredConfiguration.name: initialItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Conservative initial slice size to reduce the risk of exceeding the first frame budget.

declaredConfiguration.name: yieldTo
declaredConfiguration.description: Yield mechanism. Defaults to `scheduler.schedule(resolve, 0)`. Can use `scheduler.yield()` for finer scheduling or `requestIdleCallback` for a more conservative yield.

configuration.description: 内部行为：用 `sliceByFrameBudget(items, options)` 切片，每片调用一次 `registry.encode(slice, { type, signal, context })`（`context` 默认 `'stream'`）；`maxInFlight`（默认 1）控制同时在途的编码请求数，即背压——默认值意味着编好一片就等它被消费（`yield` 返回）后再编下一片，峰值内存只有一片；调高能让编码与下游消费重叠，代价是峰值内存同比增加。`maxInFlight` 必须是正整数，否则抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（`NaN` 会让 `>= maxInFlight` 的判断恒为 `false`，背压彻底失效，在途请求无限堆积直到内存耗尽，因此这里的校验和 `sliceByFrameBudget` 一样是必要的）。

configuration.name: targetMs
configuration.description: Target duration per slice. Defaults to 8 ms, leaving about half a 16.7 ms frame at 60 fps for rendering and other work.
configuration.descriptionEn: Target duration per slice. Defaults to 8 ms, leaving about half a 16.7 ms frame at 60 fps for rendering and other work.
configuration.descriptionZh: 所以片大小不能按固定字节数写死，必须按实测耗时反推：生成器在 `yield` 之后挂起，消费者取下一片时才恢复，挂起与恢复之间的时差正好等于消费者处理这一片的真实耗时，据此调整下一片大小——`ratio = targetMs / max(elapsed, 0.05)`，新片大小取"当前值"与"按比例算出的目标值"的中点（阻尼调整，避免噪声下来回振荡），再钳制在 `[minItems, maxItems]` 之内。

blocks.text: 裸抛一个 `SyntaxError`/`TypeError` 回答不了"哪个 store、哪种格式、第几段、已经吃进去多少字节"——排查线上存档损坏时这几个数才是关键。`TCode` 默认收紧为本包登记的 `ISerializeErrorCode`；如果上层包（如 `store-worker`）想复用这个类但注册自己的错误码联合，可以显式传 `TCode` 类型参数覆盖 `code` 的类型，构造时也可传 `source` 覆盖默认的 `'@migaia/serialize'`。
`SerializeCodecError` 只在 `/core`（进而在主入口）导出，`/registry` 不单独导出它（不重复导出同一个类）。

rows: 请求的 `type` 没有对应注册 parser
parser `encode` 抛错、流式编码中途失败、或产出为空
parser `decode` 抛错、或流式解码中途失败
chunk 形状非法（不是 `[type, data]` 对、text/bytes 数据类型错、未知形态标签、value 段被用于只接受线材的载体如 `chunkToText`/`chunkToBytes`/`collectStream`）
`SerializeCodecError` 或 tagged `TypeError`（视具体 API 而定，见各自小节）
编解码被协作式取消（`AbortSignal` 在 parser 返回前中止）
`SerializeCodecError` 或 tagged 原生 `Error`（视具体调用栈而定）
入参校验失败：非法插件 `type`、空插件表、重复插件 `type`、帧预算/`maxInFlight` 非法、`scheduler` 结构非法、`base64ToBytes` 输入非法等
环境能力缺失：构造 registry 或使用内置 JSON 插件时探测不到 `TextEncoder`/`TextDecoder`
tagged 原生 `Error`（原始缺失原因在 `cause`，若有）

blocks.text: 码值是公开 API 的一部分，改名等同破坏性变更；抛出点内部统一引用 `SerializeErrorCode` 常量，不内联字符串字面量。

guidance.heading: 4.3 tagSerializeError / createSerializeError / createSerializeTypeError / createSerializeRangeError（构造期失败）

rows: `REGISTRY_DISPOSED`、`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`、`ABORTED`（协作式取消）；可选 `errors` 是 rollback 完成后一次性创建的不可变快照（`Object.freeze`），为空则省略该字段
参数结构非法（如 `scheduler` 不是 `{ now, schedule }`）、`base64ToBytes` 输入非法
插件表为空/重复/`type` 不合法、帧预算参数越界
前三者的底层实现；也可直接用来给自定义错误打标签

blocks.text: `tagSerializeError` 的行为要点（只读附加字段，不重建、不替换、不覆盖 `stack`）：

blocks.text: `plugins`（必填）：

items: 至少 1 项，空表抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"serialize registry needs at least one plugin"）
数组第一项的 `type` 就是 `primaryType`
每项的 `type` 必须匹配 `SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN`（见 §10），非法字符抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`
`parser` 必须提供 `encode`/`decode` 函数（`dispose` 可选但若提供必须是函数），否则抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"invalid serialize plugin at index N"，原始失败挂 `cause`）
重复 `type` 抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"duplicate serialize plugin type: ..."）
校验逐项进行且发生在任何 parser 被 registry 接管之前，因此校验失败不需要回滚任何已注册的 parser

blocks.text: `options`（全部可选）：

rows: 创建后不可更换；结构非法（缺 `now`/`schedule`，或 `now()` 不返回有限数字）抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"serialize scheduler must be { now, schedule }" 等）
用于把 `text` 段就地转成字节（多段拼装出现 `bytes` 时）；省略且宿主没有 `TextEncoder` → 构造期抛 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`；提供了但形状不对（没有 `.encode` 方法）→ `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`
目前构造期只做能力探测（供后续经该 registry 派生的 API 复用），同上校验规则

`{ policy: 'throw' }`：`dispose()` 时任一 parser `dispose()` 失败会并入 `dispose()` 的 reject（见 §3.3）；`{ policy: 'report'; report }`：转发给 `report`，不影响 `dispose()` 的正常结算；`report` 缺失或非函数抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`
`dispose({ deadlineAt })` 到期时仍有在途操作，触发一次诊断回调；回调抛错被吞掉（containment），不影响 `dispose()`
两类"迟到"错误的观测出口：① 操作已经因 abort 提前 settle，但底层 parser task 之后才真正 reject（detached 迟到 rejection，不要求 registry 已 cleanup）；② 流式 `encode`/`decode` 内部 async iterator 二次清理失败。两类都不改变已结算的 primary 结果

blocks.text: 非对象/非函数的 `options` 本身（例如传了一个 `null`）会抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`。

blocks.text: `plugins`（必填）：

items: 至少 1 项，空表抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"serialize registry needs at least one plugin"）
数组第一项的 `type` 就是 `primaryType`
每项的 `type` 必须匹配 `SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN`（见 §10），非法字符抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`
`parser` 必须提供 `encode`/`decode` 函数（`dispose` 可选但若提供必须是函数），否则抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"invalid serialize plugin at index N"，原始失败挂 `cause`）
重复 `type` 抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"duplicate serialize plugin type: ..."）
校验逐项进行且发生在任何 parser 被 registry 接管之前，因此校验失败不需要回滚任何已注册的 parser

blocks.text: `options`（全部可选）：

rows: 创建后不可更换；结构非法（缺 `now`/`schedule`，或 `now()` 不返回有限数字）抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"serialize scheduler must be { now, schedule }" 等）
用于把 `text` 段就地转成字节（多段拼装出现 `bytes` 时）；省略且宿主没有 `TextEncoder` → 构造期抛 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`；提供了但形状不对（没有 `.encode` 方法）→ `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`
目前构造期只做能力探测（供后续经该 registry 派生的 API 复用），同上校验规则

`{ policy: 'throw' }`：`dispose()` 时任一 parser `dispose()` 失败会并入 `dispose()` 的 reject（见 §3.3）；`{ policy: 'report'; report }`：转发给 `report`，不影响 `dispose()` 的正常结算；`report` 缺失或非函数抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`
`dispose({ deadlineAt })` 到期时仍有在途操作，触发一次诊断回调；回调抛错被吞掉（containment），不影响 `dispose()`
两类"迟到"错误的观测出口：① 操作已经因 abort 提前 settle，但底层 parser task 之后才真正 reject（detached 迟到 rejection，不要求 registry 已 cleanup）；② 流式 `encode`/`decode` 内部 async iterator 二次清理失败。两类都不改变已结算的 primary 结果

blocks.text: 非对象/非函数的 `options` 本身（例如传了一个 `null`）会抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`。

guidance.heading: 4.3 tagSerializeError / createSerializeError / createSerializeTypeError / createSerializeRangeError（构造期失败）

rows: `REGISTRY_DISPOSED`、`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`、`ABORTED`（协作式取消）；可选 `errors` 是 rollback 完成后一次性创建的不可变快照（`Object.freeze`），为空则省略该字段
参数结构非法（如 `scheduler` 不是 `{ now, schedule }`）、`base64ToBytes` 输入非法
插件表为空/重复/`type` 不合法、帧预算参数越界
前三者的底层实现；也可直接用来给自定义错误打标签

blocks.text: `tagSerializeError` 的行为要点（只读附加字段，不重建、不替换、不覆盖 `stack`）：

items: 未标记过的错误：调用 `attachErrorIdentity` 附加 `source: '@migaia/serialize'`、`code`，`context` 若提供则一并写入
已标记且 `(source, code)` 与本次调用一致：幂等直接返回；`context` 仅在原先未定义时补写一次
已标记但 `(source, code)` 不一致：抛 `TypeError`（"serialize error already tagged with a different (source, code): ..."）——不允许静默改写已标记的错误，避免二次 `Object.defineProperty` 因 `configurable: false` 抛错

blocks.text: `createSerializeError`/`createSerializeTypeError`/`createSerializeRangeError` 均支持 `options.cause`（挂到 `Error` 构造函数的标准 `cause` 上）与 `options.context`（定位字段）。这几个函数与 `SerializeCodecError` 一起构成本包唯一的错误制造入口，包内部不允许手写裸 `throw new Error(...)`（`docs/contracts/error-codes.md` 契约）。

symbols.name: ISerializeRegistry
symbols.purpose: Registry instance returned by createSerializeRegistry, owning parser admission, asynchronous operation tracking and two-phase shutdown. Close cancels admission; dispose drains then releases resources with stable promise identity.
symbols.core:
primaryType: Default write and read type captured from the first plugin passed to `createSerializeRegistry`.
types: Snapshot of registered type strings in plugin order; no registration API adds formats after construction.
has: Checks whether a format is currently registered; returns false after disposal clears the parser table.
has.type: Format tag copied from a stored envelope or chosen from this registry types list.
`true` for a registered format, `false` otherwise; it does not start any parser work.
encode: Runs one parser and assembles its chunks into one complete result. Caller cancellation or close rejects promptly even if parser work ignores its signal.
encode.value: Application value supplied by the caller and admitted by the selected parser.
encode.options: Optional operation fields: `type` defaults to the first plugin; `signal` defaults to no caller signal; `context` defaults to `anonymous`. Obtain type from plugin registration or an envelope and signal from an abort controller.
A `Promise<ISerializeChunk>`: one value, concatenated text, or merged bytes. Rejects with `REGISTRY_DISPOSED`, `CODEC_NOT_FOUND`, `ABORTED`, `ENCODE_FAILED` or `INVALID_CHUNK`; parser failure remains on cause.
decode: Validates one chunk then runs its selected parser, preserving the original payload identity where the parser permits.
decode.chunk: Chunk returned by encode or reconstructed from a stored envelope; select its original format through options.type.
decode.options: Optional `type`, `signal` and `context`; defaults are the first plugin, no caller signal, and `anonymous`. Read type from the stored envelope, and signal from an abort controller.
A promise of the parser result. Rejects on closure, unknown format, cancellation, malformed chunks or parser failure with `REGISTRY_DISPOSED`, `CODEC_NOT_FOUND`, `ABORTED`, `INVALID_CHUNK` or `DECODE_FAILED`.
close: Synchronously stops admission and aborts the registry closing signal. Repeated calls are harmless; parser disposers are not invoked here.
Admission is closed and running public operations observe cancellation; use dispose to wait for resource cleanup.
dispose: Closes admission, drains pending parser work, then awaits owned parser disposers. Repeated calls return the same promise; the first admitted call fixes its deadline.
dispose.options: Optional `deadlineAt`: finite absolute time in the construction scheduler clock. Default is no deadline; obtain it from scheduler.now() plus a duration. Expired deadlines skip draining but still clean parsers.
Shared `Promise<void>` settling after parser cleanup. A deadline emits a diagnostic rather than a timeout rejection; cleanup follows the configured throw or report policy.

sections.content:
encode: Synchronously converts one input string to bytes; it must return Uint8Array and throws to signal failure.
encode.input: Text supplied by chunk conversion or mixed-stream collection.
Encoded Uint8Array. Registry collection wraps encoder failures and rejects nonbyte results.

blocks.text: `plugins`（必填）：

items: 至少 1 项，空表抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"serialize registry needs at least one plugin"）
数组第一项的 `type` 就是 `primaryType`
每项的 `type` 必须匹配 `SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN`（见 §10），非法字符抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`
`parser` 必须提供 `encode`/`decode` 函数（`dispose` 可选但若提供必须是函数），否则抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"invalid serialize plugin at index N"，原始失败挂 `cause`）
重复 `type` 抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"duplicate serialize plugin type: ..."）
校验逐项进行且发生在任何 parser 被 registry 接管之前，因此校验失败不需要回滚任何已注册的 parser

blocks.text: `options`（全部可选）：

rows: 创建后不可更换；结构非法（缺 `now`/`schedule`，或 `now()` 不返回有限数字）抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"serialize scheduler must be { now, schedule }" 等）
用于把 `text` 段就地转成字节（多段拼装出现 `bytes` 时）；省略且宿主没有 `TextEncoder` → 构造期抛 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`；提供了但形状不对（没有 `.encode` 方法）→ `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`
目前构造期只做能力探测（供后续经该 registry 派生的 API 复用），同上校验规则

`{ policy: 'throw' }`：`dispose()` 时任一 parser `dispose()` 失败会并入 `dispose()` 的 reject（见 §3.3）；`{ policy: 'report'; report }`：转发给 `report`，不影响 `dispose()` 的正常结算；`report` 缺失或非函数抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`
`dispose({ deadlineAt })` 到期时仍有在途操作，触发一次诊断回调；回调抛错被吞掉（containment），不影响 `dispose()`
两类"迟到"错误的观测出口：① 操作已经因 abort 提前 settle，但底层 parser task 之后才真正 reject（detached 迟到 rejection，不要求 registry 已 cleanup）；② 流式 `encode`/`decode` 内部 async iterator 二次清理失败。两类都不改变已结算的 primary 结果

blocks.text: 非对象/非函数的 `options` 本身（例如传了一个 `null`）会抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`。

guidance.heading: 4.3 tagSerializeError / createSerializeError / createSerializeTypeError / createSerializeRangeError（构造期失败）

rows: `REGISTRY_DISPOSED`、`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`、`ABORTED`（协作式取消）；可选 `errors` 是 rollback 完成后一次性创建的不可变快照（`Object.freeze`），为空则省略该字段
参数结构非法（如 `scheduler` 不是 `{ now, schedule }`）、`base64ToBytes` 输入非法
插件表为空/重复/`type` 不合法、帧预算参数越界
前三者的底层实现；也可直接用来给自定义错误打标签

blocks.text: `tagSerializeError` 的行为要点（只读附加字段，不重建、不替换、不覆盖 `stack`）：

items: 未标记过的错误：调用 `attachErrorIdentity` 附加 `source: '@migaia/serialize'`、`code`，`context` 若提供则一并写入
已标记且 `(source, code)` 与本次调用一致：幂等直接返回；`context` 仅在原先未定义时补写一次
已标记但 `(source, code)` 不一致：抛 `TypeError`（"serialize error already tagged with a different (source, code): ..."）——不允许静默改写已标记的错误，避免二次 `Object.defineProperty` 因 `configurable: false` 抛错

blocks.text: `createSerializeError`/`createSerializeTypeError`/`createSerializeRangeError` 均支持 `options.cause`（挂到 `Error` 构造函数的标准 `cause` 上）与 `options.context`（定位字段）。这几个函数与 `SerializeCodecError` 一起构成本包唯一的错误制造入口，包内部不允许手写裸 `throw new Error(...)`（`docs/contracts/error-codes.md` 契约）。

guidance.heading: 4. 错误体系：SerializeCodecError 与 tagged 原生错误

blocks.text: 包内错误分两类：编解码期失败用专门的 `SerializeCodecError` 类（携带 `type`/`phase`/`chunkIndex`/`bytesConsumed` 定位字段）；构造期/生命周期类失败（`REGISTRY_DISPOSED`、`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`、参数校验、协作式取消等）不建自定义类，而是给原生 `Error`/`TypeError`/`RangeError` 打标签（`source`/`code`/`context?`），`instanceof Error`/`instanceof TypeError`/`instanceof RangeError` 照常成立。两类失败统一用 `error.code` 判断，不需要先判断是哪个类。

裸抛一个 `SyntaxError`/`TypeError` 回答不了"哪个 store、哪种格式、第几段、已经吃进去多少字节"——排查线上存档损坏时这几个数才是关键。`TCode` 默认收紧为本包登记的 `ISerializeErrorCode`；如果上层包（如 `store-worker`）想复用这个类但注册自己的错误码联合，可以显式传 `TCode` 类型参数覆盖 `code` 的类型，构造时也可传 `source` 覆盖默认的 `'@migaia/serialize'`。
`SerializeCodecError` 只在 `/core`（进而在主入口）导出，`/registry` 不单独导出它（不重复导出同一个类）。

rows: 请求的 `type` 没有对应注册 parser
parser `encode` 抛错、流式编码中途失败、或产出为空
parser `decode` 抛错、或流式解码中途失败
chunk 形状非法（不是 `[type, data]` 对、text/bytes 数据类型错、未知形态标签、value 段被用于只接受线材的载体如 `chunkToText`/`chunkToBytes`/`collectStream`）
`SerializeCodecError` 或 tagged `TypeError`（视具体 API 而定，见各自小节）
编解码被协作式取消（`AbortSignal` 在 parser 返回前中止）
`SerializeCodecError` 或 tagged 原生 `Error`（视具体调用栈而定）

items: 未标记过的错误：调用 `attachErrorIdentity` 附加 `source: '@migaia/serialize'`、`code`，`context` 若提供则一并写入

rows: 出错时已收集的段数/字节数
`encode()` 时 `value` 段与其他段混用
`decode()` 时传入的 `chunk` 形状非法
该 chunk 的字节数，原错误挂 `cause`
`chunkIndex` 是流里的第几片（不是该次 encode 内部的段号），`bytesConsumed` 恒为 `0`
`decodeStream()` 中某一个 chunk 解码失败
`chunkIndex` 是流里的第几个 chunk，`bytesConsumed` 恒为 `0`
cause 保留 utils 的原始解码失败
`createSerializeRegistry`/JSON 插件探测不到 Encoding API

blocks.text: `encodeStream`/`decodeStream` 内部捕获到单次 `registry.encode`/`decode` 抛出的 `SerializeCodecError` 后，不会直接透传——那个内层错误的 `chunkIndex` 说的是"这一次 encode/decode 内部的第几段"，恒为 0，会把"流里的第几片/第几个 chunk"这个真正有用的位置信息盖掉。所以会重新包一层新的 `SerializeCodecError`，用流位置作为 `chunkIndex`，原始错误挂在 `cause` 上——排查时应该顺着 `cause` 链往下看真正的根因。

members.name: registryDisposed
members.description: Thrown when `encode` or `decode` is called after the registry closes or disposal begins. * * Create another registry instead of reusing this instance. Enforces the two-phase contract that * rejects new requests before releasing resources.

members.name: codecNotFound
members.description: Thrown when no registered parser matches the requested `type`. * * Check plugin registration and the archive format tag. This is a stable configuration or format * failure; retrying the same type does not fix it.

members.name: encodeFailed
members.description: Thrown when encoding fails: the parser's `encode` throws, streaming encoding fails, or no * chunks are produced. * * `cause` retains the original exception when one exists. Use `chunkIndex` and `bytesConsumed` to * locate the failure.

members.name: decodeFailed
members.description: Thrown when the parser's `decode` or streaming decoding fails. * * `cause` retains the original exception. Use `chunkIndex` and `bytesConsumed` to locate the * failure.

members.name: invalidChunk
members.description: Thrown for an invalid chunk: a malformed `[type, data]` pair, incorrect text or byte payload, * unknown kind, or a value chunk used by a carrier that accepts only wire data. * * Check parser output and input chunks. This indicates an invalid parser or damaged archive, not * a backend failure.

members.name: aborted
members.description: Thrown when encoding or decoding is cancelled through an abort signal. * * Treat this as cancellation and retry with a fresh signal when appropriate. It differs from * unrecoverable `ENCODE_FAILED` and `DECODE_FAILED` errors.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Text emitters also reject nonportable own data and values the selected format cannot express.

members.name: envUnsupported
members.description: Thrown when `createSerializeRegistry` cannot obtain host `TextEncoder` or `TextDecoder` * capabilities. Standalone `jsonParser` bytes decoding also uses this code when neither its * injected decoder nor the host `TextDecoder` exists. Core collectors require an explicit encoder * for byte merges. * * Inject `encoder` and `decoder`, or use a host with the Encoding API. `cause` retains the * original capability failure.

symbols.name: sliceByFrameBudget
symbols.purpose: Yields array slices and measures consumer work between yield and resume to adjust the next slice size. It waits between slices using an injected scheduler or yield callback; a target duration is adaptive rather than preemptive.
symbols.core:
items: Caller-owned source array; each yielded slice is a shallow array copy with original item references.
AsyncGenerator of readonly array slices. Invalid options throw INVALID_OPTION; an aborted signal throws ABORTED. Early return stops future slices.
targetMs: Positive finite consumer processing budget in milliseconds; measured elapsed time adjusts the next slice size.
`8` milliseconds per slice; this is a target rather than a hard execution deadline.
minItems: Positive safe integer lower bound on items per slice, reducing overhead from very small batches.
`64` items, including the lower clamp applied to the initial slice.
maxItems: Positive safe integer upper bound on items per slice; must be at least `minItems`.
`250000` items; adaptive growth never exceeds this upper bound.
initialItems: Positive safe integer initial size before consumer timing is available; clamped between the item bounds.
`2048` items before clamping to `minItems` and `maxItems`.
yieldTo: Optional no-argument async callback invoked between slices. Resolve after yielding execution; a throw or rejection stops iteration.
A `Promise<void>` whose fulfillment permits the next slice; rejection reaches the stream consumer.
Schedules a zero-delay task with the supplied scheduler; its wait observes cancellation.
signal: Caller-owned structural `IAbortSignal`, usually from `createAbortController().signal`, requests cooperative cancellation.
No caller cancellation signal is installed when omitted.
scheduler: Required `IScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`, or an implementation with finite `now()` and cancellable `schedule()` tasks.
parameters: items: readonly T[]
options: IFrameBudgetOptions
symbols.returns: AsyncGenerator<readonly T[], void, undefined>

declaredConfiguration.name: targetMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Target duration per slice. Defaults to 8 ms, leaving about half a 16.7 ms frame at 60 fps for rendering and other work.

declaredConfiguration.name: minItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Minimum slice size to keep per-message overhead from dominating processing.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum slice size to limit how long one slice can occupy the main thread.

declaredConfiguration.name: initialItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Conservative initial slice size to reduce the risk of exceeding the first frame budget.

declaredConfiguration.name: signal
declaredConfiguration.description: 结构化取消信号：只描述 `AbortSignal` 用到的那部分形状，不依赖 DOM lib.d.ts—— 这个包要在 Deno/Bun/小程序等不一定有全局 `AbortSignal` 类型的运行时里可用。 故意在这里复制一份而不是从 `@migaia/rpc/core` 里借用同名类型：serialize 是 store-persist/store-ssr/store-worker 依赖的底层 codec 原语，而 RPC core 是更上层的传输层；反向依赖会倒置层次，也会让只需要 codec 的消费者被迫依赖整个 RPC 包。 / import { SERIALIZE_SOURCE, createSerializeRangeError, createSerializeTypeError, SerializeErrorCode, SerializeErrorText } from './errors.js' import { isUint8Array } from '@migaia/utils/bytes' import type { ISerializeErrorCode } from './error-code.js' import { SerializeChunkKind, SerializeCleanupKind, SerializeCleanupPolicy, SerializePhase } from './format-constants.js' /** Serialization chunk protocol. guidance.heading: 4.3 tagSerializeError / createSerializeError / createSerializeTypeError / createSerializeRangeError（构造期失败）

rows: `REGISTRY_DISPOSED`、`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`、`ABORTED`（协作式取消）；可选 `errors` 是 rollback 完成后一次性创建的不可变快照（`Object.freeze`），为空则省略该字段
参数结构非法（如 `scheduler` 不是 `{ now, schedule }`）、`base64ToBytes` 输入非法
插件表为空/重复/`type` 不合法、帧预算参数越界
前三者的底层实现；也可直接用来给自定义错误打标签

blocks.text: `tagSerializeError` 的行为要点（只读附加字段，不重建、不替换、不覆盖 `stack`）：

items: 未标记过的错误：调用 `attachErrorIdentity` 附加 `source: '@migaia/serialize'`、`code`，`context` 若提供则一并写入
已标记且 `(source, code)` 与本次调用一致：幂等直接返回；`context` 仅在原先未定义时补写一次
已标记但 `(source, code)` 不一致：抛 `TypeError`（"serialize error already tagged with a different (source, code): ..."）——不允许静默改写已标记的错误，避免二次 `Object.defineProperty` 因 `configurable: false` 抛错

blocks.text: `createSerializeError`/`createSerializeTypeError`/`createSerializeRangeError` 均支持 `options.cause`（挂到 `Error` 构造函数的标准 `cause` 上）与 `options.context`（定位字段）。这几个函数与 `SerializeCodecError` 一起构成本包唯一的错误制造入口，包内部不允许手写裸 `throw new Error(...)`（`docs/contracts/error-codes.md` 契约）。

symbols.name: chunkToBytes
symbols.purpose: Converts a text or byte chunk into bytes with an explicit encoder. Existing byte storage is copied, so the returned buffer is independently owned; value chunks reject.
symbols.core:
chunk: Wire chunk returned by registry encoding or read from a carrier.
encoder: Required ITextEncoder, commonly a new host TextEncoder; used only for text chunks.
New bytes for text or a slice of existing byte storage. Value chunks throw TypeError with INVALID_CHUNK; encoder failures receive `ENCODE_FAILED` while retaining native identity where possible; wrappers keep the original on `cause`.
parameters: chunk: ISerializeChunk
encoder: ITextEncoder

blocks.text: `plugins`（必填）：

items: 至少 1 项，空表抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"serialize registry needs at least one plugin"）
数组第一项的 `type` 就是 `primaryType`
每项的 `type` 必须匹配 `SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN`（见 §10），非法字符抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`
`parser` 必须提供 `encode`/`decode` 函数（`dispose` 可选但若提供必须是函数），否则抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"invalid serialize plugin at index N"，原始失败挂 `cause`）
重复 `type` 抛 `RangeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"duplicate serialize plugin type: ..."）
校验逐项进行且发生在任何 parser 被 registry 接管之前，因此校验失败不需要回滚任何已注册的 parser

blocks.text: `options`（全部可选）：

rows: 创建后不可更换；结构非法（缺 `now`/`schedule`，或 `now()` 不返回有限数字）抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`（"serialize scheduler must be { now, schedule }" 等）
用于把 `text` 段就地转成字节（多段拼装出现 `bytes` 时）；省略且宿主没有 `TextEncoder` → 构造期抛 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`；提供了但形状不对（没有 `.encode` 方法）→ `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`
目前构造期只做能力探测（供后续经该 registry 派生的 API 复用），同上校验规则

`{ policy: 'throw' }`：`dispose()` 时任一 parser `dispose()` 失败会并入 `dispose()` 的 reject（见 §3.3）；`{ policy: 'report'; report }`：转发给 `report`，不影响 `dispose()` 的正常结算；`report` 缺失或非函数抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`
`dispose({ deadlineAt })` 到期时仍有在途操作，触发一次诊断回调；回调抛错被吞掉（containment），不影响 `dispose()`
两类"迟到"错误的观测出口：① 操作已经因 abort 提前 settle，但底层 parser task 之后才真正 reject（detached 迟到 rejection，不要求 registry 已 cleanup）；② 流式 `encode`/`decode` 内部 async iterator 二次清理失败。两类都不改变已结算的 primary 结果

blocks.text: 非对象/非函数的 `options` 本身（例如传了一个 `null`）会抛 `TypeError`／`INVALID_OPTION`。

rows: 出错时已收集的段数/字节数
`encode()` 时 `value` 段与其他段混用
`decode()` 时传入的 `chunk` 形状非法
该 chunk 的字节数，原错误挂 `cause`
`chunkIndex` 是流里的第几片（不是该次 encode 内部的段号），`bytesConsumed` 恒为 `0`
`decodeStream()` 中某一个 chunk 解码失败
`chunkIndex` 是流里的第几个 chunk，`bytesConsumed` 恒为 `0`
cause 保留 utils 的原始解码失败
`createSerializeRegistry`/JSON 插件探测不到 Encoding API

blocks.text: `encodeStream`/`decodeStream` 内部捕获到单次 `registry.encode`/`decode` 抛出的 `SerializeCodecError` 后，不会直接透传——那个内层错误的 `chunkIndex` 说的是"这一次 encode/decode 内部的第几段"，恒为 0，会把"流里的第几片/第几个 chunk"这个真正有用的位置信息盖掉。所以会重新包一层新的 `SerializeCodecError`，用流位置作为 `chunkIndex`，原始错误挂在 `cause` 上——排查时应该顺着 `cause` 链往下看真正的根因。

import {
  ConflictPolicy,

blocks.text: `IOperationContext`｜5 秒上手 —— 所有异步方法最后一个可选参数：

blocks.code: await store.get('theme', { timeoutMs: 500 });

blocks.text: 全部字段：

items: `signal?: IAbortSignal` —— 协作式取消，取消感知操作以契约 `ABORTED` 停止等待；不保证原生 `AbortError` 类，进入原子提交后返回真实结局
`timeoutMs?: number` —— 由实现层处理的便捷超时；契约包仅校验，不创建计时器或取消引擎
`pageSize?: number` —— IndexedDB 等迭代器的分页大小，`1`~`4096` 之间的整数

blocks.text: `IWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— `IOperationContext` 之上追加 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`（默认 `'conflict'`）：

blocks.code: await store.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: ConflictPolicy.replace });

blocks.text: `ISyncWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— 同步写只接受 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`，不接受 `signal`/`timeoutMs`（同步调用无法协作式取消）：

blocks.code: store.sync?.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: 'replace' });

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy`｜3 秒上手 —— 冲突策略常量，`'conflict'`（默认，已存在则失败）或 `'replace'`（覆盖）：

blocks.code:
ConflictPolicy.conflict; // 'conflict'
ConflictPolicy.replace; // 'replace'

blocks.text: `IStorageKey`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 文档主键类型：`string | number | Date | ArrayBuffer` 或以上类型的（可嵌套）只读数组。
`IKeyRange`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 范围查询边界，语义对齐 `IDBKeyRange` 但不直接依赖它：

blocks.code: const range: IKeyRange = { lower: 'a', upper: 'z', upperOpen: true };

blocks.text: 全部字段（均可选）：`lower?: IStorageKey`、`lowerOpen?: boolean`、`upper?: IStorageKey`、`upperOpen?: boolean`。
`snapshotOperationContext`｜5 秒上手 —— 读一次并校验 `IOperationContext`，返回冻结快照；供实现方在方法入口统一调用：

blocks.code: const snapshot = snapshotOperationContext(ctx); // undefined | 冻结后的快照

blocks.text: 单参数 `ctx: IOperationContext | undefined`（必填，可传 `undefined`），无选项。已是本函数产出的快照会被幂等直接返回。非法值（`signal` 不满足 `IAbortSignal` 形状、`timeoutMs` 非非负安全整数、`pageSize` 不在 `1`~`4096`、`conflictPolicy` 不是 `'conflict'/'replace'`）抛 `StorageContractError(invalidArgument)`。
`assertOperationContext`｜3 秒上手 —— 只校验不返回值（内部即调用 `snapshotOperationContext`）：

blocks.code: assertOperationContext(ctx); // 非法时抛错，合法时无返回

blocks.text: 单参数同上。
`snapshotSyncWriteOptions`｜5 秒上手 —— 校验同步写选项，禁止出现 `signal`/`timeoutMs`：

blocks.code:
import {
  ConflictPolicy,
  snapshotOperationContext,
  assertOperationContext,
  snapshotSyncWriteOptions,
  assertSyncWriteOptions,
  type IOperationContext,
  type IWriteOptions,
  type ISyncWriteOptions,
  type IConflictPolicy,
  type IStorageKey,
  type IKeyRange,
  type IOperationContextSnapshot
} from '@migaia/storage-contract';

blocks.text: `IOperationContext`｜5 秒上手 —— 所有异步方法最后一个可选参数：

blocks.code: await store.get('theme', { timeoutMs: 500 });

blocks.text: 全部字段：

items: `signal?: IAbortSignal` —— 协作式取消，取消感知操作以契约 `ABORTED` 停止等待；不保证原生 `AbortError` 类，进入原子提交后返回真实结局
`timeoutMs?: number` —— 由实现层处理的便捷超时；契约包仅校验，不创建计时器或取消引擎
`pageSize?: number` —— IndexedDB 等迭代器的分页大小，`1`~`4096` 之间的整数

blocks.text: `IWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— `IOperationContext` 之上追加 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`（默认 `'conflict'`）：

blocks.code: await store.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: ConflictPolicy.replace });

blocks.text: `ISyncWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— 同步写只接受 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`，不接受 `signal`/`timeoutMs`（同步调用无法协作式取消）：

blocks.code: store.sync?.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: 'replace' });

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy`｜3 秒上手 —— 冲突策略常量，`'conflict'`（默认，已存在则失败）或 `'replace'`（覆盖）：

blocks.code:
ConflictPolicy.conflict; // 'conflict'
ConflictPolicy.replace; // 'replace'

blocks.text: `IStorageKey`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 文档主键类型：`string | number | Date | ArrayBuffer` 或以上类型的（可嵌套）只读数组。
`IKeyRange`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 范围查询边界，语义对齐 `IDBKeyRange` 但不直接依赖它：

blocks.code: const range: IKeyRange = { lower: 'a', upper: 'z', upperOpen: true };

blocks.text: 全部字段（均可选）：`lower?: IStorageKey`、`lowerOpen?: boolean`、`upper?: IStorageKey`、`upperOpen?: boolean`。
`snapshotOperationContext`｜5 秒上手 —— 读一次并校验 `IOperationContext`，返回冻结快照；供实现方在方法入口统一调用：

blocks.code: const snapshot = snapshotOperationContext(ctx); // undefined | 冻结后的快照

blocks.text: 单参数 `ctx: IOperationContext | undefined`（必填，可传 `undefined`），无选项。已是本函数产出的快照会被幂等直接返回。非法值（`signal` 不满足 `IAbortSignal` 形状、`timeoutMs` 非非负安全整数、`pageSize` 不在 `1`~`4096`、`conflictPolicy` 不是 `'conflict'/'replace'`）抛 `StorageContractError(invalidArgument)`。
`assertOperationContext`｜3 秒上手 —— 只校验不返回值（内部即调用 `snapshotOperationContext`）：

blocks.code: assertOperationContext(ctx); // 非法时抛错，合法时无返回

blocks.text: 单参数同上。
`snapshotSyncWriteOptions`｜5 秒上手 —— 校验同步写选项，禁止出现 `signal`/`timeoutMs`：

blocks.code:
snapshotSyncWriteOptions({ conflictPolicy: 'replace' }); // { conflictPolicy: 'replace' }
snapshotSyncWriteOptions({ timeoutMs: 100 }); // 抛错：同步写不支持 timeoutMs

blocks.text: 单参数 `options: unknown`（必填），无选项。
`assertSyncWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— 只校验不返回值：

blocks.code: assertSyncWriteOptions(options);

blocks.text: `IWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— `IOperationContext` 之上追加 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`（默认 `'conflict'`）：

blocks.code: store.sync?.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: 'replace' });

ConflictPolicy.replace; // 'replace'

blocks.text: `IStorageKey`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 文档主键类型：`string | number | Date | ArrayBuffer` 或以上类型的（可嵌套）只读数组。

blocks.text: 单参数同上。

blocks.text: 单参数 `options: unknown`（必填），无选项。

Session-scoped browser key-value storage with the host’s session lifetime.
Cookie storage subject to document visibility, scope and small value limits.
Structured browser database backend; inspect capability flags before using record extensions.
In-process memory implementation whose data lifetime is owned by the concrete backend.

backend: Implementation family declared by the backend; use capabilities rather than this label to choose optional operations.
Local browser key-value storage whose data normally survives browsing sessions.
Session-scoped browser key-value storage with the host’s session lifetime.
Cookie storage subject to document visibility, scope and small value limits.
Structured browser database backend; inspect capability flags before using record extensions.
In-process memory implementation whose data lifetime is owned by the concrete backend.
capabilities: Backend-supplied `IStorageCapabilities` describing callable channels and their limits; admission snapshots these facts once.
get: Reads a string value from the L0 channel of the supplied backend, using optional operation intent.

set: Writes one string value through the supplied backend’s commit path and selected existing-key policy.
set.key: String key selected by the application for this channel; the same spelling identifies a later read or removal.

remove: Removes the application-selected string entry from the supplied backend’s value channel.

remove.ctx: Optional `IOperationContext` authored by the caller; omitted means no explicit cancellation, timeout or paging override.

has: Checks whether one string-channel key currently exists in the backend.
has.key: String key selected by the application for this channel; the same spelling identifies a later read or removal.
has.ctx: Optional `IOperationContext` authored by the caller; omitted means no explicit cancellation, timeout or paging override.

keys: Lists visible string-channel keys from the backend; visibility and opaque entries remain backend capabilities.
keys.ctx: Optional `IOperationContext` authored by the caller; omitted means no explicit cancellation, timeout or paging override.

blocks.text: `StorageContractError`｜5 秒上手 —— 本包统一抛出的错误类，构造后 `Object.freeze`：

构造参数：`code: IStorageContractErrorCode`（必填）、`details?: IStorageContractErrorDetails`（默认 `{}`，字段：`backend?: IBackendKind`、`key?: string | IStorageKey`、`cause?: unknown`）、`message?: string`（默认 `` `[storage-contract] ${code}` ``）。实例字段：`source`（恒为 `'@migaia/storage-contract'`）、`code`、`backend?`、`key?`，均只读；`cause` 通过标准 `Error` 机制可达。
`StorageContractErrorCode`｜3 秒上手 —— 稳定错误码表，常量对象：

全部取值：`invalidArgument`(`INVALID_ARGUMENT`，契约级入参/描述符结构校验失败)、`invalidKey`(`INVALID_KEY`，键违反键域)、`unsupported`(`UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`，调用了当前后端不提供的能力)、`disposed`(`STORE_DISPOSED`，store 已 `dispose()` 后继续调用)、`aborted`(`ABORTED`，操作被 `signal`/`timeoutMs` 取消)。
`STORAGE_CONTRACT_SOURCE`｜3 秒上手 —— 常量字符串 `'@migaia/storage-contract'`，等同任意 `StorageContractError` 实例的 `source` 字段。

syncRead: Whether the implementation declares a synchronous access channel; actual access is exposed through store.sync.
binary: Whether the backend supports raw byte values in its binary channel.
records: Whether the backend supports structured record reads and writes in addition to string values.
transactions: Whether the backend declares transactional record callbacks with its own commit/rollback engine.
iteration: Whether the backend supports asynchronous range iteration over structured records.
secondaryIndexes: Whether the backend exposes the complete logical secondary-index extension; legacy missing input flags normalize to false.
changeFeed: Whether the backend emits post-commit invalidation changes; legacy missing input flags normalize to false.
maxValueBytes: Optional nonnegative safe-integer approximate per-value byte limit; undefined means this descriptor supplies no per-value bound.
opaqueEntries: Whether entries invisible to the JavaScript-facing channel may still exist, such as HTTP-only cookies.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
syncRead: Whether the implementation declares a synchronous access channel; actual access is exposed through store.sync.
binary: Whether the backend supports raw byte values in its binary channel.
records: Whether the backend supports structured record reads and writes in addition to string values.
transactions: Whether the backend declares transactional record callbacks with its own commit/rollback engine.
iteration: Whether the backend supports asynchronous range iteration over structured records.
secondaryIndexes: Whether the backend exposes the complete logical secondary-index extension; legacy missing input flags normalize to false.
changeFeed: Whether the backend emits post-commit invalidation changes; legacy missing input flags normalize to false.
maxValueBytes: Optional nonnegative safe-integer approximate per-value byte limit; undefined means this descriptor supplies no per-value bound.
opaqueEntries: Whether entries invisible to the JavaScript-facing channel may still exist, such as HTTP-only cookies.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content: Choose a supported storage path before requesting structured records, binary data or notifications.

blocks.text: `StorageContractError`｜5 秒上手 —— 本包统一抛出的错误类，构造后 `Object.freeze`：

构造参数：`code: IStorageContractErrorCode`（必填）、`details?: IStorageContractErrorDetails`（默认 `{}`，字段：`backend?: IBackendKind`、`key?: string | IStorageKey`、`cause?: unknown`）、`message?: string`（默认 `` `[storage-contract] ${code}` ``）。实例字段：`source`（恒为 `'@migaia/storage-contract'`）、`code`、`backend?`、`key?`，均只读；`cause` 通过标准 `Error` 机制可达。
`StorageContractErrorCode`｜3 秒上手 —— 稳定错误码表，常量对象：

全部取值：`invalidArgument`(`INVALID_ARGUMENT`，契约级入参/描述符结构校验失败)、`invalidKey`(`INVALID_KEY`，键违反键域)、`unsupported`(`UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`，调用了当前后端不提供的能力)、`disposed`(`STORE_DISPOSED`，store 已 `dispose()` 后继续调用)、`aborted`(`ABORTED`，操作被 `signal`/`timeoutMs` 取消)。
`STORAGE_CONTRACT_SOURCE`｜3 秒上手 —— 常量字符串 `'@migaia/storage-contract'`，等同任意 `StorageContractError` 实例的 `source` 字段。
`isStorageContractError`｜3 秒上手 —— 类型守卫：

blocks.code: if (isStorageContractError(error)) console.log(error.code);

guidance.heading: context / operation-context 模块：操作上下文与写选项

blocks.code:
import {
  ConflictPolicy,
  snapshotOperationContext,
  assertOperationContext,
  snapshotSyncWriteOptions,
  assertSyncWriteOptions,
  type IOperationContext,
  type IWriteOptions,
  type ISyncWriteOptions,
  type IConflictPolicy,
  type IStorageKey,
  type IKeyRange,
  type IOperationContextSnapshot
} from '@migaia/storage-contract';

blocks.text: `IOperationContext`｜5 秒上手 —— 所有异步方法最后一个可选参数：

blocks.code: await store.get('theme', { timeoutMs: 500 });

blocks.text: 全部字段：

items: `signal?: IAbortSignal` —— 协作式取消，取消感知操作以契约 `ABORTED` 停止等待；不保证原生 `AbortError` 类，进入原子提交后返回真实结局
`timeoutMs?: number` —— 由实现层处理的便捷超时；契约包仅校验，不创建计时器或取消引擎
`pageSize?: number` —— IndexedDB 等迭代器的分页大小，`1`~`4096` 之间的整数

blocks.text: `IWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— `IOperationContext` 之上追加 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`（默认 `'conflict'`）：

blocks.code: await store.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: ConflictPolicy.replace });

blocks.text: `ISyncWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— 同步写只接受 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`，不接受 `signal`/`timeoutMs`（同步调用无法协作式取消）：

blocks.code: store.sync?.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: 'replace' });

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy`｜3 秒上手 —— 冲突策略常量，`'conflict'`（默认，已存在则失败）或 `'replace'`（覆盖）：

blocks.code:
ConflictPolicy.conflict; // 'conflict'
ConflictPolicy.replace; // 'replace'

blocks.text: `IStorageKey`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 文档主键类型：`string | number | Date | ArrayBuffer` 或以上类型的（可嵌套）只读数组。
`IKeyRange`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 范围查询边界，语义对齐 `IDBKeyRange` 但不直接依赖它：

blocks.code: const range: IKeyRange = { lower: 'a', upper: 'z', upperOpen: true };

blocks.text: 全部字段（均可选）：`lower?: IStorageKey`、`lowerOpen?: boolean`、`upper?: IStorageKey`、`upperOpen?: boolean`。
`snapshotOperationContext`｜5 秒上手 —— 读一次并校验 `IOperationContext`，返回冻结快照；供实现方在方法入口统一调用：

blocks.code: const snapshot = snapshotOperationContext(ctx); // undefined | 冻结后的快照

blocks.text: 单参数 `ctx: IOperationContext | undefined`（必填，可传 `undefined`），无选项。已是本函数产出的快照会被幂等直接返回。非法值（`signal` 不满足 `IAbortSignal` 形状、`timeoutMs` 非非负安全整数、`pageSize` 不在 `1`~`4096`、`conflictPolicy` 不是 `'conflict'/'replace'`）抛 `StorageContractError(invalidArgument)`。
`assertOperationContext`｜3 秒上手 —— 只校验不返回值（内部即调用 `snapshotOperationContext`）：

blocks.code: assertOperationContext(ctx); // 非法时抛错，合法时无返回

blocks.text: 单参数同上。
`snapshotSyncWriteOptions`｜5 秒上手 —— 校验同步写选项，禁止出现 `signal`/`timeoutMs`：

blocks.code:
snapshotSyncWriteOptions({ conflictPolicy: 'replace' }); // { conflictPolicy: 'replace' }
snapshotSyncWriteOptions({ timeoutMs: 100 }); // 抛错：同步写不支持 timeoutMs

blocks.text: 单参数 `options: unknown`（必填），无选项。
`assertSyncWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— 只校验不返回值：

blocks.code: assertSyncWriteOptions(options);

blocks.code:
import {
  ConflictPolicy,
  snapshotOperationContext,
  assertOperationContext,
  snapshotSyncWriteOptions,
  assertSyncWriteOptions,
  type IOperationContext,
  type IWriteOptions,
  type ISyncWriteOptions,
  type IConflictPolicy,
  type IStorageKey,
  type IKeyRange,
  type IOperationContextSnapshot
} from '@migaia/storage-contract';

blocks.text: `IOperationContext`｜5 秒上手 —— 所有异步方法最后一个可选参数：

blocks.code: await store.get('theme', { timeoutMs: 500 });

blocks.text: 全部字段：

items: `signal?: IAbortSignal` —— 协作式取消，取消感知操作以契约 `ABORTED` 停止等待；不保证原生 `AbortError` 类，进入原子提交后返回真实结局
`timeoutMs?: number` —— 由实现层处理的便捷超时；契约包仅校验，不创建计时器或取消引擎
`pageSize?: number` —— IndexedDB 等迭代器的分页大小，`1`~`4096` 之间的整数

blocks.text: `IWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— `IOperationContext` 之上追加 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`（默认 `'conflict'`）：

blocks.code: await store.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: ConflictPolicy.replace });

blocks.text: `ISyncWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— 同步写只接受 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`，不接受 `signal`/`timeoutMs`（同步调用无法协作式取消）：

blocks.code: store.sync?.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: 'replace' });

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy`｜3 秒上手 —— 冲突策略常量，`'conflict'`（默认，已存在则失败）或 `'replace'`（覆盖）：

blocks.code:
ConflictPolicy.conflict; // 'conflict'
ConflictPolicy.replace; // 'replace'

blocks.text: `IStorageKey`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 文档主键类型：`string | number | Date | ArrayBuffer` 或以上类型的（可嵌套）只读数组。
`IKeyRange`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 范围查询边界，语义对齐 `IDBKeyRange` 但不直接依赖它：

blocks.code: const range: IKeyRange = { lower: 'a', upper: 'z', upperOpen: true };

blocks.text: 全部字段（均可选）：`lower?: IStorageKey`、`lowerOpen?: boolean`、`upper?: IStorageKey`、`upperOpen?: boolean`。
`snapshotOperationContext`｜5 秒上手 —— 读一次并校验 `IOperationContext`，返回冻结快照；供实现方在方法入口统一调用：

blocks.code: const snapshot = snapshotOperationContext(ctx); // undefined | 冻结后的快照

blocks.text: 单参数 `ctx: IOperationContext | undefined`（必填，可传 `undefined`），无选项。已是本函数产出的快照会被幂等直接返回。非法值（`signal` 不满足 `IAbortSignal` 形状、`timeoutMs` 非非负安全整数、`pageSize` 不在 `1`~`4096`、`conflictPolicy` 不是 `'conflict'/'replace'`）抛 `StorageContractError(invalidArgument)`。
`assertOperationContext`｜3 秒上手 —— 只校验不返回值（内部即调用 `snapshotOperationContext`）：

blocks.code: assertOperationContext(ctx); // 非法时抛错，合法时无返回

blocks.text: 单参数同上。
`snapshotSyncWriteOptions`｜5 秒上手 —— 校验同步写选项，禁止出现 `signal`/`timeoutMs`：

blocks.code:
snapshotSyncWriteOptions({ conflictPolicy: 'replace' }); // { conflictPolicy: 'replace' }
snapshotSyncWriteOptions({ timeoutMs: 100 }); // 抛错：同步写不支持 timeoutMs

blocks.text: 单参数 `options: unknown`（必填），无选项。
`assertSyncWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— 只校验不返回值：

blocks.code: assertSyncWriteOptions(options);

blocks.code:
import {
  ConflictPolicy,
  snapshotOperationContext,
  assertOperationContext,
  snapshotSyncWriteOptions,
  assertSyncWriteOptions,
  type IOperationContext,
  type IWriteOptions,
  type ISyncWriteOptions,
  type IConflictPolicy,
  type IStorageKey,
  type IKeyRange,
  type IOperationContextSnapshot
} from '@migaia/storage-contract';

blocks.text: `IOperationContext`｜5 秒上手 —— 所有异步方法最后一个可选参数：

blocks.code: await store.get('theme', { timeoutMs: 500 });

blocks.text: 全部字段：

items: `signal?: IAbortSignal` —— 协作式取消，取消感知操作以契约 `ABORTED` 停止等待；不保证原生 `AbortError` 类，进入原子提交后返回真实结局
`timeoutMs?: number` —— 由实现层处理的便捷超时；契约包仅校验，不创建计时器或取消引擎
`pageSize?: number` —— IndexedDB 等迭代器的分页大小，`1`~`4096` 之间的整数

blocks.text: `IWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— `IOperationContext` 之上追加 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`（默认 `'conflict'`）：

blocks.code: await store.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: ConflictPolicy.replace });

blocks.text: `ISyncWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— 同步写只接受 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`，不接受 `signal`/`timeoutMs`（同步调用无法协作式取消）：

blocks.code: store.sync?.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: 'replace' });

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy`｜3 秒上手 —— 冲突策略常量，`'conflict'`（默认，已存在则失败）或 `'replace'`（覆盖）：

blocks.code:
ConflictPolicy.conflict; // 'conflict'
ConflictPolicy.replace; // 'replace'

blocks.text: `IStorageKey`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 文档主键类型：`string | number | Date | ArrayBuffer` 或以上类型的（可嵌套）只读数组。
`IKeyRange`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 范围查询边界，语义对齐 `IDBKeyRange` 但不直接依赖它：

blocks.code: const range: IKeyRange = { lower: 'a', upper: 'z', upperOpen: true };

blocks.text: 全部字段（均可选）：`lower?: IStorageKey`、`lowerOpen?: boolean`、`upper?: IStorageKey`、`upperOpen?: boolean`。
`snapshotOperationContext`｜5 秒上手 —— 读一次并校验 `IOperationContext`，返回冻结快照；供实现方在方法入口统一调用：

blocks.code: const snapshot = snapshotOperationContext(ctx); // undefined | 冻结后的快照

blocks.text: 单参数 `ctx: IOperationContext | undefined`（必填，可传 `undefined`），无选项。已是本函数产出的快照会被幂等直接返回。非法值（`signal` 不满足 `IAbortSignal` 形状、`timeoutMs` 非非负安全整数、`pageSize` 不在 `1`~`4096`、`conflictPolicy` 不是 `'conflict'/'replace'`）抛 `StorageContractError(invalidArgument)`。
`assertOperationContext`｜3 秒上手 —— 只校验不返回值（内部即调用 `snapshotOperationContext`）：

blocks.code: assertOperationContext(ctx); // 非法时抛错，合法时无返回

blocks.text: 单参数同上。
`snapshotSyncWriteOptions`｜5 秒上手 —— 校验同步写选项，禁止出现 `signal`/`timeoutMs`：

blocks.code:
snapshotSyncWriteOptions({ conflictPolicy: 'replace' }); // { conflictPolicy: 'replace' }
snapshotSyncWriteOptions({ timeoutMs: 100 }); // 抛错：同步写不支持 timeoutMs

blocks.text: 单参数 `options: unknown`（必填），无选项。
`assertSyncWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— 只校验不返回值：

blocks.code: assertSyncWriteOptions(options);

guidance.heading: context / operation-context 模块：操作上下文与写选项

blocks.code:
import {
  ConflictPolicy,
  snapshotOperationContext,
  assertOperationContext,
  snapshotSyncWriteOptions,
  assertSyncWriteOptions,
  type IOperationContext,
  type IWriteOptions,
  type ISyncWriteOptions,
  type IConflictPolicy,
  type IStorageKey,
  type IKeyRange,
  type IOperationContextSnapshot
} from '@migaia/storage-contract';

blocks.text: `IOperationContext`｜5 秒上手 —— 所有异步方法最后一个可选参数：

blocks.code: await store.get('theme', { timeoutMs: 500 });

blocks.text: 全部字段：

items: `signal?: IAbortSignal` —— 协作式取消，取消感知操作以契约 `ABORTED` 停止等待；不保证原生 `AbortError` 类，进入原子提交后返回真实结局
`timeoutMs?: number` —— 由实现层处理的便捷超时；契约包仅校验，不创建计时器或取消引擎
`pageSize?: number` —— IndexedDB 等迭代器的分页大小，`1`~`4096` 之间的整数

blocks.text: `IWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— `IOperationContext` 之上追加 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`（默认 `'conflict'`）：

blocks.code: await store.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: ConflictPolicy.replace });

blocks.text: `ISyncWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— 同步写只接受 `conflictPolicy?: IConflictPolicy`，不接受 `signal`/`timeoutMs`（同步调用无法协作式取消）：

blocks.code: store.sync?.set('k', 'v', { conflictPolicy: 'replace' });

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy`｜3 秒上手 —— 冲突策略常量，`'conflict'`（默认，已存在则失败）或 `'replace'`（覆盖）：

blocks.code:
ConflictPolicy.conflict; // 'conflict'
ConflictPolicy.replace; // 'replace'

blocks.text: `IStorageKey`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 文档主键类型：`string | number | Date | ArrayBuffer` 或以上类型的（可嵌套）只读数组。
`IKeyRange`｜3 秒上手 —— L1 范围查询边界，语义对齐 `IDBKeyRange` 但不直接依赖它：

blocks.code: const range: IKeyRange = { lower: 'a', upper: 'z', upperOpen: true };

blocks.text: 全部字段（均可选）：`lower?: IStorageKey`、`lowerOpen?: boolean`、`upper?: IStorageKey`、`upperOpen?: boolean`。
`snapshotOperationContext`｜5 秒上手 —— 读一次并校验 `IOperationContext`，返回冻结快照；供实现方在方法入口统一调用：

blocks.code: const snapshot = snapshotOperationContext(ctx); // undefined | 冻结后的快照

blocks.text: 单参数 `ctx: IOperationContext | undefined`（必填，可传 `undefined`），无选项。已是本函数产出的快照会被幂等直接返回。非法值（`signal` 不满足 `IAbortSignal` 形状、`timeoutMs` 非非负安全整数、`pageSize` 不在 `1`~`4096`、`conflictPolicy` 不是 `'conflict'/'replace'`）抛 `StorageContractError(invalidArgument)`。
`assertOperationContext`｜3 秒上手 —— 只校验不返回值（内部即调用 `snapshotOperationContext`）：

blocks.code: assertOperationContext(ctx); // 非法时抛错，合法时无返回

blocks.text: 单参数同上。
`snapshotSyncWriteOptions`｜5 秒上手 —— 校验同步写选项，禁止出现 `signal`/`timeoutMs`：

blocks.code:
snapshotSyncWriteOptions({ conflictPolicy: 'replace' }); // { conflictPolicy: 'replace' }
snapshotSyncWriteOptions({ timeoutMs: 100 }); // 抛错：同步写不支持 timeoutMs

blocks.text: 单参数 `options: unknown`（必填），无选项。
`assertSyncWriteOptions`｜3 秒上手 —— 只校验不返回值：

blocks.code: assertSyncWriteOptions(options);

symbols.core:
invalidArgument: A public descriptor, context, synchronous write option or callback shape is invalid; correct the input before retrying.
invalidKey: A record key violates its type, finiteness, array, depth, node or binary-size domain.
unsupported: The supplied backend lacks the required capability or callable methods; select a suitable implementation.
disposed: A caller uses a backend after its disposal; create or obtain a new store.
aborted: A signal or timeout cancels waiting; writes already in atomic commit report the actual commit outcome.

members.name: invalidArgument
members.description: A public argument or descriptor fails contract shape validation. Applies to codec descriptors, * capability descriptors, key domains, transaction options, and operation contexts. * * Enforces runtime public argument and contract shape validation in * `docs/store-persist/storage-web-integration.sdd.md` §4.2. Adapter-specific configuration * validation uses the web `INVALID_CONFIG` code instead. * * The caller corrects the argument before retrying. The failure persists until the argument * changes.

members.name: invalidKey
members.description: An `IStorageKey` violates the key domain through an invalid type, excessive depth, node count * or binary bytes, a cycle, or an empty array. * * Enforces contract key validation in `docs/store-persist/storage-web-integration.sdd.md` §4.2. * * The caller corrects the key rather than retrying the same invalid key.

members.name: unsupported
members.description: An operation requires a capability that the current backend does not provide. Examples include * failed `asRecordStore` narrowing and a structured codec on a text-only backend. * * Enforces contract capability narrowing in `docs/store-persist/storage-web-integration.sdd.md` * §4.2. * * The caller checks `capabilities` or `isRecordStore`, or selects a backend with the required * capability. The operation does not silently fall back.

members.name: disposed
members.description: A storage operation runs after the store is disposed, violating the lifecycle contract. * * Enforces contract lifecycle semantics in `docs/store-persist/storage-web-integration.sdd.md` * §4.2. * * The caller creates a new store instead of reusing the closed instance.

members.name: aborted
members.description: `IOperationContext.signal` cancels an operation or `timeoutMs` expires. * * Enforces contract cancellation semantics in `docs/store-persist/storage-web-integration.sdd.md` * §4.2. * * The caller handles the result as cancellation. A write that has entered atomic commit reports * the actual commit result rather than claiming rollback.

type IListOptions<TRecord = unknown> = {
  readonly range?: IKeyRange
  readonly index?: never // 按索引查询时改用带 index 名的选项（IIndexedListOptions）
  readonly limit?: number
  readonly orderBy?: (left: TRecord, right: TRecord) => number
  readonly direction?: 'next' | 'prev'
  readonly onInvalid?:
    'skip' | 'throw' | ((issue: IInvalidRecordIssue<TRecord>) => 'skip' | 'throw')
}
type IInvalidRecordIssue<TRecord = unknown> = {
  readonly key: IStorageKey
  readonly raw: unknown
  readonly record?: TRecord
  readonly stage: 'decode' | 'migrate' | 'validate'
  readonly cause: unknown
}

items: `range`：作用于原始 `id` 空间（不是编排后的物理 key），经 `snapshotKeyRange` 校验。
`limit`：非负安全整数，否则抛 `INVALID_CONFIG`。

`orderBy`：未提供时使用 `defineEntity` 的 `defaultOrderBy`（若也未提供，按扫描顺序输出）。提供 `orderBy` 时内部会先缓冲全部符合 `range` 的记录、排序后再应用 `limit`——这意味着带排序的 `list`/`stream` 不是流式内存友好的，会一次性把结果集载入内存。比较函数返回非 `number` 或 `NaN` 会抛 `StorageError(EXTENSION_FAILED, { extensionStage: 'comparator', operation: 'entity.orderBy' })`。

`onInvalid`：取 `'skip'`（默认）、`'throw'`，或 `(issue) => 'skip' | 'throw'` 处理器函数；`issue.stage` 标识失败发生在解码（`decode`）、迁移（`migrate`）还是校验（`validate`）阶段。处理器返回非 `'skip'`/`'throw'` 为 `INVALID_CONFIG`；handler 自身的普通失败按 `VALIDATION_FAILED` 包装，已有 storage-family 错误保持其码与原因链。issue.stage 是记录失败阶段，不决定 handler 错误码。

扫描策略：KV-only 后端（local/session/cookie）会对全部键做一次 `keys()` 扫描后按 `entityName:` 前缀过滤，并调用一次 `onDiagnostic`（`"...list/stream on a value-only backend performs a full key scan"`）——这不是 bug，是这类后端固有的能力限制。结构化后端（IndexedDB/memory）按 entity 的 v2 前缀 range 高效扫描一遍，再额外扫描一遍全表以兼容尚未迁移的历史形态记录（`[entityName, id]`），用 `seenIds` 去重避免同一记录在两次扫描中都被 yield。
`list` 是 `stream` 的缓冲版本（`for await` 收集进数组后返回）；两者共享同一套过滤/排序/`onInvalid` 逻辑。

blocks.code:
class StorageError extends Error {
  readonly source: '@migaia/storage-web'
  readonly code: IStorageErrorCode
  readonly backend?: IBackendKind
  readonly key?: string | IStorageKey
  readonly existingChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
  readonly attemptedChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
  readonly extensionStage?: 'schema' | 'codec' | 'migration' | 'comparator' | 'diagnostic'
  readonly operation?: string
  constructor(
    code: IStorageErrorCode,
    details?: {
      readonly backend?: IBackendKind
      readonly key?: string | IStorageKey
      readonly existingChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
      readonly attemptedChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
      readonly extensionStage?: 'schema' | 'codec' | 'migration' | 'comparator' | 'diagnostic'
      readonly operation?: string
      readonly cause?: unknown
    },
    message?: string
  )
}

blocks.text: `source` 恒为 `'@migaia/storage-web'`；`cause` 恒保留原始异常，永不改写 `message`；实例在构造后立即 `Object.freeze`。
`STORAGE_WEB_SOURCE` 是上述稳定 source 的唯一公开常量。`StorageErrorText` 是包维护的稳定错误文本/文本工厂集合，主要供实现自定义 backend、codec 或诊断适配器时复用；业务分支仍应比较 `(source, code)`，不要依赖 message 文本。
全部错误码（`StorageErrorCode`）：

rows: 存储后端不可用：隐私模式探测失败、`localStorageHost`/IndexedDB/`document` 被禁用或缺失
写入命中浏览器配额上限
序列化后的 cookie 值超过单值 4KB 上限
序列化失败（`JSON.stringify` 抛错、codec encode 非预期输出、`structuredClone` 写失败）
反序列化失败（`JSON.parse` 抛错、envelope 结构非法、codec decode 非预期输出）
IndexedDB 事务创建/提交失败，或事务回调抛出非 `StorageError` 异常
value/bytes/record 三通道逻辑 key 冲突且未指定 `conflictPolicy: 'replace'`
entity envelope `__v` 或 IndexedDB schema 版本高于当前代码所知的版本
扩展点（schema/codec/namespaceCodec/comparator/diagnostic）抛出了未归类的异常
事务提交时 read revision 或 global epoch 已变（并发写冲突，可重试）
Cookie 写入后读回不可见
Cookie 同名多 scope 可见，无法确定目标值归属
Web adapter 专有输入/配置校验失败（选项形状、cookie scope、IndexedDB store 名等）

blocks.text: V4 索引、Host 与 reactive 追加错误码：

rows: sidecar 指向的 authoritative record 不存在；修复或重建索引。
unique key 已属于另一记录；修改值或删除竞争记录后重试。
分页期间 epoch 改变；从头重启查询。
回填与失败状态保存同时失败；检查原生 AggregateError 的 cause/errors 后重试。
owner/generation/checkpoint 已过期；重新取得 repository session 后重试。
使用不同 ID，或等待既有安装完成。
安装并选择精确 ID；没有隐式 default。
修复 plugin/store 契约或伪造 handle。
检查 `cause`；失败 batch 未发布，可修复后重试。
等当前安装 batch settle 后显式重试。
Host 已 terminal；创建新 Host。
Host 仍 terminal；检查 aggregate cleanup errors。
query 已 terminal；创建新 query。
修复 feature 与 opaque backend kind 的绑定。
修复未知、重复或循环 feature graph。
安装 reactive plugin 后再创建 query。
选择已安装且 reactive 的 backend ID。
观察 query error；后续 invalidation/poll 可触发恢复。
adapter 已 terminal；检查 cleanup errors。
backend 已 terminal；检查 quiescence/transport cleanup errors。

guidance.id: 契约级错误-直接从-migaia-storage-contract-导入-storage-web-根不转出
guidance.heading: 契约级错误（直接从 @migaia/storage-contract 导入，storage-web 根不转出）

rows: 契约级入参/描述符结构校验失败（codec 描述符、capabilities 描述符、operation context 等）
`IStorageKey` 违反 key 域（类型非法、深度/节点/二进制字节超限、循环、空数组）
调用了当前后端不提供的能力（`asRecordStore` 收窄失败、structured codec 落到 text-only 后端、KV-only 后端调用 `batch`）
Store 已 `dispose()` 后继续调用其任何方法
操作被 `signal` 取消或 `timeoutMs` 到期

blocks.text: 两类错误都保留 `cause` 链，`isStorageErrorFamily`（内部使用）会同时识别 `StorageError` 与 `StorageContractError`，跨扩展边界（schema/codec/namespaceCodec）传播时原样穿透，不会被二次包装。
`StorageError`｜3 秒上手 —— 本包（`@migaia/storage-web`）专有失败的统一类型：
`source` 恒为 `'@migaia/storage-web'`；`cause` 恒保留原始异常，永不改写 `message`。

`StorageErrorCode` 覆盖 backend、codec/schema、事务、二级索引、Host/plugin 和 reactive 生命周期失败。常用码包括 `BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`、`DUPLICATE_KEY`、`TRANSACTION_CONFLICT`、`INDEX_UNIQUE_CONFLICT`、`INDEX_QUERY_INVALIDATED`、`BACKEND_INSTALL_FAILED`、`STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSED`、`LIVE_QUERY_DISPOSED` 与 `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_FAILED`；完整清单和恢复动作见 USEGUIDE。

契约级错误直接从 `@migaia/storage-contract` 导入，storage-web 根不转出：`StorageContractError`（`source: '@migaia/storage-contract'`）、`StorageContractErrorCode`（`invalidArgument`/`invalidKey`/`unsupported`/`disposed`/`aborted`）、`isStorageContractError` 类型守卫。两类错误都保留 `cause` 链。

symbols.name: StorageErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Table of this package’s 37 stable error codes; values are the strings on error.code. `INDEX_BACKFILL_FAILED` identifies backfill and failed-readiness persistence failing together on a native AggregateError.
symbols.core:
unavailable: `BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`: storage is disabled or missing (private mode); pick `memoryStorageHost` or ask for access.
quotaExceeded: `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`: the browser quota is full; delete data or use IndexedDB.
valueTooLarge: `VALUE_TOO_LARGE`: a cookie value is over 4 KB.
serializeFailed: `SERIALIZE_FAILED`: encoding the value failed.
deserializeFailed: `DESERIALIZE_FAILED`: decoding the stored value failed.
validationFailed: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: the schema rejected the value.
migrationFailed: `MIGRATION_FAILED`: a migration function threw.
transactionFailed: `TRANSACTION_FAILED`: the IndexedDB transaction failed or the callback threw.
duplicateKey: `DUPLICATE_KEY`: the key is used by another channel; pass `conflictPolicy: "replace"` to overwrite.
versionUnsupported: `VERSION_UNSUPPORTED`: stored data is newer than this code.
extensionFailed: `EXTENSION_FAILED`: a schema, codec or comparator threw.
transactionConflict: `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT`: data changed concurrently; re-read and retry.
writeFailed: `WRITE_FAILED`: a written cookie was not visible afterwards.
cookieScopeAmbiguous: `COOKIE_SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS`: one cookie name is visible in several scopes.
invalidConfig: `INVALID_CONFIG`: an option or scope is invalid.
indexOrphan: `INDEX_ORPHAN`: an index points to a missing record; rebuild it.
indexUniqueConflict: `INDEX_UNIQUE_CONFLICT`: a unique index key belongs to another record.
indexQueryInvalidated: `INDEX_QUERY_INVALIDATED`: data changed during paging; restart the query.
liveQueryDisposed: `LIVE_QUERY_DISPOSED`: the live query was disposed; create a new one.
indexBackfillStale: `INDEX_BACKFILL_STALE`: an index backfill checkpoint expired; reconnect and retry.
indexBackfillFailed: `INDEX_BACKFILL_FAILED`: backfill and persisting failed readiness both failed. The native AggregateError keeps the primary error first in errors and as cause, followed by the persistence failure; inspect both original objects before retrying.
backendIdInvalid: `BACKEND_ID_INVALID`: the backend id breaks the id rule.
backendDuplicate: `BACKEND_DUPLICATE`: the id is already installed.
backendNotInstalled: `BACKEND_NOT_INSTALLED`: no backend with this id; there is no default.
backendPluginInvalid: `BACKEND_PLUGIN_INVALID`: the plugin or its store breaks the contract.
backendInstallFailed: `BACKEND_INSTALL_FAILED`: installation failed and was rolled back; see `cause`.
storageHostBusy: `STORAGE_HOST_BUSY`: another installation is running; retry after it settles.
storageHostDisposed: `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSED`: the host was disposed; create a new one.
storageHostDisposeFailed: `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSE_FAILED`: cleanup failed; the host is still terminal.
liveQueryDisposeFailed: `LIVE_QUERY_DISPOSE_FAILED`: query cleanup failed; see `errors`.
reactiveFeatureInvalid: `REACTIVE_FEATURE_INVALID`: the reactive Feature does not match the backend.
reactiveTopologyInvalid: `REACTIVE_TOPOLOGY_INVALID`: the Feature graph is unknown, duplicated or cyclic.
reactiveServiceNotInstalled: `REACTIVE_SERVICE_NOT_INSTALLED`: install a reactive plugin before creating queries.
reactiveAdapterNotInstalled: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_NOT_INSTALLED`: the backend id is not reactive.
reactiveAdapterFailed: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_FAILED`: the adapter failed; later changes may recover.
reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_DISPOSE_FAILED`: adapter cleanup failed.
backendDisposeFailed: `BACKEND_DISPOSE_FAILED`: backend cleanup failed.
