symbols.name: familyDef
symbols.purpose: Creates a callable keyed family of source factory definitions with bounded strong LRU retention and weak canonical identity in a strong-key Map with weak definition values, not a WeakMap. Pair with createAtomStore for independent scoped values; forgetting identity never disposes existing state.
symbols.core:
initial: Synchronous callback receiving the application family key at store initialization and returning a nonthenable value. It is deferred in atomDefFactory, not executed on token lookup; throws propagate at initialization.
IFamilyDef callable: family(key) returns a writable source-factory token with previewSafe false; size/forget/clear control token caches. Missing WeakRef or FinalizationRegistry uses ENV_UNSUPPORTED.
maxSize: Positive safe integer maximum number of strongly retained recent tokens; live weak canonical tokens can still be reused after LRU eviction.
4096 strong entries for either family factory.
debugLabel: Application string prefix for generated token labels, followed by the stringified key in brackets.
family for source families; derived-family for derived families.
parameters: initial: (key: K) => T
options: IFamilyDefOptions (optional)
symbols.returns: IFamilyDef<K, T, IWritableAtomDefinition<T>>
examples:
const sessionByChat = familyDef((chatId: string) => ({ messages: [] }))
const def = sessionByChat('chat-1') // 同一个 key 永远拿到同一个 token

key2: Optional second key in the two- or three-segment overload; obtained from the first property type.
key3: Third key only for the three-segment overload, obtained from the second property type.

rows: 传入的不是 `atomDef`/`derivedDef`/... 产出的合法定义对象。
`atom override resolved to a read-only definition`
目标（可能经 override 解析后）是 `derived`，没有写语义。
`atom override must preserve the original write contract`
违反 §3.4 的三条替换规则。
推测读之间出现循环依赖。
`focusDef requires at least one path segment`
`<label> cannot read path segment <key>` / `<label> cannot write path segment <key>`
路径中途遇到 `null`/非对象值。
读取时该 key 已不在源数组里。
`cannot write a removed split def item`
写入时该 key 已不在源数组里。
`keyOf` 对不同元素算出了相同的 key。
`family maxSize must be a positive integer`
`family definitions require WeakRef and FinalizationRegistry; enable these capabilities in the host sandbox`
宿主环境缺少这两个全局能力。
`<context> returned a thenable — async initial values are not supported here; compose with @migaia/resource instead (...)`
初值/工厂返回值是 thenable。
`atomDef({...})` 初值克隆失败（`structuredClone` 抛错）
`primitive initial value cannot be cloned independently`
值本身不可结构化克隆，原异常在 `cause`。
实例式 atom 的 `runtime` 与调用方绑定的 runtime 不一致。
释放多个实例/条目时不止一个抛错，原因各自保留在 `errors[]`。
`AtomStore` 内部所有权登记（继承自 `@migaia/reactive`）
`this node is already owned by another Runtime`
同一个 store 对象被 `claimOwnership` 到两个不同的 Runtime——正常使用路径下不会触发，出现即说明把同一个 store 错误地跨 Runtime 复用了。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
kind: Discriminant chosen by the definition constructor; it selects source, factory, derived or writable-derived instantiation.
debugLabel: Optional caller-selected diagnostic name; does not identify or merge definition tokens.
Omitted by ordinary constructors; family constructors supply their own label defaults.
init: Initial template supplied to atomDef; thenables reject at construction. Mutable object templates are cloned per store using host structuredClone.
create: No-argument synchronous initializer, called when a store first materializes this source or when permitted preview needs it. Return a nonthenable value; exceptions propagate and preview may be abandoned.
Initial T owned by this store; callers must create independent mutable containers. A thenable result rejects with INVALID_OPTION.
previewSafe: Whether an unmaterialized source factory may run in speculative preview; safe factories must be pure and deterministic.
false for atomDefFactory and true for previewSafeAtomDefFactory; fixed by the constructor.
read: Synchronous derived callback receiving the current store getter. Read dependencies with get(definition), return T, and let throws propagate through the owning reactive evaluation.
read.get: Store-issued IAtomGet; takes a definition created by this package and returns its current scoped value with dependency tracking.
Derived T; no asynchronous result is awaited by the read contract.
write: Synchronous caller write callback receiving store get, store set and original args. The store invokes it inside batch and untracked; its return or throw is preserved.
write.get: Store-issued reader for current definition values.
write.set: Store-issued writer accepting a writable definition followed by its exact arguments.
write.args: Exactly one IAtomUpdate<T>: a replacement value or synchronous previous-to-next callback, supplied by store.set for this focused or split definition.
No result; the standard writer commits the focused or split-item update through the owning store and returns void.
equals: Synchronous equality callback for derived values. Receives new and previous candidates, returns true to retain equivalence; exceptions follow reactive computation or preview failure handling.
equals.a: First candidate supplied by the owning computation or preview.
equals.b: Second candidate supplied by the owning computation or preview.
Boolean indicating semantic equality; comparisons are synchronous and are not awaited.
No custom comparator; the owning reactive computed uses its Object.is default.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content: Share a pure definition between stores while keeping each store value and lifetime independent.

symbols.name: StoreKeyedErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Stable package semantic codes for scoped stores, previews, overrides, runtime access, optic access, environment capability and input validation. Native errors preserve original runtime classes and causes.
symbols.core:
atomStoreDisposed: A state operation uses a disposed AtomStore; create a new store instead.
disposalFailed: Several store cleanup entries failed; inspect original errors in the aggregate.
circularPreview: Speculative definition evaluation loops back to its active preview stack.
cyclicOverride: Override routing contains a cycle and cannot resolve a final definition.
overrideContract: A write or override would break the definition read/write contract.
previewUnsafe: An unmaterialized factory is evaluated speculatively without explicit preview safety.
crossRuntime: A protocol atom is read or written through a helper bound to a different Runtime.
envUnsupported: Host capabilities such as WeakRef, FinalizationRegistry or structuredClone are required but unavailable.
opticAccessFailed: An accessor or proxy fails during a pure optic read or immutable copy. Existing foreign identities remain unchanged; mutable native errors retain identity and stack, while fallback cause/errors retain the original.
invalidOption: Definition, family limit, thenable initial value, optic path or keyed-list input violates its supported contract.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.

const StoreKeyedErrorCode = {
  atomStoreDisposed: 'ATOM_STORE_DISPOSED',
  disposalFailed: 'DISPOSAL_FAILED',
  circularPreview: 'CIRCULAR_PREVIEW',
  cyclicOverride: 'CYCLIC_OVERRIDE',
  overrideContract: 'OVERRIDE_CONTRACT',
  previewUnsafe: 'PREVIEW_UNSAFE',
  crossRuntime: 'CROSS_RUNTIME',
  envUnsupported: 'ENV_UNSUPPORTED',
  opticAccessFailed: 'OPTIC_ACCESS_FAILED',
  invalidOption: 'INVALID_OPTION'
} as const
type IStoreKeyedErrorCode = (typeof StoreKeyedErrorCode)[keyof typeof StoreKeyedErrorCode]

} from '@migaia/store-keyed'

members.name: atomStoreDisposed
members.description: An atom store is used after disposal. * * Create a new store instead of reusing the disposed instance.

members.name: disposalFailed
members.description: Multiple entries fail to clean up while an atom store is disposed. An `AggregateError` exposes * each failure through `errors[]`. * * Treat this as a disposal failure and inspect each cause.

members.name: circularPreview
members.description: An atom preview cycle is detected within one render or preview stack. * * Check derived dependencies for cycles.

members.name: cyclicOverride

members.name: overrideContract
members.description: An override replaces a writable definition with a read-only target and breaks its write * contract. * * Preserve the read and write semantics across overrides.

members.name: previewUnsafe

members.name: crossRuntime
members.description: An atom is accessed from a different `Runtime`, whose dependency graph cannot see the atom. * * Access the atom within its own `Runtime` instead of sharing it across runtimes.

members.name: envUnsupported

Inspect the application accessor rather than treating this as a missing path or target * key.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Stable package semantic codes for scoped stores, previews, overrides, runtime access, optic access, environment capability and input validation. Native errors preserve original runtime classes and causes.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import StoreKeyedErrorCode from @migaia/store-keyed, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use StoreKeyedErrorCode when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when StoreKeyedErrorCode does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.content:
atomStoreDisposed: A state operation uses a disposed AtomStore; create a new store instead.
disposalFailed: Several store cleanup entries failed; inspect original errors in the aggregate.
circularPreview: Speculative definition evaluation loops back to its active preview stack.
cyclicOverride: Override routing contains a cycle and cannot resolve a final definition.
overrideContract: A write or override would break the definition read/write contract.
previewUnsafe: An unmaterialized factory is evaluated speculatively without explicit preview safety.
crossRuntime: A protocol atom is read or written through a helper bound to a different Runtime.
envUnsupported: Host capabilities such as WeakRef, FinalizationRegistry or structuredClone are required but unavailable.
opticAccessFailed: An accessor or proxy fails during a pure optic read or immutable copy. Existing foreign identities remain unchanged; mutable native errors retain identity and stack, while fallback cause/errors retain the original.
invalidOption: Definition, family limit, thenable initial value, optic path or keyed-list input violates its supported contract.

写入时该 key 已不在源数组里。

`family maxSize must be a positive integer`
`family definitions require WeakRef and FinalizationRegistry; enable these capabilities in the host sandbox`
宿主环境缺少这两个全局能力。
`<context> returned a thenable — async initial values are not supported here; compose with @migaia/resource instead (...)`
初值/工厂返回值是 thenable。
`atomDef({...})` 初值克隆失败（`structuredClone` 抛错）
`primitive initial value cannot be cloned independently`
值本身不可结构化克隆，原异常在 `cause`。
实例式 atom 的 `runtime` 与调用方绑定的 runtime 不一致。
释放多个实例/条目时不止一个抛错，原因各自保留在 `errors[]`。
`AtomStore` 内部所有权登记（继承自 `@migaia/reactive`）
`this node is already owned by another Runtime`
同一个 store 对象被 `claimOwnership` 到两个不同的 Runtime——正常使用路径下不会触发，出现即说明把同一个 store 错误地跨 Runtime 复用了。

import {
  createStoreKeyedError,
  createStoreKeyedRangeError,
  createStoreKeyedTypeError,
  createStoreKeyedAggregateError,
  StoreKeyedErrorCode,
  STORE_KEYED_SOURCE
} from '@migaia/store-keyed'

blocks.text: 包内部用来构造带 `(source, code)` 身份的错误；一般应用代码只需要读取捕获到的错误上的 `code`/`source` 字段做分支，构造函数主要面向在本包基础上二次封装的场景。
`createStoreKeyedError`｜5 秒上手：

blocks.code: throw createStoreKeyedError(StoreKeyedErrorCode.invalidOption, 'bad input')

blocks.text: 全部参数：`code: IStoreKeyedErrorCode`（必填）、`message: string`（必填）、`options?: { cause?: unknown }`（可选）。返回原生 `Error`，带 `source: '@migaia/store-keyed'` 与 `code`。
`createStoreKeyedRangeError`｜3 秒上手 / `createStoreKeyedTypeError`｜3 秒上手 —— 参数与返回类型（`RangeError`/`TypeError`）之外与上面完全一致：

blocks.code:
throw createStoreKeyedRangeError(StoreKeyedErrorCode.invalidOption, 'maxSize must be positive')
throw createStoreKeyedTypeError(StoreKeyedErrorCode.invalidOption, 'not a definition')

blocks.text: `createStoreKeyedAggregateError`｜5 秒上手 —— 多项失败时打包成 `AggregateError`：

blocks.code:
throw createStoreKeyedAggregateError(
  StoreKeyedErrorCode.disposalFailed,
  [err1, err2],
  'disposal failed'
)

blocks.text: 全部参数：`code: IStoreKeyedErrorCode`（必填）、`errors: unknown[]`（必填）、`message: string`（必填）。
`StoreKeyedErrorCode`｜3 秒上手 —— 稳定错误码表，用于 `switch`/比较：

全部取值：`atomStoreDisposed`(`ATOM_STORE_DISPOSED`)、`disposalFailed`(`DISPOSAL_FAILED`)、`circularPreview`(`CIRCULAR_PREVIEW`)、`cyclicOverride`(`CYCLIC_OVERRIDE`)、`overrideContract`(`OVERRIDE_CONTRACT`)、`previewUnsafe`(`PREVIEW_UNSAFE`)、`crossRuntime`(`CROSS_RUNTIME`)、`envUnsupported`(`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`)、`invalidOption`(`INVALID_OPTION`)。
`STORE_KEYED_SOURCE`｜3 秒上手 —— 字符串常量 `'@migaia/store-keyed'`，无调用参数：

blocks.code: error.source === STORE_KEYED_SOURCE

symbols.name: IAtomDefinition
symbols.purpose: Readable union of all four branded pure definition kinds; writable argument types are erased on this read-only boundary.
symbols.core:
kind: Discriminant chosen by the definition constructor; it selects source, factory, derived or writable-derived instantiation.
debugLabel: Optional caller-selected diagnostic name; does not identify or merge definition tokens.
Omitted by ordinary constructors; family constructors supply their own label defaults.
init: Initial template supplied to atomDef; thenables reject at construction. Mutable object templates are cloned per store using host structuredClone.
create: No-argument synchronous initializer, called when a store first materializes this source or when permitted preview needs it. Return a nonthenable value; exceptions propagate and preview may be abandoned.
Initial T owned by this store; callers must create independent mutable containers. A thenable result rejects with INVALID_OPTION.
previewSafe: Whether an unmaterialized source factory may run in speculative preview; safe factories must be pure and deterministic.
false for atomDefFactory and true for previewSafeAtomDefFactory; fixed by the constructor.
read: Synchronous derived callback receiving the current store getter. Read dependencies with get(definition), return T, and let throws propagate through the owning reactive evaluation.
read.get: Store-issued IAtomGet; takes a definition created by this package and returns its current scoped value with dependency tracking.
Derived T; no asynchronous result is awaited by the read contract.
write: Synchronous caller write callback receiving store get, store set and original args. The store invokes it inside batch and untracked; its return or throw is preserved.
write.get: Store-issued reader for current definition values.
write.set: Store-issued writer accepting a writable definition followed by its exact arguments.
write.args: Original arguments supplied by the caller to store.set for this writable definition.
Caller-defined Result, forwarded unchanged by store.set; no promise is awaited by the synchronous callback boundary.
equals: Synchronous equality callback for derived values. Receives new and previous candidates, returns true to retain equivalence; exceptions follow reactive computation or preview failure handling.
equals.a: First candidate supplied by the owning computation or preview.
equals.b: Second candidate supplied by the owning computation or preview.
Boolean indicating semantic equality; comparisons are synchronous and are not awaited.
No custom comparator; the owning reactive computed uses its Object.is default.
symbols.advanced: Share a pure definition between stores while keeping each store value and lifetime independent.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

symbols.name: IAtomStore
symbols.purpose: Caller-owned scoped definition instance table returned by createAtomStore or defaultAtomStore; separates shared token identity from per-store state and explicit lifecycle.
symbols.core:
runtime: The exact external IRuntime passed at store construction; it owns dependency tracking, batching and error reporting.
disposed: Terminal store flag set before disposal begins; subsequent state operations reject rather than recreating nodes.
size: Current number of instantiated definitions strongly retained by this store, excluding uncommitted preview entries.
get: Resolves active overrides, lazily materializes a definition and reads with Runtime dependency tracking.
get.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
Current scoped T; disposed stores use ATOM_STORE_DISPOSED and invalid definitions use INVALID_OPTION. Initialization/read failures preserve their owning semantics.
peek: Resolves and lazily materializes a definition but reads without creating a dependency edge in the current capture.
peek.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
Current untracked T with the same admission and initialization failures as get.
preview: Reads speculative state without permanently materializing uncommitted definitions. Existing instances are peeked; new factory values require previewSafe and cached previews expire through Runtime idle cleanup.
preview.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
Speculative T. Unsafe source creation uses PREVIEW_UNSAFE, preview cycles use CIRCULAR_PREVIEW; abandoned values need not become committed state.
set: Writes the resolved target inside Runtime batch/untracked. Primitive targets accept value or update(previous); writable-derived targets receive their exact args.
set.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
set.args: Primitive: one value or synchronous previous-to-next callback, with throws propagated. Writable-derived: the Args declared by writableDef, forwarded unchanged.
Undefined for primitive writes or the writable callback Result. Writing a read-only target rejects with OVERRIDE_CONTRACT.
sub: Establishes dependency observation immediately without calling the listener initially. Later change callbacks run synchronously untracked; throws are reported to runtime.reportError and do not kill other subscriptions.
sub.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
sub.onChange: Caller synchronous no-argument notification; read the current snapshot with store.peek if needed. No result is used or awaited.
External IDisposer: a no-argument idempotent unsubscribe function. Store disposal also releases active subscriptions.
override: Adds one reversible read-routing layer while preserving write contracts. Read-only definitions accept same-value replacements; primitive targets require primitive/factory replacements; writable-derived targets preserve Args and Result.
override.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
override.replacement: Compatible definition token created by the same public constructors, with value and write types required by the corresponding overload.
Idempotent undo function; target state is retained. Incompatible contracts use OVERRIDE_CONTRACT and cyclic routes use CYCLIC_OVERRIDE, rolling back the attempted layer.
isObserved: Checks the resolved definition existing node observation state without creating an instance.
isObserved.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
True when an existing node is observed; false otherwise. Disposed stores and invalid definitions still reject.
release: Releases only one instantiated definition, first trying its override-resolved target and trying the original definition only if the first removes no instance. Other store instances remain intact.
release.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
True if an instance was removed and disposed, false when neither key had one. Disposal failures propagate.
dispose: Idempotently marks terminal and clears uncommitted preview values plus overrides, releases subscriptions, then drains instance ownership in reverse order. Retaining the disposed store does not retain values through its preview cache.
No result after cleanup attempts. One collected failure is thrown unchanged; multiple failures throw DISPOSAL_FAILED AggregateError with original errors reachable.

const StoreKeyedErrorCode = {
  atomStoreDisposed: 'ATOM_STORE_DISPOSED',
  disposalFailed: 'DISPOSAL_FAILED',
  circularPreview: 'CIRCULAR_PREVIEW',
  cyclicOverride: 'CYCLIC_OVERRIDE',
  overrideContract: 'OVERRIDE_CONTRACT',
  previewUnsafe: 'PREVIEW_UNSAFE',
  crossRuntime: 'CROSS_RUNTIME',
  envUnsupported: 'ENV_UNSUPPORTED',
  opticAccessFailed: 'OPTIC_ACCESS_FAILED',
  invalidOption: 'INVALID_OPTION'
} as const
type IStoreKeyedErrorCode = (typeof StoreKeyedErrorCode)[keyof typeof StoreKeyedErrorCode]

rows: 传入的不是 `atomDef`/`derivedDef`/... 产出的合法定义对象。
`atom override resolved to a read-only definition`
目标（可能经 override 解析后）是 `derived`，没有写语义。
`atom override must preserve the original write contract`
违反 §3.4 的三条替换规则。
推测读之间出现循环依赖。
`focusDef requires at least one path segment`
`<label> cannot read path segment <key>` / `<label> cannot write path segment <key>`
路径中途遇到 `null`/非对象值。
读取时该 key 已不在源数组里。
`cannot write a removed split def item`
写入时该 key 已不在源数组里。
`keyOf` 对不同元素算出了相同的 key。
`family maxSize must be a positive integer`
`family definitions require WeakRef and FinalizationRegistry; enable these capabilities in the host sandbox`
宿主环境缺少这两个全局能力。
`<context> returned a thenable — async initial values are not supported here; compose with @migaia/resource instead (...)`
初值/工厂返回值是 thenable。
`atomDef({...})` 初值克隆失败（`structuredClone` 抛错）
`primitive initial value cannot be cloned independently`
值本身不可结构化克隆，原异常在 `cause`。
实例式 atom 的 `runtime` 与调用方绑定的 runtime 不一致。
释放多个实例/条目时不止一个抛错，原因各自保留在 `errors[]`。
`AtomStore` 内部所有权登记（继承自 `@migaia/reactive`）
`this node is already owned by another Runtime`
同一个 store 对象被 `claimOwnership` 到两个不同的 Runtime——正常使用路径下不会触发，出现即说明把同一个 store 错误地跨 Runtime 复用了。

symbols.name: KeyedSplitCache
symbols.purpose: Constructs an empty keyed get-or-create cache used by split definitions. Constructor takes no arguments and owns no disposer. Truthy cached items are reused; a falsy cached value causes of() to invoke its creator again.
symbols.core:
New empty KeyedSplitCache with strong key/item retention until prune or clear. Cache removal never disposes items automatically; provide prune onEvict when the caller owns item cleanup.
get: Looks up a stored value without creation or truthiness filtering.
get.key: Application key previously supplied to this cache of method.
Stored Item or undefined for an absent key.
of: Returns a truthy cached item or synchronously invokes the creator and replaces the value for that key.
of.key: Application key used to own and retrieve the cache entry.
of.create: Synchronous no-argument callback returning Item; throwing leaves the new entry uninstalled and propagates unchanged.
Truthy existing Item or freshly created Item; no promise is awaited and falsy cached values are recreated.

blocks.text: 本包创建的错误使用 `source: '@migaia/store-light'` 与稳定 `code`。Reactive 所有权错误、Resource 请求失败与取消保留其原 owner。FieldBuilder 初始化失败与晚到字段清理失败若已具有完整身份则保留；其余原生可扩展 Error 在原对象上标记 `INITIALIZATION_FAILED` / `FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED`，保留类型、message 和 stack；不能附加身份的值通过 coded fallback 的 `cause` 保持可达。初始化与 cleanup 同时失败时，能写 cause 的主 Error 仍为原对象，已有 cause 与 cleanup 合并；不能写入时使用 `INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED` AggregateError。

guidance.heading: 9. 状态常量与错误构造工具

blocks.text: 除上述创建入口、`$`-API、FieldBuilder 协议之外，包根还导出以下常量与错误构造工具：

blocks.code:
export const StoreFieldMode = { sync: 'sync', async: 'async' } as const
export type IStoreFieldMode = (typeof StoreFieldMode)[keyof typeof StoreFieldMode]

items: `StoreFieldMode`：`FieldBuilder.mode` 的合法取值（`'sync'` / `'async'`），自定义 Builder 实现时用它标注 `mode` 字段，见 §6。
`STORE_LIGHT_SOURCE`：本包所有错误 `error.source` 的固定值 `'@migaia/store-light'`，用于按来源过滤/断言错误。
`createStoreLightError(code, message, options?)`：构造一个携带 `(source, code)` 身份（经 `@migaia/utils/error` 的 `attachErrorIdentity`）的普通 `Error`；`options.cause` 可选，设置了才会传给 `Error` 构造器的 `cause`。
`createStoreLightRangeError(code, message)`：同上，但构造 `RangeError`；无 `cause` 选项。
`createStoreLightTypeError(code, message, options?)`：同上，但构造 `TypeError`；`options.cause` 可选。
`createStoreLightAggregateError(code, errors, message)`：构造 `AggregateError(errors, message)` 并打上 `(source, code)` 身份；`errors: unknown[]`（必填）在结果的 `.errors` 上保持可达。

blocks.text: 这四个工厂函数是本包内部构造所有错误时使用的同一套工具，导出给需要"以 `@migaia/store-light` 身份抛出自定义诊断错误"的高级集成方（例如自定义 `FieldBuilder` 实现想复用同一套错误身份约定）；日常业务代码通常不需要直接调用它们，直接 `catch` 本包抛出的错误、按 `error.code` 分支即可（见下表）。

本包创建的错误使用 `source: '@migaia/store-light'` 与稳定 `code`。Reactive 所有权错误、Resource 请求失败与取消保留其原 owner。FieldBuilder 初始化失败与晚到字段清理失败若已具有完整身份则保留；其余原生可扩展 Error 在原对象上标记 `INITIALIZATION_FAILED` / `FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED`，保留类型、message 和 stack；不能附加身份的值通过 coded fallback 的 `cause` 保持可达。初始化与 cleanup 同时失败时，能写 cause 的主 Error 仍为原对象，已有 cause 与 cleanup 合并；不能写入时使用 `INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED` AggregateError。

rows: Store 终结后继续访问；创建新 Store，不复活旧实例
Resource closing/disposed 后读取或保留；停止使用并创建新资源
capture token 无效或已消费；重新捕获，token 只能提交一次
保留/捕获不可见版本；从当前 snapshot 重新取得版本
带 dispose 的 factory 返回原始值；返回可追踪身份的对象或函数
传入未在本包实例登记的对象；同步及异步 Store 均可等待
异步字段 pending/failed 时访问；先等待 `storeReady()`
不能在主错误上附加回滚失败；展开 `cause` / `errors`
未归类的 FieldBuilder 初始化失败；检查原错误及 cause
晚到字段清理失败；由所属 Runtime 报告
异步 action 首次 await 后继续写的诊断；把后续写显式放入 `$batch()`
keepAlive、写目标或 hydrate 选项非法；按 message 修正输入
`$dispose()` 后访问用户字段或受守卫方法（`$own` 先检查 disposed）；幂等 `$dispose()`、`$disposed`、`$runtime`、`$async` 仍可使用
`[store] store is ${status}; use createAsyncStore() before accessing async fields`
读取尚未就绪（`pending`）或已失败（`failed`）的异步字段
`[store] createStore() only accepts synchronous fields; "${key}" is a IFieldBuilder. Use createAsyncStore().`
`createStore()`（非 `createAsyncStore`）的 shape 里含非 `mode: 'sync'` 的 `FieldBuilder`
`$set()` 传入的 key 不对应任何 signal（computed/wasm/方法字段，或压根不存在的 key）
对非 Store 对象（或未经 `createStore`/`createAsyncStore` 创建的对象）调用 `storeReady()`
`this node is already owned by another Runtime` / `${what} belongs to a different Runtime than this scope` / `${what} is not a Runtime-owned reactive node` / `${what} belongs to another Runtime`
`$own(resource)` 传入已属于其他 Runtime 的资源，或资源不是本 Runtime 登记的响应式节点（来自 `@migaia/reactive` 的所有权校验）
对已 `disposed`/`closing` 的 `StoreResource` 调用 `preload`/`retry`/`retain*`/`captureVersion`/`commitCapture` 等操作
`retainVersion(version)`/`captureVersion(id)`/`commitCapture(capture)` 传入的版本号既不是当前版本，也不在 retired/stale/closing 列表里
`[store] resource factory returned a disposed value`
`factory` 返回了一个已经被标记为 disposed 的值（复用了已释放的引用）
`[store] disposable resource values must use reference identity`（`TypeError`）
配置了 `dispose` 但 `factory` 产出的是原始类型（非对象/函数），无法用引用去重和追踪生命周期
`commitCapture()`/`captures.inspect()` 收到的 capture 已提交过、已失效，或不是本资源签发的
`[store] keepAliveMs must be a finite non-negative number`（`RangeError`）

symbols.name: createStoreResource
symbols.purpose: Creates a Suspense-safe async value: `read()` returns the value, throws the pending Promise while loading and the error after failure; holders (leases) keep values alive, and old versions stay readable during reloads.
symbols.core:
factory: `({ signal, generation, token }) => value | Promise`, or `{ load, ...options }`; `signal` aborts when the load is replaced or the resource closes.
options: `IStoreResourceOptions`: `keepAliveMs`, `dispose`, `onError`, `onTerminal`, `runtime`, `scheduler`.
An `IStoreResource`; invalid options throw `INVALID_OPTION`.
runtime: Runtime that owns idle cleanup and failure reporting.
The shared default runtime.
scheduler: Clock for the cache TTL and the 4000 ms render capture window.
`systemScheduler`.
keepAliveMs: How long a loaded value stays cached after the last holder released it; `0` evicts at once.
`1000`.
dispose: Cleans up an evicted object/function value; returns void or PromiseLike<void>. Physical cleanup may finish after logical disposal; await whenTerminal for completion.
Not set: a value with `$dispose()` (such as a store) is disposed automatically.
onError: `(error, phase)` observes failures in `load`, `dispose` or `listener`.
Not set: failures go to the runtime reporter.
onTerminal: Called once at logical terminal disposal; asynchronous value cleanup may still be running. Await whenTerminal for physical completion.
Not set.

blocks.text: 本包创建的错误使用 `source: '@migaia/store-light'` 与稳定 `code`。Reactive 所有权错误、Resource 请求失败与取消保留其原 owner。FieldBuilder 初始化失败与晚到字段清理失败若已具有完整身份则保留；其余原生可扩展 Error 在原对象上标记 `INITIALIZATION_FAILED` / `FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED`，保留类型、message 和 stack；不能附加身份的值通过 coded fallback 的 `cause` 保持可达。初始化与 cleanup 同时失败时，能写 cause 的主 Error 仍为原对象，已有 cause 与 cleanup 合并；不能写入时使用 `INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED` AggregateError。

rows: Store 终结后继续访问；创建新 Store，不复活旧实例
Resource closing/disposed 后读取或保留；停止使用并创建新资源
capture token 无效或已消费；重新捕获，token 只能提交一次
保留/捕获不可见版本；从当前 snapshot 重新取得版本
带 dispose 的 factory 返回原始值；返回可追踪身份的对象或函数
传入未在本包实例登记的对象；同步及异步 Store 均可等待
异步字段 pending/failed 时访问；先等待 `storeReady()`
不能在主错误上附加回滚失败；展开 `cause` / `errors`
未归类的 FieldBuilder 初始化失败；检查原错误及 cause
晚到字段清理失败；由所属 Runtime 报告
异步 action 首次 await 后继续写的诊断；把后续写显式放入 `$batch()`
keepAlive、写目标或 hydrate 选项非法；按 message 修正输入
`$dispose()` 后访问用户字段或受守卫方法（`$own` 先检查 disposed）；幂等 `$dispose()`、`$disposed`、`$runtime`、`$async` 仍可使用
`[store] store is ${status}; use createAsyncStore() before accessing async fields`
读取尚未就绪（`pending`）或已失败（`failed`）的异步字段
`[store] createStore() only accepts synchronous fields; "${key}" is a IFieldBuilder. Use createAsyncStore().`
`createStore()`（非 `createAsyncStore`）的 shape 里含非 `mode: 'sync'` 的 `FieldBuilder`
`$set()` 传入的 key 不对应任何 signal（computed/wasm/方法字段，或压根不存在的 key）
对非 Store 对象（或未经 `createStore`/`createAsyncStore` 创建的对象）调用 `storeReady()`
`this node is already owned by another Runtime` / `${what} belongs to a different Runtime than this scope` / `${what} is not a Runtime-owned reactive node` / `${what} belongs to another Runtime`
`$own(resource)` 传入已属于其他 Runtime 的资源，或资源不是本 Runtime 登记的响应式节点（来自 `@migaia/reactive` 的所有权校验）
对已 `disposed`/`closing` 的 `StoreResource` 调用 `preload`/`retry`/`retain*`/`captureVersion`/`commitCapture` 等操作
`retainVersion(version)`/`captureVersion(id)`/`commitCapture(capture)` 传入的版本号既不是当前版本，也不在 retired/stale/closing 列表里
`[store] resource factory returned a disposed value`
`factory` 返回了一个已经被标记为 disposed 的值（复用了已释放的引用）
`[store] disposable resource values must use reference identity`（`TypeError`）
配置了 `dispose` 但 `factory` 产出的是原始类型（非对象/函数），无法用引用去重和追踪生命周期
`commitCapture()`/`captures.inspect()` 收到的 capture 已提交过、已失效，或不是本资源签发的
`[store] keepAliveMs must be a finite non-negative number`（`RangeError`）

members.name: $own
members.description: Registers an external resource, such as a collection, with this store's ownership scope. A store can hold root UI state and actions while collections hold frequently accessed structures. Sharing a runtime alone does not share disposal ownership; `$own` prevents those structures from leaking when the root is disposed. The resource must be unowned or owned by this `Runtime`. Cross-runtime resources are rejected.

members.name: $dispose
members.description: Always returns a Promise. Native reactive nodes release synchronously in LIFO segments; external fields and owned resources drain through lifecycle. Resolves once every owned Signal/Computed/Effect/wasm field has finished releasing. Callers that need "started" is enough (fire React `useEffect` cleanup, tear down a request scope) may call this without awaiting; `$disposed` already flips to `true` synchronously before any owned resource is touched, so read-path guards observe the disposed state immediately regardless of whether the caller awaits.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
$runtime: Reactive runtime captured at construction. This public data property is writable; assigning it does not migrate the closed-over Runtime owner.
$async: Initially `true` when asynchronous fields were admitted. This public data property is writable and does not control initialization.
$snapshot: Returns a plain object with every field value, including computed and custom fields; throws while async fields are pending.
A new plain snapshot object.
$subscribe: Reads signal, computed and custom sources when subscribing, evaluating computed getters to capture dependencies outside this store. Later changes call `fn`; listener throws/rejections go to the Runtime reporter.
$subscribe.fn: Callback without arguments; read the store inside it.
$subscribe.options: `{ fireImmediately? }`: `true` also calls `fn` once right away; default `false`.
A function that unsubscribes.
$batch: Changes several fields with one notification. Not a transaction: a throw does not roll back earlier writes.
$batch.recipe: `(draft) => void`; assign fields on `draft`.
Nothing; dependants were notified once.
$set: Assigns several writable fields from a patch in one batch.
$set.patch: Partial object of writable (signal) fields; other keys throw `INVALID_OPTION`.
Nothing; the fields are updated.
$plain: Returns only the persistable plain fields (no computed, custom fields or methods); works before the store is ready.
A plain object for storage or JSON.
$hydrate: Writes saved values back into plain fields through the mutation policy and one notification batch. It is not a rollback transaction: earlier writes survive a later failure.
$hydrate.partial: Saved object, usually from `$plain()`.
$hydrate.options: `{ unknown?, onUnknown? }`; see `IHydrateOptions`.
Nothing; known fields are written.
$disposed: `true` after `$dispose()` was called.
$own: Adds an external disposable to this live store so `$dispose()` releases it too. After disposal, `$own` rejects with STORE_DISPOSED.
$own.resource: Object with `dispose()` and `disposed`, owned by no other runtime.
The same resource.
$dispose: Releases fields, subscriptions and owned resources in reverse registration order. Reentrant and later calls return the same completion Promise. Field access and guarded methods reject with STORE_DISPOSED; disposal and terminal metadata remain available.
Always the same Promise, resolved when cleanup finished.

guidance.heading: 9. 状态常量与错误构造工具

blocks.text: 除上述创建入口、`$`-API、FieldBuilder 协议之外，包根还导出以下常量与错误构造工具：

blocks.code:
export const StoreFieldMode = { sync: 'sync', async: 'async' } as const
export type IStoreFieldMode = (typeof StoreFieldMode)[keyof typeof StoreFieldMode]

items: `StoreFieldMode`：`FieldBuilder.mode` 的合法取值（`'sync'` / `'async'`），自定义 Builder 实现时用它标注 `mode` 字段，见 §6。
`STORE_LIGHT_SOURCE`：本包所有错误 `error.source` 的固定值 `'@migaia/store-light'`，用于按来源过滤/断言错误。
`createStoreLightError(code, message, options?)`：构造一个携带 `(source, code)` 身份（经 `@migaia/utils/error` 的 `attachErrorIdentity`）的普通 `Error`；`options.cause` 可选，设置了才会传给 `Error` 构造器的 `cause`。
`createStoreLightRangeError(code, message)`：同上，但构造 `RangeError`；无 `cause` 选项。
`createStoreLightTypeError(code, message, options?)`：同上，但构造 `TypeError`；`options.cause` 可选。
`createStoreLightAggregateError(code, errors, message)`：构造 `AggregateError(errors, message)` 并打上 `(source, code)` 身份；`errors: unknown[]`（必填）在结果的 `.errors` 上保持可达。

blocks.text: 这四个工厂函数是本包内部构造所有错误时使用的同一套工具，导出给需要"以 `@migaia/store-light` 身份抛出自定义诊断错误"的高级集成方（例如自定义 `FieldBuilder` 实现想复用同一套错误身份约定）；日常业务代码通常不需要直接调用它们，直接 `catch` 本包抛出的错误、按 `error.code` 分支即可（见下表）。

blocks.text: `factory` 既可以是函数 `(context) => T \| Promise<T>`，也可以是 `{ load, runtime?, scheduler?, dispose?, keepAliveMs?, onError?, onTerminal? }` 对象形式（等价于把这些字段和 `options` 合并）。`IStoreResourceLoadContext` 提供 `{ signal, generation, token }`，`signal` 在该次加载被取代/资源关闭时中止。

构造时只读取上述已知字段并形成稳定快照：`load` 与每个已知 accessor 最多读取一次，不枚举或执行未知字段 getter；显式 `options` 的 own-enumerable 字段覆盖 factory 对象上的同名字段。`dispose`、`onError`、`onTerminal` 若存在必须是函数，否则在任何请求或 Resource 状态建立前同步抛出 tagged `INVALID_OPTION`。

自动 `$dispose` 与自定义 disposer 的返回值遵循 lifecycle 的统一接纳语义：disposer getter、then getter 均只读取一次，捕获函数分别以原资源、原 thenable 作为 receiver 调用。getter、调用或异步 rejection 的原始异常通过 `onError(error, 'dispose')` 可达；重复 `forceDispose()` 不会重复清理同一值。

本包创建的错误使用 `source: '@migaia/store-light'` 与稳定 `code`。Reactive 所有权错误、Resource 请求失败与取消保留其原 owner。FieldBuilder 初始化失败与晚到字段清理失败若已具有完整身份则保留；其余原生可扩展 Error 在原对象上标记 `INITIALIZATION_FAILED` / `FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED`，保留类型、message 和 stack；不能附加身份的值通过 coded fallback 的 `cause` 保持可达。初始化与 cleanup 同时失败时，能写 cause 的主 Error 仍为原对象，已有 cause 与 cleanup 合并；不能写入时使用 `INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED` AggregateError。

guidance.heading: 9. 状态常量与错误构造工具

blocks.text: 除上述创建入口、`$`-API、FieldBuilder 协议之外，包根还导出以下常量与错误构造工具：

blocks.code:
export const StoreFieldMode = { sync: 'sync', async: 'async' } as const
export type IStoreFieldMode = (typeof StoreFieldMode)[keyof typeof StoreFieldMode]

items: `StoreFieldMode`：`FieldBuilder.mode` 的合法取值（`'sync'` / `'async'`），自定义 Builder 实现时用它标注 `mode` 字段，见 §6。
`STORE_LIGHT_SOURCE`：本包所有错误 `error.source` 的固定值 `'@migaia/store-light'`，用于按来源过滤/断言错误。
`createStoreLightError(code, message, options?)`：构造一个携带 `(source, code)` 身份（经 `@migaia/utils/error` 的 `attachErrorIdentity`）的普通 `Error`；`options.cause` 可选，设置了才会传给 `Error` 构造器的 `cause`。
`createStoreLightRangeError(code, message)`：同上，但构造 `RangeError`；无 `cause` 选项。
`createStoreLightTypeError(code, message, options?)`：同上，但构造 `TypeError`；`options.cause` 可选。
`createStoreLightAggregateError(code, errors, message)`：构造 `AggregateError(errors, message)` 并打上 `(source, code)` 身份；`errors: unknown[]`（必填）在结果的 `.errors` 上保持可达。

blocks.text: 这四个工厂函数是本包内部构造所有错误时使用的同一套工具，导出给需要"以 `@migaia/store-light` 身份抛出自定义诊断错误"的高级集成方（例如自定义 `FieldBuilder` 实现想复用同一套错误身份约定）；日常业务代码通常不需要直接调用它们，直接 `catch` 本包抛出的错误、按 `error.code` 分支即可（见下表）。

symbols.name: StoreLightErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Table of the stable error codes of this package; values are the strings on `error.code`.
symbols.core:
storeDisposed: `STORE_DISPOSED`: the store was used after `$dispose()`; create a new store.
resourceDisposed: `RESOURCE_DISPOSED`: the resource is closing or disposed; stop using it.
captureInvalid: `CAPTURE_INVALID`: the capture token is invalid or already used.
unknownVersion: UNKNOWN_VERSION: the version is unknown or already evicted; retaining or capturing it cannot revive it. Read a current snapshot instead.
identityRequired: `IDENTITY_REQUIRED`: a resource with `dispose` returned a primitive value.
noAsyncInit: NO_ASYNC_INIT: storeReady received an object without readiness registered by this package instance. Both synchronous and asynchronous stores created here are registered.
storeNotReady: `STORE_NOT_READY`: async fields read before the store was ready; await `storeReady()`.
initAndCleanupFailed: INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED: initialization and cleanup both fail and cleanup cannot attach to the primary Error. Aggregate errors retain the original first; writable primary errors retain identity and receive cleanup through cause instead.
fieldDisposeFailed: FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED: a late field disposer throws or rejects after initialization is abandoned or the store closes. The Runtime reports the original native error or a coded fallback retaining it.
initializationFailed: INITIALIZATION_FAILED: an unclassified field initialization fails; native mutable errors retain identity and stack, while fallback errors retain the original cause. Already classified foreign errors retain their owner.
syncFieldRequired: `SYNC_FIELD_REQUIRED`: an async field builder was passed to `createStore`.
actionBatchBoundary: `ACTION_BATCH_BOUNDARY`: diagnostic; writes after `await` in an action are not batched.
envUnsupported: `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`: the host lacks `WeakRef` or `FinalizationRegistry`.
invalidOption: INVALID_OPTION: an option, reserved built-in API key, $set target or $hydrate field is invalid; correct the named input.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.

members.name: storeDisposed
members.description: Store fields, snapshots, or subscriptions are accessed after disposal. * * Use `createStore()` or `createAsyncStore()` to create a new instance.

members.name: resourceDisposed
members.description: A resource is read, captured, or retained while closing or disposed, or its factory returns a * disposed value. * * Stop using the resource. The `disposed` state is terminal.

members.name: captureInvalid
members.description: A resource capture token is invalid or has already been consumed by `commit` or `discard`. * * Check the token lifecycle. A token is valid only before consumption and can be committed once.

members.name: unknownVersion
members.description: A retain or capture request names an unknown or no longer visible resource version. * * Read the version from the current snapshot instead of caching version IDs across reloads.

members.name: identityRequired
members.description: A resource factory with `dispose` returns a primitive value, so reference identity cannot track * ownership. * * Return an object or function for a resource with explicit disposal to provide `$dispose` or * reference identity.

members.name: noAsyncInit
members.description: `storeReady()` receives an object with no initialization Promise registered by this package * instance. Both synchronous `createStore()` and `createAsyncStore()` register readiness. * * Pass the actual constructed Store instead of an unrelated or foreign object.

members.name: storeNotReady
members.description: Asynchronous state is accessed while store initialization is pending or has failed. * * Await `storeReady()` before accessing asynchronous fields. Treat rejection as initialization * failure instead of retrying reads.

members.name: initAndCleanupFailed
members.description: Store initialization and its subsequent cleanup both fail and cannot be attached to the primary * Error. A coded `AggregateError` preserves both failures; mutable primaries keep their own * identity and receive cleanup through cause instead. * * The initialization and cleanup errors remain reachable through `cause` or `errors` (E-T13). * Treat this as initialization failure and inspect the cleanup failure.

members.name: fieldDisposeFailed
members.description: A late FieldBuilder disposer fails after initialization is abandoned or the Store is disposed. * The owning Runtime receives the original native error when possible; non-extensible or * non-Error failures remain reachable through the coded fallback's cause/errors.

members.name: initializationFailed
members.description: A FieldBuilder fails during initialization without an existing package error identity. Native * mutable errors keep their object and stack; fallback errors retain the original cause. Treat * creation as failed and inspect the original builder failure before retrying.

members.name: syncFieldRequired
members.description: An asynchronous `IFieldBuilder` is passed to the synchronous `createStore()` contract. * * Use `createAsyncStore()` for asynchronous field builders.

members.name: actionBatchBoundary
members.description: A diagnostic reports that writes after the first `await` in an asynchronous action are outside * its batch. * * This code is reported through `Runtime.reportError`, not thrown. Wrap subsequent writes in * `$batch()`.

members.name: envUnsupported
members.description: The host lacks `WeakRef` or `FinalizationRegistry` required by `ResourceCaptureRegistry`. * * Enable these capabilities in the host sandbox. This is a deployment issue.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Input or field validation fails for reserved API keys, `keepAliveMs`, a non-writable `$set` * target, or an unknown `$hydrate` field. * * Correct the field or value named in the error message.

Treat * creation as failed and inspect the original builder failure before retrying. */ readonly initializationFailed: 'INITIALIZATION_FAILED'; /** * An asynchronous `IFieldBuilder` is passed to the synchronous `createStore()` contract. * * Use `createAsyncStore()` for asynchronous field builders. */ readonly syncFieldRequired: 'SYNC_FIELD_REQUIRED'; /** * A diagnostic reports that writes after the first `await` in an asynchronous action are outside * its batch. * * This code is reported through `Runtime.reportError`, not thrown. Wrap subsequent writes in * `$batch()`. */ readonly actionBatchBoundary: 'ACTION_BATCH_BOUNDARY'; /** * The host lacks `WeakRef` or `FinalizationRegistry` required by `ResourceCaptureRegistry`. * * Enable these capabilities in the host sandbox. This is a deployment issue. */ readonly envUnsupported: 'ENV_UNSUPPORTED'; /** * Input or field validation fails for reserved API keys, `keepAliveMs`, a non-writable `$set` * target, or an unknown `$hydrate` field. * * Correct the field or value named in the error message. */ readonly invalidOption: 'INVALID_OPTION'; };

guidance.heading: 9. 状态常量与错误构造工具

blocks.text: 除上述创建入口、`$`-API、FieldBuilder 协议之外，包根还导出以下常量与错误构造工具：

blocks.code:
export const StoreFieldMode = { sync: 'sync', async: 'async' } as const
export type IStoreFieldMode = (typeof StoreFieldMode)[keyof typeof StoreFieldMode]

items: `StoreFieldMode`：`FieldBuilder.mode` 的合法取值（`'sync'` / `'async'`），自定义 Builder 实现时用它标注 `mode` 字段，见 §6。
`STORE_LIGHT_SOURCE`：本包所有错误 `error.source` 的固定值 `'@migaia/store-light'`，用于按来源过滤/断言错误。
`createStoreLightError(code, message, options?)`：构造一个携带 `(source, code)` 身份（经 `@migaia/utils/error` 的 `attachErrorIdentity`）的普通 `Error`；`options.cause` 可选，设置了才会传给 `Error` 构造器的 `cause`。
`createStoreLightRangeError(code, message)`：同上，但构造 `RangeError`；无 `cause` 选项。
`createStoreLightTypeError(code, message, options?)`：同上，但构造 `TypeError`；`options.cause` 可选。
`createStoreLightAggregateError(code, errors, message)`：构造 `AggregateError(errors, message)` 并打上 `(source, code)` 身份；`errors: unknown[]`（必填）在结果的 `.errors` 上保持可达。

blocks.text: 这四个工厂函数是本包内部构造所有错误时使用的同一套工具，导出给需要"以 `@migaia/store-light` 身份抛出自定义诊断错误"的高级集成方（例如自定义 `FieldBuilder` 实现想复用同一套错误身份约定）；日常业务代码通常不需要直接调用它们，直接 `catch` 本包抛出的错误、按 `error.code` 分支即可（见下表）。

本包创建的错误使用 `source: '@migaia/store-light'` 与稳定 `code`。Reactive 所有权错误、Resource 请求失败与取消保留其原 owner。FieldBuilder 初始化失败与晚到字段清理失败若已具有完整身份则保留；其余原生可扩展 Error 在原对象上标记 `INITIALIZATION_FAILED` / `FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED`，保留类型、message 和 stack；不能附加身份的值通过 coded fallback 的 `cause` 保持可达。初始化与 cleanup 同时失败时，能写 cause 的主 Error 仍为原对象，已有 cause 与 cleanup 合并；不能写入时使用 `INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED` AggregateError。

blocks.text: Store 构造失败：`shape` 里任意字段处理阶段抛错（比如某个 `FieldBuilder.create()` 抛错），整个构造过程回滚——原生节点同步分段释放、外部资源由 lifecycle scope 释放，内部的 `signals`/`computeds`/`wasmFields`/`fieldSources` 全部清空，原始错误继续向外抛出（清理阶段自身失败时，会尽量把清理错误挂到原错误的 `cause` 上，不会替换原始错误）。

异步字段初始化失败：`readyList` 中任一 Promise reject，Store 立即被标记为 `disposed = true`，中止其余在途初始化（`initAbort.abort()`），并回收已经创建的资源；这个转变发生在 `ready` Promise 的 reject 路径里，因此哪怕调用方没有 `await storeReady()`，Store 内部状态也已经正确收敛，不会有"部分字段可用"的僵尸状态。

`$dispose()` 时机：字段读写方法在闭包里直接引用底层节点（`node.value`），不经过任何"Store 对象本身"的代理层；因此 `$dispose()` 唯一要做的事就是把 `disposed` 标志位翻转、释放原生节点段与已有 scope、清空内部 Map。所有已经拿到 Store 引用的调用方，后续用户字段读写与受守卫方法调用会看到 `[store] store is disposed`。

`StoreResource` 的持有者概念：一份值被判定为"没有持有者"（可以被回收）需要同时满足：没有 `retainResource()`/`retainVersion()` 产生的活跃 lease，也没有任何未提交的 capture。直接 `captureVersion()` 不设 4 秒过期；只有 pending generation 成功后转换的 provisional capture 才有 4000ms 放弃窗口。`keepAliveMs` 超时只在"当前没有任何持有者"时才开始计算，一旦有新的持有者出现，倒计时会被取消。

blocks.text: 本包创建的错误带 `source: '@migaia/store-middleware'` 与稳定 `code`；Reactive、pipeline 及其它已编码错误保留实际 owner。独立动作与 binding disposer 的未编码失败附 CALLBACK_FAILED；不可附码的原值经 cause/errors 保留。`actions-only` 越界写入为 `ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED`；不可克隆值为 `CLONE_UNSUPPORTED`；遗漏 `next()` 只经 Runtime 报告 `MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED`，不反向中断业务写入；`bindStoreMiddleware()` 绑定失败且回滚清理也失败时为 `CLEANUP_FAILED`。
Host 的 pipeline 模式固定是 `sync`（见 §4），这决定了：

items: 中间件只能用 `core.usePipeline((event, next) => void)`，`next(event)` 必须在 stage 函数返回前调用。
sync 是"扁平转换管道"：`next()` 只是记录下一个值，下游 stage 在当前 stage 返回之后才执行，当前 stage 调用 `next()` 之后无法同步观察到下游已经处理完的结果（想要"后置逻辑能看到下游效果"的洋葱模型语义，需要 async pipeline——但本包的 Host 不支持切换）。
公开 emit 直接执行同步 pipeline，可向调用方传播错误；recordState/recordError 与 runAction 的观察事件使用隔离派发并向 Runtime 报告。runAction 业务函数失败继续抛出，保留其实际错误 owner。
如果一个 pipeline stage 忘了调用 `next()`，`emit()` 会检测到 `completed` 标记未被置位，同样以 `phase: 'trace-listener'` 上报一条 `[store] middleware did not call next()` 错误。

blocks.text: 更细的 pipeline 执行顺序、错误码、`onDispose` 清理协议等通用机制，见 `@migaia/plugin-host` 的 USEGUIDE。

items: `host.use(plugin)` / `host.unUse(name)` / `host.dispose()` 都是异步 API，语义完全继承自 `@migaia/plugin-host`——安装失败自动回滚，卸载资源自动逆序清理。

Host 通过 `defineHost` 的 `dispose` 钩子：先按后进先出顺序执行 `attachBindingDisposer()` 登记的 disposer（`bindStoreMiddleware()` 用它登记状态订阅和 trace 订阅的取消函数），再委托 plugin-host 卸载所有已安装插件。结果是结构化的 `{ logicalTerminal, cleanupComplete, cleanupErrors }`，绑定 disposer 的错误排在 `cleanupErrors` 前面，不以异常抛出。
`host.dispose()` 不会销毁 Store 或 Runtime，只释放这个 middleware Host 自己拥有的资源（订阅、已安装插件）。
同一个 Host 内插件名称必须唯一；重复安装同名插件会按 `@migaia/plugin-host` 的规则报错。
middleware 诊断层的失败不应该、也不会阻断业务写入；真正的业务异常仍按原始异常传播（见 §9）。

blocks.text: 它们只返回原生错误，不自动抛出；保留 stack。显式 cause（包括 undefined）由 Error 保存，AggregateError.errors 保留输入错误对象。STORE_MIDDLEWARE_SOURCE 只用于本包创建的错误，外包编码错误保持实际 owner。CALLBACK_FAILED 用于未编码的同步动作/disposer 失败；DEVTOOLS_MESSAGE_INVALID 用于报告支持 Redux 命令里的非法 JSON。immutable 失败的 cause 是完整 Utils 错误，原生复制失败在其下游 cause 上。

immutable 的严格数据契约：接纳普通/null 原型记录、普通数组、当前 realm 的原生 Map/Set/Date/RegExp/ArrayBuffer、非共享 ArrayBuffer 支持的标准 TypedArray/DataView。自定义 class（包括内建子类）、访问器与其它未接纳的原生对象以 CLONE_UNSUPPORTED 拒绝；访问器在求值前拒绝，不额外执行 getter。Map key/value、Set 成员及记录/数组数据递归接纳，循环与共享引用仍由唯一的 utils structuredClone 保持。此收窄修正旧版 class 静默丢方法的问题；旧版 getter、跨 realm 内建值及未列类型需迁移为支持的数据，或显式选择 diagnostic/opaque。Utils.immutableSnapshot 原生投影契约不变。本策略不另实现 clone 引擎。

API convergence：克隆五名只从既有 `/tolerant-clone` 导入；deprecated tolerantClone 两入口均删除。IMutationGuard/IMutationPolicy 从 `@migaia/store-light` 直接导入。旧 middlewarePlugin/IStoreMiddleware/IMiddlewareContext 删除，迁移为 IStoreMiddlewarePlugin 与 core.usePipeline；没有 shim/alias。外部旧导入需破坏版本迁移，仓库唯一生产 clone consumer 已使用窄入口。

`StoreMiddlewareErrorCode` 当前9个稳定成员：`invalidOption` (`INVALID_OPTION`)、`middlewareNotChained` (`MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED`)、`actionScopeRequired` (`ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED`)、`cloneUnsupported` (`CLONE_UNSUPPORTED`)、`callbackFailed` (`CALLBACK_FAILED`)、`devtoolsMessageInvalid` (`DEVTOOLS_MESSAGE_INVALID`)、`devtoolsCapability` (`DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY`)、`envUnsupported` (`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`)、`cleanupFailed` (`CLEANUP_FAILED`)。对应值的联合为 `IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode`；两新增场景见上述边界说明。

symbols.name: createStoreMiddlewareHost
symbols.purpose: Composes a frozen store event host through external defineHost, not class inheritance. The caller owns state access and optional application; this host owns plugin lifecycle and binding cleanup. Pipeline mode is always sync.
symbols.core:
The canonical frozen managed IStoreMiddlewareHost with domain members, live getters and fluent returns retaining this same handle; dispose returns structured cleanup results. Invalid host options use INVALID_OPTION and delegated lifecycle failures retain plugin-host identity.
identity: Readable host name `{ name }`; a unique id is added by the runtime.
Not set: the host is unnamed and identified only by its id.
identity.name: Readable host name used in errors and diagnostics.
Omission uses DEFAULT as the name. The generated id combines that name with a sequence number, allowing diagnostics to distinguish host instances.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Mutation budget for installation/setup and update hooks; expiry aborts the operation and rolls back with MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. Removal hooks and disposers instead use disposeStepTimeoutMs, while pipeline draining uses its separate budget. false disables this mutation deadline.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Maximum time to wait for running pipelines before removal or replacement continues; `false` waits until none are running.
execution: Required execution budgets: mutationTimeoutMs bounds setup/install/update; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs bounds pipeline draining and is a shared managed-removal cleanup deadline. Ordinary removal steps use disposeStepTimeoutMs. false disables the corresponding deadline.
pipeline: External pipeline options are captured once, including a non-enumerable pipeline getter, and excluded from the remaining option spread; mode is overwritten with sync before host construction.
A sync pipeline is installed even when this option is omitted.
diagnostic: Receives notable events that are not errors (`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`, `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`, rollback failures, queue waits) as `(message, code?, error?)`. Its own failures never affect the host.
Not set: diagnostics are dropped.
onDiagnosticFailure: Receives the error when `diagnostic` itself throws or rejects.
Not set: the failure goes to `globalThis.reportError` when it exists.
scheduler: Clock and timers for queue and disposal timeouts; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
The system scheduler.
queueAdmissionTimeoutMs: How long a change may wait in the FIFO queue. A number rejects waiting work with `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` (running work is not interrupted); `false` disables queue timers and diagnostics.
Not set: long waits are only reported through `diagnostic`, never rejected.
queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs: Wait time after which a queued change is reported through `diagnostic` (only when `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` is not set); `false` disables it.
`1000` milliseconds.
disposeStepTimeoutMs: Maximum wait for one cleanup step (a stage disposer, a plugin `dispose`, a resource). A timed-out step is recorded as `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` and cleanup continues; `false` waits forever.
`5000` milliseconds per step.
runtime: External IRuntime supplied at construction or obtained from the bound Store.
getState: Required synchronous zero-argument getter invoked when plugins or adapters need state. Return S; throws propagate through the invoking API.
Current S; getter failures propagate and snapshot independence follows the caller clone policy.
applyState: Optional synchronous callback receiving a replacement state from jump/reset. Return nothing; callback throws propagate through command delivery.
applyState.state: Replacement S supplied by a normalized jump/reset command or a domain caller.
No result; missing applyState throws DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY and caller failures propagate.
Absent; applying a DevTools state command throws DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY.
mutationPolicy: Exact caller policy object or a newly created off policy; share the same policy with the Store when enforcing actions-only writes.
A new off MutationPolicy instance.
pipeline.mode: Always overwritten with sync by the Store host constructor.
sync, regardless of caller omission or another supplied mode.
Store middleware executes synchronously; async and generator stage registration is unavailable.

symbols.name: IStoreMiddlewareBinding
symbols.purpose: Canonical frozen managed handle returned by bindStoreMiddleware, carrying all host capabilities plus the original light Store reference. Live revision/getters and fluent return identity preserve every Store member. Releasing this binding leaves the Store alive.
symbols.core:
identity: Immutable host identity `{ name, id }`: `name` from the `identity` option, `id` unique per host; used in errors and diagnostics.
plugin: Enable/disable controls: `plugin.disable(name)` hides a plugin (extensions, Features, stages) without releasing resources, `plugin.enable(name)` restores it in place, `plugin.disabled()` lists disabled names.
pipelineMode: Always sync: store event host construction overrides any supplied pipeline mode.
revision: Live revision getter from the same canonical managed host; plugin commits update it without replacing the Store domain or fluent handle identity.
config: Per-plugin configuration store. `config.get("plugin.key")` reads a frozen snapshot (unknown paths return `undefined`); `config.update(name, recipe)` merges a patch copy-on-write and commits only after the plugin `update` hook succeeds.
useSync: Installs synchronously and returns handles in input order. A declared setup immediately throws SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL. A thenable install result rejects as PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause; its later rejection is reported through the diagnostic third argument, not inserted retroactively into the immediate cause chain.
useSync.plugins: Plugin definitions with synchronous install.
The handle tuple in input order.
Building a host that must be usable right after construction.
use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
dispose: Stops host admission, runs binding disposers in reverse order, then delegates plugin lifecycle cleanup. Every disposer is attempted and binding errors precede plugin errors.
Shared Promise<IPluginHostDisposalResult> with logicalTerminal, cleanupComplete and cleanupErrors. Binding throws are reported in this result; unfinished physical cleanup remains reachable through physicalCompletion.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers a step that can await other work before or after the next event-processing step. This requires async mode. Store event hosts process events synchronously, so this call throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, meaning the requested step does not match the host mode. Use usePipeline for synchronous steps.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator function that uses yield to supply a processed value. That form runs only in generator or async-generator mode. On a Store event host, registration throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH because its event pipeline accepts synchronous next-style steps only. To transform an event here, register usePipeline and pass the resulting event to next before the callback returns.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers a function that combines awaited work with values supplied through yield. Only async-generator mode can execute that combination. Store event hosts cannot await yielded results, so this registration fails with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, the error for an incompatible step mode. Complete asynchronous preparation before emitting the store event, then use usePipeline for the remaining synchronous handling.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
mutationPolicy: Exact caller policy object or a newly created off policy; share the same policy with the Store when enforcing actions-only writes.
emit: Synchronously runs an event through the host pipeline. Missing continuation reports MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED; other pipeline failures may propagate from this public method.
emit.event: IMiddlewareEvent from host domain methods, Store trace binding or explicit caller construction using the event constants.
No result after synchronous delivery; this is the direct emission boundary rather than isolated business-action observation.
runAction: Emits isolated start, runs fn inside mutation policy and Runtime batch, then emits isolated end or error. Synchronous business failures retain native identity or remain reachable through cause/errors under the policy callback contract; observer failures are reported.
runAction.name: Application-selected action label propagated to all three action phases.
runAction.fn: Synchronous no-argument business callback; return T or throw. Promises are returned without awaiting, so async continuations and rejections are outside action scope.
runAction.metadata: Optional caller diagnostic record; defaults to absent and retains its reference.
Exact fn return or policy-classified synchronous failure; foreign Reactive/pipeline errors keep their package identity. Action duration covers synchronous execution only.
recordState: Emits an isolated state observation without changing Store state. Middleware failures are reported rather than reaching the business caller.
recordState.name: Application-selected state observation label.
recordState.previous: Previous snapshot owned by the caller or binding clone policy.
recordState.next: Next snapshot owned by the caller or binding clone policy.
recordState.metadata: Optional diagnostic record, absent by default and retained by reference.
No result after isolated observation; state application is a separate capability.
recordError: Emits one isolated diagnostic-error event. Reentrant calls while handling an error report directly to Runtime without starting another middleware pipeline.
recordError.phase: Caller diagnostic phase identifying the failed subsystem or operation.
recordError.error: Original diagnostic failure value retained by identity.
recordError.metadata: Optional caller metadata; defaults to absent and is not cloned.
No result; observation failures are routed to Runtime.
connectDevTools: Installs a plugin that initializes an adapter, sends events after recording sync continuation and before downstream execution and subscribes to normalized commands. Pair with createReduxDevToolsAdapter when using a Redux extension-shaped connection.
connectDevTools.adapter: IDevToolsAdapter from createReduxDevToolsAdapter or caller implementation; init/send are required and subscribe is optional.
connectDevTools.name: Optional unique plugin name chosen by the application; defaults to store-devtools.
Promise<void> after plugin installation. Invalid adapter uses INVALID_OPTION; install failures retain plugin-host semantics; jump/reset without applyState uses DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY.
attachBindingDisposer: While open, registers synchronous cleanup in reverse order before delegated plugin-host disposal. Once closing starts, registration invokes the disposer immediately; a synchronous failure propagates with CALLBACK_FAILED identity or preserves its foreign owner.
attachBindingDisposer.disposer: Caller-owned IDisposer accepting no arguments and returning nothing; throws are collected into structured disposal cleanupErrors.
No result; an open host retains cleanup until disposal, while a closing host finishes it before this call returns.
store: Exact IReactiveStore originally supplied to bindStoreMiddleware; lifecycle ownership remains with the caller.
symbols.advanced: Observe Store updates and action traces and detach them together during application cleanup.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

blocks.text: 它们只返回原生错误，不自动抛出；保留 stack。显式 cause（包括 undefined）由 Error 保存，AggregateError.errors 保留输入错误对象。STORE_MIDDLEWARE_SOURCE 只用于本包创建的错误，外包编码错误保持实际 owner。CALLBACK_FAILED 用于未编码的同步动作/disposer 失败；DEVTOOLS_MESSAGE_INVALID 用于报告支持 Redux 命令里的非法 JSON。immutable 失败的 cause 是完整 Utils 错误，原生复制失败在其下游 cause 上。

immutable 的严格数据契约：接纳普通/null 原型记录、普通数组、当前 realm 的原生 Map/Set/Date/RegExp/ArrayBuffer、非共享 ArrayBuffer 支持的标准 TypedArray/DataView。自定义 class（包括内建子类）、访问器与其它未接纳的原生对象以 CLONE_UNSUPPORTED 拒绝；访问器在求值前拒绝，不额外执行 getter。Map key/value、Set 成员及记录/数组数据递归接纳，循环与共享引用仍由唯一的 utils structuredClone 保持。此收窄修正旧版 class 静默丢方法的问题；旧版 getter、跨 realm 内建值及未列类型需迁移为支持的数据，或显式选择 diagnostic/opaque。Utils.immutableSnapshot 原生投影契约不变。本策略不另实现 clone 引擎。

API convergence：克隆五名只从既有 `/tolerant-clone` 导入；deprecated tolerantClone 两入口均删除。IMutationGuard/IMutationPolicy 从 `@migaia/store-light` 直接导入。旧 middlewarePlugin/IStoreMiddleware/IMiddlewareContext 删除，迁移为 IStoreMiddlewarePlugin 与 core.usePipeline；没有 shim/alias。外部旧导入需破坏版本迁移，仓库唯一生产 clone consumer 已使用窄入口。

`StoreMiddlewareErrorCode` 当前9个稳定成员：`invalidOption` (`INVALID_OPTION`)、`middlewareNotChained` (`MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED`)、`actionScopeRequired` (`ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED`)、`cloneUnsupported` (`CLONE_UNSUPPORTED`)、`callbackFailed` (`CALLBACK_FAILED`)、`devtoolsMessageInvalid` (`DEVTOOLS_MESSAGE_INVALID`)、`devtoolsCapability` (`DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY`)、`envUnsupported` (`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`)、`cleanupFailed` (`CLEANUP_FAILED`)。对应值的联合为 `IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode`；两新增场景见上述边界说明。

replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
dispose: Stops host admission, runs binding disposers in reverse order, then delegates plugin lifecycle cleanup. Every disposer is attempted and binding errors precede plugin errors.
Shared Promise<IPluginHostDisposalResult> with logicalTerminal, cleanupComplete and cleanupErrors. Binding throws are reported in this result; unfinished physical cleanup remains reachable through physicalCompletion.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers a step that can await other work before or after the next event-processing step. This requires async mode. Store event hosts process events synchronously, so this call throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, meaning the requested step does not match the host mode. Use usePipeline for synchronous steps.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator function that uses yield to supply a processed value. That form runs only in generator or async-generator mode. On a Store event host, registration throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH because its event pipeline accepts synchronous next-style steps only. To transform an event here, register usePipeline and pass the resulting event to next before the callback returns.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers a function that combines awaited work with values supplied through yield. Only async-generator mode can execute that combination. Store event hosts cannot await yielded results, so this registration fails with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, the error for an incompatible step mode. Complete asynchronous preparation before emitting the store event, then use usePipeline for the remaining synchronous handling.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
mutationPolicy: Exact caller policy object or a newly created off policy; share the same policy with the Store when enforcing actions-only writes.
emit: Synchronously runs an event through the host pipeline. Missing continuation reports MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED; other pipeline failures may propagate from this public method.
emit.event: IMiddlewareEvent from host domain methods, Store trace binding or explicit caller construction using the event constants.
No result after synchronous delivery; this is the direct emission boundary rather than isolated business-action observation.
runAction: Emits isolated start, runs fn inside mutation policy and Runtime batch, then emits isolated end or error. Synchronous business failures retain native identity or remain reachable through cause/errors under the policy callback contract; observer failures are reported.
runAction.name: Application-selected action label propagated to all three action phases.
runAction.fn: Synchronous no-argument business callback; return T or throw. Promises are returned without awaiting, so async continuations and rejections are outside action scope.
runAction.metadata: Optional caller diagnostic record; defaults to absent and retains its reference.
Exact fn return or policy-classified synchronous failure; foreign Reactive/pipeline errors keep their package identity. Action duration covers synchronous execution only.
recordState: Emits an isolated state observation without changing Store state. Middleware failures are reported rather than reaching the business caller.
recordState.name: Application-selected state observation label.
recordState.previous: Previous snapshot owned by the caller or binding clone policy.
recordState.next: Next snapshot owned by the caller or binding clone policy.
recordState.metadata: Optional diagnostic record, absent by default and retained by reference.
No result after isolated observation; state application is a separate capability.
recordError: Emits one isolated diagnostic-error event. Reentrant calls while handling an error report directly to Runtime without starting another middleware pipeline.
recordError.phase: Caller diagnostic phase identifying the failed subsystem or operation.
recordError.error: Original diagnostic failure value retained by identity.
recordError.metadata: Optional caller metadata; defaults to absent and is not cloned.
No result; observation failures are routed to Runtime.
connectDevTools: Installs a plugin that initializes an adapter, sends events after recording sync continuation and before downstream execution and subscribes to normalized commands. Pair with createReduxDevToolsAdapter when using a Redux extension-shaped connection.
connectDevTools.adapter: IDevToolsAdapter from createReduxDevToolsAdapter or caller implementation; init/send are required and subscribe is optional.
connectDevTools.name: Optional unique plugin name chosen by the application; defaults to store-devtools.
Promise<void> after plugin installation. Invalid adapter uses INVALID_OPTION; install failures retain plugin-host semantics; jump/reset without applyState uses DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY.

No result; an open host retains cleanup until disposal, while a closing host finishes it before this call returns.

blocks.code:
function createStoreMiddlewareError(code: IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode, message: string, options?: { readonly cause?: unknown }): Error;
function createStoreMiddlewareAggregateError(code: IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode, errors: readonly unknown[], message: string): AggregateError;

blocks.text: 它们只返回原生错误，不自动抛出；保留 stack。显式 cause（包括 undefined）由 Error 保存，AggregateError.errors 保留输入错误对象。STORE_MIDDLEWARE_SOURCE 只用于本包创建的错误，外包编码错误保持实际 owner。CALLBACK_FAILED 用于未编码的同步动作/disposer 失败；DEVTOOLS_MESSAGE_INVALID 用于报告支持 Redux 命令里的非法 JSON。immutable 失败的 cause 是完整 Utils 错误，原生复制失败在其下游 cause 上。

immutable 的严格数据契约：接纳普通/null 原型记录、普通数组、当前 realm 的原生 Map/Set/Date/RegExp/ArrayBuffer、非共享 ArrayBuffer 支持的标准 TypedArray/DataView。自定义 class（包括内建子类）、访问器与其它未接纳的原生对象以 CLONE_UNSUPPORTED 拒绝；访问器在求值前拒绝，不额外执行 getter。Map key/value、Set 成员及记录/数组数据递归接纳，循环与共享引用仍由唯一的 utils structuredClone 保持。此收窄修正旧版 class 静默丢方法的问题；旧版 getter、跨 realm 内建值及未列类型需迁移为支持的数据，或显式选择 diagnostic/opaque。Utils.immutableSnapshot 原生投影契约不变。本策略不另实现 clone 引擎。

API convergence：克隆五名只从既有 `/tolerant-clone` 导入；deprecated tolerantClone 两入口均删除。IMutationGuard/IMutationPolicy 从 `@migaia/store-light` 直接导入。旧 middlewarePlugin/IStoreMiddleware/IMiddlewareContext 删除，迁移为 IStoreMiddlewarePlugin 与 core.usePipeline；没有 shim/alias。外部旧导入需破坏版本迁移，仓库唯一生产 clone consumer 已使用窄入口。

`StoreMiddlewareErrorCode` 当前9个稳定成员：`invalidOption` (`INVALID_OPTION`)、`middlewareNotChained` (`MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED`)、`actionScopeRequired` (`ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED`)、`cloneUnsupported` (`CLONE_UNSUPPORTED`)、`callbackFailed` (`CALLBACK_FAILED`)、`devtoolsMessageInvalid` (`DEVTOOLS_MESSAGE_INVALID`)、`devtoolsCapability` (`DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY`)、`envUnsupported` (`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`)、`cleanupFailed` (`CLEANUP_FAILED`)。对应值的联合为 `IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode`；两新增场景见上述边界说明。

symbols.name: MutationPolicy
symbols.purpose: Class behind createMutationPolicy. Constructor accepts optional off or actions-only mode, default off; nested synchronous action depth is restored in finally and never extends across awaited continuations.
symbols.core:
mode: Optional IMutationPolicyMode; off is the default and actions-only enables action depth checks.
New MutationPolicy with independent synchronous action depth, initially zero; no resource cleanup is required and the caller must share this exact guard with protected stores.
insideAction: Whether synchronous nested action depth is currently greater than zero.
assertMutationAllowed: Checks current action depth only when mode is actions-only. It is a guard called by a Store, not a subscription or automatic instrumentation hook.
assertMutationAllowed.operation: Optional caller diagnostic label, default mutation, describing the blocked write.
No result on admission; actions-only outside action scope throws ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED. Off always admits supported writes.
runInAction: Raises action depth for synchronous fn execution, supports nesting, and restores depth in finally even on throw. Async continuations run after scope exit.
runInAction.fn: Synchronous no-argument callback supplied by the caller; return any T, or throw the original business failure.
Exact fn result. A mutable native uncoded callback error keeps its object/type/stack and receives CALLBACK_FAILED; frozen or non-Error values remain reachable through cause/errors. Foreign coded failures keep their owner. Returned promises are not awaited and do not extend action scope.
symbols.advanced: Reject direct Store writes while admitting synchronous methods or explicit host actions.
parameters: mode: IMutationPolicyMode (optional)
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this class.

blocks.code:
function createStoreMiddlewareError(code: IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode, message: string, options?: { readonly cause?: unknown }): Error;
function createStoreMiddlewareAggregateError(code: IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode, errors: readonly unknown[], message: string): AggregateError;

blocks.text: 它们只返回原生错误，不自动抛出；保留 stack。显式 cause（包括 undefined）由 Error 保存，AggregateError.errors 保留输入错误对象。STORE_MIDDLEWARE_SOURCE 只用于本包创建的错误，外包编码错误保持实际 owner。CALLBACK_FAILED 用于未编码的同步动作/disposer 失败；DEVTOOLS_MESSAGE_INVALID 用于报告支持 Redux 命令里的非法 JSON。immutable 失败的 cause 是完整 Utils 错误，原生复制失败在其下游 cause 上。

immutable 的严格数据契约：接纳普通/null 原型记录、普通数组、当前 realm 的原生 Map/Set/Date/RegExp/ArrayBuffer、非共享 ArrayBuffer 支持的标准 TypedArray/DataView。自定义 class（包括内建子类）、访问器与其它未接纳的原生对象以 CLONE_UNSUPPORTED 拒绝；访问器在求值前拒绝，不额外执行 getter。Map key/value、Set 成员及记录/数组数据递归接纳，循环与共享引用仍由唯一的 utils structuredClone 保持。此收窄修正旧版 class 静默丢方法的问题；旧版 getter、跨 realm 内建值及未列类型需迁移为支持的数据，或显式选择 diagnostic/opaque。Utils.immutableSnapshot 原生投影契约不变。本策略不另实现 clone 引擎。

API convergence：克隆五名只从既有 `/tolerant-clone` 导入；deprecated tolerantClone 两入口均删除。IMutationGuard/IMutationPolicy 从 `@migaia/store-light` 直接导入。旧 middlewarePlugin/IStoreMiddleware/IMiddlewareContext 删除，迁移为 IStoreMiddlewarePlugin 与 core.usePipeline；没有 shim/alias。外部旧导入需破坏版本迁移，仓库唯一生产 clone consumer 已使用窄入口。

`StoreMiddlewareErrorCode` 当前9个稳定成员：`invalidOption` (`INVALID_OPTION`)、`middlewareNotChained` (`MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED`)、`actionScopeRequired` (`ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED`)、`cloneUnsupported` (`CLONE_UNSUPPORTED`)、`callbackFailed` (`CALLBACK_FAILED`)、`devtoolsMessageInvalid` (`DEVTOOLS_MESSAGE_INVALID`)、`devtoolsCapability` (`DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY`)、`envUnsupported` (`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`)、`cleanupFailed` (`CLEANUP_FAILED`)。对应值的联合为 `IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode`；两新增场景见上述边界说明。
