disposed: True as soon as whole-registry disposal starts, including during the first owned callback; register/replace/get/require/has/remove and retain reject. Use whenTerminal for physical completion.
whenTerminal: Waits for the whole-registry disposal ledger to finish; it does not initiate disposal or wait for ad-hoc remove/replace cleanup.
Promise of physical terminal completion; inspect disposeAsync for cleanup failures.
register: Registers one token/value pair after runtime admission; duplicate token registration rejects. Use the original token returned by createStoreToken.
register.token: The exact IStoreToken returned by createStoreToken; reuse that object for registration and lookup. Equal debug names do not share identity.
register.value: Application-owned value; reactive ownership, if present, must match registry.runtime.
register.options: Optional IStoreRegistrationOptions; owned defaults false and nonobject or nonboolean flags reject.
Idempotent unregister function; it only removes its original entry and disposes it when owned, leaving replacements untouched.
replace: Installs or replaces a token entry. A different previously owned value is disposed after replacement, so a cleanup throw does not undo the new entry.
replace.token: The exact IStoreToken returned by createStoreToken; reuse that object for registration and lookup. Equal debug names do not share identity.
replace.value: Replacement value admitted to this Runtime ownership boundary.
replace.options: Optional ownership for the new entry, default false; not inherited from the old entry.
Nothing; the new value is registered, or validation/old synchronous cleanup fails.
get: Looks up a token synchronously without adding a React subscription to registry changes.
get.token: The exact IStoreToken returned by createStoreToken; reuse that object for registration and lookup. Equal debug names do not share identity.
Registered value, or undefined if absent; throws after registry closure.
require: Reads an existing registration and rejects a missing token with STORE_MISSING.
require.token: The exact IStoreToken returned by createStoreToken; reuse that object for registration and lookup. Equal debug names do not share identity.
Registered value preserving its original identity.
has: Checks whether this exact token key has a current entry; no source data subscription is created.
has.token: The exact IStoreToken returned by createStoreToken; reuse that object for registration and lookup. Equal debug names do not share identity.
True for a present entry, including one storing undefined.
remove: Deletes an entry before optional owned-value cleanup; asynchronous cleanup failures are reported through Runtime and not joined by later disposeAsync.
remove.token: The exact IStoreToken returned by createStoreToken; reuse that object for registration and lookup. Equal debug names do not share identity.
remove.disposeOwned: Defaults true; false removes the registration while retaining any owned value for external cleanup.
True if an entry was removed, false if absent; synchronous cleanup can throw after removal.
retain: Acquires one Provider retention. Its release function schedules disposal via setTimeout(0) only if requested and the registry still has zero owners in that generation.
retain.disposeOnRelease: True requests terminal registry disposal after the last owner releases; false only drops this retention.

disposeAsync: Starts disposal if needed and returns one stable shared completion, including thenables started by an earlier synchronous dispose.

members.description: Provider-local atom state/override boundary. Same Runtime may host many registries.

members.name: lifecycle
members.description: Part of the project's unified lifecycle shape (see `@migaia/lifecycle`'s `ILifecycleState`).

members.name: whenTerminal
members.description: Resolves once this registry (and any thenable disposer results) has actually finished tearing down.

members.signature: register<T>(token: IStoreToken<T>, value: T, options?: IStoreRegistrationOptions): IDisposer;

members.name: replace
members.signature: replace<T>(token: IStoreToken<T>, value: T, options?: IStoreRegistrationOptions): void;

members.name: retain
members.description: React StrictMode probes effect cleanup/setup. Delayed release avoids disposing an internally-owned registry between those two phases.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Idempotent, immediately enters `closing`. If an owned value's disposer returns a thenable, this cannot block on it (it's sync) — the thenable is tracked and observed (never left as an unhandled rejection) so a later `disposeAsync()` call still waits for it instead of resolving early just because `dispose()` already ran (see `disposeAsync()`). `lifecycle` only reaches `terminal` once every tracked thenable has actually settled.

members.name: disposeAsync
members.description: Awaitable counterpart. Single-flight: concurrent calls share one completion instead of each racing their own pass over `#entries`. Calling this after a prior synchronous `dispose()` does not resolve early — it waits for whatever thenable disposer results that `dispose()` started but could not block on (tracked by the lifecycle disposal ledger).

guidance.heading: 2.5 assertStoreFeature(config, path, apiName?) / normalizeStoreConfig(config?, barrierScope?) / readStoreFeature(config, path)

blocks.text: 这三个是 `useStoreFeature`/`useAssertStoreFeature`/`StoreProvider` 内部依赖的非 hook 版本，公开导出是为了让"不在组件里、但需要读取/校验同一份配置语义"的代码复用同一套逻辑（例如自定义的 SSR 请求作用域装配代码，或者非 React 的适配层）：

items: `readStoreFeature(config, path)`：纯查询，`path === 'wasm'` 直接读 `config.features.wasm`；`path` 形如 `` `experimental.${key}` `` 时读 `config.features.experimental[key] === true`；其他 `path` 一律返回 `false`。

`assertStoreFeature(config, path, apiName?)`：`config` 为 `null` 时抛 `[store] ${apiName} requires a StoreProvider (feature "path")`；`config` 非空但 `readStoreFeature` 返回 `false` 时抛 ` [store] ${apiName} requires feature "path" to be explicitly enabled on StoreProvider config`。`useAssertStoreFeature` 就是"取 `useStoreConfig()` 后调用这个函数"的薄封装。

`normalizeStoreConfig(config?, barrierScope?)`：`StoreProvider` 内部用来把 `IStoreProviderConfig` 归一化成 `IStoreConfigValue`（`features` 补全默认值、`ready` 屏障数组转换成在 normalize 返回前同步求值+缓存的 `ITrackedReady`）的同一段逻辑，独立导出后可以在 Provider 之外复现相同的归一化行为；`barrierScope` 决定就绪 Promise 与工厂结果缓存的隔离边界——不同调用传不同的 `barrierScope` 对象，各自独立求值，不会共享缓存。`config.ready` 里出现既不是函数也不是 thenable 的元素会抛 `[store] config.ready must be an array of Promises or zero-argument functions`。
`useStoreConfig`：拿完整归一化配置快照；无 Provider 时返回 `null`（这一点与 `useStoreRegistry` 不同——配置是可选的，Registry 不是）。
`useStoreFeature`：查询单个特性是否开启；无 Provider 一律返回 `false`，不抛，适合写"有就用、没有就降级"的可选增强代码。
`useAssertStoreFeature`：断言版本，供实验性/前置依赖初始化的 API 在入口处调用。未开启（含"根本没有 Provider"这种情况）都会抛 `Error`，因为实验特性不允许"默默在树外半开着生效"。

blocks.code: StoreProviderState.pending; // 'pending' | 'ready' | 'error' 之一

blocks.text: 业务代码一般不需要直接用它，除非要复刻类似的三态就绪追踪逻辑。

items: `features.wasm`：声明本树会用到 wasm 字段。为 `true` 且 `ready` 为空数组时，会自动追加一个立刻 reject 的屏障（见 5），避免"开了开关却没人 init"。
`features.experimental`：白名单对象，只有值严格为 `true` 的 key 才算开启；未列出或非 `true` 一律视为关闭。
`ready`：见 2.3。
`fallback`：`ready` 屏障 pending 期间渲染的占位内容，默认 `null`（不是 `undefined`——不传 `fallback` 且有 `ready` 时，pending 阶段渲染的是"什么都不渲染"而不是上一次的 children）。

`defaults.warnAsyncActions`：只是配置快照的一部分，通过 `useStoreConfig()` 暴露给业务代码读取；`StoreProvider` 不会把它自动传给 `createStore`——各个 Store 仍要自己在 `createStore(shape, { warnAsyncActions: true })` 里显式声明。这个字段更适合用作"业务代码统一读一个地方决定要不要传"的约定，而不是自动生效的开关。

guidance.heading: 2.5 assertStoreFeature(config, path, apiName?) / normalizeStoreConfig(config?, barrierScope?) / readStoreFeature(config, path)

blocks.text: 这三个是 `useStoreFeature`/`useAssertStoreFeature`/`StoreProvider` 内部依赖的非 hook 版本，公开导出是为了让"不在组件里、但需要读取/校验同一份配置语义"的代码复用同一套逻辑（例如自定义的 SSR 请求作用域装配代码，或者非 React 的适配层）：

items: `readStoreFeature(config, path)`：纯查询，`path === 'wasm'` 直接读 `config.features.wasm`；`path` 形如 `` `experimental.${key}` `` 时读 `config.features.experimental[key] === true`；其他 `path` 一律返回 `false`。

`assertStoreFeature(config, path, apiName?)`：`config` 为 `null` 时抛 `[store] ${apiName} requires a StoreProvider (feature "path")`；`config` 非空但 `readStoreFeature` 返回 `false` 时抛 ` [store] ${apiName} requires feature "path" to be explicitly enabled on StoreProvider config`。`useAssertStoreFeature` 就是"取 `useStoreConfig()` 后调用这个函数"的薄封装。

`normalizeStoreConfig(config?, barrierScope?)`：`StoreProvider` 内部用来把 `IStoreProviderConfig` 归一化成 `IStoreConfigValue`（`features` 补全默认值、`ready` 屏障数组转换成在 normalize 返回前同步求值+缓存的 `ITrackedReady`）的同一段逻辑，独立导出后可以在 Provider 之外复现相同的归一化行为；`barrierScope` 决定就绪 Promise 与工厂结果缓存的隔离边界——不同调用传不同的 `barrierScope` 对象，各自独立求值，不会共享缓存。`config.ready` 里出现既不是函数也不是 thenable 的元素会抛 `[store] config.ready must be an array of Promises or zero-argument functions`。
`useStoreConfig`：拿完整归一化配置快照；无 Provider 时返回 `null`（这一点与 `useStoreRegistry` 不同——配置是可选的，Registry 不是）。

import {
  StoreSharedErrorCode,
  type IStoreSharedErrorCode,
  STORE_SHARED_SOURCE,
  createStoreSharedError,
  createStoreSharedRangeError
} from '@migaia/store-shared'

blocks.text: `StoreSharedErrorCode`｜3 秒上手 —— 稳定错误码表，用于 `switch`/比较（无调用形式，是一个常量对象）：
全部取值（本包构造的错误使用以下 code；foreign callback identity 保留原 owner）：

items: `arrayDisposed`(`'ARRAY_DISPOSED'`) —— `SharedInt32Array` 已 `dispose()` 后继续读写；调用方应新建数组，不要复用已释放实例
`signalDisposed`(`'SIGNAL_DISPOSED'`) —— `SharedInt32Signal` 已 `dispose()` 后继续读写；同上，新建 signal
`bufferTooSmall`(`'BUFFER_TOO_SMALL'`) —— 传入的 `SharedArrayBuffer` 太小，放不下要求的 cell 布局；调用方应分配更大的 buffer，这是构造期参数错误，不要重试同一 buffer
`indexOutOfRange`(`'INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE'`) —— `SharedInt32Array` 下标越界；调用方检查下标是否在 `[0, length)`，这是永久性参数错误
`contentionLimit`(`'CONTENTION_LIMIT'`) —— Seqlock 持续约 1 秒仍未 settle（cell 未稳定/锁未获取，期间按轮自旋并退避），或 `update` 在自旋上限内持续写入失败；通常是某个写者持锁期间崩溃留下的死锁，无法自愈，调用方应重建 buffer
`envUnsupported`(`'ENV_UNSUPPORTED'`) —— `Atomics.waitAsync` 在当前环境不可用；调用方改用 `sync()` 自行拉取，或换支持 `waitAsync` 的运行时，库不做静默降级
`updateFailed`(`'UPDATE_FAILED'`) —— updater 抛出的未编码 native 错误原位附码；冻结或非 Error 值在 cause，foreign identity 不改写；回调在锁外，不影响后续正常写入
`invalidOption`(`'INVALID_OPTION'`) —— 构造/写入口参非法（长度非负整数、int32 范围等）；调用方修正入参，这是永久性参数错误

blocks.text: `IStoreSharedErrorCode` 是其取值的联合类型。
`STORE_SHARED_SOURCE`｜3 秒上手 —— 本包构造错误携带的 `source` 值（foreign updater 原错误保留其 owner）（字符串常量，无调用形式）：

blocks.code: STORE_SHARED_SOURCE // '@migaia/store-shared'

blocks.text: `createStoreSharedError`｜5 秒上手 —— 构造一个带 `(source, code)` 身份标记的 `Error`（用于组合本包之上的自定义封装时，抛出与本包同一套身份契约的错误）：

blocks.code: throw createStoreSharedError(StoreSharedErrorCode.invalidOption, 'entity slot must be preallocated')

blocks.text: 全部参数：`code: IStoreSharedErrorCode`（必填）、`message: string`（必填）、`options?: { readonly cause?: unknown }`（可选，透传给 `Error` 构造函数的 `cause`）。
`createStoreSharedRangeError`｜5 秒上手 —— 与上面相同，但构造 `RangeError`（本包自身校验入参失败时用的就是它）：

blocks.code: throw createStoreSharedRangeError(StoreSharedErrorCode.invalidOption, 'length must be >= 0')

blocks.text: 参数与 `createStoreSharedError` 完全一致，唯一区别是返回的运行时类型是 `RangeError`。

`signalDisposed`(`'SIGNAL_DISPOSED'`) —— `SharedInt32Signal` 已 `dispose()` 后继续读写；同上，新建 signal
`bufferTooSmall`(`'BUFFER_TOO_SMALL'`) —— 传入的 `SharedArrayBuffer` 太小，放不下要求的 cell 布局；调用方应分配更大的 buffer，这是构造期参数错误，不要重试同一 buffer

symbols.name: SharedInt32Array
symbols.purpose: Class constructor form of sharedInt32Array, taking Runtime, required fixed length and optional buffer/initialValues. Attaching validates ABI and length without reinitializing shared data.
symbols.core:
runtime: IRuntime from @migaia/reactive createRuntime; it owns dependency tracking and watch error reporting for this instance.
length: Application-selected nonnegative integer fixed length.
New SharedInt32Array local wrapper with an independent observation cursor for each shared cell. Dispose it when this Runtime no longer reads it; invalid length, header or initialization rejects construction without publishing a usable wrapper.
runtime: Exact external Runtime supplied at construction, never transferred to another Runtime after creation.
buffer: Underlying SharedArrayBuffer issued by this constructor or attached from another instance.buffer. Share the buffer with another wrapper using the same kind and array length.
disposed: Local wrapper terminal state; disposal disconnects this Runtime only and leaves other wrappers sharing the buffer alive.
watch: Starts one Atomics.waitAsync wake loop that reconciles remote changes before each wait. It captures the expected version before sync, so a write during sync cannot become an unseen baseline. The stop handle is published before reconciliation, allowing reentrant stop/dispose. Active repeated calls retain the first scheduler and stop handle; no silent polling fallback is installed.
watch.scheduler: Optional IScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler; defaults to systemScheduler and controls zero-delay rescheduling and cancellation between wakeups.
No-argument idempotent IDisposer. Missing waitAsync throws ENV_UNSUPPORTED; asynchronous loop failures are reported to Runtime. Disposing the instance also stops its loop without deleting shared memory.
length: Application-selected fixed cell count, copied into the ABI header and checked on attachment.
get: Reads a validated cell; inside Runtime tracking it materializes or reuses only that index source, otherwise it reads directly.
get.index: Zero-based integer selected by the caller within zero inclusive and array.length exclusive.
Current consistent int32 value; invalid index uses INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE, disposed access ARRAY_DISPOSED.
set: Writes a validated int32 and publishes only if its value changes; observers of other indices are not invalidated.
set.index: Zero-based integer selected by the caller within zero inclusive and array.length exclusive.
set.value: Caller integer in the signed int32 range, from -2147483648 through 2147483647.
No result; local cell tracking and shared generation publication are handled for this write.
update: Reads consistently, executes the callback outside the lock and attempts expected-value commit, retrying when a writer wins. User code never runs while the seqlock is held.
update.index: Zero-based integer selected by the caller within zero inclusive and array.length exclusive.
update.update: Synchronous current-to-next int32 callback, pure and repeatable because contention can invoke it again. Return a valid integer. It runs outside the lock; thrown native errors retain identity/class/stack with UPDATE_FAILED when unclassified, complete foreign identities remain unchanged, and other failures remain on cause.
Committed next integer or unchanged current integer; retry exhaustion uses CONTENTION_LIMIT, invalid output INVALID_OPTION.
sync: Publishes unseen remote cell versions locally. With an index checks one cell; without one scans only after the shared generation changes, batching notifications.
sync.index: Optional valid index; defaults to all cells after the generation gate.
Changed cell count; indexed calls return zero or one. Every wrapper owns its cursor, so one reader cannot consume another reader update.

blocks.text: 两者都是本包内部构造错误时使用的工厂：先 `new Error(message, options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause } : undefined)`（或 `RangeError`），再用 `attachErrorIdentity(error, { source: STORE_SHARED_SOURCE, code })` 挂上身份字段。两者签名与行为完全一致，唯一区别是构造出的运行时错误类型（`Error` vs `RangeError`）。公开导出是为了让在 `@migaia/store-shared` 之上做薄封装的调用方（例如包装 `SharedInt32Array` 的上层库）可以抛出携带同一套 `(source, code)` 身份契约的错误，而不必自己重新实现 `attachErrorIdentity` 调用。
`options.cause` 省略时不会传 `cause` 给底层 `Error` 构造函数（区别于显式传 `undefined`，两者在 `Error` 构造语义上是等价的，这里只是实现细节）。

blocks.code:
throw createStoreSharedRangeError(
  StoreSharedErrorCode.invalidOption,
  'entityCount must be a positive integer'
)

rows: 传入的 `buffer` 小于 `SharedInt32Signal`（32 字节）或按 `SharedInt32Array` 的 `length` 推算出的所需大小
`SharedInt32Array` 的 `get`/`set`/`update`/`sync(index)` 下标越界或非整数
一致读持续约 1 秒未 settle，或获取写锁持续约 1 秒未成功（两者均按轮自旋并退避），或 `update()` 的 CAS 重试自旋 65536 次仍未写入
当前运行环境不支持 `Atomics.waitAsync`，却调用了 `.watch()`
updater 抛错；锁外执行，后续写仍可用
native 原位附码；冻结/非 Error cause；foreign owner 保留
构造/写入口参非法：`buffer` 类型不对、`options` 不是对象、`options` 读取失败、`length` 非法、`initialValues` 物化失败、`length` 换算出的 slot 数超限、写入值不是合法 int32、`update()` 的回调不是函数

blocks.text: 本包构造的错误携带自身 source/code；完整 foreign updater identity 保留原 owner，未编码 native 原位附 UPDATE_FAILED，冻结错误以 cause 保留（通过 `attachErrorIdentity` 挂载），可用 `error.code === StoreSharedErrorCode.xxx` 分支处理，见 README 的 错误身份 小节。`CONTENTION_LIMIT` 系列几乎总是意味着另一个持锁的写者异常终止（线程被强制终止、页面崩溃）而没有走到释放锁那一步——共享内存里的 seq 会永远停在奇数。这类错误没有应用层可以自动恢复的办法，通常需要重新创建一块 buffer 并放弃旧的那份共享状态。

guidance.heading: 错误身份：StoreSharedErrorCode / STORE_SHARED_SOURCE / createStoreSharedError / createStoreSharedRangeError

blocks.code:
import {
  StoreSharedErrorCode,
  type IStoreSharedErrorCode,
  STORE_SHARED_SOURCE,
  createStoreSharedError,
  createStoreSharedRangeError
} from '@migaia/store-shared'

blocks.text: `StoreSharedErrorCode`｜3 秒上手 —— 稳定错误码表，用于 `switch`/比较（无调用形式，是一个常量对象）：
全部取值（本包构造的错误使用以下 code；foreign callback identity 保留原 owner）：

items: `arrayDisposed`(`'ARRAY_DISPOSED'`) —— `SharedInt32Array` 已 `dispose()` 后继续读写；调用方应新建数组，不要复用已释放实例
`signalDisposed`(`'SIGNAL_DISPOSED'`) —— `SharedInt32Signal` 已 `dispose()` 后继续读写；同上，新建 signal
`bufferTooSmall`(`'BUFFER_TOO_SMALL'`) —— 传入的 `SharedArrayBuffer` 太小，放不下要求的 cell 布局；调用方应分配更大的 buffer，这是构造期参数错误，不要重试同一 buffer
`indexOutOfRange`(`'INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE'`) —— `SharedInt32Array` 下标越界；调用方检查下标是否在 `[0, length)`，这是永久性参数错误
`contentionLimit`(`'CONTENTION_LIMIT'`) —— Seqlock 持续约 1 秒仍未 settle（cell 未稳定/锁未获取，期间按轮自旋并退避），或 `update` 在自旋上限内持续写入失败；通常是某个写者持锁期间崩溃留下的死锁，无法自愈，调用方应重建 buffer
`envUnsupported`(`'ENV_UNSUPPORTED'`) —— `Atomics.waitAsync` 在当前环境不可用；调用方改用 `sync()` 自行拉取，或换支持 `waitAsync` 的运行时，库不做静默降级
`updateFailed`(`'UPDATE_FAILED'`) —— updater 抛出的未编码 native 错误原位附码；冻结或非 Error 值在 cause，foreign identity 不改写；回调在锁外，不影响后续正常写入
`invalidOption`(`'INVALID_OPTION'`) —— 构造/写入口参非法（长度非负整数、int32 范围等）；调用方修正入参，这是永久性参数错误

blocks.text: `IStoreSharedErrorCode` 是其取值的联合类型。
`STORE_SHARED_SOURCE`｜3 秒上手 —— 本包构造错误携带的 `source` 值（foreign updater 原错误保留其 owner）（字符串常量，无调用形式）：

blocks.code: STORE_SHARED_SOURCE // '@migaia/store-shared'

blocks.text: `createStoreSharedError`｜5 秒上手 —— 构造一个带 `(source, code)` 身份标记的 `Error`（用于组合本包之上的自定义封装时，抛出与本包同一套身份契约的错误）：

blocks.code: throw createStoreSharedError(StoreSharedErrorCode.invalidOption, 'entity slot must be preallocated')

blocks.text: 全部参数：`code: IStoreSharedErrorCode`（必填）、`message: string`（必填）、`options?: { readonly cause?: unknown }`（可选，透传给 `Error` 构造函数的 `cause`）。
`createStoreSharedRangeError`｜5 秒上手 —— 与上面相同，但构造 `RangeError`（本包自身校验入参失败时用的就是它）：

blocks.code: throw createStoreSharedRangeError(StoreSharedErrorCode.invalidOption, 'length must be >= 0')

blocks.text: 参数与 `createStoreSharedError` 完全一致，唯一区别是返回的运行时类型是 `RangeError`。

subs: Readonly external IObserver set owned by the canonical Runtime source binding; application code should observe through Runtime effects instead of mutating this set.
version: Local reactive graph version number from the Runtime source binding; distinct from shared bigint seqlock versions.
value: Read consistently from shared memory, publish an unseen version and track a dependency. Setting validates signed int32, skips unchanged values and publishes local/remote notifications after commit.
value.next: Caller integer in the signed int32 range, from -2147483648 through 2147483647.

True when the shared version differs, otherwise false; contention failures propagate.
onObserved: External observable protocol hook; currently a no-op and does not start watch automatically.

onUnobserved: External observable protocol hook; currently a no-op, so explicit watch ownership remains with its stop handle or dispose.
No result; explicit watchers are unchanged.
dispose: Idempotently stops its watch and disposes this Runtime source binding; shared memory and other attached wrappers are untouched.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
runtime: IRuntime from @migaia/reactive createRuntime; it owns dependency tracking and watch error reporting for this instance.
initialValue: Caller integer in the signed int32 range, from -2147483648 through 2147483647.
buffer: Optional buffer obtained from another current signal instance; omitted means allocate a new scalar layout.
New SharedInt32Signal local reactive wrapper over new or attached shared storage; caller owns wrapper disposal, never the other wrappers sharing its buffer. Invalid initial value/buffer rejects construction with tagged native range errors.
runtime: Exact external Runtime supplied at construction, never transferred to another Runtime after creation.
buffer: Underlying SharedArrayBuffer issued by this constructor or attached from another instance.buffer. Share the buffer with another wrapper using the same kind and array length.
disposed: Local wrapper terminal state; disposal disconnects this Runtime only and leaves other wrappers sharing the buffer alive.
watch: Starts one Atomics.waitAsync wake loop that reconciles remote changes before each wait. It captures the expected version before sync, so a write during sync cannot become an unseen baseline. The stop handle is published before reconciliation, allowing reentrant stop/dispose. Active repeated calls retain the first scheduler and stop handle; no silent polling fallback is installed.
watch.scheduler: Optional IScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler; defaults to systemScheduler and controls zero-delay rescheduling and cancellation between wakeups.
No-argument idempotent IDisposer. Missing waitAsync throws ENV_UNSUPPORTED; asynchronous loop failures are reported to Runtime. Disposing the instance also stops its loop without deleting shared memory.
subs: Readonly external IObserver set owned by the canonical Runtime source binding; application code should observe through Runtime effects instead of mutating this set.
version: Local reactive graph version number from the Runtime source binding; distinct from shared bigint seqlock versions.
value: Read consistently from shared memory, publish an unseen version and track a dependency. Setting validates signed int32, skips unchanged values and publishes local/remote notifications after commit.
value.next: Caller integer in the signed int32 range, from -2147483648 through 2147483647.
Current integer on read; writes return no value. Disposed access uses SIGNAL_DISPOSED and invalid writes use INVALID_OPTION.
sync: Pulls the current shared version into the local cursor and notifies this Runtime only if it has not observed that version.
True for a newly observed version, otherwise false; SIGNAL_DISPOSED after disposal and CONTENTION_LIMIT if reads cannot settle.
peek: Consistently reads current shared memory without dependency tracking, updating the observed cursor or notifying local observers.
Current shared integer even if remote changes have not been published locally; disposed access throws SIGNAL_DISPOSED.
isStale: Compares shared seqlock version with the local observed cursor without tracking or notification; this low-level hook does not perform the public active guard.
True when the shared version differs, otherwise false; contention failures propagate.
onObserved: External observable protocol hook; currently a no-op and does not start watch automatically.
No result and no new watcher is created.
onUnobserved: External observable protocol hook; currently a no-op, so explicit watch ownership remains with its stop handle or dispose.
No result; explicit watchers are unchanged.
dispose: Idempotently stops its watch and disposes this Runtime source binding; shared memory and other attached wrappers are untouched.
No result; later value, peek, sync and watch reject with SIGNAL_DISPOSED.

sections.content: Share a counter or integer flag across thread runtimes while each reader independently synchronizes notifications.

items: `arrayDisposed`(`'ARRAY_DISPOSED'`) —— `SharedInt32Array` 已 `dispose()` 后继续读写；调用方应新建数组，不要复用已释放实例

blocks.text: 错误由 `(source, code)` 二元组唯一定位，本包构造错误的 `source` 为 `@migaia/store-shared`（即 `STORE_SHARED_SOURCE`）。码值是公开 API 的一部分，本包内部所有抛出点都引用这张表，不内联字面量；触发条件与调用方建议见 README 的对应小节与本文 §10 错误一览表。

两者都是本包内部构造错误时使用的工厂：先 `new Error(message, options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause } : undefined)`（或 `RangeError`），再用 `attachErrorIdentity(error, { source: STORE_SHARED_SOURCE, code })` 挂上身份字段。两者签名与行为完全一致，唯一区别是构造出的运行时错误类型（`Error` vs `RangeError`）。公开导出是为了让在 `@migaia/store-shared` 之上做薄封装的调用方（例如包装 `SharedInt32Array` 的上层库）可以抛出携带同一套 `(source, code)` 身份契约的错误，而不必自己重新实现 `attachErrorIdentity` 调用。
`options.cause` 省略时不会传 `cause` 给底层 `Error` 构造函数（区别于显式传 `undefined`，两者在 `Error` 构造语义上是等价的，这里只是实现细节）。

signalDisposed: Signal value, peek, sync or watch uses a disposed local wrapper.
bufferTooSmall: An attached buffer cannot hold the current signal or array layout; allocate the correct kind and size.
indexOutOfRange: A validated array API receives a noninteger or out-of-range index.
contentionLimit: A seqlock remains unstable or locked for the sustained contention window, or update exhausts its retry count; a crashed writer may require replacing the buffer.
envUnsupported: Explicit watch requires missing Atomics.waitAsync; callers may choose manual sync instead.
updateFailed: An updater throws outside the lock. Unclassified extensible native errors receive UPDATE_FAILED in place, preserving identity, class and stack. Frozen or non-Error failures remain on cause; complete foreign source/code identities retain their owner.
invalidOption: Length, int32 value, buffer brand, ABI header or array options violate the supported construction/write domain.

members.description: The supplied `SharedArrayBuffer` cannot hold the required cell layout. * * Allocate a larger buffer. This is a construction input error; do not retry the same buffer.

members.name: contentionLimit

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Construction or write input is invalid, such as a length that is not a non-negative integer or * a value outside the int32 range. * * Correct the input. This is a permanent input error.

blocks.text: 错误由 `(source, code)` 二元组唯一定位，本包构造错误的 `source` 为 `@migaia/store-shared`（即 `STORE_SHARED_SOURCE`）。码值是公开 API 的一部分，本包内部所有抛出点都引用这张表，不内联字面量；触发条件与调用方建议见 README 的对应小节与本文 §10 错误一览表。

两者都是本包内部构造错误时使用的工厂：先 `new Error(message, options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause } : undefined)`（或 `RangeError`），再用 `attachErrorIdentity(error, { source: STORE_SHARED_SOURCE, code })` 挂上身份字段。两者签名与行为完全一致，唯一区别是构造出的运行时错误类型（`Error` vs `RangeError`）。公开导出是为了让在 `@migaia/store-shared` 之上做薄封装的调用方（例如包装 `SharedInt32Array` 的上层库）可以抛出携带同一套 `(source, code)` 身份契约的错误，而不必自己重新实现 `attachErrorIdentity` 调用。
`options.cause` 省略时不会传 `cause` 给底层 `Error` 构造函数（区别于显式传 `undefined`，两者在 `Error` 构造语义上是等价的，这里只是实现细节）。

rows: 传入的 `buffer` 小于 `SharedInt32Signal`（32 字节）或按 `SharedInt32Array` 的 `length` 推算出的所需大小
`SharedInt32Array` 的 `get`/`set`/`update`/`sync(index)` 下标越界或非整数
一致读持续约 1 秒未 settle，或获取写锁持续约 1 秒未成功（两者均按轮自旋并退避），或 `update()` 的 CAS 重试自旋 65536 次仍未写入
当前运行环境不支持 `Atomics.waitAsync`，却调用了 `.watch()`
updater 抛错；锁外执行，后续写仍可用
native 原位附码；冻结/非 Error cause；foreign owner 保留
构造/写入口参非法：`buffer` 类型不对、`options` 不是对象、`options` 读取失败、`length` 非法、`initialValues` 物化失败、`length` 换算出的 slot 数超限、写入值不是合法 int32、`update()` 的回调不是函数

blocks.text: 本包构造的错误携带自身 source/code；完整 foreign updater identity 保留原 owner，未编码 native 原位附 UPDATE_FAILED，冻结错误以 cause 保留（通过 `attachErrorIdentity` 挂载），可用 `error.code === StoreSharedErrorCode.xxx` 分支处理，见 README 的 错误身份 小节。`CONTENTION_LIMIT` 系列几乎总是意味着另一个持锁的写者异常终止（线程被强制终止、页面崩溃）而没有走到释放锁那一步——共享内存里的 seq 会永远停在奇数。这类错误没有应用层可以自动恢复的办法，通常需要重新创建一块 buffer 并放弃旧的那份共享状态。

import {

  type IStoreSharedErrorCode,
  STORE_SHARED_SOURCE,
  createStoreSharedError,
  createStoreSharedRangeError
} from '@migaia/store-shared'

blocks.text: `StoreSharedErrorCode`｜3 秒上手 —— 稳定错误码表，用于 `switch`/比较（无调用形式，是一个常量对象）：
全部取值（本包构造的错误使用以下 code；foreign callback identity 保留原 owner）：

items: `arrayDisposed`(`'ARRAY_DISPOSED'`) —— `SharedInt32Array` 已 `dispose()` 后继续读写；调用方应新建数组，不要复用已释放实例
`signalDisposed`(`'SIGNAL_DISPOSED'`) —— `SharedInt32Signal` 已 `dispose()` 后继续读写；同上，新建 signal
`bufferTooSmall`(`'BUFFER_TOO_SMALL'`) —— 传入的 `SharedArrayBuffer` 太小，放不下要求的 cell 布局；调用方应分配更大的 buffer，这是构造期参数错误，不要重试同一 buffer
`indexOutOfRange`(`'INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE'`) —— `SharedInt32Array` 下标越界；调用方检查下标是否在 `[0, length)`，这是永久性参数错误
`contentionLimit`(`'CONTENTION_LIMIT'`) —— Seqlock 持续约 1 秒仍未 settle（cell 未稳定/锁未获取，期间按轮自旋并退避），或 `update` 在自旋上限内持续写入失败；通常是某个写者持锁期间崩溃留下的死锁，无法自愈，调用方应重建 buffer
`envUnsupported`(`'ENV_UNSUPPORTED'`) —— `Atomics.waitAsync` 在当前环境不可用；调用方改用 `sync()` 自行拉取，或换支持 `waitAsync` 的运行时，库不做静默降级
`updateFailed`(`'UPDATE_FAILED'`) —— updater 抛出的未编码 native 错误原位附码；冻结或非 Error 值在 cause，foreign identity 不改写；回调在锁外，不影响后续正常写入
`invalidOption`(`'INVALID_OPTION'`) —— 构造/写入口参非法（长度非负整数、int32 范围等）；调用方修正入参，这是永久性参数错误

blocks.text: `IStoreSharedErrorCode` 是其取值的联合类型。
`STORE_SHARED_SOURCE`｜3 秒上手 —— 本包构造错误携带的 `source` 值（foreign updater 原错误保留其 owner）（字符串常量，无调用形式）：

blocks.code: STORE_SHARED_SOURCE // '@migaia/store-shared'

blocks.text: `createStoreSharedError`｜5 秒上手 —— 构造一个带 `(source, code)` 身份标记的 `Error`（用于组合本包之上的自定义封装时，抛出与本包同一套身份契约的错误）：

blocks.code: throw createStoreSharedError(StoreSharedErrorCode.invalidOption, 'entity slot must be preallocated')

blocks.text: 全部参数：`code: IStoreSharedErrorCode`（必填）、`message: string`（必填）、`options?: { readonly cause?: unknown }`（可选，透传给 `Error` 构造函数的 `cause`）。
`createStoreSharedRangeError`｜5 秒上手 —— 与上面相同，但构造 `RangeError`（本包自身校验入参失败时用的就是它）：

blocks.code: throw createStoreSharedRangeError(StoreSharedErrorCode.invalidOption, 'length must be >= 0')

blocks.text: 参数与 `createStoreSharedError` 完全一致，唯一区别是返回的运行时类型是 `RangeError`。

symbols.name: createSSRRequestScope
symbols.purpose: Constructs a fresh request scope; objects from a different Runtime cannot be registered.
symbols.core:
SSRRequestScope to retain through rendering and await disposeAsync afterward.
runtime: Existing IRuntime from @migaia/reactive createRuntime, mutually exclusive with runtimeOptions. The scope claims its own instance, not exclusive ownership of that Runtime. Applications provide a distinct Runtime and scope per request when isolation is required.
Creates an isolated Runtime.
runtimeOptions: IRuntimeOptions forwarded to reactive createRuntime when runtime is absent; callback, adapter and scheduler contracts remain defined by reactive.
Reactive defaults: microtask flushing, default host adapter and 100 maxFlushPasses.
runtimeOptions.adapter: Host capabilities: `scheduleMicrotask`, `now` (monotonic time), `timestamp` (epoch time) and `reportError`. Each missing entry falls back to the default.
`queueMicrotask`, `performance.now()`, `Date.now()` and a reporter that does nothing.
runtimeOptions.onError: Receives errors that the runtime cannot throw to a caller (effect failures during an async flush, lifecycle hook failures, trace listener failures) with a `phase` context. Synchronous reporter failures and returned thenable rejections reach the shared utils host exception queue, without changing graph operations.
Not set: errors go to `adapter.reportError`.
runtimeOptions.onTrace: Receives every trace event from creation on, same as calling `subscribeTrace` immediately.
Not set: no trace events are produced unless `subscribeTrace` is used.
runtimeOptions.maxFlushPasses: Maximum runs of one effect within one flush. Exceeding it is treated as a self-triggering loop: the queue is cleared and `FLUSH_LOOP` is thrown with the dropped node names. Must be a positive integer.
`100` runs per effect per flush.
runtimeOptions.scheduleIdle: Schedules cleanup work, such as suspending computed values nobody observes. Use it to align cleanup with animation frames or idle callbacks.
Uses `adapter.scheduleMicrotask`.
runtimeOptions.schedulerStrategy: Decides when pending effects flush: receives a `flush` function and calls it when appropriate (for example in `requestAnimationFrame`). It must call synchronously or schedule; returning a thenable falls back to the safe default and reports `INVALID_OPTION`.
Merge all writes of the current task into one microtask flush.

symbols.core:
runtime: Existing IRuntime from @migaia/reactive createRuntime, mutually exclusive with runtimeOptions. The scope claims its own instance, not exclusive ownership of that Runtime. Applications provide a distinct Runtime and scope per request when isolation is required.

runtimeOptions: IRuntimeOptions forwarded to reactive createRuntime when runtime is absent; callback, adapter and scheduler contracts remain defined by reactive.

runtimeOptions.adapter: Host capabilities: `scheduleMicrotask`, `now` (monotonic time), `timestamp` (epoch time) and `reportError`. Each missing entry falls back to the default.
`queueMicrotask`, `performance.now()`, `Date.now()` and a reporter that does nothing.
runtimeOptions.onError: Receives errors that the runtime cannot throw to a caller (effect failures during an async flush, lifecycle hook failures, trace listener failures) with a `phase` context. symbols.name: ISSRResource
symbols.purpose: The methods needed to manage loaded data within one server request: wait for loading, save or restore cached data, and release the resource. [Resource](/en/docs/resource/api/Resource) provides these methods. Construct it with scope.runtime, the request scope’s execution context, and pass it to scope.registerResource. The scope can then wait for it, ask it for cached data, and clean it up by default. Without registration, the scope does not manage it. A resource using a different runtime makes registration throw CROSS_RUNTIME. Resource itself defines whether cached data is available to save.
symbols.core:
runtime: Exact Runtime owner, identical to scope.runtime.
disposed: Terminal flag checked by dehydration and cleanup.
promise: Current prefetch Promise, reread each round and deduplicated by identity per key; continuous getter failure is captured once.
dehydrate: Synchronous optional resource cache snapshot producer.
IResourceCacheSnapshot or undefined to omit; errors propagate.
hydrate: Synchronously applies external resource snapshot.
hydrate.snapshot: Version-2 IResourceCacheSnapshot with relative ageMs/remainingTtlMs from validated SSR state.
Void; failures remain reachable through scope hydration.
dispose: Synchronous resource cleanup; this protocol does not accept async disposal.
Void; scope disposal retains failures, unregisterResource propagates them.

归属校验:`register()` 要求 `store.$runtime === scope.runtime`,不满足抛出 `Error('[store] SSR store "${key}" belongs to a different Runtime')`;`registerResource()` 同理。重复 key 直接抛 `Error('[store] duplicate SSR store key: ${key}')`(Resource 版消息里是 `SSR resource`),不会静默覆盖已有注册。
`options.owned`(默认 `true`)决定这个 Store/Resource 是否由 scope"拥有"——owned 的条目会在 `dispose()` 时被自动 `$dispose()`/`dispose()`;传 `owned: false` 表示调用方自己管理生命周期,scope 只负责脱水/复水,不负责销毁。

注册顺序与待处理的 hydrate:如果在这个 key 注册之前,scope 已经通过 `hydrate()` 收到过一份还没人认领的快照,`register()`/`registerResource()` 会在登记生效之前先把这份待处理快照应用到新传入的 Store/Resource 上——如果 `$hydrate()`/`hydrate()` 在这一步抛错,注册整体失败,这个 key 保持"空闲"状态,待处理快照也原样保留,方便调用方修好问题后重试同一个 key,而不是陷入"key 已被占用但没有正常内容"的僵局。

blocks.code: const failures: readonly ISSRResourceFailure[] = await scope.awaitResources({ timeoutMs: 3000 });

rows: 有限范围 [0, 2147483647]；整个等待过程的总预算,不是单个 Resource 各自的超时。`0` 合法,语义是"立刻过期"——不等待任何在途 Resource。

blocks.text: timeoutMs 合法范围是 [0, 2147483647]；非法值通过 awaitResources 返回的 Promise 拒绝为 `RangeError('[store] SSR awaitResources timeoutMs must be finite and non-negative')`。

逐轮 settle 是这个方法的核心行为:每一轮只等待"这一轮新出现的 Promise",按 Promise 身份去重而不是按 key——同一个 key 首次 settle 后又发起了 retry/refetch(拿到一个新 Promise),仍然会被继续等到,不会因为这个 key "见过"就永久跳过。这样设计是为了正确处理瀑布式注册(Resource A resolve 之后的回调里才注册 Resource B)——旧版本用一趟 `Promise.all` 时,B 根本来不及被等到,`dehydrate()` 时它还没准备好,预取等于白做。
三种失败旁路都会被收进 `failures` 清单,不会让任何一种绕过其余处理直接中止整个等待:

items: 读取 `resource.promise` 这个 getter 本身同步抛错(某 key 只记一次,避免持续抛错的 key 每轮重复报错);
单个 Resource 在 `timeoutMs` 预算耗尽后仍未 settle,错误信息是 `'[store] SSR resource "${key}" did not settle within ${timeoutMs}ms'`;
等待期间 `scope.dispose()` 被调用——这种情况直接返回已经收集到的结果,不算作剩余 Resource 的失败。

blocks.text: Resource 的完成回调里无限注册新 Resource 属于调用方的 bug,但不能让它把渲染线程永远吊住:轮次上限是 64(`MAX_RESOURCE_ROUNDS`),超过会抛出 `Error('[store] SSR resources kept registering new resources past 64 rounds')`。

createStoreSsrError(code, message, options?) 接受可选 cause；createStoreSsrRangeError(code, message) 与 createStoreSsrTypeError(code, message) 都只有两个参数，没有 cause 选项。三者保持原生类型和 stack；AggregateError 的 errors 保持原对象及顺序。
`createStoreSsrAggregateError`：

symbols.name: SSRRequestScope
symbols.purpose: Creates one fixed-Runtime request registry, equivalent to createSSRRequestScope.
symbols.core:
New request-owned SSRRequestScope with empty registries and fixed Runtime; finish with disposeAsync. Invalid options or simultaneous runtime/runtimeOptions throw INVALID_OPTION before a usable scope is returned.
runtime: Runtime fixed at construction, identical to the owner of every registered object. Cleanup releases registered owned objects; the scope does not dispose the Runtime itself.
disposed: Terminal flag set before cleanup; later active operations fail SCOPE_DISPOSED.
register: Registers a same-Runtime store. Pending hydration runs before commit, followed by an active-state recheck. A hydration throw keeps the key free and pending data available; reentrant scope disposal rejects SCOPE_DISPOSED. Neither failure transfers ownership of the candidate, so the caller cleans it up. Duplicates fail INVALID_OPTION, other Runtime fails CROSS_RUNTIME.
register.key: Caller-stable nonempty string other than `__proto__`; store and resource keys use separate namespaces.
register.store: ISSRStore, normally @migaia/store-light createStore with scope.runtime.
register.options: Optional ISSRRegistrationOptions; default owned true.
Void; retains the exact store by key.
unregister: Removes store registration, then starts requested owned cleanup. Synchronous failure leaves the key removed; asynchronous errors are retained for disposeAsync.
unregister.key: Caller-stable nonempty string other than `__proto__`; store and resource keys use separate namespaces.
unregister.disposeOwned: Default true; false leaves removed store alive.
Whether key existed; synchronous cleanup errors propagate.
detach: Removes store registration without cleanup and transfers ownership to caller.
detach.key: Caller-stable nonempty string other than `__proto__`; store and resource keys use separate namespaces.
Exact ISSRStore or undefined.
registerResource: Registers a same-Runtime resource; pending hydration runs before commit and an active-state recheck. A thrown hydrate leaves the candidate unowned and pending data available; reentrant scope disposal rejects SCOPE_DISPOSED without admitting the candidate. Caller cleanup remains required. Duplicates fail INVALID_OPTION and mismatched owner fails CROSS_RUNTIME.
registerResource.key: Caller-stable nonempty string other than `__proto__`; store and resource keys use separate namespaces.
registerResource.resource: ISSRResource, normally @migaia/resource Resource constructed with scope.runtime.
registerResource.options: Optional registration policy, default owned true.
Void; retains resource until removal or disposal.
unregisterResource: Disposes requested owned resource before deleting its registration; synchronous disposal failure leaves registration present.
unregisterResource.key: Caller-stable nonempty string other than `__proto__`; store and resource keys use separate namespaces.
unregisterResource.disposeOwned: Default true; false skips cleanup.
Whether registration was removed; original cleanup errors propagate.
detachResource: Removes resource without disposing it; caller takes cleanup ownership.
detachResource.key: Caller-stable nonempty string other than `__proto__`; store and resource keys use separate namespaces.
Exact ISSRResource or undefined.
hydrate: Validates, then applies entries best-effort. Missing registrations become pending hydration; each call replaces pending maps. Successful changes remain applied if another entry fails. One failure is rethrown unchanged; several become HYDRATE_FAILED AggregateError.
hydrate.state: Version-1 ISSRState from deserializeSSRState or validated application data.
Void; no rollback protocol is provided.
dehydrate: Reads live registrations in key order. Store fields and resource data are validated, deeply copied and frozen; metadata is shallow copied. Disposed entries and resource snapshots returning undefined are omitted.
Frozen ISSRState; unsupported data fails SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED, entry access failures can become INVALID_SNAPSHOT with cause.
dehydrateTrusted: Skips nested validation, copying and freezing. Only outer records are frozen; entry data remains live. Pair with serializeTrustedSSRState immediately for known immutable JSON fixtures.
Branded ITrustedSSRState, not an immutable snapshot.
awaitResources: Waits in waterfall rounds, deduplicating last Promise identity per key. New retries/refetches participate. Getter failures and rejections become diagnostics. Continued new work after 64 rounds rejects RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT. Disposal returns already collected failures.
awaitResources.options: Optional IAwaitResourcesOptions, default empty with no deadline.
Promise of readonly ISSRResourceFailure entries. At timeout only still-pending Promises receive RESOURCE_TIMEOUT; fulfilled entries are omitted and rejected entries retain their original reason. A zero budget recognizes already-settled work without awaiting in-flight resources. Invalid options reject the Promise rather than throwing synchronously.
dehydrateAsync: Waits, reports each failure, then calls dehydrate. It does not independently remove failed keys; inclusion follows resource.dehydrate. Disposal during waiting makes final dehydration reject SCOPE_DISPOSED.
dehydrateAsync.options: Optional IDehydrateAsyncOptions, defaults to no deadline and Runtime reporting.
Promise<ISSRState>; diagnostic throws/rejections are reported best-effort and do not stop other reports. Returned reporter thenables are observed without awaiting.
dispose: Marks terminal, wakes waits and clears registrations/pending state, then starts all owned cleanup: resources before stores, reverse registration order per group. Idempotent; one failure does not prevent other cleanup.
Void without awaiting store cleanup. One synchronous failure is rethrown unchanged; several become SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED AggregateError. Await disposeAsync for completion.
disposeAsync: Starts disposal if needed and awaits every tracked owned cleanup. Completion is published before synchronous cleanup callbacks, so reentrant calls from dispose or disposeAsync share the same Promise. It waits for the full cleanup set admitted by the synchronous start pass and replays failures; the Runtime itself is retained.
Stable Promise<void>; exact single retained failure or SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED AggregateError for multiple failures.
runtime: Existing IRuntime from @migaia/reactive createRuntime, mutually exclusive with runtimeOptions. The scope claims its own instance, not exclusive ownership of that Runtime. Applications provide a distinct Runtime and scope per request when isolation is required.
Creates an isolated Runtime.
runtimeOptions: IRuntimeOptions forwarded to reactive createRuntime when runtime is absent; callback, adapter and scheduler contracts remain defined by reactive.
Reactive defaults: microtask flushing, default host adapter and 100 maxFlushPasses.
runtimeOptions.adapter: Host capabilities: `scheduleMicrotask`, `now` (monotonic time), `timestamp` (epoch time) and `reportError`. Each missing entry falls back to the default.
`queueMicrotask`, `performance.now()`, `Date.now()` and a reporter that does nothing.
runtimeOptions.onError: Receives errors that the runtime cannot throw to a caller (effect failures during an async flush, lifecycle hook failures, trace listener failures) with a `phase` context. Synchronous reporter failures and returned thenable rejections reach the shared utils host exception queue, without changing graph operations.
Not set: errors go to `adapter.reportError`.
runtimeOptions.onTrace: Receives every trace event from creation on, same as calling `subscribeTrace` immediately.
Not set: no trace events are produced unless `subscribeTrace` is used.
runtimeOptions.maxFlushPasses: Maximum runs of one effect within one flush. Exceeding it is treated as a self-triggering loop: the queue is cleared and `FLUSH_LOOP` is thrown with the dropped node names. Must be a positive integer.
`100` runs per effect per flush.
runtimeOptions.scheduleIdle: Schedules cleanup work, such as suspending computed values nobody observes. Use it to align cleanup with animation frames or idle callbacks.
Uses `adapter.scheduleMicrotask`.
runtimeOptions.schedulerStrategy: Decides when pending effects flush: receives a `flush` function and calls it when appropriate (for example in `requestAnimationFrame`). It must call synchronously or schedule; returning a thenable falls back to the safe default and reports `INVALID_OPTION`.
Merge all writes of the current task into one microtask flush.

members.name: detach
members.description: Remove a registration without disposing it; ownership transfers to the caller.

members.name: registerResource
members.signature: registerResource(key: string, resource: ISSRResource, options?: ISSRRegistrationOptions): void;

members.name: hydrate
members.description: Applies validated JSON state best-effort rather than atomically. A store or resource can reject its own hydration; every other entry is still attempted and failures are collected. The contracts provide no stage/commit/rollback protocol, so successful changes remain applied. Pending hydration records always reflect the entries actually consumed, including when a later entry fails. Callers must handle partial application rather than assume rollback.

members.name: dehydrateTrusted
members.description: Returns live dehydration references without copying, freezing or validation. Later mutations can change the payload before serialization, including across an await; this is not a snapshot. Use only for known-safe JSON data that stays immutable through serialization, such as owned documentation/demo fixtures. Request input or concurrently mutable stores must use dehydrate() instead. Select this fast path only when skipping validation and copying is justified.

members.name: awaitResources
members.description: Waits for registered asynchronous resources in rounds and returns their failures. Callers can fail the page or refetch on the client. New waterfall registrations participate in later rounds. Promises are deduplicated by identity, so a new retry or refetch promise for the same key is awaited. One resource failure does not block other prefetches. Thrown promise getters and timeouts are included in the failure list. Disposal during the wait returns results already collected without marking remaining resources as failures.

members.name: dehydrateAsync
members.description: Takes a snapshot after prefetching. Each resource decides inclusion through its own dehydrate() result; the failure list does not independently filter payload keys. Reports failures to the runtime's `onError` with phase `ssr-resource` by default, so client refetches remain diagnosable. When `onResourceError` is provided, it handles reporting instead.

members.name: disposeAsync
members.description: Awaitable teardown boundary for real Store Light instances whose `$dispose()` is asynchronous. Concurrent and repeated callers share the same completion and failure replay.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates one fixed-Runtime request registry, equivalent to createSSRRequestScope.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import SSRRequestScope from @migaia/store-ssr, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use SSRRequestScope when its class contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when SSRRequestScope does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained class example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
New request-owned SSRRequestScope with empty registries and fixed Runtime; finish with disposeAsync. Invalid options or simultaneous runtime/runtimeOptions throw INVALID_OPTION before a usable scope is returned.
runtime: Runtime fixed at construction, identical to the owner of every registered object. Cleanup releases registered owned objects; the scope does not dispose the Runtime itself.
disposed: Terminal flag set before cleanup; later active operations fail SCOPE_DISPOSED.
register: Registers a same-Runtime store. Pending hydration runs before commit, followed by an active-state recheck. A hydration throw keeps the key free and pending data available; reentrant scope disposal rejects SCOPE_DISPOSED. Neither failure transfers ownership of the candidate, so the caller cleans it up. Duplicates fail INVALID_OPTION, other Runtime fails CROSS_RUNTIME.
register.key: Caller-stable nonempty string other than `__proto__`; store and resource keys use separate namespaces.
register.store: ISSRStore, normally @migaia/store-light createStore with scope.runtime.
register.options: Optional ISSRRegistrationOptions; default owned true.
Void; retains the exact store by key.
unregister: Removes store registration, then starts requested owned cleanup. Synchronous failure leaves the key removed; asynchronous errors are retained for disposeAsync.
unregister.key: Caller-stable nonempty string other than `__proto__`; store and resource keys use separate namespaces.
unregister.disposeOwned: Default true; false leaves removed store alive.
Whether key existed; synchronous cleanup errors propagate.
detach: Removes store registration without cleanup and transfers ownership to caller.
detach.key: Caller-stable nonempty string other than `__proto__`; store and resource keys use separate namespaces.
Exact ISSRStore or undefined.
registerResource: Registers a same-Runtime resource; pending hydration runs before commit and an active-state recheck. A thrown hydrate leaves the candidate unowned and pending data available; reentrant scope disposal rejects SCOPE_DISPOSED without admitting the candidate. Caller cleanup remains required. Duplicates fail INVALID_OPTION and mismatched owner fails CROSS_RUNTIME.
registerResource.key: Caller-stable nonempty string other than `__proto__`; store and resource keys use separate namespaces.
registerResource.resource: ISSRResource, normally @migaia/resource Resource constructed with scope.runtime.
registerResource.options: Optional registration policy, default owned true.
Void; retains resource until removal or disposal.
unregisterResource: Disposes requested owned resource before deleting its registration; synchronous disposal failure leaves registration present.
unregisterResource.key: Caller-stable nonempty string other than `__proto__`; store and resource keys use separate namespaces.
unregisterResource.disposeOwned: Default true; false skips cleanup.
Whether registration was removed; original cleanup errors propagate.
detachResource: Removes resource without disposing it; caller takes cleanup ownership.
detachResource.key: Caller-stable nonempty string other than `__proto__`; store and resource keys use separate namespaces.
Exact ISSRResource or undefined.
hydrate: Validates, then applies entries best-effort. Missing registrations become pending hydration; each call replaces pending maps. Successful changes remain applied if another entry fails. One failure is rethrown unchanged; several become HYDRATE_FAILED AggregateError.
hydrate.state: Version-1 ISSRState from deserializeSSRState or validated application data.
Void; no rollback protocol is provided.
dehydrate: Reads live registrations in key order. Store fields and resource data are validated, deeply copied and frozen; metadata is shallow copied. Disposed entries and resource snapshots returning undefined are omitted.
Frozen ISSRState; unsupported data fails SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED, entry access failures can become INVALID_SNAPSHOT with cause.
dehydrateTrusted: Skips nested validation, copying and freezing. Only outer records are frozen; entry data remains live. Pair with serializeTrustedSSRState immediately for known immutable JSON fixtures.
Branded ITrustedSSRState, not an immutable snapshot.
awaitResources: Waits in waterfall rounds, deduplicating last Promise identity per key. New retries/refetches participate. Getter failures and rejections become diagnostics. Continued new work after 64 rounds rejects RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT. Disposal returns already collected failures.
awaitResources.options: Optional IAwaitResourcesOptions, default empty with no deadline.
Promise of readonly ISSRResourceFailure entries. At timeout only still-pending Promises receive RESOURCE_TIMEOUT; fulfilled entries are omitted and rejected entries retain their original reason. A zero budget recognizes already-settled work without awaiting in-flight resources. Invalid options reject the Promise rather than throwing synchronously.
dehydrateAsync: Waits, reports each failure, then calls dehydrate. It does not independently remove failed keys; inclusion follows resource.dehydrate. Disposal during waiting makes final dehydration reject SCOPE_DISPOSED.
dehydrateAsync.options: Optional IDehydrateAsyncOptions, defaults to no deadline and Runtime reporting.
Promise<ISSRState>; diagnostic throws/rejections are reported best-effort and do not stop other reports. Returned reporter thenables are observed without awaiting.
dispose: Marks terminal, wakes waits and clears registrations/pending state, then starts all owned cleanup: resources before stores, reverse registration order per group. Idempotent; one failure does not prevent other cleanup.
Void without awaiting store cleanup. One synchronous failure is rethrown unchanged; several become SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED AggregateError. Await disposeAsync for completion.
disposeAsync: Starts disposal if needed and awaits every tracked owned cleanup. Completion is published before synchronous cleanup callbacks, so reentrant calls from dispose or disposeAsync share the same Promise. It waits for the full cleanup set admitted by the synchronous start pass and replays failures; the Runtime itself is retained.
Stable Promise<void>; exact single retained failure or SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED AggregateError for multiple failures.
runtime: Existing IRuntime from @migaia/reactive createRuntime, mutually exclusive with runtimeOptions. The scope claims its own instance, not exclusive ownership of that Runtime. Applications provide a distinct Runtime and scope per request when isolation is required.
Creates an isolated Runtime.
runtimeOptions: IRuntimeOptions forwarded to reactive createRuntime when runtime is absent; callback, adapter and scheduler contracts remain defined by reactive.
Reactive defaults: microtask flushing, default host adapter and 100 maxFlushPasses.
runtimeOptions.adapter: Host capabilities: `scheduleMicrotask`, `now` (monotonic time), `timestamp` (epoch time) and `reportError`. Each missing entry falls back to the default.
`queueMicrotask`, `performance.now()`, `Date.now()` and a reporter that does nothing.
runtimeOptions.onError: Receives errors that the runtime cannot throw to a caller (effect failures during an async flush, lifecycle hook failures, trace listener failures) with a `phase` context. Synchronous reporter failures and returned thenable rejections reach the shared utils host exception queue, without changing graph operations.
Not set: errors go to `adapter.reportError`.
runtimeOptions.onTrace: Receives every trace event from creation on, same as calling `subscribeTrace` immediately.
Not set: no trace events are produced unless `subscribeTrace` is used.
runtimeOptions.maxFlushPasses: Maximum runs of one effect within one flush. Exceeding it is treated as a self-triggering loop: the queue is cleared and `FLUSH_LOOP` is thrown with the dropped node names. Must be a positive integer.
`100` runs per effect per flush.
runtimeOptions.scheduleIdle: Schedules cleanup work, such as suspending computed values nobody observes. Use it to align cleanup with animation frames or idle callbacks.
Uses `adapter.scheduleMicrotask`.
runtimeOptions.schedulerStrategy: Decides when pending effects flush: receives a `flush` function and calls it when appropriate (for example in `requestAnimationFrame`). It must call synchronously or schedule; returning a thenable falls back to the safe default and reports `INVALID_OPTION`.
Merge all writes of the current task into one microtask flush.

declaredConfiguration.name: runtimeOptions.adapter
declaredConfiguration.description: Injects host capabilities. Missing entries use `defaultRuntimeAdapter`.

declaredConfiguration.name: runtimeOptions.maxFlushPasses
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum executions for one observer within one flush. The default is 100. Exceeding the limit * is treated as a self-triggering cycle and throws after clearing the queue. * * The limit is configurable scheduling policy, not a physical constant.

declaredConfiguration.name: runtimeOptions.scheduleIdle
declaredConfiguration.description: Schedules suspension of an unobserved `Computed`. Defaults to the adapter's * `scheduleMicrotask`. * * Suspension is cleanup, so its timing is separate from flushing. This configurable channel can * align cleanup with animation-frame or idle policies without requiring callers or tests to wait * for a hard-coded microtask.

declaredConfiguration.name: runtimeOptions.schedulerStrategy
declaredConfiguration.description: Selects flush timing at creation; the runtime does not expose strategy replacement.

configuration.name: runtime
configuration.description: 1. 每个 `SSRRequestScope` 自带一个独立的 `Runtime`(除非显式传入)。`Runtime` 是 `@migaia/reactive` 里状态归属的最终判据。 2. `register()`/`registerResource()` 会强制校验归属:传入的 Store/Resource 必须满足 `store.$runtime === this.runtime`(或 `resource.runtime === this.runtime`),否则直接抛错拒绝注册。这意味着即使不小心把一个挂在全局默认 Runtime、或另一个请求的 Runtime 上的 Store 传进来,也无法注册成功——校验在注册那一刻就拦下,不会等到脱水阶段才发现串数据。 3. claimOwnership(scope, scope.runtime) 登记 scope 实例，不独占 Runtime；两个 scope 可显式复用一个 Runtime。请求隔离仍由应用为每请求创建独立 Runtime 保证。

blocks.text: `StoreSsrErrorCode` —— 本包稳定错误码表，配合 `attachErrorIdentity` 贴出来的 `error.code` 字段做 `switch`/比较：
全部取值：

rows: 在请求 scope 释放（disposed）后继续注册/脱水/读取
`dispose()` 时多个 store/resource 清理失败，作为 `AggregateError` 抛出
`hydrate()` 对多个 store/resource 应用失败，作为 `AggregateError` 抛出（尽力而为，非原子）
SSR 快照形状非法：`stores`/`resources` 不是纯对象，或某个资源快照字段非法
内联脚本 id 非法、JSON parse 失败或不支持的 state.version；SyntaxError 原位附码
SSR store/resource 注册键非法（空串或 `__proto__`）
载荷包含无法 JSON 序列化的值：循环引用、非有限数、非纯对象、超节点/深度上限、非 JSON 类型
入参校验失败：`timeoutMs` 非法、同时给 `runtime` 与 `runtimeOptions`、键重复
注册的 store/resource 属于另一个 Runtime，与本请求 scope 不隔离
Codec 契约/注册问题：`encode` 返回了 value chunk，或载荷引用的 codec 类型在读取侧未注册
`awaitResources()` 期间资源持续注册新资源，超过探测轮数上限（64）仍未收敛
单个已注册的 resource 在 SSR 截止时间前未 settle

blocks.text: `createStoreSsrError`/`createStoreSsrRangeError`/`createStoreSsrTypeError` —— 签名分别为：

createStoreSsrError(code, message, options?) 接受可选 cause；createStoreSsrRangeError(code, message) 与 createStoreSsrTypeError(code, message) 都只有两个参数，没有 cause 选项。三者保持原生类型和 stack；AggregateError 的 errors 保持原对象及顺序。
`createStoreSsrAggregateError`：

blocks.code: throw createStoreSsrAggregateError(StoreSsrErrorCode.hydrateFailed, [err1, err2], '批量失败');

blocks.text: 签名：`(code: IStoreSsrErrorCode, errors: unknown[], message: string) => AggregateError`，产出贴好身份的 `AggregateError`，`errors[]` 保持可达、顺序不变。
`STORE_SSR_SOURCE`（`'@migaia/store-ssr'`）是本包构造错误携带的固定 `source` 值，一般不需要手动引用，除非要用它去过滤/识别本包抛出的错误。
`StoreSsrErrorCode`｜3 秒上手 —— 稳定错误码表，用于 `switch`/比较，配合 `attachErrorIdentity` 贴出来的 `code` 字段使用：

全部取值：`scopeDisposed`(`SCOPE_DISPOSED`)、`scopeDisposalFailed`(`SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`)、`hydrateFailed`(`HYDRATE_FAILED`)、`invalidSnapshot`(`INVALID_SNAPSHOT`)、`invalidStateScript`(`INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT`)、`invalidStoreKey`(`INVALID_STORE_KEY`)、`serializeUnsupported`(`SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED`)、`invalidOption`(`INVALID_OPTION`)、`crossRuntime`(`CROSS_RUNTIME`)、`codecContract`(`CODEC_CONTRACT`)、`resourceRoundLimit`(`RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT`)、`resourceTimeout`(`RESOURCE_TIMEOUT`)。
`createStoreSsrError`/`createStoreSsrRangeError`/`createStoreSsrTypeError`｜5 秒上手 —— 本包内部用来构造带 `(source, code)` 身份的错误，导出后也可供上层代码复用同一套错误身份约定：

createStoreSsrError(code, message, options?) 接受可选 cause；createStoreSsrRangeError(code, message) 与 createStoreSsrTypeError(code, message) 均仅两个参数，不接受 cause 选项。三者经 canonical attachErrorIdentity 附码，保持 native 类型与 stack。
`createStoreSsrAggregateError`｜5 秒上手：

blocks.code: throw createStoreSsrAggregateError(StoreSsrErrorCode.hydrateFailed, [err1, err2], '批量失败');

blocks.text: 签名：`(code: IStoreSsrErrorCode, errors: unknown[], message: string)`，产出贴好身份的 `AggregateError`，`errors[]` 保持可达。
`STORE_SSR_SOURCE`(`'@migaia/store-ssr'`)是本包构造错误携带的固定 `source` 值，一般不需要手动引用，除非要用它去过滤/识别本包抛出的错误。

symbols.core:
scopeDisposed: Active operation after disposal; create a fresh request scope.
scopeDisposalFailed: Several cleanup failures; inspect AggregateError.errors.
hydrateFailed: Several hydration failures; successful entries remain applied.
invalidSnapshot: Malformed stores/resources or resource metadata, property-access failures and invalid JSON syntax. Unclassified extensible native errors receive INVALID_SNAPSHOT in place with identity/class/stack preserved; frozen/non-Error failures remain on cause and complete foreign identities keep their owner.
invalidStateScript: Unsupported envelope version or invalid script ID.
invalidStoreKey: Empty, non-string or `__proto__` registration/snapshot key.
serializeUnsupported: Non-JSON value, cycle, non-finite number, non-plain object, depth over 256 or traversal over one million nodes.
invalidOption: Invalid options, ownership, timeout, duplicate key, or simultaneous runtime/runtimeOptions.
crossRuntime: Registered object belongs to another Runtime.
codecContract: Writer codec returns value chunk or reader lacks named codec.
resourceRoundLimit: Waterfall resources continue changing beyond the round limit.
resourceTimeout: One resource Promise is still unsettled at the total deadline; completed siblings do not receive this code. Choose fallback or client refetch.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.
examples: throw createStoreSsrAggregateError(StoreSsrErrorCode.hydrateFailed, [err1, err2], '批量失败');

members.name: scopeDisposed
members.description: Registration, dehydration, or reads continue after request scope disposal. * * Create a new `SSRRequestScope` for each request instead of reusing the disposed scope.

members.name: scopeDisposalFailed
members.description: Multiple stores or resources fail to clean up during request scope disposal. An * `AggregateError` exposes each cause through `errors[]`. * * Treat this as a disposal failure.

members.name: hydrateFailed
members.description: `hydrate()` fails to apply state to multiple stores or resources. Hydration is best-effort and * non-atomic. An `AggregateError` exposes each cause through `errors[]`. * * Treat this as a hydration failure.

members.name: invalidSnapshot
members.description: An SSR snapshot is invalid because `stores` or `resources` is not a plain object, or a resource * snapshot field is invalid, or accessing input snapshot properties fails. Keep the original * reflective failure reachable and correct the supplied data before retrying. * * Check the supplied `ISSRState` structure.

members.name: invalidStateScript
members.description: The inline state script ID is invalid, JSON payload parsing fails, or `ISSRState.version` is * not the supported version `1`. Syntax errors retain their native class and stack. * * Use a valid ID and the supported version.

members.name: invalidStoreKey
members.description: An SSR store or resource registration key is empty or equals `__proto__`. * * Use a non-empty, non-reserved string key.

members.name: serializeUnsupported
members.description: The payload is not JSON-serializable because it contains cycles, non-finite numbers, non-plain * objects, non-JSON types, or exceeds node or depth limits. * * Restrict state to JSON-serializable plain values.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Input validation fails for `timeoutMs`, simultaneous `runtime` and `runtimeOptions`, or * duplicate keys. * * Correct the input named in the error message.

members.name: crossRuntime
members.description: A registered store or resource belongs to another `Runtime` and does not share this request * scope isolation. * * Create and register the store or resource within the same `Runtime`.

members.name: codecContract
members.description: A codec violates its output or registration contract. `encode` returns a value chunk instead of * wire data, or the payload names a codec type not registered on the reader. * * Correct the codec output or register the codec before reading.

members.name: resourceRoundLimit
members.description: Resources keep registering new resources during `awaitResources()` and exceed the convergence * round limit. * * Check resource factories and dependencies for an infinite registration chain.

members.name: resourceTimeout
members.description: A registered resource did not settle before the SSR deadline. The caller may render without * that resource or retry on the client.

blocks.text: `StoreSsrErrorCode` —— 本包稳定错误码表，配合 `attachErrorIdentity` 贴出来的 `error.code` 字段做 `switch`/比较：
全部取值：

rows: 在请求 scope 释放（disposed）后继续注册/脱水/读取
`dispose()` 时多个 store/resource 清理失败，作为 `AggregateError` 抛出
`hydrate()` 对多个 store/resource 应用失败，作为 `AggregateError` 抛出（尽力而为，非原子）
SSR 快照形状非法：`stores`/`resources` 不是纯对象，或某个资源快照字段非法
内联脚本 id 非法、JSON parse 失败或不支持的 state.version；SyntaxError 原位附码
SSR store/resource 注册键非法（空串或 `__proto__`）
载荷包含无法 JSON 序列化的值：循环引用、非有限数、非纯对象、超节点/深度上限、非 JSON 类型
入参校验失败：`timeoutMs` 非法、同时给 `runtime` 与 `runtimeOptions`、键重复
注册的 store/resource 属于另一个 Runtime，与本请求 scope 不隔离
Codec 契约/注册问题：`encode` 返回了 value chunk，或载荷引用的 codec 类型在读取侧未注册
`awaitResources()` 期间资源持续注册新资源，超过探测轮数上限（64）仍未收敛
单个已注册的 resource 在 SSR 截止时间前未 settle

blocks.text: `createStoreSsrError`/`createStoreSsrRangeError`/`createStoreSsrTypeError` —— 签名分别为：

createStoreSsrError(code, message, options?) 接受可选 cause；createStoreSsrRangeError(code, message) 与 createStoreSsrTypeError(code, message) 都只有两个参数，没有 cause 选项。三者保持原生类型和 stack；AggregateError 的 errors 保持原对象及顺序。
`createStoreSsrAggregateError`：

blocks.code: throw createStoreSsrAggregateError(StoreSsrErrorCode.hydrateFailed, [err1, err2], '批量失败');

blocks.text: 签名：`(code: IStoreSsrErrorCode, errors: unknown[], message: string) => AggregateError`，产出贴好身份的 `AggregateError`，`errors[]` 保持可达、顺序不变。
`STORE_SSR_SOURCE`（`'@migaia/store-ssr'`）是本包构造错误携带的固定 `source` 值，一般不需要手动引用，除非要用它去过滤/识别本包抛出的错误。
`StoreSsrErrorCode`｜3 秒上手 —— 稳定错误码表，用于 `switch`/比较，配合 `attachErrorIdentity` 贴出来的 `code` 字段使用：

全部取值：`scopeDisposed`(`SCOPE_DISPOSED`)、`scopeDisposalFailed`(`SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`)、`hydrateFailed`(`HYDRATE_FAILED`)、`invalidSnapshot`(`INVALID_SNAPSHOT`)、`invalidStateScript`(`INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT`)、`invalidStoreKey`(`INVALID_STORE_KEY`)、`serializeUnsupported`(`SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED`)、`invalidOption`(`INVALID_OPTION`)、`crossRuntime`(`CROSS_RUNTIME`)、`codecContract`(`CODEC_CONTRACT`)、`resourceRoundLimit`(`RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT`)、`resourceTimeout`(`RESOURCE_TIMEOUT`)。
`createStoreSsrError`/`createStoreSsrRangeError`/`createStoreSsrTypeError`｜5 秒上手 —— 本包内部用来构造带 `(source, code)` 身份的错误，导出后也可供上层代码复用同一套错误身份约定：

createStoreSsrError(code, message, options?) 接受可选 cause；createStoreSsrRangeError(code, message) 与 createStoreSsrTypeError(code, message) 均仅两个参数，不接受 cause 选项。三者经 canonical attachErrorIdentity 附码，保持 native 类型与 stack。
`createStoreSsrAggregateError`｜5 秒上手：

blocks.code: throw createStoreSsrAggregateError(StoreSsrErrorCode.hydrateFailed, [err1, err2], '批量失败');

blocks.text: 签名：`(code: IStoreSsrErrorCode, errors: unknown[], message: string)`，产出贴好身份的 `AggregateError`，`errors[]` 保持可达。
`STORE_SSR_SOURCE`(`'@migaia/store-ssr'`)是本包构造错误携带的固定 `source` 值，一般不需要手动引用，除非要用它去过滤/识别本包抛出的错误。

symbols.name: array
symbols.purpose: Describes fixed zero-filled f64 elements with shared tracking buckets. Call array(length, granularity?); there is no item builder parameter or compatibility overload for the old argument order.
symbols.core:
length: Caller-selected safe integer from 0 through 536870911; immutable element count, invalid values fail RangeError INVALID_OPTION.
granularity: Caller positive safe integer indices per bucket, default 64; one tracks each index independently, larger buckets can invalidate peers.
Returns Store Light IFieldBuilder with FIELD_BUILDER true, mode StoreFieldMode.sync from @migaia/store-light and synchronous create(context). A sync-only annotation is typeof StoreFieldMode.sync, not the full IStoreFieldMode union that also permits async. After ensureWasm, pass it to createStore; Store Light supplies {runtime,signal,createSource} and owns the field. Creation before readiness fails NOT_INITIALIZED. An aborted context preserves an unclassified native reason in place with INIT_ABORTED, a complete foreign identity unchanged, or an untaggable reason on cause. Rollback preserves primary and cleanup failures. Direct create requires caller-owned disposal. Field exposes readonly length/disposed, idempotent dispose(): void, at(index): number, setAt(index,value): void, setRange(lo,hi,values): void, view(): Float64Array. Indices are safe integers in [0,length); reads track buckets. Writes require number, including NaN/infinities. Range is half-open [lo,hi); all ArrayLike length and element reads finish before writes, so a getter failure leaves memory unchanged. Unclassified native input errors receive INVALID_OPTION in place, foreign identities remain unchanged, and frozen/non-Error failures remain on cause. Changed buckets commit once each in a batch; each commit refreshes the current memory view after owner-triggered memory growth, with attempted memory rollback on failure. view returns an independent copy without tracking, never writeback. After disposal data operations fail FIELD_DISPOSED; sources release before allocation.
parameters: length: number
granularity: number (optional)
symbols.returns: IFieldBuilder<IWasmArrayField>
examples:
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'
import { ensureWasm, number, boolean, string, array, record } from '@migaia/store-wasm'

await ensureWasm()

const store = createStore({
  hp: number(),
  alive: boolean(),
  name: string(64),
  hits: array(1000),
  pos: record({ x: number(), y: number() })
})

store.hp.value = 100
store.alive.value = true
store.name.value = 'boss'
store.hits.setAt(0, 1)
store.pos.x = 10

store.$dispose() // 递归释放上面五个字段各自持有的 WASM 分配

const field = array(1000) // granularity 默认 64
const field2 = array(1000, 1) // 每个 index 独立追踪

const store = createStore({
  hp: number(),
  alive: boolean(),
  name: string(64),
  hits: array(1000),
  pos: record({ x: number(), y: number() })
})
store.$dispose() // 递归释放全部五个字段各自持有的 WASM 分配

const store = createStore({ field: array(1000) }) // length=1000, granularity 默认 64
store.field.setAt(0, 1)
store.field.setRange(1, 3, [2, 3])

blocks.text: 所有字段共享同一套生命周期契约（`IDisposable`）：

1. 构造：`ensureWasm()` 已就绪的前提下，调用 `field.create(context)`（通常由 `createStore()` 代为调用）同步完成分配 + 响应式 Source 创建。构造中途任何一步失败（比如 `context.signal` 已经 aborted、内存对齐校验失败），已经分配的内存和已创建的 Source 会被完整回滚，不会半途留下资源。 2. 使用：读写会先检查 `disposed` 状态，已释放的字段继续读写会抛 `Error`（具体信息见 §10）。 3. 释放：`dispose()` 释放底层内存分配、注销 `FinalizationRegistry` 登记、并 dispose 掉自己创建的响应式 Source（`array()`/`record()` 会 dispose 掉全部分桶/全部 key 的 Source）。`dispose()` 本身是幂等的——重复调用直接返回，不会重复释放或抛错。 4. GC 兜底：字段构造成功后会用 `FinalizationRegistry`（运行时不支持时静默跳过，不报错）登记自己，一旦字段对象本身被垃圾回收且从未显式 `dispose()`，注册的回调会异步释放底层分配。这只是防止"忘记 dispose 导致的永久泄漏"的最后一道保险——时机完全不可预测（取决于 GC 何时运行），不能作为常规的资源管理方式，显式 `dispose()`（或让 `store.$dispose()` 代为处理）才是设计上的主路径。
`createStore()` 场景下不需要关心上面第 3 步——Store 会把每个 wasm 字段登记进自己的 disposal scope，`store.$dispose()` 时按 scope 的规则统一释放。只有绕开 Store 直接调用 `builder.create(context)` 时，才需要自己在合适的时机调用 `field.dispose()`。

rows: `allocate`/`allocateSync` 的 `byteLen` 不是 `[0, 0xffff_ffff]` 内的安全整数
`wasm.allocate: byteLen must fit an unsigned 32-bit integer`
字段构造时 WASM 尚未就绪（未 `await ensureWasm()`）
`[store] WASM is not initialized; await ensureWasm() or use StoreProvider`
字段构造时 signal 已 aborted
原生 reason（通常 DOMException/AbortError）或带 cause 的 Error
未编码 native reason 原位附 INIT_ABORTED；foreign identity 保留；无法附码时原值在 cause，message/stack 按原值保留
`[store] cannot use a disposed wasm field`
`[store] cannot use a disposed wasm field`
`array()` 字段 dispose 后调用任意方法
`[store] cannot use a disposed wasm field`
`wasm.array: length exceeds the Wasm32 allocation limit`
`array()` 的 `granularity` 不是正安全整数

`array()` 分配地址未按 8 字节对齐（防御性校验，正常不会触发）

symbols.name: boolean
symbols.signature: export declare function boolean(): IFieldBuilder<IWasmBooleanField>;
symbols.purpose: Describes a one-byte boolean field initially false; accepts actual booleans without truthy coercion, owned by Store Light.
symbols.core: Returns Store Light IFieldBuilder with FIELD_BUILDER true, mode StoreFieldMode.sync from @migaia/store-light and synchronous create(context). A sync-only annotation is typeof StoreFieldMode.sync, not the full IStoreFieldMode union that also permits async. After ensureWasm, pass it to createStore; Store Light supplies {runtime,signal,createSource} and owns the field. Creation before readiness fails NOT_INITIALIZED. An aborted context preserves an unclassified native reason in place with INIT_ABORTED, a complete foreign identity unchanged, or an untaggable reason on cause. Rollback preserves primary and cleanup failures. Direct create requires caller-owned disposal. Field exposes value getter/setter, readonly observed/disposed and idempotent dispose(): void. Reading tracks its source; Object.is-equal writes do nothing. Memory growth refreshes backing views. Disposed value access fails FIELD_DISPOSED. Disposal marks terminal, removes reactive sources then frees allocation. Value is boolean; true encodes as one and false as zero. Other types throw TypeError INVALID_OPTION.
parameters: This function declaration has no parameters.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content: Returns Store Light IFieldBuilder with FIELD_BUILDER true, mode StoreFieldMode.sync from @migaia/store-light and synchronous create(context). A sync-only annotation is typeof StoreFieldMode.sync, not the full IStoreFieldMode union that also permits async. After ensureWasm, pass it to createStore; Store Light supplies {runtime,signal,createSource} and owns the field. Creation before readiness fails NOT_INITIALIZED. An aborted context preserves an unclassified native reason in place with INIT_ABORTED, a complete foreign identity unchanged, or an untaggable reason on cause. Rollback preserves primary and cleanup failures. Direct create requires caller-owned disposal. Field exposes value getter/setter, readonly observed/disposed and idempotent dispose(): void. Reading tracks its source; Object.is-equal writes do nothing. Memory growth refreshes backing views. Disposed value access fails FIELD_DISPOSED. Disposal marks terminal, removes reactive sources then frees allocation. Value is boolean; true encodes as one and false as zero. Other types throw TypeError INVALID_OPTION.

blocks.code:
import {
  StoreWasmErrorCode,
  type IStoreWasmErrorCode,
  STORE_WASM_SOURCE,
  createStoreWasmError,
  createStoreWasmRangeError,
  createStoreWasmTypeError,
  createStoreWasmAggregateError,
  WasmReservedKey,
  type IWasmReservedKey
} from '@migaia/store-wasm'

const StoreWasmErrorCode = {
  notInitialized: 'NOT_INITIALIZED',
  fieldDisposed: 'FIELD_DISPOSED',
  initAborted: 'INIT_ABORTED',
  reservedFieldName: 'RESERVED_FIELD_NAME',
  allocationFailed: 'ALLOCATION_FAILED',
  invalidOption: 'INVALID_OPTION',
  cleanupFailed: 'CLEANUP_FAILED',
  instancePoisoned: 'INSTANCE_POISONED'
} as const
type IStoreWasmErrorCode = (typeof StoreWasmErrorCode)[keyof typeof StoreWasmErrorCode]

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，是公开 API 的一部分——改名视为破坏性变更。每条码值的触发条件：

rows: 字段在 `ensureWasm()` settle 之前同步构造/分配
读写/使用一个已 `dispose()` 的字段
字段初始化时 `context.signal` 已经 aborted
`record()` 的 `shape` 用了 `'dispose'`/`'disposed'` 作为 key
WASM 分配失败或对齐/长度校验失败
构造/写入参数非法（超容量、下标越界、granularity 非法等）
字段释放或构造回滚时有多个 owned resource 清理失败（携带 `AggregateError.errors`）
WASM 实例此前已 trap，之后任何导出调用都会再次 trap；`cause` 是原始 trap，只能重载页面或重启进程

blocks.code: const STORE_WASM_SOURCE: '@migaia/store-wasm'

blocks.text: 本包每个抛出的错误上 `source` 字段的固定值，用于结合 `code` 做双重识别，避免和其他包同名的 `code` 混淆。

四个错误构造函数，均通过 `attachErrorIdentity`（`@migaia/utils/error`）把 `source: STORE_WASM_SOURCE` 与传入的 `code` 挂到对应类型的原生错误对象上，不修改 `stack`。包内部构造字段错误时统一走这四个函数；扩展自定义字段类型（见 §12）时可以复用它们保持错误身份风格一致。`createStoreWasmError`/`createStoreWasmTypeError` 的 `options.cause` 若提供会传给底层 `Error`/`TypeError` 构造函数的 `{ cause }`。
全部字段 builder 使用 store-light 的 StoreFieldMode.sync。若类型注解需要只表达同步分支，使用 typeof StoreFieldMode.sync，不把包含 async 的完整 IStoreFieldMode union 当作旧 sync-only 类型的等价别名。

blocks.code:
const WasmReservedKey = { dispose: 'dispose', disposed: 'disposed' } as const
type IWasmReservedKey = 'dispose' | 'disposed'

blocks.text: record shape 保留 dispose/disposed 两个生命周期名；record(shape) 先创建描述，实际字段 create(context) 阶段检查并以 RESERVED_FIELD_NAME TypeError 拒绝，常见触发点是 createStore。

blocks.code:
import {
  StoreWasmErrorCode,
  STORE_WASM_SOURCE,
  createStoreWasmError,
  createStoreWasmRangeError,
  createStoreWasmTypeError,
  createStoreWasmAggregateError,
  WasmReservedKey
} from '@migaia/store-wasm'

blocks.text: `StoreWasmErrorCode`｜3 秒上手 —— 稳定错误码表：

全部取值：`notInitialized`(`NOT_INITIALIZED`)、`fieldDisposed`(`FIELD_DISPOSED`)、`initAborted`(`INIT_ABORTED`)、`reservedFieldName`(`RESERVED_FIELD_NAME`)、`allocationFailed`(`ALLOCATION_FAILED`)、`invalidOption`(`INVALID_OPTION`)、`cleanupFailed`(`CLEANUP_FAILED`)、`instancePoisoned`(`INSTANCE_POISONED`)。本包构造错误带自身 source/code；native 输入读取失败原位附 INVALID_OPTION，取消保留 native reason 或 cause；完整 foreign identity 保留原 owner。
`createStoreWasmError` / `createStoreWasmRangeError` / `createStoreWasmTypeError` / `createStoreWasmAggregateError`｜5 秒上手 —— 一般由包内部使用，扩展自定义字段类型时可复用：

blocks.code: throw createStoreWasmError(StoreWasmErrorCode.invalidOption, 'my.field: bad value')

blocks.text: 参数：`code: IStoreWasmErrorCode`（必填）、`message: string`（必填）；`createStoreWasmError`/`createStoreWasmTypeError` 额外接受第三参数 `{ cause?: unknown }`；`createStoreWasmAggregateError` 签名为 `(code, errors: readonly unknown[], message: string)`。均返回已挂好 `(source, code)` 身份标记的对应错误类型（`Error`/`RangeError`/`TypeError`/`AggregateError`）。
`WasmReservedKey`｜3 秒上手 —— 常量对象，无调用参数：

blocks.code: WasmReservedKey.dispose // 'dispose'，record() 禁用的 key 之一

blocks.text: 全部 builder 使用 canonical StoreFieldMode.sync（来自 store-light），保持同步。`WasmReservedKey` 取值：`dispose`、`disposed`。

blocks.text: 所有字段共享同一套生命周期契约（`IDisposable`）：

1. 构造：`ensureWasm()` 已就绪的前提下，调用 `field.create(context)`（通常由 `createStore()` 代为调用）同步完成分配 + 响应式 Source 创建。构造中途任何一步失败（比如 `context.signal` 已经 aborted、内存对齐校验失败），已经分配的内存和已创建的 Source 会被完整回滚，不会半途留下资源。 2. 使用：读写会先检查 `disposed` 状态，已释放的字段继续读写会抛 `Error`（具体信息见 §10）。 3. 释放：`dispose()` 释放底层内存分配、注销 `FinalizationRegistry` 登记、并 dispose 掉自己创建的响应式 Source（`array()`/`record()` 会 dispose 掉全部分桶/全部 key 的 Source）。`dispose()` 本身是幂等的——重复调用直接返回，不会重复释放或抛错。 4. GC 兜底：字段构造成功后会用 `FinalizationRegistry`（运行时不支持时静默跳过，不报错）登记自己，一旦字段对象本身被垃圾回收且从未显式 `dispose()`，注册的回调会异步释放底层分配。这只是防止"忘记 dispose 导致的永久泄漏"的最后一道保险——时机完全不可预测（取决于 GC 何时运行），不能作为常规的资源管理方式，显式 `dispose()`（或让 `store.$dispose()` 代为处理）才是设计上的主路径。
`createStore()` 场景下不需要关心上面第 3 步——Store 会把每个 wasm 字段登记进自己的 disposal scope，`store.$dispose()` 时按 scope 的规则统一释放。只有绕开 Store 直接调用 `builder.create(context)` 时，才需要自己在合适的时机调用 `field.dispose()`。
