symbols.purpose: Describes an eight-byte little-endian f64 field, initially zero, with independent reactive tracking and Store Light ownership.
symbols.core: Returns Store Light IFieldBuilder with FIELD_BUILDER true, mode StoreFieldMode.sync from @migaia/store-light and synchronous create(context). A sync-only annotation is typeof StoreFieldMode.sync, not the full IStoreFieldMode union that also permits async. After ensureWasm, pass it to createStore; Store Light supplies {runtime,signal,createSource} and owns the field. Creation before readiness fails NOT_INITIALIZED. An aborted context preserves an unclassified native reason in place with INIT_ABORTED, a complete foreign identity unchanged, or an untaggable reason on cause. Reading tracks its source; Object.is-equal writes do nothing. Memory growth refreshes backing views. Disposed value access fails FIELD_DISPOSED. Disposal marks terminal, removes reactive sources then frees allocation. Value is number; typeof checking allows NaN/infinities. Object.is distinguishes signed zero. blocks.text: 所有字段共享同一套生命周期契约（`IDisposable`）：

1. 构造：`ensureWasm()` 已就绪的前提下，调用 `field.create(context)`（通常由 `createStore()` 代为调用）同步完成分配 + 响应式 Source 创建。构造中途任何一步失败（比如 `context.signal` 已经 aborted、内存对齐校验失败），已经分配的内存和已创建的 Source 会被完整回滚，不会半途留下资源。 2. 使用：读写会先检查 `disposed` 状态，已释放的字段继续读写会抛 `Error`（具体信息见 §10）。 3. 释放：`dispose()` 释放底层内存分配、注销 `FinalizationRegistry` 登记、并 dispose 掉自己创建的响应式 Source（`array()`/`record()` 会 dispose 掉全部分桶/全部 key 的 Source）。`dispose()` 本身是幂等的——重复调用直接返回，不会重复释放或抛错。 4. GC 兜底：字段构造成功后会用 `FinalizationRegistry`（运行时不支持时静默跳过，不报错）登记自己，一旦字段对象本身被垃圾回收且从未显式 `dispose()`，注册的回调会异步释放底层分配。这只是防止"忘记 dispose 导致的永久泄漏"的最后一道保险——时机完全不可预测（取决于 GC 何时运行），不能作为常规的资源管理方式，显式 `dispose()`（或让 `store.$dispose()` 代为处理）才是设计上的主路径。
`createStore()` 场景下不需要关心上面第 3 步——Store 会把每个 wasm 字段登记进自己的 disposal scope，`store.$dispose()` 时按 scope 的规则统一释放。只有绕开 Store 直接调用 `builder.create(context)` 时，才需要自己在合适的时机调用 `field.dispose()`。

members.name: notInitialized
members.description: Rejects synchronous field creation or allocation before `ensureWasm()` finishes, or after * initialization fails. First await `ensureWasm()`, or use the `StoreProvider` `ready` barrier to * finish initialization.

members.name: fieldDisposed
members.description: Rejects reads, writes, or other use of a disposed WASM field. Create a new field instead of * reusing it. `detail` identifies the operation.

members.name: initAborted
members.description: Reports field initialization cancelled through an AbortSignal. Preserve an unclassified native * reason by identity/class/stack; complete foreign identities remain with their owner, and other * reasons stay reachable through cause. Handle it as cooperative cancellation.

members.name: reservedFieldName
members.description: Rejects a `wasm.record` field named `dispose` or `disposed`. Choose a different field name.

members.name: allocationFailed
members.description: Reports WASM allocation failure or invalid alignment or memory length. Examples include * `byteLen` exceeding the Wasm32 limit, failed 8-byte alignment, or corrupt stored length. Check * allocation parameters and memory integrity. This is an allocation or memory failure rather than * a logic error.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Rejects invalid field construction or write arguments, including excessive length, invalid * `granularity`, out-of-range indices or ranges, or inaccessible ArrayLike length/items. Keep the * original read failure reachable. Correct the parameter instead of retrying the same invalid * input.

members.name: cleanupFailed
members.description: Reports multiple owned-resource cleanup failures during field release or construction rollback. * Inspect `AggregateError.errors`. It preserves all original cleanup failures in execution * order.

members.name: instancePoisoned
members.description: Rejects allocation after an earlier call into the shared `@migaia/wasm` instance raised * `WebAssembly.RuntimeError` (a trap). A trap can leave the Rust arena borrow held, so every * later export would trap again; the instance is unusable for the rest of the page or process. * `cause` is the original trap. Reload the page or restart the process; retrying cannot succeed.

symbols.purpose: Describes initially empty UTF-8 bytes with fixed capacity plus four-byte length header; capacity never reallocates and oversized writes never truncate.
symbols.core:
maxBytes: Caller UTF-8 byte capacity, default 256; safe integer from 0 through 4294967291. Invalid size throws RangeError INVALID_OPTION at builder construction.
Returns Store Light IFieldBuilder with FIELD_BUILDER true, mode StoreFieldMode.sync from @migaia/store-light and synchronous create(context). A sync-only annotation is typeof StoreFieldMode.sync, not the full IStoreFieldMode union that also permits async. After ensureWasm, pass it to createStore; Store Light supplies {runtime,signal,createSource} and owns the field. Creation before readiness fails NOT_INITIALIZED. An aborted context preserves an unclassified native reason in place with INIT_ABORTED, a complete foreign identity unchanged, or an untaggable reason on cause. Rollback preserves primary and cleanup failures. Direct create requires caller-owned disposal. Field exposes value getter/setter, readonly observed/disposed and idempotent dispose(): void. Reading tracks its source; Object.is-equal writes do nothing. Memory growth refreshes backing views. Disposed value access fails FIELD_DISPOSED. Disposal marks terminal, removes reactive sources then frees allocation. Value is string; TextEncoder byte count determines capacity, not character count. Non-string throws TypeError INVALID_OPTION; overflow throws Error INVALID_OPTION before commit. Reads decode current bytes; corrupt length fails ALLOCATION_FAILED.
parameters: maxBytes: number (optional)
symbols.returns: IFieldBuilder<IWasmStringField>

import { ensureWasm, number, boolean, string, array, record } from '@migaia/store-wasm'

await ensureWasm()

  hp: number(),
  alive: boolean(),
  name: string(64),
  hits: array(1000),
  pos: record({ x: number(), y: number() })
})

store.hp.value = 100
store.alive.value = true
store.name.value = 'boss'
store.hits.setAt(0, 1)
store.pos.x = 10

store.$dispose() // 递归释放上面五个字段各自持有的 WASM 分配

  hp: number(),

store.$dispose() // 递归释放全部五个字段各自持有的 WASM 分配

store.field.value = 'hello'

blocks.code:
const handler = createWorkerHandler(compute, postMessage);

handler.pendingCount; // 0 —— 当前正在处理中的消息数
handler.disposed; // false

await handler(incomingMessage); // 处理一条消息；disposed 时直接返回，静默丢弃

handler.close(); // 同步标记不可用；不执行底层清理
await handler.dispose(); // 先 close()，再等底层端点初始化并 dispose；失败会 reject

items: `handler(message)`：`disposed === true` 时直接返回 `Promise<void>`（resolve），不会处理也不会报错——这是有意的静默丢弃：`close()`/`dispose()` 之后 Worker 可能还会因为消息队列里的残留消息被再调用一次，不应该因此抛错。

`pendingCount`：每次调用 `handler(message)` admission 时 +1，等待 endpoint 并同步交付消息后 -1。它是 inbound dispatch 指标，不代表 provider compute 已完成，也不能作为 `Worker.terminate()` 的 quiescence 门禁；真正的 provider drain/cleanup 由 Web RPC endpoint 拥有，终止前必须等待 `handler.dispose()` 完成。

`close()` vs `dispose()`：`close()` 同步标记 `disposed = true`，只负责"停止接受新消息"，不触发任何用户清理；`dispose()` 是唯一异步释放入口，内部先 `close()`，再等待底层 endpoint 初始化并执行 `endpoint.dispose()`，清理失败时会把错误 reject 出来（错误形态与 `@migaia/rpc-core` 的 `endpoint.dispose()` 一致，是 `RpcLifecycleError`，`cleanupErrors` 字段列出具体哪个资源没清理干净）。两者都是幂等的——`close()` 重复调用是无操作；`dispose()` 多次调用复用同一个 Promise，不会重复触发清理。

`STORE_WORKER_SOURCE`（`'@migaia/store-worker'`）是本包构造错误携带的固定 `source` 值，一般不需要手动引用，除非要用它去过滤/识别本包抛出的错误（例如把它和 `@migaia/rpc/core` 的 `RpcError`——`source: '@migaia/rpc/core'`——区分开）。

blocks.code: import { StoreWorkerErrorCode, createStoreWorkerError, createStoreWorkerAggregateError } from '@migaia/store-worker';

blocks.text: `StoreWorkerErrorCode`｜3 秒上手 —— 稳定错误码表：

全部取值：`invalidOption`(`INVALID_OPTION`)、`adapterDisposed`(`ADAPTER_DISPOSED`)、`requestAborted`(`REQUEST_ABORTED`)、`invalidRequestChunk`(`INVALID_REQUEST_CHUNK`)、`invalidResponseChunk`(`INVALID_RESPONSE_CHUNK`)、`cleanupFailed`(`CLEANUP_FAILED`)。
`createStoreWorkerError`｜5 秒上手：

blocks.code: throw createStoreWorkerError(StoreWorkerErrorCode.invalidOption, '自定义消息');

blocks.text: 签名：`(code: IStoreWorkerErrorCode, message: string, options?: { readonly cause?: unknown }) => Error`，内部经 `attachErrorIdentity` 贴上 `source: '@migaia/store-worker'` 与传入的 `code`。
`createStoreWorkerAggregateError`｜5 秒上手：

blocks.code: throw createStoreWorkerAggregateError(StoreWorkerErrorCode.cleanupFailed, [err1, err2], '清理失败');

blocks.text: 签名：`(code: IStoreWorkerErrorCode, errors: readonly unknown[], message: string) => AggregateError`，`errors` 原样保留在结果的 `errors` 字段。
`STORE_WORKER_SOURCE`(`'@migaia/store-worker'`)是贴在每个本包错误上的固定 `source` 值，用于判定"是否是本包抛出的错误"。

symbols.name: workerComputed
symbols.purpose: Constructs a standard Resource whose fetcher selects input synchronously and sends through the adapter. Input reads before returning establish reactive dependencies. It never disposes the adapter or Worker.
symbols.core:
adapter: WorkerAdapter instance returned by its constructor; the caller retains disposal ownership.
selectInput: Synchronous no-argument callback returning Input for each Resource fetch attempt; may run again on dependency change, refetch or retry. Throws become Resource failure; do not return a Promise.
Resource<Output> from @migaia/resource, including state, refetch(), promise, cancel(), dehydrate/hydrate and dispose(). Canonical resource documentation defines generation cancellation and retry. Dispose it separately, then await adapter.dispose and terminate caller Worker.
debugName: Label shown in reactive diagnostics and in request error context.
Not set: diagnostics show no label.
ttl: Success lifetime in milliseconds; positive finite lifetimes revalidate on an expired read. `0` and `Infinity` disable time expiration, but changed dependencies, including after suspension, still trigger refetching. Must be ≥ 0 or `Infinity`.
`Infinity`: fresh until a dependency changes or `refetch()` is called.
autoStart: Start the first request in the constructor.
`true`: starts immediately unless the initial snapshot is fresh.
staleWhileRevalidate: Keep showing expired success data while the refresh runs (`refreshing` is `true`) instead of switching to `pending`.
`false`: an expired value is replaced by `pending`.
retry: Resource retry policy: a non-negative integer extra-attempt count, or synchronous (failureCount,error) => boolean. failureCount starts at one and error is the original fetch failure. Return true to retry; callback throws or non-boolean/thenable results become Resource failure, without awaiting a Promise.
Zero extra attempts; no automatic retry.
retryDelay: Finite non-negative milliseconds, or synchronous (failureCount,error) => milliseconds for each accepted retry. Receives the one-based count and original failure; callback throws or invalid/non-number/thenable results become Resource failure. A delayed retry remains cancellable through Resource.
Zero milliseconds; retries without a configured delay.
keepAlive: Keep upstream dependencies connected while nothing reads `state`, so changes are still tracked.
`false`: unobserved resources disconnect upstream.
initialSnapshot: Success snapshot from `dehydrate()` (server rendering or persistence) used as the initial state; it is revalidated when expired.
Not set: start from `idle`.
scheduler: IScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler controls Resource TTL and retry clocks; forwarded unchanged to Resource.
systemScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler.
runtime: IRuntime returned by reactive createRuntime; selectInput reads belong to this Resource Runtime. Other-Runtime reads are governed by reactive ownership checks.
Reactive defaultRuntime; pass a request/instance Runtime for isolation.
transfer: Synchronous callback receiving the selected Input and returning readonly native transfer entries for that request; it runs in the Resource fetcher after selectInput. Throws become Resource fetch failures; no Promise result is supported. Transferring may detach caller data and does not guarantee end-to-end zero-copy.
Omitted: no native transfer entries.

blocks.text: 主线程侧的 `ISerializeParser` 实现，`encode`/`decode` 都通过 `send('worker', 'call', { phase, chunk }, ...)` 把工作转发给 Worker：

items: encode：Uint8Array 分类为 bytes，其余为 value。portable RPC 桥把 bytes 编为 base64url，transfer list 另传；显式 transfer 可能 detach backing buffer，但不提供载荷零拷贝保证。
`decode(chunk, context)`：请求 Worker 解码，返回值取自结果段的负载（`result[1]`），调用方拿到的就是还原后的值本身，不是包一层的 `ISerializeChunk`。

`dispose()`：异步 dispose 底层端点，并在 `terminateOnDispose: true` 时继续尝试 `worker.terminate?.()`；两步都会执行。单个 cleanup 失败会被原样 reject，端点与 terminate 都失败时返回 `CLEANUP_FAILED` `AggregateError`，不会吞掉 parser/endpoint/terminate 错误。

blocks.text: `context.signal` 会作为这次 RPC 调用的取消信号透传；调用被取消时，`request` 内部会把泛化的 `AbortError` 重新包装成 `SerializeCodecError`（见 §9），带上 `type`/`phase`/`source`/`chunkIndex`/`bytesConsumed` 这些定位信息，而不是让调用方拿到一个语义模糊的通用 abort 错误。
纯粹是 `{ type, parser: workerParser(options) }` 的包装，产出可以直接塞进 `createSerializeRegistry([...])` 插件数组的标准形状。

blocks.text: `StoreWorkerErrorCode` —— 本包稳定错误码表，配合 `attachErrorIdentity` 贴出来的 `error.code` 字段做 `switch`/比较：
全部取值：

rows: Worker parser/adapter 的 options 在 JavaScript 边界上不是对象，或某个字段类型不对
Worker 适配器已释放（`close()`/`dispose()` 之后）继续调用
Worker 侧的序列化请求被协作式取消（`AbortSignal`）；transfer 请求不证明已发送或 detach，须看实际 buffer
发给 Worker 的请求 chunk 形状非法（`isChunkShape` 校验未通过），协议错误
Worker 返回的 chunk 形状非法，Worker 侧实现错误
释放期间 endpoint 与（可选的）`worker.terminate()` 清理均失败

blocks.text: `createStoreWorkerError(code, message, options?)`：

签名：`(code: IStoreWorkerErrorCode, message: string, options?: { readonly cause?: unknown }) => Error`。构造一个标准 `Error`，`options.cause` 提供时透传给原生 `Error` 的 `cause`；内部经 `@migaia/utils/error` 的 `attachErrorIdentity` 贴上 `source: '@migaia/store-worker'` 与传入的 `code`，不改写 `stack`。
`createStoreWorkerAggregateError(code, errors, message)`：

签名：`(code: IStoreWorkerErrorCode, errors: readonly unknown[], message: string) => AggregateError`。构造 `AggregateError(errors, message)`，`errors` 原样保留在结果的 `errors` 字段（顺序不变），同样贴上 `(source, code)` 身份。包内唯一的实际调用点是 `workerParser().dispose()`——endpoint 清理与 `terminateOnDispose: true` 时的 `worker.terminate()` 若同时失败，两个原始错误都会被保留在 `errors[]` 里，不会只保留其中一个。
`STORE_WORKER_SOURCE`（`'@migaia/store-worker'`）是本包构造错误携带的固定 `source` 值，一般不需要手动引用，除非要用它去过滤/识别本包抛出的错误（例如把它和 `@migaia/rpc/core` 的 `RpcError`——`source: '@migaia/rpc/core'`——区分开）。

symbols.signature:
export declare function createSupervisor<
  TSpec,
  THandle extends IUnitHandle<TExit>,
  TExit,
  TContext extends ILaunchContext = ILaunchContext,
>(
  options: ISupervisorOptions<TSpec, THandle, TExit, TContext>,
): ISupervisor<THandle, TSpec>;
symbols.purpose: Creates a command controller around an application profile, runtime launcher and shared budget. Construction validates policy but does not start execution.
symbols.core:
An `ISupervisor`; invalid configuration throws `INVALID_OPTION`, insufficient required capabilities throw `CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED`.
id: Nonempty stable name chosen by the application for diagnostics and durable process ownership.
report: Application callback receiving each contained launch, health, cleanup or late error; returns void synchronously and must not throw. Late health-check failure remains reported after monitor closure; only the exact abort reason is suppressed, and passive failures retain the original object.
ready: Optional asynchronous handshake receiving the launched handle and attempt cancellation signal; resolve to admit readiness, reject or throw to fail startup.
Absent: launch completion is readiness.
startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.
`10000` milliseconds for each attempt.
restart: Automatic restart policy for classified exits; nested fields control mode, backoff and the failure window.
An empty policy uses the nested defaults below.
restart.mode: Chooses which actual exits schedule an automatic restart; manual restart remains available.
`on-failure`; normal completion stops.
restart.initialDelayMs: Finite nonnegative first restart delay in scheduler milliseconds.
`250` milliseconds before the first retry.
restart.factor: Finite multiplier of successive restart delays; must be at least one.
`2`; each failure doubles the delay until its cap.
restart.maxDelayMs: Finite nonnegative upper bound of exponential retry delay in milliseconds.
`30000` milliseconds caps backoff.
restart.maxRestarts: Nonnegative safe integer controlling failures admitted in one sliding restart window.
`5` failures before exhaustion.
restart.windowMs: Finite nonnegative scheduler window for counting recent failures.
`60000` milliseconds of failure history.
terminalPolicy: After exhaustion, keeps terminal admission closed or schedules an explicit cooldown.
Absent: remain terminal until explicit restart.
terminalPolicy.mode: Selects a terminal wait until explicit restart or a timed cooldown retry after exhaustion; only disposal permanently closes the supervisor.
terminalPolicy.afterMs: Finite nonnegative cooldown duration required only for the cooldown policy.
stop: Ordered application drain, graceful exit and forced reap phases for each retiring unit.
Absent: each phase uses its nested default.
stop.beforeTerminate: Asynchronous application drain receiving handle, native cancellation signal and remainingMs getter; resolve when drained. Failure is reported and termination proceeds.
Absent: skip application draining work.
stop.drainTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative maximum application drain time; a command graceMs overrides this phase only.
`5000` milliseconds for application drain.
stop.exitTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative wait for actual graceful exit before requesting force.
`5000` milliseconds before force.
stop.reapTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative recovery wait after force; a timed-out unit keeps its lease until actual exit.
`5000` milliseconds of forced recovery.
health: Serial periodic checks for ready handles; consecutive failures invalidate the generation.
Absent: no health monitor is installed.
health.check: Application asynchronous check receiving the current handle and cancellation signal; resolve if healthy, reject or throw to count failure.
health.intervalMs: Finite positive interval between serial checks, measured by the scheduler.
`5000` milliseconds between checks.
health.timeoutMs: Finite nonnegative deadline for one health check before recording failure.
`2000` milliseconds for one check.
health.failureThreshold: Nonnegative safe integer threshold of consecutive failed checks that invalidates readiness.
`3` consecutive failures invalidate the unit.
isolation: Required admission accepts enforced or monitored capabilities; best effort records weaker guarantees as degradation.
`required`; insufficient capabilities fail construction.
requires: Additional capability names chosen by the application, merged with profile requirements before admission.
An empty list adds no capability requirements.
scheduler: Monotonic clock and timers supplied by the application; see `IScheduler` in `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
`systemScheduler`; uses the host timers.
launcher: Runtime adapter supplied by the application; its launch result must settle exited only after execution and resources stop.
spec: Initial application specification validated by the selected unit profile before admission.
budget: Shared matching-kind budget returned by `createUnitBudget`; actual exit releases its occupied lease.
profile: Application-supplied `IUnitProfile` owns validation, required capabilities, termination and exit classification.
hooks: Optional `ISupervisionHooks` supplied by the outer adapter for adoption, attachment and diagnostics.
Absent: no adapter extension hooks run.
parameters: options: ISupervisorOptions<TSpec, THandle, TExit, TContext>
symbols.returns: ISupervisor<THandle, TSpec>

symbols.name: createUnitBudget
symbols.purpose: Creates a shared runtime-neutral capacity and launch-rate budget. Pair with createSupervisor or profile constructors; retain leases until actual unit exit.
symbols.core:
An `IUnitBudget`; invalid numeric limits or parent-kind mismatch throw coded `INVALID_OPTION` before admission starts.
kind: Choose which kind of work this budget counts: processes, threads or coroutines, where a coroutine is a task running within the current runtime. Set kind when creating the budget so unrelated resource types do not share capacity. If parent is supplied, its kind must match; a mismatch makes construction throw TypeError.
maxUnits: Finite nonnegative integer local concurrency cap; zero admits no unit.
overflow: Explicit reject refuses full capacity immediately; queue waits in FIFO order.
Omitted: queues in the current implementation; set reject explicitly for immediate refusal.
queueTimeoutMs: Finite positive scheduler deadline for a queued acquisition; expiry is a queue-timeout result.
`30000` milliseconds for each acquisition.
launchRate: Sliding grant rate independent of concurrent capacity; false disables rate limiting.
`{ max: 8, windowMs: 1000 }` grants eight leases per second.
Disable launch-rate limiting while retaining concurrency limits.
launchRate.max: Positive integer maximum successful grants in one sliding launch-rate window.
launchRate.windowMs: Finite positive scheduler length of the sliding grant-rate window.
parent: Optional matching-kind budget obtained from another createUnitBudget call; the lease composes both slots.
Absent: only local admission is applied.
scheduler: Monotonic clock and timers supplied by the application; see `IScheduler` in `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
`systemScheduler`; uses the host timers.
parameters: options: IUnitBudgetOptions<TKind>

symbols.purpose: Reasons attached to exit events and last-exit diagnostics. Values are stable public contract identifiers; use the matching table entries below.
symbols.core:
exited: The profile classified natural completion as successful.
crashed: The profile observed an unsuccessful execution result.
stopped: A normal stop retired the active execution unit.
killed: A force command requested immediate unit termination.
abandoned: Bounded recovery ended before actual exit was observed.
launchFailed: Launching, attachment or readiness failed with a cause.
startupTimeout: Launch or readiness exceeded the startup deadline.
unhealthy: Repeated health checks invalidated the ready generation.
resourceViolation: A monitored or native resource limit was exceeded.

symbols.name: ISupervisorBaseOptions
symbols.purpose: Shared readiness, restart, drain and health policy used by every execution profile.
symbols.core:
id: Nonempty stable name chosen by the application for diagnostics and durable process ownership.
report: Application callback receiving each contained launch, health, cleanup or late error; returns void synchronously and must not throw. Late health-check failure remains reported after monitor closure; only the exact abort reason is suppressed, and passive failures retain the original object.
ready: Optional asynchronous handshake receiving the launched handle and attempt cancellation signal; resolve to admit readiness, reject or throw to fail startup.
Absent: launch completion is readiness.
startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.
`10000` milliseconds for each attempt.
restart: Automatic restart policy for classified exits; nested fields control mode, backoff and the failure window.
An empty policy uses the nested defaults below.
restart.mode: Chooses which actual exits schedule an automatic restart; manual restart remains available.
`on-failure`; normal completion stops.
restart.initialDelayMs: Finite nonnegative first restart delay in scheduler milliseconds.
`250` milliseconds before the first retry.
restart.factor: Finite multiplier of successive restart delays; must be at least one.
`2`; each failure doubles the delay until its cap.
restart.maxDelayMs: Finite nonnegative upper bound of exponential retry delay in milliseconds.
`30000` milliseconds caps backoff.
restart.maxRestarts: Nonnegative safe integer controlling failures admitted in one sliding restart window.
`5` failures before exhaustion.
restart.windowMs: Finite nonnegative scheduler window for counting recent failures.
`60000` milliseconds of failure history.
terminalPolicy: After exhaustion, keeps terminal admission closed or schedules an explicit cooldown.

symbols.name: SupervisionErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Stable semantic errors from supervisor construction and contained execution failures. Values are stable public contract identifiers; use the matching table entries below.
symbols.core:
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION`: invalid constructor, specification or command option; correct the named field before retrying.
capabilityUnsupported: `CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED`: required capability lacks a sufficient guarantee; change launcher or isolation policy.
launchFailed: LAUNCH_FAILED: preacquisition, launch, attachment or readiness failed. An acquireUnit failure before lease acquisition still returns a controlled failed readiness outcome and follows the configured failure policy; inspect phase and preserved cause.
startupTimeout: STARTUP_TIMEOUT: startup missed its deadline. Bounded retirement advances to the configured backoff, stopped or terminal policy without leaking a temporary terminal event or leaving starting stuck; readiness receives a stable failed result.
exitUnexpected: `EXIT_UNEXPECTED`: unexpected actual exit; inspect native status and original cause.
unhealthy: `UNHEALTHY`: health failures crossed the threshold; the generation is invalidated.
resourceLimitExceeded: `RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: resource monitoring observed a limit breach; inspect the limit detail.
reapTimeout: `REAP_TIMEOUT`: recovery deadline ended before actual exit; the lease remains occupied.
supervisionExhausted: `SUPERVISION_EXHAUSTED`: restart window exhausted; inspect terminal error before explicit restart.
scopeClosed: `SCOPE_CLOSED`: a unit-producing command ran during disposal; wait for completion.
scopeTerminal: `SCOPE_TERMINAL`: a unit-producing command ran after disposal; create a new supervisor.
heartbeatMissed: `HEARTBEAT_MISSED`: a coroutine heartbeat became stale; inspect cooperative task progress.
orphanReclaimFailed: ORPHAN_RECLAIM_FAILED: registry listing or a per-record probe/termination/removal failed. Listing failure is collected and reported with detail.step=list and original cause; no record is touched. Failed records remain available for retry.

ready: Optional asynchronous handshake receiving the launched handle and attempt cancellation signal; resolve to admit readiness, reject or throw to fail startup.
Absent: launch completion is readiness.
startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.

`on-failure`; normal completion stops.

`250` milliseconds before the first retry.
restart.factor: Finite multiplier of successive restart delays; must be at least one.

restart.maxDelayMs: Finite nonnegative upper bound of exponential retry delay in milliseconds.

restart.maxRestarts: Nonnegative safe integer controlling failures admitted in one sliding restart window.
`5` failures before exhaustion.

terminalPolicy: After exhaustion, keeps terminal admission closed or schedules an explicit cooldown.

stop: Ordered application drain, graceful exit and forced reap phases for each retiring unit.

configuration.description: `replace({ strategy: 'start-then-switch' })` needs a budget with room for two concurrent units. The old port stays usable until the candidate is ready and the `switched` event fires; then the old task receives cancellation. `replace({ spec })` validates the new specification before touching the active unit. configuration.name: budget
configuration.description: Cooperative termination depends on the task settling. A task that ignores cancellation can outlive the 5 second reap deadline. The supervisor reports `REAP_TIMEOUT`, records `abandoned`, and retains its budget lease until the task actually exits. It cannot preempt a synchronous loop or isolate a crash from the event loop. The `fault-isolation` capability is therefore `unsupported`; requests for it are rejected under the default `isolation: 'required'` policy.

The `fault-isolation` capability is therefore `unsupported`; requests for it are rejected under the default `isolation: 'required'` policy.

symbols.name: ICoroutineSupervisorOptions
symbols.purpose: Cooperative task policy with optional heartbeat monitoring; heartbeat and health cannot coexist.
symbols.core:
id: Nonempty stable name chosen by the application for diagnostics and durable process ownership.
report: Application callback receiving each contained launch, health, cleanup or late error; returns void synchronously and must not throw. Late health-check failure remains reported after monitor closure; only the exact abort reason is suppressed, and passive failures retain the original object.
ready: Optional asynchronous handshake receiving the launched handle and attempt cancellation signal; resolve to admit readiness, reject or throw to fail startup.
Absent: launch completion is readiness.
startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.
`10000` milliseconds for each attempt.
restart: Automatic restart policy for classified exits; nested fields control mode, backoff and the failure window.
An empty policy uses the nested defaults below.
restart.mode: Chooses which actual exits schedule an automatic restart; manual restart remains available.
`on-failure`; normal completion stops.
restart.initialDelayMs: Finite nonnegative first restart delay in scheduler milliseconds.
`250` milliseconds before the first retry.
restart.factor: Finite multiplier of successive restart delays; must be at least one.
`2`; each failure doubles the delay until its cap.
restart.maxDelayMs: Finite nonnegative upper bound of exponential retry delay in milliseconds.
`30000` milliseconds caps backoff.
restart.maxRestarts: Nonnegative safe integer controlling failures admitted in one sliding restart window.
`5` failures before exhaustion.
restart.windowMs: Finite nonnegative scheduler window for counting recent failures.
`60000` milliseconds of failure history.
terminalPolicy: After exhaustion, keeps terminal admission closed or schedules an explicit cooldown.
Absent: remain terminal until explicit restart.
terminalPolicy.mode: Selects a terminal wait until explicit restart or a timed cooldown retry after exhaustion; only disposal permanently closes the supervisor.
terminalPolicy.afterMs: Finite nonnegative cooldown duration required only for the cooldown policy.
stop: Ordered application drain, graceful exit and forced reap phases for each retiring unit.
Absent: each phase uses its nested default.
stop.beforeTerminate: Asynchronous application drain receiving handle, native cancellation signal and remainingMs getter; resolve when drained. Failure is reported and termination proceeds.
Absent: skip application draining work.
stop.drainTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative maximum application drain time; a command graceMs overrides this phase only.
`5000` milliseconds for application drain.
stop.exitTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative wait for actual graceful exit before requesting force.
`5000` milliseconds before force.
stop.reapTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative recovery wait after force; a timed-out unit keeps its lease until actual exit.
`5000` milliseconds of forced recovery.
health: Serial periodic checks for ready handles; consecutive failures invalidate the generation.
Absent: no health monitor is installed.
health.check: Application asynchronous check receiving the current handle and cancellation signal; resolve if healthy, reject or throw to count failure.
health.intervalMs: Finite positive interval between serial checks, measured by the scheduler.

id: Nonempty stable name chosen by the application for diagnostics and durable process ownership.
report: Application callback receiving each contained launch, health, cleanup or late error; returns void synchronously and must not throw. Late health-check failure remains reported after monitor closure; only the exact abort reason is suppressed, and passive failures retain the original object.
ready: Optional asynchronous handshake receiving the launched handle and attempt cancellation signal; resolve to admit readiness, reject or throw to fail startup.
Absent: launch completion is readiness.
startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.

restart: Automatic restart policy for classified exits; nested fields control mode, backoff and the failure window.

restart.initialDelayMs: Finite nonnegative first restart delay in scheduler milliseconds.

restart.factor: Finite multiplier of successive restart delays; must be at least one.

restart.maxDelayMs: Finite nonnegative upper bound of exponential retry delay in milliseconds.

restart.maxRestarts: Nonnegative safe integer controlling failures admitted in one sliding restart window.

restart.windowMs: Finite nonnegative scheduler window for counting recent failures.

terminalPolicy: After exhaustion, keeps terminal admission closed or schedules an explicit cooldown.

stop: Ordered application drain, graceful exit and forced reap phases for each retiring unit.

requires: Additional capability names chosen by the application, merged with profile requirements before admission.

scheduler: Monotonic clock and timers supplied by the application; see `IScheduler` in `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
`systemScheduler`; uses the host timers.
spec: Initial application specification validated by the selected unit profile before admission.
budget: Shared matching-kind budget returned by `createUnitBudget`; actual exit releases its occupied lease.
heartbeat: Optional heartbeat-age watchdog observing task progress rather than native health.

`1`; the first stale observation fails.

startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.

configuration.name: launcher
configuration.description: For durable recovery, inject a registry and call `reclaimOrphanProcesses` before creating a supervisor or pool. Recovery terminates only a record whose fingerprint still matches; reused pids are removed without termination. Each failed record stays available for another attempt. An optional prewarm pool uses the same budget, launcher and specification objects as its supervisor. It starts idle units but the supervisor still performs readiness after taking one. `restart()` and `replace()` bypass stale idle units. When pool and supervisor use the same id, registry port and namespace, adoption reuses the exact warm durable record and its actual-exit cleanup. Distinct owners register their own records. Output sink exceptions during buffered replay or live forwarding are reported without stopping delivery. A registry list failure is collected and reported as ORPHAN_RECLAIM_FAILED with detail.step set to list; no record is touched.
configuration.descriptionEn: For durable recovery, inject a registry and call `reclaimOrphanProcesses` before creating a supervisor or pool. Recovery terminates only a record whose fingerprint still matches; reused pids are removed without termination. Each failed record stays available for another attempt. An optional prewarm pool uses the same budget, launcher and specification objects as its supervisor. It starts idle units but the supervisor still performs readiness after taking one. `restart()` and `replace()` bypass stale idle units. When pool and supervisor use the same id, registry port and namespace, adoption reuses the exact warm durable record and its actual-exit cleanup. Distinct owners register their own records. Output sink exceptions during buffered replay or live forwarding are reported without stopping delivery. A registry list failure is collected and reported as ORPHAN_RECLAIM_FAILED with detail.step set to list; no record is touched.

configuration.name: spec
configuration.description: `@migaia/supervision/process` is a platform-neutral contract. Supply an adapter whose `launch(spec, context)` starts without a shell, transfers only the named `env.inherit` keys plus `env.set`, drains every `drain` stream from startup through `context.output`, and fulfills `handle.exited` only after the unit and adapter-owned resources have closed. The adapter must generate a fingerprint that changes across pid reuse, terminate the declared process tree idempotently, and report capability strengths honestly. The profile itself never calls a platform spawn API.

The adapter must generate a fingerprint that changes across pid reuse, terminate the declared process tree idempotently, and report capability strengths honestly. The profile itself never calls a platform spawn API.

id: Application identifier supplied at pool construction.

budget: The process-capacity budget supplied to the pool. Each idle process occupies one slot, represented by a lease: an object that records and later releases that capacity. launcher: The runtime adapter that actually starts the pool processes. Its launch() result supplies an exited Promise, which must complete only after execution and associated resources have stopped. idle: Current number of ready idle entries still owned by the pool.
take: Synchronously transfers one ready idle entry and its occupied lease to the caller.

invalidate: Retires owned idle entries; already transferred entries remain owned by their consumers.
Idle entries begin retirement without synchronously awaiting actual exit.
dispose: Permanently closes the pool and awaits bounded teardown of every remaining owned entry.
Resolves after owned idle entries finish bounded retirement.

`10000` milliseconds for each attempt.
scheduler: Monotonic clock and timers supplied by the application; see `IScheduler` in `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
`systemScheduler`; uses the host timers.
launcher: Runtime adapter supplied by the application; its launch result must settle exited only after execution and resources stop.
spec: Initial application specification validated by the selected unit profile before admission.
budget: Shared matching-kind budget returned by `createUnitBudget`; actual exit releases its occupied lease.
registry: Application durable record port and namespace for recovering prior-run process identities.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
id: Nonempty stable name chosen by the application for diagnostics and durable process ownership.
report: Application callback receiving each contained launch, health, cleanup or late error; returns void synchronously and must not throw. Late health-check failure remains reported after monitor closure; only the exact abort reason is suppressed, and passive failures retain the original object.
isolation: Required admission accepts enforced or monitored capabilities; best effort records weaker guarantees as degradation.
`required`; insufficient capabilities fail construction.
requires: Additional capability names chosen by the application, merged with profile requirements before admission.
An empty list adds no capability requirements.
startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.
`10000` milliseconds for each attempt.
scheduler: Monotonic clock and timers supplied by the application; see `IScheduler` in `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
`systemScheduler`; uses the host timers.
launcher: Runtime adapter supplied by the application; its launch result must settle exited only after execution and resources stop.
spec: Initial application specification validated by the selected unit profile before admission.
budget: Shared matching-kind budget returned by `createUnitBudget`; actual exit releases its occupied lease.
registry: Application durable record port and namespace for recovering prior-run process identities.
Absent: no durable records or orphan recovery.
registry.port: Application storage implementing `IProcessRegistry`; add and removal follow actual process ownership.
registry.namespace: Application chosen isolation name; recovery lists only records in this namespace.
usage: Native resource sampling policy used when process memory or CPU limits are monitored.
Absent: samples use interval and threshold defaults.
usage.intervalMs: Finite positive scheduler interval for native process resource samples. Both supervisor and prewarm pool reject zero/nonfinite intervals and nonpositive or unsafe failure thresholds as RangeError/INVALID_OPTION.
`1000` milliseconds between samples.
usage.failureThreshold: Positive safe-integer count of consecutive sampleUsage rejections before the process is unhealthy. A successful sample resets this count; a successful sample exceeding a monitored limit terminates immediately.
`3` consecutive sampleUsage rejections, not three successful over-limit samples.
wallClock: Epoch clock supplied by the application for durable launch timestamps; not used for deadlines.
`systemWallClock`; uses host epoch time.
size: Nonnegative integer target of ready idle processes, each retaining one shared budget lease.
idleTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative maximum idle retention before an unused prewarm handle is retired; zero expires immediately.
`60000` milliseconds of idle retention.
exitTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative wait for actual graceful exit before requesting force.
`5000` milliseconds before force.
reapTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative recovery wait after force; a timed-out unit keeps its lease until actual exit.
`5000` milliseconds of forced recovery.

symbols.purpose: Application-owned shared admission budget; closing admission does not release live leases.
symbols.core:
kind: Unit kind chosen at budget construction; parent and supervisor kinds must match it.
acquire: Requests a FIFO lease respecting capacity, rate, parent and cancellation. It reserves local capacity before waiting for the parent; reservation is not a started unit. Refusal is data and composite release returns parent before child.
acquire.signal: Optional caller cancellation signal; aborted requests return the aborted reason.
An `IBudgetOutcome`; granted leases must be released after actual exit.
tryAcquire: Attempts immediate admission without joining the wait queue; existing queued callers have precedence.
A synchronous granted lease or stable rejection reason.
inUse: Number of occupied local unit leases; queued requests are counted separately.
pending: Unresolved acquire calls including the active FIFO queue head.
closed: Whether admission has permanently closed; existing occupied leases remain valid.
close: Rejects waiting and future acquisitions; existing leases remain occupied until their owners release them.
Admission is closed; repeated close calls have no further effect.

symbols.name: IProcessSupervisorOptions
symbols.purpose: Process profile construction with optional usage monitoring, output tails, registry and prewarm adoption.
symbols.core:
id: Nonempty stable name chosen by the application for diagnostics and durable process ownership.
report: Application callback receiving each contained launch, health, cleanup or late error; returns void synchronously and must not throw. Late health-check failure remains reported after monitor closure; only the exact abort reason is suppressed, and passive failures retain the original object.
ready: Optional asynchronous handshake receiving the launched handle and attempt cancellation signal; resolve to admit readiness, reject or throw to fail startup.
Absent: launch completion is readiness.
startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.
`10000` milliseconds for each attempt.
restart: Automatic restart policy for classified exits; nested fields control mode, backoff and the failure window.
An empty policy uses the nested defaults below.
restart.mode: Chooses which actual exits schedule an automatic restart; manual restart remains available.
`on-failure`; normal completion stops.
restart.initialDelayMs: Finite nonnegative first restart delay in scheduler milliseconds.
`250` milliseconds before the first retry.
restart.factor: Finite multiplier of successive restart delays; must be at least one.
`2`; each failure doubles the delay until its cap.
restart.maxDelayMs: Finite nonnegative upper bound of exponential retry delay in milliseconds.
`30000` milliseconds caps backoff.
restart.maxRestarts: Nonnegative safe integer controlling failures admitted in one sliding restart window.
`5` failures before exhaustion.
restart.windowMs: Finite nonnegative scheduler window for counting recent failures.
`60000` milliseconds of failure history.
terminalPolicy: After exhaustion, keeps terminal admission closed or schedules an explicit cooldown.
Absent: remain terminal until explicit restart.
terminalPolicy.mode: Selects a terminal wait until explicit restart or a timed cooldown retry after exhaustion; only disposal permanently closes the supervisor.
terminalPolicy.afterMs: Finite nonnegative cooldown duration required only for the cooldown policy.
stop: Ordered application drain, graceful exit and forced reap phases for each retiring unit.
Absent: each phase uses its nested default.
stop.beforeTerminate: Asynchronous application drain receiving handle, native cancellation signal and remainingMs getter; resolve when drained. Failure is reported and termination proceeds.
Absent: skip application draining work.
stop.drainTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative maximum application drain time; a command graceMs overrides this phase only.
`5000` milliseconds for application drain.
stop.exitTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative wait for actual graceful exit before requesting force.
`5000` milliseconds before force.
stop.reapTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative recovery wait after force; a timed-out unit keeps its lease until actual exit.
`5000` milliseconds of forced recovery.
health: Serial periodic checks for ready handles; consecutive failures invalidate the generation.
Absent: no health monitor is installed.
health.check: Application asynchronous check receiving the current handle and cancellation signal; resolve if healthy, reject or throw to count failure.
health.intervalMs: Finite positive interval between serial checks, measured by the scheduler.
`5000` milliseconds between checks.
health.timeoutMs: Finite nonnegative deadline for one health check before recording failure.
`2000` milliseconds for one check.
health.failureThreshold: Nonnegative safe integer threshold of consecutive failed checks that invalidates readiness.
`3` consecutive failures invalidate the unit.
isolation: Required admission accepts enforced or monitored capabilities; best effort records weaker guarantees as degradation.
`required`; insufficient capabilities fail construction.
requires: Additional capability names chosen by the application, merged with profile requirements before admission.
An empty list adds no capability requirements.
scheduler: Monotonic clock and timers supplied by the application; see `IScheduler` in `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
`systemScheduler`; uses the host timers.
launcher: Runtime adapter supplied by the application; its launch result must settle exited only after execution and resources stop.
spec: Initial application specification validated by the selected unit profile before admission.
budget: Shared matching-kind budget returned by `createUnitBudget`; actual exit releases its occupied lease.
usage: Native resource sampling policy used when process memory or CPU limits are monitored.
Absent: samples use interval and threshold defaults.
usage.intervalMs: Finite positive scheduler interval for native process resource samples. Both supervisor and prewarm pool reject zero/nonfinite intervals and nonpositive or unsafe failure thresholds as RangeError/INVALID_OPTION.
`1000` milliseconds between samples.
usage.failureThreshold: Positive safe-integer count of consecutive sampleUsage rejections before the process is unhealthy. A successful sample resets this count; a successful sample exceeding a monitored limit terminates immediately.
`3` consecutive sampleUsage rejections, not three successful over-limit samples.
output: Bounds diagnostic stdout and stderr tails while launchers continue draining regardless of observers.
Absent: retain bounded tails without a chunk observer.
output.tailBytes: Positive safe-integer maximum bytes retained separately per output stream; zero is invalid and does not disable tail capture.
`65536` bytes for each stream.
output.onChunk: Synchronous observer receives stream label and drained bytes; returns void and does not own draining. Throws are reported.
Absent: only bounded diagnostic tails are retained.
registry: Application durable record port and namespace for recovering prior-run process identities.
Absent: no durable records or orphan recovery.
registry.port: Application storage implementing `IProcessRegistry`; add and removal follow actual process ownership.
registry.namespace: Application chosen isolation name; recovery lists only records in this namespace.
prewarm: Pool from createPrewarmPool with matching budget, launcher and spec; transfers the idle handle and lease. Matching id, registry port and namespace reuse the exact warm durable record and its actual-exit cleanup; different owners create their own records.
Absent: launch every admitted process cold.
wallClock: Epoch clock supplied by the application for durable launch timestamps; not used for deadlines.
`systemWallClock`; uses host epoch time.

An `IThreadSupervisor`; invalid specification or unsupported isolation fails before native launch.
id: Nonempty stable name chosen by the application for diagnostics and durable process ownership.
report: Application callback receiving each contained launch, health, cleanup or late error; returns void synchronously and must not throw. Late health-check failure remains reported after monitor closure; only the exact abort reason is suppressed, and passive failures retain the original object.
ready: Optional asynchronous handshake receiving the launched handle and attempt cancellation signal; resolve to admit readiness, reject or throw to fail startup.
Absent: launch completion is readiness.
startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.
`10000` milliseconds for each attempt.
restart: Automatic restart policy for classified exits; nested fields control mode, backoff and the failure window.
An empty policy uses the nested defaults below.
restart.mode: Chooses which actual exits schedule an automatic restart; manual restart remains available.
`on-failure`; normal completion stops.
restart.initialDelayMs: Finite nonnegative first restart delay in scheduler milliseconds.
`250` milliseconds before the first retry.
restart.factor: Finite multiplier of successive restart delays; must be at least one.
`2`; each failure doubles the delay until its cap.
restart.maxDelayMs: Finite nonnegative upper bound of exponential retry delay in milliseconds.
`30000` milliseconds caps backoff.
restart.maxRestarts: Nonnegative safe integer controlling failures admitted in one sliding restart window.
`5` failures before exhaustion.
restart.windowMs: Finite nonnegative scheduler window for counting recent failures.
`60000` milliseconds of failure history.
terminalPolicy: After exhaustion, keeps terminal admission closed or schedules an explicit cooldown.
Absent: remain terminal until explicit restart.
terminalPolicy.mode: Selects a terminal wait until explicit restart or a timed cooldown retry after exhaustion; only disposal permanently closes the supervisor.
terminalPolicy.afterMs: Finite nonnegative cooldown duration required only for the cooldown policy.
stop: Ordered application drain, graceful exit and forced reap phases for each retiring unit.
Absent: each phase uses its nested default.
stop.beforeTerminate: Asynchronous application drain receiving handle, native cancellation signal and remainingMs getter; resolve when drained. Failure is reported and termination proceeds.
Absent: skip application draining work.
stop.drainTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative maximum application drain time; a command graceMs overrides this phase only.
`5000` milliseconds for application drain.
stop.exitTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative wait for actual graceful exit before requesting force.
`5000` milliseconds before force.
stop.reapTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative recovery wait after force; a timed-out unit keeps its lease until actual exit.

health: Serial periodic checks for ready handles; consecutive failures invalidate the generation.

health.check: Application asynchronous check receiving the current handle and cancellation signal; resolve if healthy, reject or throw to count failure.
health.intervalMs: Finite positive interval between serial checks, measured by the scheduler.

health.timeoutMs: Finite nonnegative deadline for one health check before recording failure.

symbols.name: IThreadSupervisorOptions
symbols.purpose: Native worker construction policy sharing the core readiness and lifecycle commands.
symbols.core:
id: Nonempty stable name chosen by the application for diagnostics and durable process ownership.
report: Application callback receiving each contained launch, health, cleanup or late error; returns void synchronously and must not throw. Late health-check failure remains reported after monitor closure; only the exact abort reason is suppressed, and passive failures retain the original object.
ready: Optional asynchronous handshake receiving the launched handle and attempt cancellation signal; resolve to admit readiness, reject or throw to fail startup.
Absent: launch completion is readiness.
startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.
`10000` milliseconds for each attempt.
restart: Automatic restart policy for classified exits; nested fields control mode, backoff and the failure window.
An empty policy uses the nested defaults below.
restart.mode: Chooses which actual exits schedule an automatic restart; manual restart remains available.
`on-failure`; normal completion stops.
restart.initialDelayMs: Finite nonnegative first restart delay in scheduler milliseconds.
`250` milliseconds before the first retry.
restart.factor: Finite multiplier of successive restart delays; must be at least one.
`2`; each failure doubles the delay until its cap.
restart.maxDelayMs: Finite nonnegative upper bound of exponential retry delay in milliseconds.
`30000` milliseconds caps backoff.
restart.maxRestarts: Nonnegative safe integer controlling failures admitted in one sliding restart window.
`5` failures before exhaustion.
restart.windowMs: Finite nonnegative scheduler window for counting recent failures.
`60000` milliseconds of failure history.
terminalPolicy: After exhaustion, keeps terminal admission closed or schedules an explicit cooldown.
Absent: remain terminal until explicit restart.
terminalPolicy.mode: Selects a terminal wait until explicit restart or a timed cooldown retry after exhaustion; only disposal permanently closes the supervisor.
terminalPolicy.afterMs: Finite nonnegative cooldown duration required only for the cooldown policy.
stop: Ordered application drain, graceful exit and forced reap phases for each retiring unit.
Absent: each phase uses its nested default.
stop.beforeTerminate: Asynchronous application drain receiving handle, native cancellation signal and remainingMs getter; resolve when drained. Failure is reported and termination proceeds.
Absent: skip application draining work.
stop.drainTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative maximum application drain time; a command graceMs overrides this phase only.
`5000` milliseconds for application drain.
stop.exitTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative wait for actual graceful exit before requesting force.
`5000` milliseconds before force.
stop.reapTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative recovery wait after force; a timed-out unit keeps its lease until actual exit.
`5000` milliseconds of forced recovery.
health: Serial periodic checks for ready handles; consecutive failures invalidate the generation.
Absent: no health monitor is installed.
health.check: Application asynchronous check receiving the current handle and cancellation signal; resolve if healthy, reject or throw to count failure.
health.intervalMs: Finite positive interval between serial checks, measured by the scheduler.
`5000` milliseconds between checks.
health.timeoutMs: Finite nonnegative deadline for one health check before recording failure.
`2000` milliseconds for one check.
health.failureThreshold: Nonnegative safe integer threshold of consecutive failed checks that invalidates readiness.
`3` consecutive failures invalidate the unit.
isolation: Required admission accepts enforced or monitored capabilities; best effort records weaker guarantees as degradation.
`required`; insufficient capabilities fail construction.
requires: Additional capability names chosen by the application, merged with profile requirements before admission.

scheduler: Monotonic clock and timers supplied by the application; see `IScheduler` in `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
`systemScheduler`; uses the host timers.
launcher: Runtime adapter supplied by the application; its launch result must settle exited only after execution and resources stop.
spec: Initial application specification validated by the selected unit profile before admission.
budget: Shared matching-kind budget returned by `createUnitBudget`; actual exit releases its occupied lease.

blocks.text: `defineTrayHost(definition)` 返回冻结且带身份标记的 `ITrayHost<TName, TConfig, TPlugins, TExposes, TRouting>`。必填字段为 `name`、 `plugins(instance, trayPlugin)` 与 `exposes`；定义阶段不调用插件工厂或配置验证器。 `exposes` 是只读的 `plugin.feature` 路径数组；方法调用使用 `plugin.feature.method`。 结构复制品不具备原定义的身份，不能传给 registry 或 `instance()`。

rows: thread / process 必填；coroutine 禁止
每次初始化时验证并转换配置，输出交给 `plugins`
仅 process 可用；包含 `name` 与同步 `wrap(command)`
声明子实例插件可用的 policy；父端把它并入 registry 注册集，子端经 `deps.tray.routing` 调用（见 Routing）

blocks.text: `supervisor.restart.mode` 接收 `'never' | 'on-failure' | 'always'`。 `sandbox.wrap` 的输入与输出均为 RPC Process 的 `IProcessLaunchCommand`： `{ command, args, cwd?, env }`；返回完整的新命令，保留所需环境与工作目录。

`createTray({ hosts, routing?, probe?, report? })` 返回 `ITray<THosts, TRouting>`。 `hosts` 是必填的定义只读数组；`routing` 是可选的共享 policy 只读数组，与各 host DSL 的 `routing` 合并注册，构成 `tray.routing` 命名空间（见 Routing）。 `probe` 的类型为 `IRpcProbe | readonly IRpcProbe[]`；`report(error: unknown): void` 接收运行与清理诊断，默认使用 `console.error`。

`serveTrayHost(host, { probe?, report? })` 返回 `Promise<void>`。它只接受本 realm 导入的可信 thread / process 定义；coroutine 由 registry 的任务运行器服务。 `probe` 与 `report` 使用上述相同类型，默认 reporter 也是 `console.error`。 Worker 或子进程入口与父 registry 应导入同一个定义模块。下面的 `hosts.ts` 定义 Worker Host：
`worker.ts` 编译后连接父 registry：

blocks.code:
import { serveTrayHost } from '@migaia/tray'
import { worker } from './hosts.js'

await serveTrayHost(worker)

entry 只连接父 registry，不再 spawn。Bun/Deno 与 browser Worker 尚未验证。

items: 省略 runtime 使用 `coroutine`：共享事件循环，适合轻量 I/O host，停止是合作式的。
`thread` 使用独立 Worker isolate，必须提供 entry，可设置 `limits.heapBytes`。
`process` 使用子进程，必须提供 entry，可设置 `sandbox: { name, wrap }` 接入外部沙箱。
Node Worker/process entry 导入共享 host 定义后执行 `await serveTrayHost(host)`；

blocks.text: `defineTrayHost` 的必填字段是 `name`、`plugins` 与 `exposes`。`exposes` 使用 `plugin.feature` 路径，remote 调用使用 `plugin.feature.method` 路径。 可选 `config(input)` 在每次实例初始化时验证配置；`supervisor` 接收 `restart: { mode, maxRestarts, windowMs, initialDelayMs }` 与 `startupTimeoutMs`。 `entry` 接收 `string | URL`，仅适用于 `thread` / `process`； `limits: { heapBytes }` 仅适用于 `thread`，`sandbox: { name, wrap }` 仅适用于 `process`。

`createTray({ hosts, routing?, probe?, report? })` 返回 `ITray`；`hosts` 必须是 `defineTrayHost` 返回的定义数组。`probe` 接收一个 `IRpcProbe` 或其只读数组， `report(error)` 接收运行与清理诊断，默认使用 `console.error`。 子入口 `serveTrayHost(host, { probe?, report? })` 返回 `Promise<void>`， 在子 realm 内等待退出请求与插件清理，然后结束 Worker 或进程。

`plugins(info, trayPlugin)` 在每次 generation init 时调用；`info` 包含 id、host、 generation 和 validator 的 config 输出。插件通过 `defineFeature(factory, { tray: trayPlugin.getFeature('tray') })` 声明依赖， 从 `deps.tray.self()` 读取身份，`await deps.tray.to(otherHost, id)` 得到 admission-bound remote，`deps.tray.exit(error?)` 结束当前实例。第一次 exit 决定结果：无错误是 clean exit， 有错误是 crash；PluginHost disposer 执行后才结束 task/realm。根入口只导出 `ITrayClientPlugin` 类型，不提供 runtime client 单例。

remote 的统一调用形式是 `request|notify|stream(path, payload, options?)`； `options` 的类型为 `ITrayCallOptions`，只包含 `signal?: AbortSignal` 与 `timeoutMs?: number`。 零 payload 可省略，带 options 时写 `request(path, undefined, { timeoutMs })`； 业务对象中的 `undefined` 字段会被拒绝，只有 wire envelope 的 absent payload/config 被省略。 Uint8Array 可跨所有三个 runtime；非 portable config 在创建连接前拒绝。

`list({ host?, runtime?, state? })` 返回冻结 snapshot，`get(id)` 合并 RPC unit detail。 `on(event, listener)` / `watch({ signal? })` 仅观察生命周期；记录冻结，没有 emit。 watch 保留最近 100 条未读记录，不是持久日志。每个实例的 stop/restart/replace/remove 按调用顺序进入队列；replace 的 config 只在新 generation init 成功后提交。 停止前先运行 child PluginHost cleanup（graceMs 默认 5000）；失败或超时会 report 并继续停止。

实例 remove 后旧 remote 永久拒绝 `TRAY_INSTANCE_UNKNOWN`，同 id 的重新 spawn 不会复活 旧 admission。非 ready 调用立即拒绝 `TRAY_INSTANCE_NOT_READY`；已发送调用通过原 RPC receipt 完成，不被移到新 generation。target 业务错误的 source/code/cause chain 原样通过； Tray 验证和 start 错误使用自己的稳定 code，并保留原错误于 cause。

`defineRoutingPolicy(name, pick)` 提供纯 policy 契约，host DSL 可声明 `routing: [policy]`； 注册后通过 `tray.routing.<name>(host)` 或 `tray.routing('<name>', host)` 选实例；pub/sub 见 USEGUIDE。`pick(candidates, context)` 同步返回实例 id， `context` 为 `{ host, sequence }`。名称须符合 `^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`， 不能使用内置 policy 名称或函数、对象的保留属性名；非法定义抛 `TRAY_ROUTING_INVALID`。

symbols.purpose: Any host definition, whatever its type parameters.
symbols.core:
entry: Required URL or nonempty entry string for thread and process hosts; coroutine hosts reject this field. The frozen definition stores its URL text for the runtime adapter.
Absent for coroutine; required for thread and process runtimes.
limits: Thread-only resource limits containing optional positive heapBytes; process and coroutine hosts reject this field.
Omitted: no explicit thread heap limit is supplied to the adapter.
sandbox: Process-only caller-owned ITraySandbox whose wrap method transforms the launch command; Tray supplies no sandbox implementation.
Omitted: the process launch command is not sandbox-wrapped.
name: Unique host name; `spawn(name, ...)` and `list({ host })` use it.
runtime: Where the instances of this host run.
`coroutine`: in the parent event loop.
config: Validator `(input) => config` run on every initialisation; it receives the `config` given to `spawn()` / `replace()` and its output reaches `plugins(instance)`. Throw to reject.
Not set: the input is passed through unchecked.
plugins: Factory `(instance, trayPlugin) => plugins` called on every initialisation. `instance` holds id, host, generation and config; `trayPlugin` is the plugin whose `tray` Feature gives `self()`, `to()`, `exit()`, `routing`, `publish()` and `subscribe()`.
plugins.instance: Identity and validated config of this initialisation (`ITrayInstanceInfo`).
plugins.trayPlugin: The client plugin; depend on it with `defineFeature(factory, { tray: trayPlugin.getFeature("tray") })`.
The plugin tuple installed into the instance host.
exposes: Feature paths `plugin.feature` that remote callers may use; methods are then called as `plugin.feature.method`.
supervisor: Restart policy and startup timeout of supervised instances; see `ITraySupervisorPolicy`.
Not set: the default policy of the runtime adapter.
routing: Routing policies the instance plugins may call through `deps.tray.routing`; the parent also registers them.
Not set: only `roundRobin` and `leastInFlight`.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.

blocks.text: `defineTrayHost(definition)` 返回冻结且带身份标记的 `ITrayHost<TName, TConfig, TPlugins, TExposes, TRouting>`。必填字段为 `name`、 `plugins(instance, trayPlugin)` 与 `exposes`；定义阶段不调用插件工厂或配置验证器。 `exposes` 是只读的 `plugin.feature` 路径数组；方法调用使用 `plugin.feature.method`。 结构复制品不具备原定义的身份，不能传给 registry 或 `instance()`。

rows: thread / process 必填；coroutine 禁止
每次初始化时验证并转换配置，输出交给 `plugins`
仅 process 可用；包含 `name` 与同步 `wrap(command)`
声明子实例插件可用的 policy；父端把它并入 registry 注册集，子端经 `deps.tray.routing` 调用（见 Routing）

blocks.text: `supervisor.restart.mode` 接收 `'never' | 'on-failure' | 'always'`。 `sandbox.wrap` 的输入与输出均为 RPC Process 的 `IProcessLaunchCommand`： `{ command, args, cwd?, env }`；返回完整的新命令，保留所需环境与工作目录。

`createTray({ hosts, routing?, probe?, report? })` 返回 `ITray<THosts, TRouting>`。 `hosts` 是必填的定义只读数组；`routing` 是可选的共享 policy 只读数组，与各 host DSL 的 `routing` 合并注册，构成 `tray.routing` 命名空间（见 Routing）。 `probe` 的类型为 `IRpcProbe | readonly IRpcProbe[]`；`report(error: unknown): void` 接收运行与清理诊断，默认使用 `console.error`。

`serveTrayHost(host, { probe?, report? })` 返回 `Promise<void>`。它只接受本 realm 导入的可信 thread / process 定义；coroutine 由 registry 的任务运行器服务。 `probe` 与 `report` 使用上述相同类型，默认 reporter 也是 `console.error`。 Worker 或子进程入口与父 registry 应导入同一个定义模块。下面的 `hosts.ts` 定义 Worker Host：
`worker.ts` 编译后连接父 registry：

blocks.code:
import { serveTrayHost } from '@migaia/tray'
import { worker } from './hosts.js'

await serveTrayHost(worker)

blocks.text: 所有 Tray 自有边界错误都带 `source: '@migaia/tray'` 与稳定 `code`。生产代码按 `(source, code)` 分支，不依赖 message：
外部门返回 `blocked` 后，可再次显式调用 `ready()` 重新门控；使用 entry 的 readiness getter 取得 provider 当前快照。`failed` 或 getter/快照错误保留原 rejected Promise。启动成功和 dispose 后都不再采样外部门，没有自动重试。
完整 entry 契约、readiness gate、状态、错误码与生命周期语义见 USEGUIDE.md。
根入口的 `defineTrayHost` / `createTray({ hosts })` 管理完整 PluginHost 实例； `createTrayGraph(entries)` 继续管理静态 capability 集合。每个实例与父 Host 独立。
entry 只连接父 registry，不再 spawn。Bun/Deno 与 browser Worker 尚未验证。

items: 省略 runtime 使用 `coroutine`：共享事件循环，适合轻量 I/O host，停止是合作式的。
`thread` 使用独立 Worker isolate，必须提供 entry，可设置 `limits.heapBytes`。
`process` 使用子进程，必须提供 entry，可设置 `sandbox: { name, wrap }` 接入外部沙箱。
Node Worker/process entry 导入共享 host 定义后执行 `await serveTrayHost(host)`；

blocks.text: `defineTrayHost` 的必填字段是 `name`、`plugins` 与 `exposes`。`exposes` 使用 `plugin.feature` 路径，remote 调用使用 `plugin.feature.method` 路径。 可选 `config(input)` 在每次实例初始化时验证配置；`supervisor` 接收 `restart: { mode, maxRestarts, windowMs, initialDelayMs }` 与 `startupTimeoutMs`。 `entry` 接收 `string | URL`，仅适用于 `thread` / `process`； `limits: { heapBytes }` 仅适用于 `thread`，`sandbox: { name, wrap }` 仅适用于 `process`。

`createTray({ hosts, routing?, probe?, report? })` 返回 `ITray`；`hosts` 必须是 `defineTrayHost` 返回的定义数组。`probe` 接收一个 `IRpcProbe` 或其只读数组， `report(error)` 接收运行与清理诊断，默认使用 `console.error`。 子入口 `serveTrayHost(host, { probe?, report? })` 返回 `Promise<void>`， 在子 realm 内等待退出请求与插件清理，然后结束 Worker 或进程。

`plugins(info, trayPlugin)` 在每次 generation init 时调用；`info` 包含 id、host、 generation 和 validator 的 config 输出。插件通过 `defineFeature(factory, { tray: trayPlugin.getFeature('tray') })` 声明依赖， 从 `deps.tray.self()` 读取身份，`await deps.tray.to(otherHost, id)` 得到 admission-bound remote，`deps.tray.exit(error?)` 结束当前实例。第一次 exit 决定结果：无错误是 clean exit， 有错误是 crash；PluginHost disposer 执行后才结束 task/realm。根入口只导出 `ITrayClientPlugin` 类型，不提供 runtime client 单例。

remote 的统一调用形式是 `request|notify|stream(path, payload, options?)`； `options` 的类型为 `ITrayCallOptions`，只包含 `signal?: AbortSignal` 与 `timeoutMs?: number`。 零 payload 可省略，带 options 时写 `request(path, undefined, { timeoutMs })`； 业务对象中的 `undefined` 字段会被拒绝，只有 wire envelope 的 absent payload/config 被省略。 Uint8Array 可跨所有三个 runtime；非 portable config 在创建连接前拒绝。

`list({ host?, runtime?, state? })` 返回冻结 snapshot，`get(id)` 合并 RPC unit detail。 `on(event, listener)` / `watch({ signal? })` 仅观察生命周期；记录冻结，没有 emit。 watch 保留最近 100 条未读记录，不是持久日志。每个实例的 stop/restart/replace/remove 按调用顺序进入队列；replace 的 config 只在新 generation init 成功后提交。 停止前先运行 child PluginHost cleanup（graceMs 默认 5000）；失败或超时会 report 并继续停止。

实例 remove 后旧 remote 永久拒绝 `TRAY_INSTANCE_UNKNOWN`，同 id 的重新 spawn 不会复活 旧 admission。非 ready 调用立即拒绝 `TRAY_INSTANCE_NOT_READY`；已发送调用通过原 RPC receipt 完成，不被移到新 generation。target 业务错误的 source/code/cause chain 原样通过； Tray 验证和 start 错误使用自己的稳定 code，并保留原错误于 cause。

`defineRoutingPolicy(name, pick)` 提供纯 policy 契约，host DSL 可声明 `routing: [policy]`； 注册后通过 `tray.routing.<name>(host)` 或 `tray.routing('<name>', host)` 选实例；pub/sub 见 USEGUIDE。`pick(candidates, context)` 同步返回实例 id， `context` 为 `{ host, sequence }`。名称须符合 `^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`， 不能使用内置 policy 名称或函数、对象的保留属性名；非法定义抛 `TRAY_ROUTING_INVALID`。

`createTray({ hosts, routing?, probe?, report? })` 返回 `ITray`；`hosts` 必须是 `defineTrayHost` 返回的定义数组。`probe` 接收一个 `IRpcProbe` 或其只读数组， `report(error)` 接收运行与清理诊断，默认使用 `console.error`。 子入口 `serveTrayHost(host, { probe?, report? })` 返回 `Promise<void>`， 在子 realm 内等待退出请求与插件清理，然后结束 Worker 或进程。

`plugins(info, trayPlugin)` 在每次 generation init 时调用；`info` 包含 id、host、 generation 和 validator 的 config 输出。插件通过 `defineFeature(factory, { tray: trayPlugin.getFeature('tray') })` 声明依赖， 从 `deps.tray.self()` 读取身份，`await deps.tray.to(otherHost, id)` 得到 admission-bound remote，`deps.tray.exit(error?)` 结束当前实例。第一次 exit 决定结果：无错误是 clean exit， 有错误是 crash；PluginHost disposer 执行后才结束 task/realm。根入口只导出 `ITrayClientPlugin` 类型，不提供 runtime client 单例。

remote 的统一调用形式是 `request|notify|stream(path, payload, options?)`； `options` 的类型为 `ITrayCallOptions`，只包含 `signal?: AbortSignal` 与 `timeoutMs?: number`。 零 payload 可省略，带 options 时写 `request(path, undefined, { timeoutMs })`； 业务对象中的 `undefined` 字段会被拒绝，只有 wire envelope 的 absent payload/config 被省略。 Uint8Array 可跨所有三个 runtime；非 portable config 在创建连接前拒绝。

blocks.text: `defineTrayHost(definition)` 返回冻结且带身份标记的 `ITrayHost<TName, TConfig, TPlugins, TExposes, TRouting>`。必填字段为 `name`、 `plugins(instance, trayPlugin)` 与 `exposes`；定义阶段不调用插件工厂或配置验证器。 `exposes` 是只读的 `plugin.feature` 路径数组；方法调用使用 `plugin.feature.method`。 结构复制品不具备原定义的身份，不能传给 registry 或 `instance()`。

rows: thread / process 必填；coroutine 禁止
每次初始化时验证并转换配置，输出交给 `plugins`
仅 process 可用；包含 `name` 与同步 `wrap(command)`
声明子实例插件可用的 policy；父端把它并入 registry 注册集，子端经 `deps.tray.routing` 调用（见 Routing）

blocks.text: `supervisor.restart.mode` 接收 `'never' | 'on-failure' | 'always'`。 `sandbox.wrap` 的输入与输出均为 RPC Process 的 `IProcessLaunchCommand`： `{ command, args, cwd?, env }`；返回完整的新命令，保留所需环境与工作目录。

`createTray({ hosts, routing?, probe?, report? })` 返回 `ITray<THosts, TRouting>`。 `hosts` 是必填的定义只读数组；`routing` 是可选的共享 policy 只读数组，与各 host DSL 的 `routing` 合并注册，构成 `tray.routing` 命名空间（见 Routing）。 `probe` 的类型为 `IRpcProbe | readonly IRpcProbe[]`；`report(error: unknown): void` 接收运行与清理诊断，默认使用 `console.error`。

`serveTrayHost(host, { probe?, report? })` 返回 `Promise<void>`。它只接受本 realm 导入的可信 thread / process 定义；coroutine 由 registry 的任务运行器服务。 `probe` 与 `report` 使用上述相同类型，默认 reporter 也是 `console.error`。 Worker 或子进程入口与父 registry 应导入同一个定义模块。下面的 `hosts.ts` 定义 Worker Host：
`worker.ts` 编译后连接父 registry：

import { serveTrayHost } from '@migaia/tray'
import { worker } from './hosts.js'

await serveTrayHost(worker)

blocks.text: 所有 Tray 自有边界错误都带 `source: '@migaia/tray'` 与稳定 `code`。生产代码按 `(source, code)` 分支，不依赖 message：
外部门返回 `blocked` 后，可再次显式调用 `ready()` 重新门控；使用 entry 的 readiness getter 取得 provider 当前快照。`failed` 或 getter/快照错误保留原 rejected Promise。启动成功和 dispose 后都不再采样外部门，没有自动重试。
完整 entry 契约、readiness gate、状态、错误码与生命周期语义见 USEGUIDE.md。

symbols.core:
id: Id of the instance this remote is bound to.
request: Calls an exposed method on this instance admission and waits for its result. Not ready: `TRAY_INSTANCE_NOT_READY`; removed: `TRAY_INSTANCE_UNKNOWN`; target errors keep their own source and code.
request.path: `plugin.feature.method` of a Feature listed in the host `exposes`.
request.args: `(payload?, options?)`: one portable payload (omit for a zero-argument method; write `undefined` when passing options) and `ITrayCallOptions`.
The method result.
notify: Sends a one-way call to this instance admission; no result is returned.
notify.path: `plugin.feature.method` of an exposed Feature.
notify.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
Resolves once the call was sent.
stream: Calls a method returning an iterable on this instance admission and yields its items as they arrive.
stream.path: `plugin.feature.method` of an exposed iterator method.
stream.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
An async iterator of the method items.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
host: Name of the host whose instances are candidates.
request: Calls an exposed method on a ready instance picked by the policy for this call and waits for its result. Not ready: `TRAY_INSTANCE_NOT_READY`; removed: `TRAY_INSTANCE_UNKNOWN`; target errors keep their own source and code.
request.path: `plugin.feature.method` of a Feature listed in the host `exposes`.
request.args: `(payload?, options?)`: one portable payload (omit for a zero-argument method; write `undefined` when passing options) and `ITrayCallOptions`.
The method result.
notify: Sends a one-way call to a ready instance picked by the policy for this call; no result is returned.
notify.path: `plugin.feature.method` of an exposed Feature.
notify.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
Resolves once the call was sent.
stream: Calls a method returning an iterable on a ready instance picked by the policy for this call and yields its items as they arrive.
stream.path: `plugin.feature.method` of an exposed iterator method.
stream.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
An async iterator of the method items.

blocks.text: `supervisor.restart.mode` 接收 `'never' | 'on-failure' | 'always'`。 `sandbox.wrap` 的输入与输出均为 RPC Process 的 `IProcessLaunchCommand`： `{ command, args, cwd?, env }`；返回完整的新命令，保留所需环境与工作目录。

`createTray({ hosts, routing?, probe?, report? })` 返回 `ITray<THosts, TRouting>`。 `hosts` 是必填的定义只读数组；`routing` 是可选的共享 policy 只读数组，与各 host DSL 的 `routing` 合并注册，构成 `tray.routing` 命名空间（见 Routing）。 `probe` 的类型为 `IRpcProbe | readonly IRpcProbe[]`；`report(error: unknown): void` 接收运行与清理诊断，默认使用 `console.error`。

`serveTrayHost(host, { probe?, report? })` 返回 `Promise<void>`。它只接受本 realm 导入的可信 thread / process 定义；coroutine 由 registry 的任务运行器服务。 `probe` 与 `report` 使用上述相同类型，默认 reporter 也是 `console.error`。 Worker 或子进程入口与父 registry 应导入同一个定义模块。下面的 `hosts.ts` 定义 Worker Host：
`worker.ts` 编译后连接父 registry：

blocks.code:
import { serveTrayHost } from '@migaia/tray'
import { worker } from './hosts.js'

await serveTrayHost(worker)

symbols.name: ITrayRuntimeOptions
symbols.purpose: Runtime-discriminated host options: coroutine has no launch fields, thread owns entry and heap limits, and process owns entry and an optional sandbox.
symbols.core:
runtime: Where the instances of this host run.
`coroutine`: in the parent event loop.
entry: Required URL or nonempty entry string for thread and process hosts; coroutine hosts reject this field. The frozen definition stores its URL text for the runtime adapter.
Absent for coroutine; required for thread and process runtimes.
limits: Thread-only resource limits containing optional positive heapBytes; process and coroutine hosts reject this field.
Omitted: no explicit thread heap limit is supplied to the adapter.
sandbox: Process-only caller-owned ITraySandbox whose wrap method transforms the launch command; Tray supplies no sandbox implementation.
Omitted: the process launch command is not sandbox-wrapped.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.

items: 省略 runtime 使用 `coroutine`：共享事件循环，适合轻量 I/O host，停止是合作式的。
`thread` 使用独立 Worker isolate，必须提供 entry，可设置 `limits.heapBytes`。

blocks.text: `defineTrayHost` 的必填字段是 `name`、`plugins` 与 `exposes`。`exposes` 使用 `plugin.feature` 路径，remote 调用使用 `plugin.feature.method` 路径。 可选 `config(input)` 在每次实例初始化时验证配置；`supervisor` 接收 `restart: { mode, maxRestarts, windowMs, initialDelayMs }` 与 `startupTimeoutMs`。 `entry` 接收 `string | URL`，仅适用于 `thread` / `process`； `limits: { heapBytes }` 仅适用于 `thread`，`sandbox: { name, wrap }` 仅适用于 `process`。

`createTray({ hosts, routing?, probe?, report? })` 返回 `ITray`；`hosts` 必须是 `defineTrayHost` 返回的定义数组。`probe` 接收一个 `IRpcProbe` 或其只读数组， `report(error)` 接收运行与清理诊断，默认使用 `console.error`。 子入口 `serveTrayHost(host, { probe?, report? })` 返回 `Promise<void>`， 在子 realm 内等待退出请求与插件清理，然后结束 Worker 或进程。

`plugins(info, trayPlugin)` 在每次 generation init 时调用；`info` 包含 id、host、 generation 和 validator 的 config 输出。插件通过 `defineFeature(factory, { tray: trayPlugin.getFeature('tray') })` 声明依赖， 从 `deps.tray.self()` 读取身份，`await deps.tray.to(otherHost, id)` 得到 admission-bound remote，`deps.tray.exit(error?)` 结束当前实例。第一次 exit 决定结果：无错误是 clean exit， 有错误是 crash；PluginHost disposer 执行后才结束 task/realm。根入口只导出 `ITrayClientPlugin` 类型，不提供 runtime client 单例。

remote 的统一调用形式是 `request|notify|stream(path, payload, options?)`； `options` 的类型为 `ITrayCallOptions`，只包含 `signal?: AbortSignal` 与 `timeoutMs?: number`。 零 payload 可省略，带 options 时写 `request(path, undefined, { timeoutMs })`； 业务对象中的 `undefined` 字段会被拒绝，只有 wire envelope 的 absent payload/config 被省略。 Uint8Array 可跨所有三个 runtime；非 portable config 在创建连接前拒绝。

`list({ host?, runtime?, state? })` 返回冻结 snapshot，`get(id)` 合并 RPC unit detail。 `on(event, listener)` / `watch({ signal? })` 仅观察生命周期；记录冻结，没有 emit。 watch 保留最近 100 条未读记录，不是持久日志。每个实例的 stop/restart/replace/remove 按调用顺序进入队列；replace 的 config 只在新 generation init 成功后提交。 停止前先运行 child PluginHost cleanup（graceMs 默认 5000）；失败或超时会 report 并继续停止。

实例 remove 后旧 remote 永久拒绝 `TRAY_INSTANCE_UNKNOWN`，同 id 的重新 spawn 不会复活 旧 admission。非 ready 调用立即拒绝 `TRAY_INSTANCE_NOT_READY`；已发送调用通过原 RPC receipt 完成，不被移到新 generation。target 业务错误的 source/code/cause chain 原样通过； Tray 验证和 start 错误使用自己的稳定 code，并保留原错误于 cause。

`defineRoutingPolicy(name, pick)` 提供纯 policy 契约，host DSL 可声明 `routing: [policy]`； 注册后通过 `tray.routing.<name>(host)` 或 `tray.routing('<name>', host)` 选实例；pub/sub 见 USEGUIDE。`pick(candidates, context)` 同步返回实例 id， `context` 为 `{ host, sequence }`。名称须符合 `^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`， 不能使用内置 policy 名称或函数、对象的保留属性名；非法定义抛 `TRAY_ROUTING_INVALID`。

hostUnavailable: `TRAY_HOST_UNAVAILABLE`: routing found no ready instance; wait for one.
routingUnknown: `TRAY_ROUTING_UNKNOWN`: the policy name is not registered or declared.
topicInvalid: `TRAY_TOPIC_INVALID`: the topic is not a non-empty string.
